waciske tsho —cici coru ji —— ༷ ri di— co tshigosasnyeri—dzi——༷kā — tre7 —wanawa47 ci— 7 ci —parmibhe rtebyerde durdu ༵ d+dha byedro ( rten tshi cipa cho tsho 7shutshewa ciX ci ༈ brgyud gsum rtsa gsum sbyabasaganas kuna'adus pa / /bka' drin mawo re da chosadabyingasarangagrol gyis/ /'di phyi bar dorgasumadu thugs rjes zungs / /tharaba'ilamasna zin par byiX zasdosdu rdosdu ༵/byu /sku sacirī rma

ṣ+ṭak+ṣatro dāṣ+kashaṃkhe yam̐3)0 rtsoñtshamaspezarwasgyumalge//ezhe/ri/ཿhūṃm/hāgyururat+taprotshoji pyadinajirmo'eri'irilhorinidzo(rmāzushīzachurmār+pā.aṣāsbyimarnyadharma/d+dhatāsnge/ru/kūs/rngasi/rnyihūṃhrīḥji gyis zhuthigye/po/4'byekyasu57so gli shaṃ pogyisde dzer+ṣaco

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdakar chag1 ston pa 'tshang rgya chul gyi rnam bzhag mdo dang sngags kyi bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'i skor/ rmā2 sgyu 'phrul bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus tshan pa gnyis/ 113 spyi don mdzod kyi lde mig skabs kyi zin bris/ 414 dpal gsang ba snying po'i zin bris gsang ba'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde'u mig 171 ( gsang snying skor zhal rgyun phyogs bsdus/ 3 (06 bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang gzer bzhi'i rnam bzhag bshad nga / 3657 bskyed rim la sku mdog phyag mtshan nges can gsal dgos mi dgos sogs kyi dris lan skor/ 3828 stong thun seng ge'i nga ro'i nyer mkho'i bar ldeb phyogs bsdus/ 4009 zhal gdams sogs gsung thor bu'i skor/ 42410 ngal gso'i mgron po'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba/ 431

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༄tsho/ /ston pa 'tshang rgya tshul gyi rnam bzhag mdo dang sngags kyi bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'i skor/chos 'byung rin po che'i gter mdzod nyi 'od las/ de yang bstan pa'i bdag po thub pa'i dbang po 'dis/ dang por thugs bskyed cing tshogs bsags/lam legs par mthar phyin nas/ 'bras bu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ni sku gsum gyi tshul te/ de yang chos sku sangs rgyas pa'i gnas ni 'og min yin la/ 'dzam bu'i gling ni sprul pa'i sku sangs rgyas pa'i tshul ston pa'o/ /de la yang rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis so/ /mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la yang / nyan rang theg chung dang / mtshan nyid theg pa chen po'o/ /de la theg chung ba ni/ rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa ste/ spobacu rang rgyud pa gcig /'og min nam rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas par 'dod do/ /theg pa chen po ni/ rgyal ba 'di bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas zin par 'dod de/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ rigs kyi bu nga ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang po 'das pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas so/ /zhes pa dang / mdo yab sras mjal ba las/ shāka thub 'di sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas zin nas/phyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir sangs rgyas tshul bstan te/de skad du/ bye ba brgya ru rgyal ba 'dis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /1

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃd rung chog pa'i 'du shes med/ /slar yang byang chub thugs kyang 'jug /ces so/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa la yang gnyis te/ sngags phyi rgyud dang / nang rgyud do/ /phyi pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs kyi chos sku dang / longs sku ni sangs rgyas yin la/ sprul sku ni sangs rgyas su mi bzhed de/ de bas na longs sku ni 'dod pa'i khams su yang sangs ma rgyas shing / skye ba'i srid pa yang mi bzhed de/gzugs khams kyi 'og min sdug po bkod pa de nyid du sangs rgyas shing / skye ba'i srid pa yang de nyid du bzhes par bzhed do/ /de kho na nyid rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'tshang mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes so/ /'o na 'dzam bu'i gling du/ chu bo ni rañdza na'i drung du dka' thub spyad nas/ mthar byang chub kyi shing drung du srad la bdud btul nas/tho rang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ mi 'gal te dka' thub kyi ngang de nyid nas 'og min du byon nas/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa til gyi gong bu bzhin du bzhugs pa la phyag byas nas/ seng ge'i khri la 'dug ste/ stong pa'i ngang la yun ring por mnyam par bzhag kyang gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag med pas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par ma nus nas/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du byon nas ting nge 'dzin las bslangs nas 'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gsang sngags kyi don me shes par ji ltar 'tshang rgya bar bya snyam zhes gsungs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de ting nge 'dzin las langs nas de 2

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhin gshegs pa de dag la phyag byas te/ thal mo sbyar nas gsang sngags don ji ltar lags zhus pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa lnga'i gdams ngag gsungs nas/ de ma thag tu de bsgoms pa dang sangs rgyas so skad/ de ltar sangs rgyas nas dka' thub kyi khog pa las bzhengs nas/ bdud btul ba dang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mdzad pa yin te/ stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'og min du/ /sangs rgyas ma gyur 'dod khams su/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mi mdzad do/ /zhes pas mngon no/ /gsang sngags nang pa rnal 'byor bla med pha rgyud pa ni/ 'og min du rnam par snang mdzad chen po la dbang zhus nas der sangs rgyas la/ de'i sprul pa po 'dir sangs rgyas par 'dod de/ zla gsang thig le las/ gtsang ma'i ris dag spangs nas ni/ /'og min stug po nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po ni 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /zhes so/ /yang na sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de 'og min mchog gi gnas su rdo rje 'chang la dbang zhus nas de nyid kyis dbang bskur bas sangs rgyas par 'dod do/ /'dul ba don yod pa'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'og min nyams dgar ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtso dbang phyug des/ /chos kyi pho brang der ni dbang bskur ba/ /kun tu bzang po rdo rje dbyings kyi skur/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rjes byin brlabs nas/ /de nyid du ni mngon par byang chub pas/ /bla med snying po rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ /rang byung bde ba chen por mngon sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /ma rgyud pa ni grags gyi sangs rgyas sa bcu gcig 3

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa de nyid 'og min btsun mo'i gzhal yas su dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs zhus nas/bud med mchog la brten nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob ste/ rab rgyud mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ bcu gcig sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / / bud med phyag rgyar brten byas nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob 'gyur/ /yang na sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des/ 'og min du longs sku bde ba chen po'i sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang la dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus pas sa bzhi bgrod do/ /rdo rje bde ba chen po'i rgyud dang / ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ bum pa'i dbang ni bcu gcig ste/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni bcu gnyis mchog khes rab ye shes bcu gsum pa/ /de ltar de bzhin bcu bzhi pa/ /dbang re la ni sa re ste/ /'di rnams sa yi dbang phyug bdag /ces so/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas tshul la/ theg dman nyan thos rnams kyis grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i mthar sangs rgyas skar rgyal la bstod pas bskal pa dgu'i tshogs 'dus/ de nas bskal pa 'di'i sangs rgyas 'od srung bsnyen bkur ba yan chad la bskal pa dgu bcu go gcig ste bskal chen brgyar mtshan dpe'i rgyu bsgrub nas dga' ldan gyi gnas su lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar por sku 'khrungs shing / de nas dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa ste/ de dang srid pa tha ma pa rgyal bu don grub kyi dus su grangs med gsum gyi tshogs rdzogs kyang tshogs lam chen po'i rten tsam yin zhing / de nas rdo rje'i gdan 'a/ bzhugs pa tshun chad so so'i skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan yin la/ byang chub kyi shing drung du srod la bdud dpung bye ba phrag mang po bzhupa/ stan 4

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthog gcig de kho nar bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam gyis sbyor mthong sgom pa mi slob pa'i bar lam bzhi mthar phyin par mdzad cing sangs rgyas par 'dod do/ /theg chen nges pa'i don kho na'i dbang du byas na/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin pa yin te/yab sras mjal ba'i mdor/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol du 'jig rten khams gaṅgā klung gi bye ma snyed kyi zhing gcig tu gyur pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don mdzad de mya ngan las 'das nas/ slar yang de 'og tu sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskal pa 'di'i bar du bstan cing / da dung yang so so skye bo sems dang po bskyed nas bzung ste sangs rgyas pa'i tshul 'khor ba ma stongs bar du mdzad do/ /zhes pa nas/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas te/ /sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung yang ni 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas mang po ston par mdzad/ /ces so/ /de la theg chen pa rnams kyi lugs su grangs med dang por tshogs sbyor/ gnyis par ma dag sa bdun/ gsum par dag pa sa gsum bgrod nas srid pa tha ma pa'i skabs su 'og min du phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams las 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur nod cing rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin skyes te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon par sprul pa'i gzugs kyis rdo rje'i gdan du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te 'gro ba'i don mdzad par bzhed do/ /'og min du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul yang / kha 5

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃcig tu 'og min du stug po bkod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas pa'i rjes la gtsang gnas kyi 'og min du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan par bzhed do/ /lang kar gshegs pa las/ gtsang ma'i ris dag spangs pa yi/ /'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir sangs rgyas/ /zhes dang / 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas mngon par 'tshang mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min tu/ /'dod chags bral khyod der sangs rgya/ /zhes so/ /bya ba'i rgyud las/ dang por thugs bskyed nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog kun tu ston pa'i spyan sngar sngags thos te sngags kyi spyod pa spyad pa'i sgo nas grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / dam pa tog dkar po nas 'phos pa zas gtsang gi sras su gyur nas sangs rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /spyod rgyud las/ sems bskyed de sngags kyi spyod pa spyad nas sa bcu mngon du byas shing 'og min du longs skur sangs rgyas ba'i tshul bstan par bshad do/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la bzhed tshul gsum gyi/ dang po rnal 'byor rgyud de nyid bsdus pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' don grub byang chub kyi snying por bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul nas/ mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te sems bskyed cing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bshad do/ /gnyis pa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen sogs kyis zas gtsang gi sras chu bo ni rañdza na'i 'gram du dka' thub mdzad pa'i tshe sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul bas/ ye shes kyi lus 'og min du byon pa la sangs rgyas rnams 6

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyis dbang bskur nas sangs rgyas te/ slar rnam smin gyi lus la zhugs nas sprul skur 'tshang rgya tshul bstan par bzhed la/ de ltar yang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi grol ba'i thig le las/ ci phyir shākya thub pa yis/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags kyang / /'di don ma rtogs ne+e raljir/ /ci yang ma yin ting 'dzin gnas/ /de tshe phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs kyis/ /thal byung blo can de bzlog ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med rab bstan pas/ /nam phyed dus na rgyal ba ltar/ /de nyid goms pas tho rangs dus/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag rtogs/ /'gro ba 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub snying por bzhugs nas kyang / /dpung bdud rnams rab bcom ste/ /sems can gzung bar bya don du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gsum pa/ yo ga'i shing rta chen por slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/ rgyal bas sems bskyed nas grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin thams cad bskyed cing srid pa tha ma par mdzad/ sangs rgyas rnams las dbang bskur ba thob cing bskal pa mang po'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas nas slar shākya'i rigs su skye ba bstan par bshad do/ /rnal 'byor bla med chen po'i lugs ltar na nges don du srid pa tha ma'i byang sems su gyur pa zhig gnas 'og min chen por lam thun mong ma yin pa'i zab lam gyi nye rgyu la brten nas mngon par byang chub pa lnga la sogs pas rdo rje 'chang nyid du sangs rgyas par gyur cing / slar sprul pa'i sku 'dzam gling ma gha dh+war sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan par bzhed do// 2 mngon byang lnga la gzhi 7

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyi mngon byang dang / lam gyi mngon byang / 'bras bu'i mngon byang dang gsum las/ dang po gzhi'i mngon byang lnga ni/ sems can rnams shi ba'i dus su shar ba'i dri bcas kyi ye shes de dang / rten rlung rags pa dang / snang ba gsum ste lnga ni gzhi'i mngon byang / gnyis pa lam gyi mngon byang lnga ni/ stong pa/ stong pa po/ shin tu stong pa/ thams cad stong pa/ don gyi 'od gsal ste lnga ni lam gyi mngon byang lnga/ gsum pa 'bras bu'i mngon byang lnga ni/ rnal 'byor rang gi yid ngor dkar cha thur du dag pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sku rdo rje/ dmar cha gyen du dag pa nyi gdan gsung rdo rje/ rlung sems thad du dag pa phyag mtshan rdo rje sogs thugs rdo rje/ de dag 'od du zhu ba 'od gong du gyur pa 'od kyi gong bu sogs la mngon par byang chub pa ste/ de dag rnal 'byor rang gi stong bzhi'i ye shes shar ba'i snang ngor rim bzhin snang ba yin cing de nyid sku yongs dzo gas su byang chub ste 'bras bu'i mngon byang lnga'o/ /ma rgyud la mkhas pa'i grub chen rnams kyis bshad pa ltar na/ dbang bskur ba de'i tshe shes rab ma dang sbyar bas/dkar cha zhu ba'i bde chen gyis stong nyid gzigs pa mthar thug pa zla ba la byang chub/ shes rab ma'i dmar cha dang lhan cig drangs pas rten thig le lhag pa'i khyad par gyis bde stong dbyer med mthar thug pa nyi ma la byang chub pa/ de yi spyi bo nas thim sku thams cad gang ba'i bde stong gis dri ma gdod nas stong par mkhyen par mthar thug pa phyag mtshan la byang chub pa/ de las chos thams cad yul yul can dbyer med gzigs pa mthar thug pa gcig tu gyur pa stong pa nyid la byang chub pa/ de nyid las thugs chos sku dang longs sku sogs su gyur pa 8

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ5 yongasajogs las byang chub pa'o// 2 mdzod sde las kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyalaposagrol ba'i thig le drangs nas bshad pa gsung skabs/ ngal gso skor gsum gyi spyi don legs bshad rgya mtsho las/ sngags bla med la gsar rnying gnyis su phyes te gsar ma'i skabs su grol thig gi lung drangs pa dang / rnying ma'i lugs la sgyu 'phrul bla ma'i lung drangs te so so'i lugs kyi mngon par byang chub tshul gsal bor gsung yod pas shes par bya/ 2 mi pham rin po ches kyang sgyu 'phrul gyi skabs 'diro mngon byang lnga ni sgyu 'phrul lam rimo sogs las gsungs pa ltar shes dgas gsungs/ sgyu 'phrul bla ma las/ dan grub dka' thub lus can la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sprin bzhin du/ /'dus pas longs spyod don gyi phyir/ /srod dang tho rangs dus nyid du/ /nyi zla za ba'i dbang byin nas/ /rol pa'i ka ra bstan pa yis/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes dang / lam rim las/ don grub dka' thub lus can la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sprin bzhin du/ /'dus pa gsang ba'i longs sbyod kyis/ /srod dang tho rangs dus nyid du/ /nyi zla za ba'i dbang byin cing / /rol pa'i ka ra bstan pa yis/ /ye shes brtan rdzogs dbang thob pas/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ kong sprul rin po ches/ phyi'i mngon byang / nang gi mngon byang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mngon byang gi rim pa la 'jug pa'i tshul yang /nub snga ma zla 'od snang ba'i tshe snang ba'i ye shes nyid gtso bor bsgom/ de nas nyin mor babs pa na mched pa nyin mo bsgom/ nyi ma nub pa na thob pa bsgom pas skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su don gyi 'od gsal mngon par byang chub pa 9

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃmangon du byed do/ /nang gi ting nge 'dzin dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i phyi'i dus kyi khyad par yin te/ des na phyi'i mngon byang zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus kyi khyad par snga ma de nyid kyi nyi ma dmar thag chad pa na tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs sngon du 'gro bas rig ma dang lhan cig slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pas gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba sbyin te/ dpe'i ye shes la mngon par byang chub pa'i rim par ngo sprod pa'i gdams ngag ston pa ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ de nyid kyi rgyun goms pas tho rangs kyi dus su mngon par byang chub pa mthong lam mngon du byed de/ 'di ni rnal 'byor pha ma'i rgyud gnyis char las bshad/ ces dang / 'dir rgyu'i mngon byang mthong lam thob pa'i skabs dang sbyar na gzigs pa rnam dag mthar thug ma yin pa'i skabs dang / sku gnyis thob pa'i dod du slob pa'i zung 'jug 'grub pa ste/ phyi ma 'di la nang gi mngon byang mthong lam zhes bya ba ni phyi rol dus kyi khyad par la mi sbyor bar nang bde stong gi rim pa la sbyor bas so/ /byang sems dkar dmar gyi thig le'ang mthong lam pa'i skabs der phal cher 'byung ba'i khams yin la 'tshang rgya ba'i dus su ye shes kyi rang 'od yin pa'i khyad par yod pa dang / de'ang sngar gyi rgyun gnas 'gyur ba yin cing / phyi ma 'di 'dus pa las mi gsal yang ma rgyud kyi lugs te/ 'tshang rgya kha'i skabs kyi nye rgyu'i spyod pa la gnas pa'i tha mar yang 'di lta bu la brten nas 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs// //10

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༄tsho/ /sgyu 'phrul bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus tshan pa gnyis/de yang sngon 'og min gyi gnas su gsungs pa slar yang zlos kyi tshul du phyag na rdo rjes dra ma lnga la gsungs/ de rnams srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis gser gyi glegs bam la be+eḍār+ya'i zhun mas bris te/ ji skad du/ gzhi rgyu dgongs snod gnas srung bdag brgyud 'dzin/ /zhes pas/ gser gyi byang bu la bri gzhi phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ be+eḍūr+ya'i zhun mas bris pa rgyu phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i sgrom bu snod ngo mtshar bar dgongs pa/ nam mkha' 'byung bzhis mi 'jig pas gter gnas dam par dgongs pa/ ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pas gter srung khyad par can du dgongs pa/ chos bdag rgyal po dzaḥlas can dbang po yang rab rtogs grol dus mnyam du dgongs pa/ skye 'phags byang sems sa la gnas pa sogs grub brnyes brgyud 'dzin dar rgyas su 'byung ba la dgongs pa ste/dgongs pa'i rtsal bdun gyi nam mkha' la sbas so/ /de ltar gsang bdag gis bka' bsdu mdzad pa'i tshe de'i byin rlabs kyis sa ho ri'i rgyal po dzaḥste in+t+ra bhu ti la/ rmis ltas ngo mtshar ba bdun byung ba dang mthun par rgyal po'i khang steng du badz+ra pa ṇi'i sku khru gang ba zhig dang / tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad kyi glegs bam dang bcas babs/ sa ho ra zhes pa ni/ thon mis rgya gar la med kyang bod la zha dang za dang 'a rnams dgos par dgongs te bzhag la/ de yang zha ni sha dang 11

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmathun/ 'a ni a dang mthun/ za ni sa dang mthun pas rgya gar ba rnams sa ho ra zer ba la/ bod kyis za hor du 'bod do/ /rgyal po dzaḥl in+t+ra bhu ti gsungs pa ni/ rgyal po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lam rnam bkod du/ shar phyogs in+t+ra'i lung pa nas/ /rgya lung rdo rje brtsegs pa sa /rigs can in+t+ra bhu ti ngas/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos mngon bstan pas/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sgrub pa yang tshom bu lnga bcu stong dang bcas/ /phyag na rdo rje mngon grub ste/ /spang len btul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang / /dge bar bskur nas sdig pa med/ /de nas sa la reg par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dis rgyal pos glegs bam kyi brda don ma lus pa mkhyen tshul yang shes nus so/ /de yang tan+t+ra po sde bco brgyad po la bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mang yang / 'dir gter chen bla ma'i dgongs pa ltar 'dzin dgos gsungs/ de thams cad kyi bsdus don lta bu'i rgyud sde chen po gcig ni rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud dpal gsang ba snying po'o/ /rgyal pos ku ku rwa dza la bshad de/ 'di ni lo rgyus la lar ku ta rā dza zhes kyang 'byung ste nyin mo khyi'i rnam pa can gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma stong phrag re la chos ston cing mtshan mo de dag dang lhan cig tu dur khrod kyi gnas su gshegs nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa dam tshig gi kun tu spyod pa la gnas shing /de ltar lo bcu gnyis spyad nas mthar tshom bu 'bum dang bcas te phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes par yang bshad do/ /des in+t+ra bhu ti ste 'byor ba'i dbang po bar pa la bshad de 'khor tshom bu khri dang bcas/ des seng ha rā dza ste seng ge'i rgyal po la bshad de zhabor tshom bu stong dang bcas/ des u pa rā dza ste nye 12

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃba'i rgyal po la bshad de tshom bu brgya dang bcas/ des sras mo go ma de wi ste lha'i btsun pa la bshad de 'khor tshom bu lnga bcu dang bcas te kun kyang tshogs sgrub kyi lam gyis rdo rje 'chang gi sar gshegos so/ /tshomo bu phyi ma gnyis kyi grangs gzhan dang mi 'dra bar snang nga / /ga mas sgeg rdar la bshad/ slab dpon sgegs pa'i rdo rje ni/ yul ṣa ma ṣa rar 'brungs/ o rgyan du rab tu byung zhing sde snod spyi dang khyad par thogs med kyi lugs la mkhas/ o rgyan gyi gling phran ma dhi ma zhes bya bar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas bris sku'i zhal las 'od 'phros gling de yun ring gsal bar mdzad pas nyi ma dang 'dra bar mtshan gsol/ rgyud sde spyi dang bye brag sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes/ sku tshe smad la o rgyan du 'gro don cher mdzad/ na ler+sār lo bcu bzhugs shing sngags kyi bstan pa spel/ snying 'grel rin spar khab dang dam tshig gsal bkra sogs sgyu 'phrul skor gyi bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad nas mthar rdo rje'i sku brnyes so/ /des sangs rgyas gsang ba la bshad de/ 'di ni yul dbus su zhabrungs/ na ler+sār rab tu byung / sangs rgyas ye shes bla mar brten/ wā ra ṇa sir 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas grub pa'i mtshan ma mngon du mthong / o rgyan du byon nas sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang mjal/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med rgyud sde lnga gsan cing lhag par sgyu 'phrul la mkhas/ sangs rgyas zhi ba dang lhan du ri bo ta lar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mjal bar byon pas zhabs sa la mi reg pa'i dngos grub brnyes/ rje btsun sgrol ma dang 'jam dpal gyis bskul nas gangs ti ser phebs te sgrub pa mdzad nas bzhugs dus slob dpon 13

g.yu khog bla ma chos dgings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃchen po pad+ma dang bi ma mi tra la gdams te 'phags yul du byung ba'i tshul lo/ /rgyal dbang lnga pa'i deb ther las/ grong khyer shing thabs can na rgyal po shing rta bcu pa zhes bya ba byung ba'i sras chos rgyal mya ngan med ces bya ba bden tshig gi mthus mchod rten bye ba bzhengs pa/ de'i sras rgyal po dza zhes pa smon lam gyi mthus rdo rje sems dpa'i glegs bam gyi char pho brang gi steng du bab pas mdo sde za ma tog rlung gis khyer te pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi steng du babs pa lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyis gnyan po gsang ba btags la/ de'i sras za hor rgyal po in+t+ra bhu ti/ de la sras mo go ma de wa dang / sras sha bkra gnyis/ de'i sras rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin/ de la sras dharma rā dza/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ lha lcam man+dha ra ba dang gsum/ snga ma'i sras dharma pa la/ shākya de wa/ ma hā de wa gsum byung ngo / /zhes gsungs/ bod du ni/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa ni/ dang po gnyags la babs te/gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra ni/ yul yar klungs 'phyos su/ yab gnyags stag sgra lha snang dang / yum sru bza' sgron skyid gnyis kyi sras su zhabrungs/ mgrin par sme ba rdo rje rgya gram yod/ mtshan rgyal ba'i blo gros su btags/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa las rab tu byung zhing mdo sngags kyi chos mang du bsgyur/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bi ma la/ be+e ro/ g.yu sgra snying po kun la brten pas/ dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭika stong thun dang bcas pa/ snyan brgyud gdams ngag gi chu bo gnad yig dmar khrid dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo bskur thabs ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ phyag bzhes phrin sgrub kyi chu bo bstan srung 14

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdrag sngags dang bcas pa ste bka'i chu bo chen po bzhi 'dus/ mdo sgyu sems gsum ka'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur cing nyan bshad kyi sgo nas slob ma khyad par can mang du bskrun pas bkan drin bsam gyis mi khyab/ mthar snyan brgyud rdo rje zam pa dang / man ngag sde las dngos grub chen po brnyes te stong gsal 'od kyi phung por gshegs so/ /de la slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ phur pa mkhan po rnams dpal brgyad du 'dren pa yod de/ 'dir sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ gra dpal gyi snying po/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu/ snyan dpal dbyangs/ 'tshur nag ye shes dpal/ thag bzang dpal gyi rdo rje'o/ /u pa do dang gsal/ dbon rgyud las kyang phrin las rgya cher byung ngo/ /gnyis pa snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa bar du gnubs la babs te/de yang rma gnyags gnyis nas brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum du gyes pa 'dus tshul ni/sangs rgyas gsang bas slob dpon chen po pad+ma dang bi ma mi tra la gdams te/bi ma las rma gnyags gnyis la gdams/ mes gtsug ru rin chen gzhon nu dang / gye re mchog skyong gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis kas dar rje dpal gyi grags pa dang / zhad rgyal ba'i yo tan gnyis la bshad/ shad gis gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la bshad pa ste bka' srol gcig go/ /yang slob dpon pad+ma dang bi ma la gnyis kas gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra la/ des sog po dpal gyi ye shes la/ des gnubs la bshad pa ste bka' srol gcig go/ /yang me gnyags thun mong gi slob ma khu byang chub 'od dang / khyung po dbyig 'od gnyis las/ khus zhang dang / khyung posadar rje la bshad/ zhang gis mkhas pa gtsug 15

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgyer rnam gnyis dang / khus bshad bka' gtso bor bzung bas bka' phyogs skyong ma dang / gnas las btags pa bka' mchims phu mar yang grags te/gnubs la bshad pa ni bka' srol gcig go/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum du gyes pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gcig tu 'dres so/ /gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes ni/ yab gnubs rigs gsal ba'i dbang phyug dang / yum mchims mo bkra shis 'tsho zhes bya ba'i sras su 'brungs/ mtshan rdo rje khri gtsug tu grags/ mkhan po bho dhi satwa las rab tu byung / rgya gar la lan bdun du byon te/ rgya bal gyi yul nas gshed skor rgya mtsho'i drag sngags rnams spyan drangs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ bdag 'dra gnubs kyi ban chung yang / /snying nas chos bzhin bya sems skyes/ /zhe sdang dgra bos byed ma ster/ /sangs rgyas bsnyan pa srung ba'i phyir/ /zhe sdang de ma thag tu bskyed/ /dkar po'i che ba 'don bsams nas/ /ngan sngags yig sna sna tshogs bslabs/ /zhes dang / bla ma bcu gcig zhabs nas btegs/ /'on kyang mkhas pa bzhi la gakhugs/ /slob dpon dpal gyi seng ge dang / /rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po dang / /'phung byed shin+ti gar+bha dang / /bal po ba su dha ra bzhi/ /mkhas pa bzhi yi thugs brdol nas/ /zab pa'i man ngag thugs la btags/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ /skabs shig rdo rje gdan la tshogs gsog mdzad pas/ nam mkha'i klong nas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa zhig rang gi thad gru gang gi sar byung ste lan gnyis su ma zin/lan gsum pa'i tshe phyag g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyi bar du chags pa'i mod la de phyag na rdo rje dngos kyi skur gyur/ dbang bskur/ byin gyis brlabs/ sangs 16

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrgyasaye shes su mtshan gyi cod paṇa btags/ dbang rtags su rdo rje rtse dgu 'bral med du 'chang ba da lta rong byams chen gyi thugs ka na yod par grags/sku tshe'i tshad ni/ bka' shog rgya bo cher/ rgya gar mkhas pa bi ma mi dra dang / /o rgyan mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /bal po'i mkhas pa ba su dh+wa ra dang / /bod kyi mkhas pa dzñā na ku ma ras/ /bdag la gnang ba'i man ngag 'di rnams yin/ /zhes pas chos rgyal khri srong gi dus na byung bar rtsod pa med de/ gnubs kyi ban chung sangs rgyas ngas/ /lo ni brgya dang sum cur lon/ /zhes tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa brnyes nas mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi bar du bzhugs par snang ngo/ /'di la brgyud 'dzin gyi slob bu sras kyi dam pa gcig thugs zin gyi sras bzhi dang lngar byung ba las/ sras kyi dam pa ni/ gnubs chen dang gdung gcig pa'i khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ gnubs khu lung du 'khrungs/ rus gcig pa dang skal ldan du mkhyen nas rjes su bzung / lta ba sgang dril/ gab pa mngon phyung / gsang ba khong lhod ltar phyung / star ga gegs sel gyi tshul te bzhi ka thob pas gdams ngag mtha' dag rdzogs pa yon tan rgya mtsho'o/ /khong gis rkang mgyogs bsgrubs/ yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ dam can bran du 'khol/ chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon du gyur pa'o/ /'di la sras ye shes rgya mtsho dang / pad+ma dbang rgyal gnyis 'khrungs/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i sras lha rje gnubs chung ngam hūṃ chung ste/ 'dis mi la la drag sngags bstan/ thugs zin gyi sras bzhi las/ so ye shes dbang phyug la lta ba bcud dril te bshad/ ba gor blon chen 'phags la gzhung 'grel ṭī ka dang sbyar nas bshad/ dan yon tan mchog 17

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃl star ga gegs sel gyi tshul du bshad/ sru legs pa'i sgron ma la tshig sdebs sbyor legs par bshad pa ste/ gnubs chen gyi mgur las/ shes rab kyi nags tshal na/ /yon tan gyi ljon shing zhabrungs/ /snod mchog ni lnga ru blug /gcig gis ni rtsa ba khyer/ /blon 'phags pa yin/ /gcig gis ni lo ma khyer/ /legs pa'i sgron ma yin/ gcig gis ni me tog khyer/ dan yon tan mchog /gcig gis ni 'bras bu khyer/ /ye shes dbang phyug yin/ /gcig gis ni thams cad khyer/ /yon tan rgya mtsho yin/ /zhes gsungs/ gnubs chen gyis/gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho dang / so ye shes dbang phyug la bshad/ de gnyis kyi slob ma nyang shes rab mchog 'di bskyed dzo+ogs la mkhas par grags shing rdo rje phur pa yi dkyil 'khor gyi zhal gzigs/ brag la rdo rje brgyab pas 'jim pa la byas pa bzhin sogs grub pa brnyes pa'o/ /de'i slob ma chos lung gi nyang shes rab 'byung gnas bla ma'i thugs zin cing bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum la mkhas shing yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i slob ma lha rje zur po che'o/ /zur po che 'di stong tshab 'phags pa rin po che'i yang slob ma yin pas/ de'i dbang du byas na gnubs chen po dang zur po che'i bar na bla ma gcig las med pa yin no/ /gsum pa tha ma zur la babs tshul ni/ lha rje zur po che shākya 'byung gnas ni dpal chen po 'jig rten tu mngon sum byon pa yin te/bstan pa phyi dar la snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba btsugs/ zur chung ba shes rab grags kyis yal ga brkyangs/ zur shākya seng ges lo 'bras rgyas par byas pas/ zur mes dbon rnam gsum zhes grags la/ spyir zur zhes pa'i gdung 18

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adi dang por rgya gar nas lhag pa zhig ste/ 'phags pa'i yul du 'od gsal lha dbang gzhon nu gtsug tor can/ de'i sras man+t+ra zangs zhu can/ de'i sras mdo khams su byung ba zur rgyal ba gsum du grags/ de'i sras zur bshes gnyen stag sgra can/ de'i sras zur rin chen rgya mtsho/ de'i sras mtsho mig po che/ sngon lha rje zur po che de'i sras su bshad pa dang / gzhan du a tsa ra'i sras su 'dod kyang / 'dir kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas zur ba'i rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi yi ge zhig gzigs pa de nyid btsan par bgyis te mig po che la zur a tsa ra/zur kha can lag can/ zur bzang shes rab 'byung gnas te sras gsum byung bas/ tha chung shes rab 'byung gnas kyi sras lha rje zur po che/ zur ston bla ma/zur sgom rdo rje 'byung gnas/ zur sgom chung dang bzhi byung la/ che ba a tsa ras rgya gar la byon pa'i sras nyi ma'i snying po/ slar bod du byon nas thag lung par bzhugs sa'i sras zur thag sgom chen/ de'i sras zur chung shes rab grags pa yin zhes pa yin no/ /lha rje zur po che ni/ yul mdo khamasakyi sa'i cha yar rdzong dam zhes bya bar yab zur bzang shes rab 'byung gnas dang / yum yon bdag mo bde ba lcam zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan shākya 'byung gnas su btags/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs/ spyir zur la bla ma mang du bzhugs te/ khyad par du chos lung gi nyang ye shes 'byung gnas las zur ba'i me tog phog pa'i chos sgyu 'phrul dang sems phyogs zhus/ gzhan yang / lce shag mchog tho gar nam mkha' lde/ nyang stod kyi 'bre khro chu/ zhu snyon bsod nams shākya/ stong tshab 'phags pa byang chub/ rgya ston blo gros bka' sdod/19

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ snyiye shes snying po/ gnyan nag dbang grags/ lce shākya rgyal sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma 'khor gsum yang dag gi mchod pas mnyes par byas nas rgyud lung man ngag mtha' dag gsan/ dgongs pa nyams 'og tu chud/ sde snod dang rgyud sde'i grub mtha' kun la mkhas par byas nas/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud bsdebs/rtsa ba dang 'grel ba bsdebs/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs su bsdebs/ sgrub thabs chog yig la sogs par bsdebs nas lag len du thebs par byas/ mkha' 'gro'i lung gis bskul nas rta nag gi lung par byon/ 'ug pa'i tshang yod pa'i brag phug kha shar bstan zhig tu yang dag lha dgu'i sgrub pa mdzad pas/ dpal chen po yang dag lha dgu'i zhal mngon sum du mthong / de ltar bzhugs gnas kyi ming las bla ma 'ug pa lung pa zhes su grags so/ /lha rje zur po che la slob ma rtse mo bzhi/ rtse skog dang lnga/ sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa las/ rtse mo bzhi ni/lta dgongs kyi rtse mor gyur pa zur chung shes rab grags pa/ sgyu 'phrul gyi bshad pa'i rtse mor gyur pa me nyag khyung grags/ mkhyen brgya'i rtse mor gyur pa zhung dgos chung / sgom sgrub kyi rtse mor gyur pa bzang sgom shes rab rgyal po'o/ /rtse skog ni chos kyi steng du pho zo'i rtse mor gyur pa rtsags bla ma'o/ /de bzhin du sgrub sgom kho 'gying / yul sgom nag mo/ lce sgom shāka rgyal/ zur sgom rdor 'byung /g.yu sgom jo 'bar/ sba sgom bsod nams snying po la sogs te sgom chen brgya brtsa brgyad do/ /de thams cad kyang nam mkha' la 'gro ba sogs rdzu 'phrul thob pa 'ba' zhig tu grags/ rtse mo bzhi'i nang nas kyang glang po'i nang nas khyu mchog lta bu de nyid brag rgya bo la lo nyi shu rtsa bzhir bsgrub gnas byas pa bde gshegs 20

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrgya bo ba zhes zur chung shes rab grags pa ni/ yab zur thag pa sgom chen dang /yumashes rab sgyid kyi sras su g.yas ru gtsang gi char ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas 'khrungs/ lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe zur chen la gtad de byon/ lam du rta nag 'brog pa g.yu dang zangs khyer ba gnyis dang / shangs pa khrab khyer ba rnams lhan du byon/ zur chung la spyang slog las 'bul rgyu med pas spyang slog yod pa phyag rten du phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khong rnams 'khor ba la blo ldog ma ldog /lta bas bag zan dang / lo ma thug re drongs gsungs pa las/'brog pa gnyis pos zar ma 'dod/ shangs pas cung zad zos/ zur chung bas lhag med du zos/ bla mas spyang slog dang khrab gnyis zhog /g.yu dang zangs gnyis bdag po la gtod gsungs/ der zur chung ba la khyod kyi rus pa ci yin/bla ma dang rus gcig par brjod na 'gran par song dwogs nas/ zur chung chung zhig lags byas pas de ltar thogs/ de las can du mkhyen nas slob gnyer byed du bcug pas blo gros kyi spobs pa mchog tu gyur pa zhig byung / dang por shin tu dbul nas bla mas gtor ma btang ba dag blangs nas zan chung bya bzhin gsol ba dang / dpe cha tsam 'bri ba'i yo byad med tsa na/ lha rje zur po che la pan gyi khang sngon bya ba na jo mo g.yu mo bya ba'i sgom ma phyug mo ma smad gnyis yod pas/ khyod rang 'di'i steng du sdod gsungs/ nga khyim thab mi byed zhus pas/'du shes ma chung / ston pas gnang ba dang bkag pa'i mtshams ngas shes/ khong gnyis kyi yo byad la spyod nas dbang zhus/ dpe bris/ chos thams cad lhag ma ma lus par nyan pas chog pa yin/ des khong gnyis kyang tshogs rdzogs/ khyod 21

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrang gi don yang 'grub gsungs/ der gsungs bzhin nyan pas 'dod pa thams cad rdzogs pa dang / yang gsungs pas/ da khyod der ma sdod 'di la gab pas rang don gzhan don gang yang mi 'grub pas 'dir shog gsungs/ der ji skad gsungs pa bzhin byas pas mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'o/ /de la slob ma ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ phyam bcu drug dral ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sgom mi gnyis/ yus po che mi gcig /dkyus ma gnyis/ sta gu ra mi gnyis/ go ma chod pa gsum la sogs pa mang du byon te/ ka ba bzhi ni/ de yang dge bshes khyung po grags ses/ grwa pa mtshan nyid pa chen po bzhi btang nas/ zur chung ba bya ba'i chos log mkhan ba glang 'di sun phyungs la shog ces bsgos pas bzhi po lha rje'i spyan sngar phyin tsa na/ zur chung ba thul pa phyi nang ldog nas bzhes te 'dug /der gcig gis pags pa phyi nang slog pa'i gos 'di gang gi chos lugs yin zer/ pags pa dang po nas 'di ltar yod pas phyi nang ma ldog /phyi nang 'dzol ba khyed rang gi chos yin mod gsungs/ gcig gis 'o na chos gtam bya'o smras pas/ chos kyi ngo bo brngod med mtha' bral la chos gtam ga na yod gsungs/ der skyo ston gyis dris pa/ 'o na khyed rdzogs pa po'i lugs kyi sgom gtso bor byed pa lags sam byas pas/ da dmigs pa gang la gtad 'dug gsungs/ 'o na mi sgom pa lags sam byas pas/ nga gang la yengs 'dug gsungs pas spobs pa lan med du song / yang glan ston shāka bzang gis dris pas/ khyed gsang ba sgyu 'phrul ba'i lugs kyis snang ba thams cad lha dang lha mor 'dod pa lags sam byas pas/ yul bem po rang rgyud du snang ba'i 22

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmangon sum gyi tshad ma sus 'gog gsungs/ 'o na mi 'dod pa e yin byas pas/sems can gyi ma dag pa'i 'brul snang rang rgyud pa sbyong phyir mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang 'gal bar sus nus gsungs pas khong bzhi pham par mdzad/khong rnams shin tu dad de/ da lta 'dir bsdad na slob dpon mi dgyes pas/sang phod thabs byas nas 'ong bar dam bcas/ rjes su slob mar gyur te rdzogs chen gyi ka ba gung bu'i skyo ston shāka ye/ mdo'i ka ba skyo skyed lung gi yang khyed bla ma/ sgyu 'phrul gyi ka ba chu bar gyi glan shākya bzang po/ phrin sgrub kyi ka ba nag mo ri'i mda' tig chos shāka go/ /yang ma thog byang 'bar dang brgyud pa lnga zhes kyang grags/ rba dge mthong gis slob ma blo rno ba zhig rtsod du btang ba des/ka ba chos can zer ba dang / khyod 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i zhabrul ngor ka ba rang rgyud du snang yang / nga rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi don la ka ba grub pa mi gda' gsungs nas phyag yug yug mdzad pas ka ba la chags thogs med par song bas kho dad nas slob mar byas pa ma thog byang 'bar ro/ /gdung ma brgyad ni/ ma thog pa/ skyo ston chos seng / glan shākya byang chub/ rtsag shāka rangs/gnubs ston bag ma/ dbus pa sa 'thor/ shu ston zla grags/ rtse ston byang dpal dang brgyad do/ /sgom chen mi gnyis ni/ 'ba' sgom dig ma dang / bon sgom do pa'o/ /yus po che ni/ la stod kyi zi ston bso rgyal lo/ sta gu ra mi gnyis ni/ shad ston grags se dang / khyung po grags se'o/ /phyam dral la sogs te dkyus ma'i ming smos ma 'tshal lo/ /go ma chod pa mi gsum ni/ mgo phya tsha/mig chung dbang seng / 'gos chung dbang nge gsum mo/ /mgo phya tshas thabs 23

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlam gyi skabs su rgyab rten tu ma rgyud dgos zer 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi rtsar dgyes rdor nyan du song ba'i tshe/ lam du btsun pa gnyis dang phrad nas jo bo ban de lam na dgra 'dug go zer ba la/ lan du/ gzung 'dzin gyi 'phrang la nyon mongs kyi jag pa bkye nas/ nyan thos kyi byis pa btson du bzung bar mchi'o/ /btsun pa gnyis na re/ ban de ku mthong can sbos su re ba cig 'dug go zer bas/ yang lan du/ theg rgyal gyi kha nas lta rgyal gyi rbab 'dril nas/nyan thos kyi grong khyer bcom par mchi'o/ /gsungs/ mig chung dbang seng na re/sgyu 'phrul 'di la dkyil 'khor phyir 'don pa'i dus su rgyab rten du yo ga dgos zer nas sum pa ye 'bar gyi rtsar song / 'gos chung dbang nges sgyu 'phrul 'di la gzhi lam gyi grub mtha'i skabs su rgyab rten du tshad ma dgos zer spang ka dar chung ba'i rtsar tshad ma nyan du song ngo/ /de dag ni gsang ba snying po la lam thabs grol gnyis ka yod de ma rgyud kyi mtshan nyid ma byed/ dkyil 'khor rang sa nas thon pa la mig ltas khung nas 'chus/ tshad ma tshig gi grub mtha' yin te gzhi lam thog tu mi phebs pa ma go/ /rgyu des go ma chod mi gsum gyis bshad grwa ma 'khyongs bas sku mtshams las thon dgos pa byung / lha rje zur chung ni/ rdzu 'phrul shin tu che bas nyi zer la byon bzhud mdzad de/ 'ug pa lung du snga chos/sgro phug tu gung chos/ brag rgya bor dgong chos te nyi ma re la chos thun gsum re 'chad par mdzad pa'o/ /'di la jo mo snga ma bcad mo dar ma bo dhi khab tu bzhes pa'i sras btsad tsha lcam dral gnyis zhabrungs te/ rje btsun rdo rje 'bar dang / rje sras mo shākya lcam ste/rdo rje 'bar gyi sras bcad tsha shāka rdor/ de las brgyud 24

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i sras brgyud kyang yod do/ /de la bod 'dir dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i bshad pa'i chu mgo lta bur gyur pa gsang bdag sgro phug pa chen po'am/ zur shākya seng ge ni/ lha rje zur chung ba de sku mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba'i tshe bu slob rnams kyis rigs sras bskrun par gsol ba btab pas gsang bdag lag na rdo rje de nyid ka ba bzhi'i gras mda' rig chos shāka kyi sring mo mda' mo gtsug tor lcam zhes bya ba slob mar gyur pa zhig yod pa des mngal du spyan drangs pas shing pho stag gi lor sku bltams/ mtshan shākya seng ger btags/ zla ba brgyad na yab gshegs/ yum dang zhang pos bskyangs/ lo bco lnga nas rim bzhin bla ma mang po dang khyad par ka ba bzhi sogs dang / gzhan yang dam pa sangs rgyas deng ri na bzhugs pa'i drung du phebs/ chos kyi bdud rtsi'ang nod/dam pa'i zhal nas sgro phug pa la 'di bstan pa'i spyi dpal chen por 'gyur zhes dbugs 'byin mdzad/ sgro phug pa'i sras jo btsun rdo rje grags/ sras mo rdo rje lcam mo/ /rdo rje grags pa la sras lnga/ rnal 'byor/ rgyal tshab/ cung nge sogs so/ /lha rje rnal 'byor la sras gnyis/ rgyal tshab kyi sras jo btsun kun dga' snying po'o/ /zhes deb ther sngon po las gsungs/ de la gdugs thogs kyi slob ma grwa sa 'dzin pa stong dang / de'i nang nas kyang thugs zin gyi slob ma bcu gnyis byung snye/ nag po bzhi/ ston pa bzhi/ mes po bzhi las/ nag po bzhi ni/ lce ston rgya nag zur nag 'khor lo/ nyang nag mdo bo/ mda' nag gtsug tor dbang phyug go/ /ston pa bzhi ni/ nye ston chos seng / gyabs ston rdo rje mgon tha/ zhang ston/ rgya ston dang bzhi'o/ /mes po bzhi ni/ rtsangs pa byi ston/25

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgayung ston hor ni/ spang ston lcags kyu/ dbus pa chos seng ngo/ /'dren tshul 'di zur stod lugs su grags la/ smad lugs su de las tha dad pa'ang yod/'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis deb ther sngon po las/ sgro phug pa'i slob ma gtsang pa byi ston dang / sgang dri ras pa nye ston chos kyi seng ge gnyis kyi gtsang nag 'od 'bar la gsungs/ des mes ston mgon po/ des sro shes rab tshul khrims/ de la pak+shi shāka 'od dang / rta nag bdud 'dul gyis gsan/ pazhi shāka 'od 'di zur ba'i gdung rgyud yin te/ zur dbang chen 'od po la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i chung ba la shākya 'od du mtshan gsol/ grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs nas hor se chen rgyal po la tshe chu phul nas dgu lo brgya thub pa byung ba sogs so/ /rta nag nas mda' shākya 'phel/ de'i slob ma zur byams pa seng ge/ de la g.yung ston rdo rje dpal dang / rta nag bsam 'grub rdo rje gnyis kyis gsan/zur byams pa seng ge ni/ yab zur nyi ma seng ge zhes bya ste mes po pak+shi'i sras yin/ khro phu las rab tu byung / mtshan yang de ltar thogs/ dgung lo bco lnga la 'ug bya lung du mda' shākya 'phel las gsang snying gsan sbyang mdzad pas mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur/ de la slob ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab cing / gzhan don rgya cher spyod pa bcu drug tsam yod pa las/ gtso bor gyur pa'i sras kyi thu bo g.yung ston rdo rje dpal dang / rta nag sgrol ma ba bsam 'grub rdo rje'o/ /de la g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ni gdung rus glan/ 'brungs sa ni tshong 'dus pa yin/de'i slob dpon ni karma pa rang byung rdo rje/ zur byams pa seng ge'o/ /rta nag sgrol ma ba bsam 'grub rdo rje ni/ shing mo lug gi lo la rta nag gnas gsar du 26

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi gdung brgyud la 'khrungs/ slob dpon ni zurabyams pa seng ge dang / glan nya tshal pa bsod nams mgon po'o/ /khong gshegs khar rang gi sras la/ nga ni bde ba can du 'gro/ nyid kyis kyang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis thub par 'dug ste/ de nas bde ba can du shog gsungs/ de la zur brgyud dang sras brgyud gnyis las/ zur brgyud ni/ zur bzang po dpal gyi sras zur ham shākya 'byung gnas sogs so/ /phyis kyi zur ba'i brgyud pa la shin tu bka' drin che/ sras brgyud ni sras sgrol chen sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po ni/ lcags pho stag la rta nag gnas gsar du 'khrungs/ zur shākya 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar byon/ nga'i bla ma'i sras zhes gces par bskyangs/yab las sgyu 'phrul gyi chos skor rnams thugs su chud par mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu pa la 'gos lo ye bzang rtse bas rjes su bzung nas dbang khrid mang du mdzad pa'o/ /brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa lcags mo phag gi lo la gtsang du sku gshegs/ zur chung ba 'brungs nas dus 'di yan chad la lo bzhi brgya dang bcu bdun no/ /de'i slob ma 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal ni yab 'gos ston 'byung gnas rdo rje dang / yum srid thar skyid gnyis kyi sras su chu sprel la zhabrungs/ de nas rab tu byung / sgrol sangs rgyas rin chen las sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang sogs snga 'gyur rgyud sde'i dbang bka' thams cad gsan/ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud sogs lung dang man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa'o/ /zhwa dmar bzhi pa spyan snga chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po ni/ tre shod khang dmar du yab ldong dgon pa 27

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃskyabs dang / yum bra bza' bsod nams sgrol ma'i sras su 'khrungs/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / mtshan chos kyi grags pa gsol/ dgung lo nye bzhi pa la 'gos lo chen po las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po sogs gsan pa mtha' yas pa mdzad/ slob dpon pad+mas zhal gzigs shing gdams pa'ang bstsal/ 'bri gung rin phun tshogs ni/ dgung lo brgyad kyi steng du zhwa dmar bzhi pa spyan snga rin po che'am chos kyi grags pa las rab tu byung / mtshan rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal por gsol/ mdo sngags la gsan pa phul du phyin/ nub gcig man lam na rdzing bu me tog gis bkra bar sngags pa skra'i rtse mo la spyan ras gzigs/ rnyed pa thams cad rta mgrin/ rtsa ba rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par 'dug pa zhig khrus byed par gzigs nas de la ngo mtshar skyes tsa na/ mkha' 'gro mdzes ma zhig gis 'di'i skra dang khyod kyi skra mtshungs pa yin/ khyod kyi skra breg pas lha tshogs 'di rnams spangs pa'i nyes pa byung zhing 'byung 'khrugs kyi nad byung / ming dang lus kyang dkar chos su bsgyur na rten 'brel thams cad nga rang gis shes gsungs/ de bzhin du mdzad pas sku tshe yun ring du bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel byung / ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas dung shog dkar po dang / gser shog ser po/ mchong shog smug po/ g.yu shog ljang skya/ lcags shog nag po rnams spyan drangs/ tshes bcu la zangs mdog dpal rir pheb/ slob dpon rin po che dang khri srong lde'u btsan sogs mjal/spyir gsar rnying bka' gter gyi bdag por gyur/ khyad par mdo sgyu semasagasum gyi bshad srol thun mong ma yin pa btsugs/ mkha' 'gro snying tig la28

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ /khrid yigakyang mdzad pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /des rang grol nyi zla sangasargyas la sgyu 'phrul skor rnams gsungs/ des 'khon rigs tshe dbang nor rgyas labashad/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub ni/ yab 'khon rigs tshe dbanganor rgyas dang / yum rgyal mo 'dzom gyi sras su lcags bya lor 'brungs/dgung lo bcu la rab tu byung / yab las g.yung 'grel dang phyogs bcu'i mun sel sogs gsan sbyangs mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad par nyi zla sangs rgyas las rdzogs chen dang gzhan yang bka' gter mang po dang / khyad par theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod la bshad lung sogs gsan sbyangs mthar phyin mdzad pa dang / dgung lo so bzhi par bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan dpal 'byor lhun grub tu gsol/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos kyang gsar rnying gi dbang lung khrid man ngag gi skor mtha' yas pa gsan pa'o/ /phyis 'du 'dzi spangs nas pha wang kha'i nags khrod du sgrub pa kho nar mdzad do/ /zur chen bkra shis kun dga'am chos dbyings rang grol ni/ zur gyi brgyud pa'i gdung rabs ma chad pa las/yab zur chen po gzhon nu don 'grub dang / yum mkha' 'gro'i rigs las mtshan nyid yid 'dzin gnyis kyi sras su shing 'brug gi lor zhabrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis par snang gsal rin po che ngag dbang ye shes grub pa las/ kar gling zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol sogs kyi dbang lung mang po dang nyams khrid gnang / mtshan chos dbyings rang grol du gsol/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston pha wang kha dpal 'byor lhun grub las/ dpal gsang ba snying po'i rgyud dang / 'grel ba spar khab/ bod 'grel g.yung ṭīka rnams sbyar 29

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃba'i gsung bshad mdzad pa sogs bka' gter gyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis gnang / sku tshe'i mthar gung thang du bzhugs/ dar lding rin 'dzin chen po phrin las lhun grub la snying po'i rgyud kyi bshad pa sogs gnang / thugs sras rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po la zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las rab 'byams kyi lung dang man ngag gnang / zur chen chos dbyings rang grol zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshe yang rgyal mchog la ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung tshul rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rnam thar las/ legs byas 'di'i mthus sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ /smin gling yab sras kyi rigs ni 'od gsal lha las chad pa zhig yin te/ bod yul gyi sa cha kha rag tu sngon chad mthong ma myong ba'i skyes bu gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa zhig snang bas der mi rnams ya mtshan du gyur/ de'i tshe mi'i grib kyis lha'i bu myos par gyur pas na/ myos zhes pa'i rigs rgyud du grags pa las rim par byon pa'i/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sprul pa rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub ni/ yab myos ston mkhas grub mdo sngags bstan 'dzin dang / yum rgyal rigs dgos 'dzom ma'i sras su lcags mo phag gi lo la 'khrungs/ lcags sbrul hor zla lnga pa'i nyer lnga'i srod la mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo/ shing pho sprel lo sprel zla'i srod la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas mjal ba dang / yab rje nyid 'a sa bka' gter du ma'i dbang khridasogs gsan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol la gsang ba snying po'i bshadargyud spar khab dang g.yung ṭīka gnyis kyi steng nas gsan pa la sogs pa'o/ /denas mi ring bar yab rje nyid dar rgyas chos sdings su zhi bar gshegs/ yab rje30

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgatso boragyur pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa bcu phrag gsum lhag la mdo sngags kyi chosatshulabasam gyis mi khyab gsan/ rang gi sras gter chen la zab rgyas kyi chos thams cad tshang sprugs su bstsal te rgyal tshab tu mnga' dbang bskur/dbus gtsang lho mon sogs gdul bya'i zhing rnams su gzhan phan gyi phrin las g.yel ba mi mnga' ba'i ngang dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gnyis par chu stag la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku gshegs/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa ni/ yab myos ston gsang bdag chen po rigo 'dzin phri+on las lhun grub dang / yum ni bod chas rgyal gyi gdung rgyud las byan pa'i dan 'grub dbang rgyal gyi sras mo lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma ste/ yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su me khyi hor zla gnyis pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcur ngo mtshar gyi ltas chen po dang bcas te 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig par kun mkhyen rgyal ba lnga ba'i drung du gtsug phud phul/ mtshan ngag dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin du bstsa la/ de nas rim bzhin smin grol lam bzang ston pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po bcu drug dang / zab chos sna tshogs gsan pa'i yongs 'dzin so lnga rnams gus pas bsten/dgung lo bcu drug nas drug cu re dgu'i bar chos kyi phrin las bskyangs/ mthar shing rta hor zla dang po nas bsnyun tshul bstan te/ shar phyogs su goms pa bdun 'gro dgos yod gsungs te zhabs goms pa bdun spos nas skyil krung gis bzhugs te/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang / /sku dang ye shes rol par 'byams klas pa'i/ /zab gsang rnal 'byor chen po'i nyams len la/ /dbyer med thugs kyi thig ler ro gcig shog /ces 'da' kha zhal 31

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyum phun tshogs dpal 'dzom gnyis kyi sras mor myos ldan sa yos lor 'khrungs/ log smon rnams kyis brdzi bar ma nus par sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs su phebs/ nyams rtogs phul du phyin pa'i zhal slob mang po byung / mthar dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gcig pa sa glang lo gro bzhin zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcur ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas par gshegs/ 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin ni/yab rin chen rnam rgyal dang / yum tshe dbang dpal 'dzom gnyis kyi sras su dmar ser can zhes pa me mo sprul gyi lor 'khrungs/ gter chen bla ma'i gser khrir zhabs zung bkod nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi phrin las rgya cher bskyangs bar mdzad nas sku gshegs so/ /rje 'di nyid kyi rigs kyi gcung / rin chen rnam rgyal gyi sras mkhan o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje ni/ chu khyi lor 'khyungs/ dgung lo nyi shur phebs pa na bsnyen par rdzogs nas chos kyi khri la zhabs pad bkod de mkhan po mdzad/ 'dul ba sogs mdzad pa mthar rgyas su gnang nas zhi bar gshegs/de'i slob ma chos kyi grags pa zhes pa ni kun mkhyen phyi ma'i dngos slob sgom chen ngag dbang chos grags yin gsungs/ des ku lung bla ma 'jigs med ngo mtshar la'o/ /gnubs chen nas rim par brgyud de zur pa mes dbon gsum la bka' babs te zur lugs su grags pa dang / rong zom chos bzang la pad+ma be+e ro sogs kyi brgyud pa'i bka' babs pas/ snying 'grel dkon mchog 'grel du grags pa mdzad pa rong lugs so/ /rog shes rab 'od la so zur skyor lugs sogs mang du 'dus shing de las rog lugs su grags pa byung / sgro 34

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃphug pa'i slob ma 'dzam ston 'gro ba'i mgon po las kaḥdam pa bde gshegs kyis gsan pa'i rgyun phyis nas dbus su yar 'phel ba la sgyu 'phrul khams lugs su grags so/ /de yang gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza'i rnam 'phrul ka dam pa bde gshegs sam bla ma shar ba spobs pa mtha' yas ni/ yab gtsang pa dpal sgrub dang / yum gtsang mo rin chen rgyan gnyis kyi sras su chu pho stag gi lo la mdo khams su spo 'bor sgang du zhabrungs/ gdung rus sga yin/dgung grangs bcu bdun par dbus su byon/ 'phan yul du bla ma byang chub seng ge las rab tu byung / mtshan shes rab seng ger gsol/ sgro phug pa'i thugs sras 'dzam ston 'gro ba'i mgon po ni/ kam po'i gnas dang nye ba zhig yin te/mkhas grub chen po de la sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi skor dang sems phyogs sogs gsan/ de dang de la mkhas pa'i pha rol du phyin/ kaḥdam pa bde gshegs kyi ring la bstan pa'i chu mgo brnyes pa yin/ kaḥdam pa la 'dzam ston rin po ches kam po gnas nang du bsgoms na phung po 'od skur grol ba dang / ka ༷thog tu byon na bstan pa mthar rgyas gcig 'byung bar lung bstan pas/ bstan pa kho na thugs la bcangs nas ka thog tu phebs pas rten 'brel khyad par can 'grigs/de nas sa yul gyi yi ge kaḥ'adra ba'i thog sa mo yos kyi lor dgon pa 'debs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ mdo khams kyi ljongs su gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su bting nas dgung grangs don gcig pa chu byi tha skar can gyi zla bar gzugs sku bsdus so/ /de'i slob ma rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rnam 'phrul chos rje gtsang ston pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni/ me mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ bcu 35

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃchems kyi tshul du gsungs te/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis kyi nyi dros la mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba byung ngo gsungs te/ phyag gnyis ḍa dril khrol pa'i tshul dang spyan lta stangs dang bcas skad cig la mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /bu slob ni gter lung las/ dam ldan chos bdag slob bu ni da lta'i mnga' bdag yab sras sogs sa thob rje 'bangs skye ba'i mtha' 'gro don nus pa sum cu lnga:rang don thub pa brgyad cu brgyad chos kyi 'brel pa stong tsho gnyis: smon lam 'brel pa khri phrag lnga: las kyi 'brel pa drug cu bdun gdugs thogs bdun gyis zhabs nas 'degs mi chen gsum gyis mnga' thang spel zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba lnga pa po dang / mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs sde srid snga phyi dang mchod yon nyi zla zung du 'brel/ sa skya ba bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ chab mdo rgyal ba 'phags pa lha sogs dang / 'dul mngon phar tshad dbu ma sdom gsum gsang bdag dgongs rgyan ste/ gzhung tshogs de rnams rigs lam nas drangs pa'i bshad sbyang mdzad pa'i rab 'byams pa o rgyan chos grags sogs bdun dang / khyad par rgyud lung man ngag rig gnas dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du rdzogs par gnang nas rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba ni/rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma/ lo chen chos dpal rgya mtsho sku mched gnyis dang /sku sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ yid bzhin legs grub/ rin chen rnam rgyal rnams so/ /rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ sa byi lor zhabrungs/ dgung lo nyer bdun thog gshegs/ de'i gcung lo chos dpal rgya mtsho ni/ myos ston chen po phrin las lhun grub kyi sras su me pho rta'i lo la 'khrungs/ bcu gsum par 32

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgater chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du gtsug phud phul bas mtshan bstan 'dzin 'jam dbyangs dbang por gsol/ bco lnga par rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che las rab tu byung zhing nyi shu par bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhan yang gcen rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa bcu phrag gnyis lhag bsten nas/bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ gter chen bla ma'i phrin las kyi rgyun bskyangs bas bshad sgrub bstan pa'i gsal byed gcig pur gyur nas mthar dgung lo re lnga pa sa khyi hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer bzhi la gshegs/ pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho ni/ yab gter chen nyid dang yum rje rigs mkha' 'gro'i rtags kyis spras pa'i yon tan sgrol ma zhes pa'i sras su me stag lor 'khrungs/ yab kyi zhal chems su/chos char pha las bu lhag ces gsungs pa ltar chos kyi phrin las bskyangs pa'i mthar dgung lo so gsum pa sa khyi'i lor log smon can rnams kyi dbang du song nas hor zla dang po'i nyer drug la gshegs/ yid bzhin legs grub ni/ yab gter chen bla ma dang / yum sa hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi dbon rgyud las byung ba'i sras mo phun tshogs dpal 'dzom las sa mo lug lo 'khrungs/ma/khas btsun bzang po'i yon tan dang ldan kyang log smon can de rnams kyi dbang du song / rin chen rnam rgyal ni shing khyir sku bltams/ sdig can gyis brdzi bar ma nus te khams phyogs su byon/ phyis gdan sar phebs te/ rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtshos rje gter chen bla ma'i chos khrir mnga' gsol/chos kyi phrin las rgya cher bskyangs nas mthar dgu lo drug cu rtsa lnga pas pho stag gi lor gshegs/ mi 'gyur dpal gyi sgrol ma ni/ yab gter bla ma dang /33

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbadun par kaX dam pa rin po che dang mjal nas chos gsan/ mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa bla ma'i bka' srol bzhin bskyangs ba'o/ /de nas rim bzhin mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan bar gyis bstan pa bskyangs pas kaX thog bla rabs bcu gsum zhes rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul zam ma chad par byon pa yin/ khyad par du mkhas grub ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ mdo dang sgyu 'phrul rdzogs pa chen po sde gsum so so'i bka' srol gyi rtsa ba rnams slar yang nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad cing bshad sgrub kyis khyab bdal du spel ba yin no// ༈ ring brgyud skabs/ spyi don yid kyi mun sel las/ rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po dzas/ o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+t+ra bhu dhi/ za hor gyi rgyal po u pa rā dza/ yul dbus kyi dge slong ku ku rā dza gsum la bshad de/ de thams cad kyang sku tshe de nyid la lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs so/ /in+t+ra bhu tis sras shākya bhu ti dang / sras mo go ma dī bi la bshad de de gnyis kyang rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi grwal la 'khod do/ /ku ku rā dzas rgyud bco brgyad du phyes nas/nā ga rdzu na dang / drang srong bha shī ta la bshad de/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob po/ rgyud sde bco brgyad ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud sde drug phyi ma drug phyi ma'i phyi ma drug go/ /nā ga rdzu nas/ pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ des bi ma mi dra la bshad de/ 'di gnyis gdul bya'i don du parnyi tar snang yang / ngo bo lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin dngos yin no/ /yang sras mo go mas si twe ka ma la/ des sangs rgyas gsang ba la gsungs te/ 'di gnyis ni tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin la gnas so/ /yang drang srong bha shī tas pra bha hasti la bshad/ 'dis kyang phyag rgya chen po'i 36

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrig 'dzin brnyes so/ /des kyang slob dpon chen po pad+ma la gsungs so/ /'di dag la khacig gang zag snyan brgyud du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ la la ni rgyu'i rig 'dzin yin la/ phal cher phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin mang zhing pad+ma dang bi ma la ni lhun grub kyi sa la bzhugs nas/ sems can gyi don du parnyi tar snang ba ste/'pho ba chen po'i skur bzhengs pa yin no/ /snya na brgyud ni/ bod du rim pas brgyud pa rnams te/ snga 'gyur/ bar 'gyur/ phyi 'gyur gsum du grags so/ /de yang sangs rgyas gsang ba gangs ti ser bzhugs dus/ bran ka mur ti/ sba mañdzu shrī/ be+e ro tsa na gsum la bshad de/ de las brgyud pa ni snga 'gyur ro/ /pad+mas gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra dang / ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la mchims phur dbang bskur te sgra bsgyur rgya gar gyi gling du bsgyur nas bshad pa la bar 'gyur zhes grags so/ /bi ma las gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra dang / rma rin cheno mchog la bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i bar khang du gsungs pa ni phyi 'gyur ra/ /bka' brgyud 'di'i rim pa ni/ de gsum ga la brgyud de/ bai ro tsa na dang / gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra gnyis ka'i slob ma me rin chen mchog go/ /des gye re mchog skyong nas rim pa bzhin/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ gnub sangs rgyas ye shes/ba gor blon chen 'phags pa/ don yon tan mchog dge gsal ba'i byang chub/rgya slob dpon gzhon nu/ 'gar tshul khrims bzang po/ rong pa chos kyi bzang po/mtshur ye shes dbang po/ dan chos kyi dbang phyug shad mchog gi bla ma/ kyi yon tan 'byung gnas/ slob dpon gzhon nu don grub/ des gu ru dri med 'od zer la gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs/ 2 sa ho ra'i rgyal po dzaḥl rmis ltas ngo mtshar 37

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃb bdun byung ba dang mthun par rgyal po'i khang steng du badz+ra pa ṇi'i sku khru gang ba zhig dang / tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad kyi gleg bam dang bcas pa babs/ de'i tshe rgyal pos gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u rtogs nas de dang phyag rdor gyi sku la brten nas zla ba bdun bsgrubs pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong zhing ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas gleg bam gyi brda don ma lus pa mkhyen par gyur te/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lam rnam bkod du/shar phyogs in+t+ra'i lung pa nas/ /rgya lung rdo rje brtsegs pa mā /rigs can in+t+ra bhu ti ngas/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos mngon bstan pas/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sgrub pa yang / /tshom bu lnga bcu stong dang bcas/ /phyag na rdo rje mngon grub ste/ /spang len brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang / /dge bar bskur nas sdig pa med/ /ces gsungs/ lo rgyus la lar rgyal po dza0 sa glegs bam gyi brda ma khrol bar slob dpon ku ku rā dza 'di nyid kyis rtogs nas rgyud sde bco brgyad du phyes te slar rgyal po la bshad par gsungs pa yod pa gang ltar mi 'gal yang / gtso bor lam rnam bkod dang lam rim chen mo rnams nas bshad pa ltar ro/ /des in+t+ra bhu ti bar pa la bshad de 'khor tshom bu khri dang bcas/ des seng ha rā dza la bshad de tshom bu stong dang bcas/ des u pa rā dza la bshad de tshom bu brgya dang bcas/ des sras mo go ma de wī la bshad de 'khor tshom bu lnga bcu dang bcas te kun kyang tshogs sgrub kyi lam gyis rdo rje 'chang gi sar gshegs so/ /rdzogs pa a nu yo ga'i skor rnams mi yul du yongs su grags pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ mdo dgongs pa lung ston sogs las ji ltar lung bstan pa dang mthun par/38

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃston pamachog gi sprul sku mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyer brgyad na/ dam pa'i rigasacan dra ma lngas 'jig rten mun pa lta bur gyur pa mthong nas ston pa mya ngan las 'das par shes te/ gang du 'du ba'i gnas ni/ ji skad du/ rtse na rtsal gyirgyal po gnas/ /ngos la brag dkar khyi tshugs pa/ /seng ge gnam du 'phyonga'adras brgyan/ /rtsi sman rtsa brgyad rtsa bar 'byungs/ /'du ba'i nad kyis yongs mi tshugs/ /spyi bor ka lan+ta ka ni/ /mi gnyis gcig pur gnas pa yi/ /mdzod ldan de yi tshang bcas pa/ /skal ldan rnams ni bgrod par sla/ /skal med rnams kyis yongs mi thar/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i laṅga'i yul gyi ri bo drag shul can nam gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse mor rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi bya bas gshegs te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas yid la byas nas gdung tshig nyer gsum bton pas/ ston pa rigs drug pa kun tu bzang po nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par bstan te/ dam pa'i rigs can drwa ma lnga sogs rig 'dzin 'dus pa phal mo che la/ sngar 'og min dang / dga' ldan dang /sum cu rtsa gsum ste lha gnas gsum du bstan cing grags pa'i gsang ba'i rgyud thams cad slar yang bzlas te gsungs so/ /de rnams srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyi gser gyi gleg bam la baiḍūr+ya zhun mas bris te/ ji skad du/ gzhi rgyu dgongs snod gnas srung bdag brgyud 'dzin/ /zhes pas gser gyi byang bu la bri gzhi phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ be+eḍār+ya'i zhun mas bris pa rgyu phun sum tshogs par dgongs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i sgrom bu snod ngo mtshar bar dgongs pa/ nam mkha' 'byung bzhis mi 'jig pas gter gnas dam 39

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpar dgongs pa/ ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pas gter srung khyad par can du dgongs pa/ chos bdag rgyal po dzaḥlas can dbang po yang rab rtogs grol dus mnyam du dgongs pa/ skye 'phags byang sems sa la gnas pa sogs grub brnyes brgyud 'dzin dar rgyas su 'byung ba la dgongs pa ste/dgongs pa'i rtsal bdun gyis nam mkha' la sbas so/ /de yang gsang ba'i bdag pos dbang bskur zhing bstan pa'i don thams cad rgyal pos thugs su chud cing tshig gi brgyud pa rnams rig 'dzin gyi dge bsnyen chen po li tsa bī dri med grags pa las zhus/ spyi mdo'i 'grel ba sogs bstan bcos kyang mdzad/des slob dpon u pa rā dza dang / rang gi sras shākya pu tri/ na ga pu tri/ gu h+ya su tri gsum la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag rnams bstan/ de yang shākya pu tri ni in+t+ra bhu ti chung ba'am slob dpon la ba pa yin no/ /des sedha pu tri dang / ku ku rā dza phyi ma gnyis la bshad/ phyi mas slob dpon chen po ro langs bde ba la dbang bskur zhing bshad pa'o/ /40

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༄༅//spyi don mdzod kyi lde mig skabs kyi zin bris bzhugs/bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ /bdag gi rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol/ gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde gsungs skabs su zhal rgyun 'ga' zhig brjed byang phyogs bsgrigs su bri ba la/ dang po mchod brjod dus/dpal ldan bla ma sogs thad gter chen nyag bla'i gsungs rgyun las/ don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'i bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad spros pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos bakhyod de phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam gdod ma'i stong tshen gyi dbyings dang / glo bur sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i rig pa'i rang mdangs kyi khams sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du snang ba de dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje grub pa'i gzi brdzid dper na nam mkha'i spyin las char byung ba bzhin du dbyings ye zung 'jug gi sprin las sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshul du ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs par mdzad nas/ dbyar gyi rnga gsang sgrogs pa bzhin du gsang ba rgyud sde'i dbyings kyis gdul bya'i shes rgyud kun la khyab par mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bla ma de la gus pas 'dud do/ /zhes gsungs/ kho bo'i bla ma'i zhal rgyun ltar/ don dam dbyings zhes pas rang bzhin rnam dag /sgrib bral rig pa'i sku zhes pas glo bur bral 41

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdag gi ye shes cha shas du ma ldan pa'i sku ste/ dbyings rig dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje snying po'i lam gyis rgyud la mngon gsal du grub pa'i gzi brjid ces pa zhabs drung dang kun mkhyen chen po'i mtshan yang yin gsungs/gsang mchog rgyud sde'i thad gter chen bla ma'i gsung rgyun las gsang ba mchog gi rgyud sde'i snang ba nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi gzugs su bkod pa dang / gdul bya rnams gling bzhi'i gzugs su bkod nas/grub gnyis lang tsho rgyas pa'i pad+ma'i tshal du sgrub par mdzad pa'i brgyud gsum bla ma rta bdun dbang po'i gzugs su bkod pa dang gsang chen gsung gi sgra dbyangs 'od stong 'phro ba'i gzugs su bkod de/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i yid nam mkha'i gzugs su bkod nas de yi ngos la brtan par bzhugs gyur cig /ces pa'i don no/ /rgyud don zab mo bdag 'dras gting dpag par dka' na yang / skye bo'i brjod pa'i rjes 'brangs brag cha ltar du brgyud ldan bla mas legs par bshad pa'i man ngag la brten nas/rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di yi cha shas tsam gleng zhes brtsam par dam bca' ba dang / 'dir gzu bo'i blo yis nyon cig ces rang phyogs kyi grub mtha'i gsung rgyun la chags pa dang / gzhan phyogs kyi grub mtha' la sdang ba lta bu ma yin par drang po'i ngang tshul can gyi blo yis nyon ces nyan par bskul ba'o/ /mngon byang lnga'i byang chub brnyes/ /zhes pa'i thad/ rin po ches gter ston la/ mngon byang lnga rnying lugs kyi bla med ltar bya dgos/ da lta'i mngon byang lnga 'di rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud kyi lugs red de dang mi 'dra gsungs/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po'i thad gsung rgyun las/ spyir zab pa gdod ma'i stong chen 42

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgyi dbyings dang / gsal ba ye shes kyi 'khor lo zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zab pa chos sku dngos lam byed dang / gsal ba gzugs sku dngos lam du byed pa ste/gzhunga'adi la sbyar na lhag pa'i bden gnyis lam byed la gsungs so/ /sgo mi 'dra ba gsum zhes pa'i thad bskyed chog rgyas pa bskyed rim sgom pa la'ang ciskye gnas bzhi'i bag chags sbyong byed bdag sras gzhan sras mngon byang lnga bskyed rdo rje'i cho ga bzhi bskyed sogs rgyas pa dang / 'bring po cho ga gsum bskyed dang /bsdus pa a nu ltar sngags tsam brjod pa lha yi 'khor lo rdzogs pa'i bskyed rim dang / shin tu bsdus pa a ti ltar rig pa ye shes kyi rtsal snang lha'i 'khor lo ye nas yin pa nyid la rnam pa ma bsgyur kyang chog ste/ gal te lha'i rnam par bsgyur bar 'dod na yang skad cig dran rdzogs kyi tshul du chu las nya ldang ba ltar rig pa'i rtsal de nyid du snang ba ni ye nas dam ye dbyer med lhun gyis grub pa'i lha nyid du gyur pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun las/ de yang bsdus pa yid bzhin mdzod/ sems nyid ngal gso las gsungs pa ltar/ kun mkhyen phyi mas/ ma bcos rig pa stong gsal ngang / /zhes dbyings lam byed dang / /lhun grub snang cha'i rten 'brel kun/ /zhes ye shes lam byed la slob pa lta bu dang /bcos ma'i bskyed chog la mi ltos par ka dag dang lhun grub lam byed khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis la brten pa'o/ /zin bris gzhan las/ dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus zhi ba lta bu la mtshon na rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las rgyas pa gtso 'khor thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug dang / 'bring po rigs lnga zhal gsum phyag drug gzhan thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang / bsdus pa gtso bo 43

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzhal gsum phyag drug 'khor thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs/ gter chen bla ma'i gsung rgyun las/ lha grangs mang nyung la sbyar te gsungs la/ de yang rigs chung dang bcas te yongs/ rdzogs ni dkyil 'khor rgyas pa/ rig lnga dang sgo ba yab yum tsam ni bsdus par gsungs/ yo ga gsum thad/ chos rje mi pham rin po ches/ 'bras bu'i theg pa la/ lha sngags sogs kyi thabs mkhas bsten pas mi tshe 'ga' yis 'grub pa phyi rgyud/ rang gnas ye shes 'char ba'i thabs la brten pa rnal 'byor bla med gnyis/ de'i phyi ma la'ang dmigs bcas bskyed rim gtso che ba pha rgyud/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pas 'char ba ma rgyud/ gnyis med ye shes lam byed zung 'jug rgyud gsum/phyi ma la'ang las rlung dang bcas pa'i rnam shes dang ye shes kyi rlung byed pa 'dren pa'i sgo nas ye shes 'tshol byed dus zhalor/ ye rlung 'od gsal ba'i sems 'ba' zhig lam byed rdzogs pa po'i mthar phyin pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ ma hā la yang gsum du phye ba'i skabs su/ gsung rgyun las/ pha rgyud la gsum du phye ba'i mtshan gzhir rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa dang / sgru 'phrul 'di bzhag dgos par gsungs la/ zhal rgyun las/'di gsum ka'i skabs su rig pa 'od gsal byang chub sems nyid lta skur 'char ba la slob par khyad med kyang / gtso bor rdul tshon ras bris sogs phyi dkyil la brten nas bdag sras gzhan sras sogs bskyed chog rgyas pa'i rnam bzhag ston pa ma hā'i ma hā dang / phyi dkyil la brten nas lha'i rnal 'byor sgom pa gtso bor mi byed par rdo rje lus kyi grong khyer gdod nas rgyal pa'i dkyil 44

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'akhor chen por gnas pa nyid shes par byas nas skad cig dran rdzogs su lhar gsal ba ma hā'i a nu'am pha rgyud kyi ma rgyud ces bya'o/ /phyi dkyil sogs yod mod/ gtso bor rang rig pa'i ye shes skye ba med pa bden pa dbyer med kyi rang bzhin nyid lha'i zhabor lor bsgom pa'i tshul rtsal du 'don pa ma hā'i a ti ste pha rgyud kyi gnyis med rgyud ces bya'o/ /'di ma hā la skor gsum du phye ba'i a ti yin gsungs/ 'dir pha rgyud ces pa'i pha'am thabs kyi ldog pa ni/ snang cha lha'i 'khor lo spros pa'i rnam grangs shin tu rgyas pa dang / shes rab ma'i rgyud kyi khyad par gtso bo dbyings sam shes rab kyi cha gtan la rgyas par 'beb pa ste/'dir gnyis ka cha mnyam par ston pas gnyis med ces so/ /'o na 'dus pa dang 'khor lo sdom pa nas snang srid dag mnyam yin par bstan pa mkhas pa chen po rje sogs kyis ma gsungs pas mi 'thad snyam na/ de tsam gyis 'gal mi dgos te/ phyag na rdo rjes bde mchog stod 'grel dus 'khor ltar bshad pa dang /lu ba pas sbas rgyud ltar bshad pa gnyis 'gal bar mi 'dod pa ltar/ 'dir yang sngags kyi 'phags lam grub pa'i skyes bu chen po bi ma mi dra sogs kyi dgongs pa yin pas/ gnyis ka rgyud de'i dgongs par gnas so/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal ba'i gzugs sku sgrub byed dang / ye shes chos sku sgrub byed gtsor ston pa'i steng nas khyad par yod pas/ bskyed rim dang sgyu 'phrul las/bde chen gtsor ston gyi khyad 'ong ba yin par gsungs/ de'i rigs pas rdzogs chen dang gzhung 'di gnyis ka'i rgyud du grub ces gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/rin po ches/ rgyud 'di'i lam la thabs grol gnyis yod kyang / gtso bor grol 45

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlam rang yin te/ g.yo ba rlung dang / bde ba thig le'i rdzogs rim gtso bor mi byed par 'od gsal ye shes kyi rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pas ma hā'i a tir bzhag pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / zhabs drung dris lan las/ rgyud 'grel phyogs bcu'i mun sel las gsungs pa'i bab la brtags na/ sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi lam rim dang rdzogs chen khregs chod dang thod rgal gsum po a ti'i ma hā sogs gsum du mdzad pa 'dra ba zhig snang / zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ma hā'i ma hā'i skabs sdod bcud thams cad shu n+ya ta sogs kyis sbyangs te de'i ngang las rang nyid rgyu'i he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'byung rim sogs nas rim pas bskyed pa dang / bskyed gzhi rang lus ye nas rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid yin pas snang tshul gyi lus kyi cha shas dag yongs su gyur pa las lhar bskyed pa ni yongs grub kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang / a ti'i skabs yum ka'i sgrub gzhung gi zin bris na/ rig pa'i rang ngo thugs rje dang sbyar ba'i skye 'chi sbyang tshul dang sku gsum mngon du gyur tshul gsungs/ rgyud thams cadwa sgyu rgyal po yin pas che ba/ lam bsgrod pa'i myur khyad gzhan las che bas yang rtse/rgyal bas 'od gsal gnyug ma'i de kho na nyid gdul bya la ston par bzhed na re zhig snod du ma gyur pa rnams la lha mi'i theg pa sogs chos phung mtha' yas pa gsungs pas bstan pa thams cad sgyu 'byungs khungs lo chen rin po ches mdo rgyud mang po mi shes kyang gsang snying la sbyang pa che bas mdo rgyud gzhan sla mo byung gsungs pa ltar/ mdo rgyud thams cad la khyab byed lta bur yod pas lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel rgyal ba'i zhe phug ste brnag chos sam gces nor ro/ /46

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmi pham rin po ches rgyud 'dir snang srid dag mnyam dang / dbang bzhi pa'i don gyi ye shes bstan pas rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal por gsungs/ zhal rgyun la/'di grub mtha' 'di man gyi yang rtse yin pa'am/ yang na 'dir lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med nyid rgyas par bstan pas brngod bya'i don gyi ngos nas theg rtse la'ang de las gzhan ston tu med pa'i ldog pa nas so/ /zhes gsungs/ bsdus don lta bu'i rgyud dang / phyi'i thugs rgyud zhes pa'i thad/ rin po che'i gsung las/pha rgyud ma hā yo gar snang phyogs kyi lha dang / ma rgyud a nu yo gar stong phyogs kyi ye shes gtso bor byed par bshad pa dang sbyar na rgyud 'di ma hāre phyi rgyud du dang /bsdus don dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud du bshad pa la nges pa chen po ster/ 'di las dpag na 'di pa'i stong gzugs kyi sku yang ye shes rang snang gi dkyil 'khor dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gtso shos su bshad dgos pas rgyu las sgrub lugs dang ma 'dra rung / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku ni sgrub par nges par 'dod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zin bris las/ rtsa bshad gnyis mi 'gal te/ rgyud phyi ma de nyid rtsa rgyud la ltos pas bshad rgyud dang / bshad rgyud sde bzhi la ltos pas rtsa rgyud yin no/ /spyir ma hā yo ga'i rgyud rnams rgyan bdun gyis 'chad pa yin no/ /snga rabs pa rnams kyis 'chad tshul ni/ mtshon dpe dang sbyar te bshad lugs gsum ni/ mda' ltar rtse mo nas bzung ste 'chad pa zhes bya ba ni gsang ba chen po gzhi/ snying po ma nor ba lam/ de kho na nyid nges pa 'bras bu ste mtshan gyi nang du chos thams cad gzhi lam 'bras gsum du bsdus nas 'chad pa mda' ltar rtse mo nas bzung ste bshad pa'o/ /mdung ltar rked pa nas bzung ste 'chad pa 47

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzhes bya ba ni rtsa rgyud le'u lnga par rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin/ mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid gsum dngos dang zhar byung ci rigs par bsdus nasabashad do/ /rtsa rgyud le'u nyer gcig par gzhi rang bzhin gyi snang ba rtogs byar gdams pa/ log rtog 'khrul ba'i snang ba dag byar gdams pa/ gdul bya lam gyi snang ba bsgrod byar gdams pa/'bras bu bde gshegs kyi snang ba thob byar gdams pa ste/ chos thams cad snang ba bzhir bsdus nas 'chad pa yin gsungs pa ral gri ltar yu ba nas bzung ste 'chad pa'o/ /gsung rgyun las/ rgyud rgyud kyis bshad ces pa rgyas pa sogs bshad rgyud rnams dang sbyar te 'chad/ rgyud 'grel bas bshad pa ni/rang rang gi 'dod gzhung so sos bshad pa spar khab sogs so/ /rgyud sgrub thabs kyis bshad pa ni/ man ngag gi gzhung phra mo rnams kyis rgyud don dmigs phye ste 'chad pa dang / man ngag gis bshad pa ni/ de dag dang khyad par zab lam sbas bshad rnams snyan brgyud dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros kyis brgyan te 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/rgyud man ngag gis bshad pa'i thad/ bi ma'i drwa chen sogs kyi sgo nas rgyud kyi skabs dang spyar na 'di dang 'di ston gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /ma hā yo ga'i rgyan bdun sogs/ 'di sbas rgyud min par rin chen za ma tog kha phye ba lta bu yin pas 'chad tshul de mi dgos zhes gsungs/ brjod bya'i don bsnyan bsdus rtogs gsum gyi rdo rje sems dpa' dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rnams ston pa'i gzhung la'ang brjod bya'i ming rjod byed la btags nas rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes dang / dkyil 48

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'akhor gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes btags don ni/ sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes de nyid kyi ngo bo mtshan med stong pa nyid yin kyang / sems can gyi blo la ltos nas rig pa nyid ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i tshul du mtshan ma'i phyag rgyar mngon par snang ba'o/ /'chad pa'i skyes bu rigs lnga las/ 'dir ston pa kun tu bzang po'i mdun na bzhugs pa'i thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul 'chad pa'i skyes bu rdo rje mi bskyod pa la yang de ltar grags so/ /bshad rgyud me long gi lung don ni/'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa 'od gsal rig pa'i cho 'phrul tsam du zad pas/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi bye brag las 'khor 'das su bzhag gi/ rang gi ngo bo'i bzang ngan gnyis su grub pa med pa'i phyir thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni rang rig pa byang chub kyi sems nyid do/ /des na 'khor 'das tha dad du grub pa med pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal de nyid kyis chos thams cad bsdu ba'i phyir/ rdo rje'i rdul rdzas ltar 'khor 'das bzang ngan ris chad can du so sor mi phyed cing mi shig pa'i phyir rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin no/ /rdo rje zhes pa'i thad/ mtshon byed kyi rdo rje chos bdun ldan ni/ sa chu me rlung gis gnod pas mi tshugs pas rim par mi chod pa dang mi shigs pa dang bden pa dang sra ba'i khyad par bzhi dang / rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang / gzugs can gzhan thogs med du phug par nus pa dang tshur gang gis kyang mi tshugs pas na brtan pa dang / thams cad la thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa zhes khyad chos bdun dang ldan pa bzhin/ mtshon bya don gyi ye shes rtog ge'i blos mi chod pa dang / tha snyad kyi rigs pa'i ji bzhin yul min pas mi shigs pa/ gnas lugs ji lta ba 49
