g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhin du bden pa/ skal pa dman pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' bas sra ba/ngo bo la 'pho 'gyur med pas brtan pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab cing 'jug pa'i thogs pa med pas/ gang gis kyang brdzi bar ma nus pas ma pham pa ste/ rdo rje chos bdun dang ldan pa de'i yon tan 'phags chen rnams kyis kyang brjod kyis mi lang na so so'i skye bos lta ga la zhig mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang zin bris las/ 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa sems rang snang gi dbang du btang na snang ba snang yul dag ma dag sogs gnyis kyi rnam par yod kyang / ye shes rang snang gi dbang du btang na/ de ltar gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'di kho na nyid do/ /rig pa nang gsal ltar na ye shes rang gi dbyings kho na las gzhan mi snang ba dang / phyi gsal ltar na ye shes rang snang ni chos thams cad rang snang du mthong ba las/ gzhan du mi snang bas na rang ri ga ces bya/ de lta bu'i dbyings rig tha dad med pa ste dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin de kho na nyid la rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin te/ brgya byin gyi rdo rje ni tshur gnod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing / phar lha min gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs kyang 'joms pa ltar tshur spros pas brdzi mi nus shing / dbyings de mngon du gyur na phar spros pa'i kun rtog mtha' dag thal mar ram zang thal du 'bigs par byed pas na rdo rje dang mtshungs pa'o/ /'di'i rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis sems dpa'i don dang phyi ma gnyis kyis rdo rje'i don bshad do/ /dper na byas mi rtag gnyis phan tshun yin khyab mnyam gyi ngo bo gcig yin kyang / byas pa sgrub phyogs dang / mi rtag pa dgag phyogs nas bzhag pa'i ldog cha so sor yod pa bzhin du 50

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrig pa sgrub phyogs dang / dbyings dgag phyogs nas bshad pa yin gsungs/gsar rnying thun mong gi rgyud mnyam sbyor las/ rdo rje stong pa nyid du bshad/ /sems dpa' ye shes chen po ste/ /de dag bdag nyid grub pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod do/ /gsung rgyun las so/ /bshad rgyud me long las chos rnams sogs thad/ gsungs rgyun las/rdo rje ni rang bzhin dbyer mi phyed pa'i shes rab stong pa nyid yin la/ de yang rdo rje de rang bzhin gang dang dbyer mi phyed ce na/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang dbyer mi phyed pa yin la/ stong pa nyid la rdo rje zhes bya ste/ mnyams sbyor las/rdo rje stong pa nyid du bshad/ /ces so/ /sems dpa' zhes pa ni/ chos rnams ma lus sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi bstan to/ /rdo rje chos bdun mtshon bya don la sbyar na/ rig pa gting gsal chen po la chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i rtog pas mi chod pa/ bden 'dzin sogs shes sgrib kyi rtog pas mi shig pa/ phyin ci ma log par yang dag par bden pas bden pa/ skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral bas sra ba/ rig stong zung 'jug chos sku thig le nyag gcig dus gsum 'pho 'gyur dang bral bas brtan pa'o/ /srid zhi dbyer med du khyab pas thams cad du thogs pa med pa/rang ngo ye nas snyon bral yon tan kun ldan du gnas pas thams cad du ma pham pa'o// ༈ kun rtog dang bden dngos gnyis char gyis stong zhes pa'i thad/ grub dbang rin po ches mkhan po 'jigs 'od la/ tshig 'di rnams bcos dgos pas da phan chod dpe bcos ma grub bar du snang sems gnyis kyis stong pa zhes sbyor la shod/ phyis su 'di gnyis kyang sbyar rgyu yin/ 'dir ma yin dgag 51

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbashad pa'ang btags pa tsam las dngos min gsungs/ 'di rnams mkhan po 'jigs 'od nas khra bla ma spyin pa la gsungs/ (| (jikun mkhyen chen pos ma yin dgag tu gsungs pa ni/ spyir dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan 'phang ba ma yin dgag yin kyang / 'dir dgag gzhi chos nyid spros bral yin pas/de med pa ma yin pa tsam la dgongs/ snang tshul la dpyod pa kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i bden gnyis skabs su don dam par zab zhi spros bral sogs gsungs pas ma yin dgag gsungs pa de yang rgyu mtshan dper na btags pa tsam du yin gyi dngos min te/ mi pham rin po ches gnas lugs don dam dpyod pa'i dbang du btang ba'i bden gnyis dang / snang tshul dpyad pa kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i dbang du btang ba'i bden gnyis las kun mkhyen chen pos zab zhi spros bral sogs don dam du bzhed pa phyi ma'i skabs yin no/ /zhes gsungs/(| lta man ngag dang ldan pas de la mnyam par bzhag pa/ zhes pa'i skabs/ rin po ches bla ma gter ston la/ 'od gsal rig pa ngo legs par 'phrod rjes de la mnyam par bzhag na dbyings la'ang mnyam par bzhag pa yin/ dbyings la mnyam par bzhag na yang 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag pa yin de gnyis me dang tsha ba lta bu gdod nas dbyer med zung 'jug chen por bzhugs pa yin gsungs/ gter ston nyid kyis gsang snying 'chad skabs su/ /de la zhes pa'i 'bru 'grel tshul yang 'od gsal de la zhes par sbyar nas gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan dbyings ye me dang tsha ba bzhin nam yang 'du 'bral med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin tu mi pham rin po ches/ gzung 'dzin 52

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃganyis su med pa yi/ /chos nyid mthong ba gang yin pa/ /rang sems 'di yi stong las ni/ /gzhan du myong ba ji ltar srid/ /stong dang dbyer med ma myong ba'i/ /shes pa rang byung ye shes min/ /gang du dbyer med myong ba'i tshe/ /stong phyir mi skye mi 'gag la/ /gnas med gzung du med pa yi/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gnyug ma'i don/ /rang byung ye shes gang yin pa/ /bden gnyis dbyer med chos nyid do/ /dbu ma chen po'i rang bzhin yin/ /chos dbyings zhes pa yul dang ni/ /ye shes zhes pa yul can dang / /yul can mi rtag yul rtag par/ /ji srid so sor snang de'i ring / /dbyings rig dbyer med rang byung gi/ /ye shes rjen par myong ba min/ /ye shes rjen par ngos zin tshe/ /chos dbyings byas kyang de ga rang / /ye shes byas kyang de ga rang / /dbyer med byas kyang de ga rang / /de nyid don dam gnyug ma dang / /lhan skyes bde chen chos kun gyi/ /chos nyid nam yang 'gyur ba med/ /don la skye dang skye med gnyis/ /so sor dbye ba yod na 'di/ /dbyings rig dbyer med chos nyid ni/ /nam yang srid pa ma yin te/ /de phyir ldog pas phye na yang / /don la dbyer med ngo bo de/ /gnyis snang can gyi blo'i spyod yul/ /kun las rab tu 'das nas su/ /so so rang rig gis myong na/ /brjod med nyams pa'i don la reg /de la snang stong gnyis su med/ /chos dang chos nyid dbyer med la/ /yul dang yul can 'byed du med// thig le nyag gcig chos kyi dbyings/ /tha snyad tshig gis mi mtshon kyang / /so so rang rig 'od gsal ba/ /ye nas bab kyi gnas pa yi/ /gnas lugs don la som nyi bral/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun las/ rgyud 'di ltar na/ dbyings ye 'du 53

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ 'bral med pa'i ye shes nyid sku gsum gyi yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin par ngo legs par 'phrod rjes rig pa chos nyid bcos med du bskyang ba'i man ngag dang ldan pas rig cha de la mnyam par bzhag mthus chos kyi dbyings sam stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa yin pas stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag par 'gro/ zhes dang / rin po ches/ kun mkhyen snga phyis lam dus kyi 'od gsal 'char dus rig cha sad dgos/ dbu ma'i lta ba zur nas mi dgos gsungs/ zhes dang / ye shes rang ngo la kun gzhi'i bslad cha ma zhugs pas snang cha gang yang ye shes sam rig ngor song ba rig pa nyid snang cha de dang de shar bar 'char gyi tha dad du mi 'char ro/ /de'i snang cha thams cad rig pa nyid kyis bsdus pa yang yin te/ gzhi snang dang po bzhin no/ /zhes dang / de ltar snang ba gang dang rang rig thog tu song yang snang ba des rig pa btum rgyu'am g.yogs rgyu 'geb rgyu med par n+ning ba de nyid rig pa rang du hril gyis 'gro ba ni rig pa yul la mi thogs pa' don te/ rig pa zang thal zer don de red/ ces dang /de dag kyang gzhi snang gi rig pa'i rang gshis la chos kun med snang stong gzugs su mthong ba'i rtsal rang chas su yod pas yin gyi/ stong nyid de la thos bsam sngon song sogs kyi mthus min pas/ chos sku kun tu bzang po la bla ma bya ba yod min te/ /rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs tsa na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bla ma 'jigs 'od gsung rgyun/man ngag dang ldan pa zhes pa dbyings kyi tshul legs par ngo 'phrod pa'i rnal 'byor bas rig pa bcos med du mnyam par bzhag pas/ stong nyid rtogs pa 64

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrang stobs kyis 'ong bas na/ zhes dang / zin bris las/ dbyings la snang ba gang yang ma grub pas dbyings de la mnyam par bzhag ste nam mngon tu gyur pa na yang rjes thob tu gang snang thams cad ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyag gcig tu 'char ba las rang dag bar gtan mi 'char te/ yul snang thams cad ye shes kyi rnam rol kho nar 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / zhal rgyun tu/ rje bla mas gsang ba 'dus pa sogs kyi zab mo'i lam gyi 'od gsal mngon tu gyur dus zur nas stong nyid dran dgos zhes gsungs pa de/ theg rtse'i lugs kyis mar gzhal na/ gzhi rgyud de la/ gzhi gzhi snang gnyis las/ snga ma 'chi 'od stong sang gi rnam can gyi dang / gnyis pa nam mkha' 'od gsal nas lhun grub la thim pa'i bar la gzhi snang gi ye shes te de gnyis las/ snga ma ni ye shes rlung gis ma bskyod pa'i skabs kyi 'od gsal yon tan phyir la mched pa'i skabs yin la/ des na zab rgyas gnyis thad nas stong nyid dang sbyar ba dang / rgyu las sgrub tshul yod la/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'di dus gzhi snang gi yon tan phyi gsal du mched pa'i skabs la ltos na thum zhad can 'dra ba yin pas stong nyid dran dgos gsungs/ phyi ma'i phyogs gtso bor ston pas sems las 'das pa'i rang gnas kyi shes rab kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid rtogs 'ong ba'i khyad par yod te/de'i rgyu mtshan ni dang po gzhung 'di dang theg rtse ltar na spyir snang srid dag mnyam du bstan pa/ de'i gnad mthar thug rig pa sku gsum gyi bdag nyid du ngo sprod pa'i khyad par dang / mngon tu byed rgyu'i 'od gsal yang ye shes rlung gis bskyod pa'i skabs kyi 'od gsal nyid lam du byed pa'i khyad par/ rdzogs rim dus 55

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsu'ang phra thig la sems thim pa'i dmigs pa mi byed pa'i khyad par gyis/ gzhi gzhi snang gnyis kyis zlas drang ba'i gzhi dang 'dra ba'i lam gyi 'od gsal la rtsal dag sdud gang thub byed pa ma yin pas khyad par gyi sems kun ye shes/rlung kun ye rlung su gsal bar sad nas rang lus nyid kyang 'od skur dengs bas khyad par yod pa ni/ lam sgrub tshul gyi khyad par ngo sprod yod med kyis red gsungs/ da lta'i skabs 'dir yang / dag pa'i snang ba kho na can gyi gzhi dang snang cha de rags par mched pa tsam las rtsal mched cing rgyas pa'i skabs kyi ye shes yin pas 'di ngo 'phrod cing sgom pa na lam shin tu myur bas khyad par che zhes gsungs/ ༈ brtan bsdus rtogs gsum skabs/ zin bris las/ brtan pa ni/grub chen skye 'phreng gsol 'debs las/ gdod nas rnam dag byang chub sems nyid de/ dmyal mes ma tshig sogs ltar/ mar ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba na yang ngo bo gzhan du ma gyur bas/ brtan pa'i rdo rje/ bsdus pa ni/ rdzas mang po phyog gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu min gyi/ rgyal po'i bka' rtags kyis 'bangs dbang du bsdus pa lta bu ste lam dus su bde ba chen po'i ye shes rnams mngon du gyur pa na/ de'i rjes thog tu gang snang de'i tshos mdog bsgyur ba lta bu ste phyag rgyas btab pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhi lam gang gi skabs su yang ye shes kyi tshul las ma 'das pas na bsdus pa'o/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes de nyid sgrib bral du byas pa ni rtogs pa ste/ snga ma brtan bsdus gnyis gnas tshul la ye nas dag pa'i cha nas dang / phyi ma rtogs pa'i rdo rje nyid glo bur gyi sgrib pa bral ba'i cha nas sa/ /zhes gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/ brtan pa ni/ gong gi 66

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃshes rab stong pa nyid de'i snang cha thabs rig pa rang byung gi ye shes yin la/ de ltar dbyings dang ye shes de gnyis me dang tsha ba bzhin tu gdod nas zung 'jug chen por bzhugs shing sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du rang bzhin la bzang ngan med cing / dus thams cad dang ngo bo gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gnas pas na brtan pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsdus pa ni/de nyid kyi phyag rgyas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la btab pas mnyam pa nyid du bsdus zhes pa ni/ de nyid chos thams cad kyi srog tu song bas dbus na gnas shing sems nyid kyi klong du brtan g.yo'i chos kun mnyam pa nyid du bsdus pas na bsdus pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ rin po che'i zhal rgyun tu/dbyings ye zung gi bdag nyid du gnas pa'i rtags su chos kun snang stong zung 'jug yin zhes gsungs/ rtogs pa'i skabs gsung rgyun las/ tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs zhes pa gsungs/ rnam pa las snang cha sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du goms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / don dam dkor bdun la goms par byas pas ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /spyir tshogs gnyis ni ye nas snang ba dang stong pa'i yon tan du rdzogs zin pa la lhun grub ces brjod do/ /glo bur du bsags pa de ni dri ma sel byed kyi rkyen kyi cha tsam la rgyu tshogs gnyis zhes btags pa tsam yin no/ /gnas tshul la gzhi 'bras gnyis su med par rtogs nas de nyid lam du byed pas na 'bras bu lam byed do/ /lam la brten nas gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin mngon sum du snang ba la snang lugs dri bral gyi cha nas 'bras bu'i rdo rje'o/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni zhes pa thabs snang ba'i cha 57

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang / shes rab stong pa'i cha gnyis 'brel pa'i don de la sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes bshad/ ces gsungs/ zin bris las 'byung ba lnga'i bcud 'dus pa'i thig le'i cha phra ba zhes pa pha ma'i khu khrag gi thig le ste/ de sbyong byed bskyed rim skabs/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs sogs yin la/ ris su ma chad ces pa yang /phung khams rags pa'i snang ba sna tshogs pa so sor 'char ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i cha nas bshad kyi 'bras dus kyi ris med lta bu la go rgyu min/ zhes gsungs/rags pa khams drug ldan du shar ba 'phrul ba ste/ pags pa/ sha khrag rus pa rkang khams dkar dmar dang drug go/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun las/ khams drug ldan gyi gdul bya ngos bzung chen po zhes dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes pa 'di/rags phra rtogs dka' sla sogs kyis sgo nas sbyar dgos gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/ de ltar snang ba sgyu ma ltar zhes pa ni/ ma dag 'khor ba'i chos phung po khams dang skye mched dag pa sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu ma ltar ris med du 'char ba'i gnad ni gdod ma'i stong chen gyi dbyings yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar dbyings ngor gang yang ma grub pas gang gi phyogs su ma lhung bas na cir yang 'char zhes gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/ drang don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni/ nges don sna 'phrul drwa ba de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba ste/ de'i mtshon byed lha yab yum zung du 'jug pa ste/ stong pa nyid mtshon byed lha yum/rig pa'i ye shes mtshon byed lha yab/ zung 'jug mtshon byed lha yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pas na/ lha yum rnams ni sgyu ma dang / yab rnams ni 58

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'aphrul ba dang / yab yum kha sbyor bde ba'i skur bzhugs pa drwa ba'i don to/ /de yang gang drang na gang zag mtshan ma'i blo can de drang / gang du drang na nges don sbru 'phrul drwa ba de la drang / tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas drang na lha yab yum thabs shes phan tshun 'khril sbyor gyi phyag rgya'i brda dang rtags la brten nas drang pa yin no/ /lha rtog dbyer med kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni/ rtog tshogs kyi rang bzhin lhar 'phrul ba dang / lha'i ngo bo rtog tshogs su snang yang rang bzhin lha yin pa las ma g.yos pa'i phyir na lha rtog dbyer med ces bshad do/ /rtog tshogs zhes pa/'khor ba'i chos phung khams skye mched yul yul can dang bcas pa la sgyu ma dang /de nyid ltar shar ba ni 'phrul ba'o/ /sgyu 'phrul snga ma gnyis zhes pa/ rtogs tshog dang nges don no/ /tsam zhes pa gnas snang mi mthun pa'o/ /'dir ston zhes pa ni/ ston pas gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tshams par bstan pa'i chos ni rgya mtsho'i rgyud de/ don zab cing gting dpag dka' ba rgya mtsho lta bu/ tshig rgya che zhing mtha' yas pa de thams cad kyi brjod bya rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid kyi nang du rdzogs par ston pas na/ 'dir ston zhes bshad do/ /'dis ston zhes pa ni/ bstan pa dang theg pa thams cad kyi don ma lus pa rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid las 'phros te ston pas na 'dis ston zhes bshad do/ /'di phyir ston zhes pa ni/ theg pa'i sgo gang nas zhugs kyang mthar thug theg pa 'di las mi 'da' bas theg pa gzhan thams cad 'di nyid kyi lam stegs kyi tshul du gsungs pa yin pas/ lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin te/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje las/59

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃdri ma med pa'i lung nyid do/ /las dang ye shes phyi nyid kyi/ /rdzogs pa'i rdzogs phyi lung nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbru ma las kyi lung mtshan nyid sde gsum/ye shes lha'i lung phyi rgyud sde gsum/ bya bral rdzogs pa'i lung nang rgyud sde gsum/de dag gi lung gi spyir gyur pas na lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun las/ gsang sngags phyi pa'i mtshan bcas mtshan med ces pa/ mtshan bcas ni lha'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang / mtshan med ni stong nyid sgom pa ste de gnyis la gom pas yar 'bras bu sku gsum dang mthun pa'i lam bsgom tshul yod kyang mar skye 'chi bar do gsum dang mthun pa'i lam sgom tshul med pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/ nges pa'i don rnams bstan par bshad do/ /zhes pa rnams kyi don ni/ rgyud kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo gnyug ma'i sems kyi rdo rje de nyid sems can rnams la skad cig kyang ma bral bar rang chas su gnas kyang shin tu phra zhing zab pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pas rang bzhin gyis gsang zhing phal gyi spyod yul du ma gyur bas na gsang ba'i rang bzhin bstan la/ snying po'i skad dod gsum po gang gi sgo nas bshad kyang mdo rgyud kyi lam gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khyad chos brjod pas snying po'i sgras ni rgyud don gyi che ba bstan/ gnyug ma'i 'od gsal gyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du gyur pa ni 'bras bu mthar thug ste rgyud 'di'i brjod bya mthar thug kyang de las gzhan ma yin pas/ de kho na nyid des rgyud don gyi mtshan nyid ngos bzung ba dang / de lta bu'i rgyud don gdul bya kha drang ba tsam gyi ched du bstan pa tsam min par thub pa'i dgongs pa'i zhe phug yin par nges pas nges don yin par bstan no/ /60

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ ces sogs sgras/ bskal pa bye ba grangs med pas/ ji srid sangs rgyas gang thob pa/ /gang gis dam pa'i bde bas khyod/ /skye ba 'dir ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes lam gzhan gyi bskal pa grangs med mang pos 'thob dgos pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid/ sngags bla med kyi lam gyis tshe gcig la 'grub pa myur lam khyad par can ni lhan skyes kyi bde ba nyid bsgoms pas 'grub par gsungs pa yin no/ /rgyu'i de kho na nyid ces pa/kun rtog gis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rgyu mi byed pa 'di nyid rgyu yin nges yin pas so/ /'bras rgyud nyid 'bras bu yin nges yin pas na 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid ces pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ mtshan grol lam ltar bshad na rgyud lung man ngag dang mthun par bshad la/ nang gsang thabs lam ltar bshad pa steng sgo 'ju 'dul dang / 'og sgo khams gsum rol ba dang sbyar nas bshad pa yin/ yang 'bor lo bzhi dang sbyar nas mtshan 'chad tshe/ lte ba na rtsa 'dab drug cu re bzhi'i dbus nang dbyings phyug lnga'i thig le'am khams dmar po'i rang bzhin can gyis thig le ni rtogs dka' bas gsang ba dang / ye shes snying po'am srog mi shigs pa'i thig le na sogs/ mkha' 'gro gro ma rngams ma'i thig le— kun tu bzang po'i thig le ni bde chen ye shes bskyed par nges pas nges pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/ lte ba/ snying kha/ma grin pa/ spyi bo rnams la rtsa 'dab rim par drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / brgyad dang bcu drug dang / so gnyis dag gi dbus na rim par dbyings phyug lnga'i thig le a'i rnam can dang / snying gar dwangs ma lnga'i dbus na ye shes snying po'i thig le 61

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang / mgrin par mkha' 'gro ma rngams ma'i thig le e yig gi rnam pa can/ spyi bor dkar cha haṃ gi rnam can tu gsungs/ zhal rgyun ltar na/ spyi bo dang mgrin snying lte ba bzhi po la/ dang po la gnad du bsnun pas bde chen skye bas rkyen dang mthar bde chen ye shes kyi sku thob byed yin pas bde chen 'khor lo dang / gzhi dus zas la longs spyod pas dang de la gnad du bsnun pas longs sku thob pas dang / snying kha'i 'khor lo la gnad du bsnun pas chos sku thob pa dang / de bzhin lte ba dang sprul pa'i sku 'thob byed du 'gyur bas sprul pa'i 'khor lo zhes/'di dag gi skabs su zhalor lo ni gcod byed rtsibs dang ldan pa yin pa ltar/'di dag la gnad du bsnun na rtog sgrib gcod pas so/ /zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ steng sgo dang sbyar nas bshad kyang rung mod/ 'dir 'og sgo dang sbyar nas bshad na/ rtsa gnas kyi thig le sogs lus kyis khyab tshad rtsas khyab/ rtsas khyab tshad thig les khyab/ thig les khyab tshad bde ba'i ye shes kyi ros khyab/rnal 'byor bas thig le dbab ldog byas nas lhan skyes bde chen ye shes mngon tu myong / zhes so/ /gleng gzhi'i thad/ gsung rgyun las/ phun sum tshogos pa lnga po de rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu yang yin/ rgyud gleng ba'i gzhi yang yin pas na gleng gzhi zhes bshad pa yin gsungs/ gleng gzhi'i skad dod da na zhes pa sbyin pa la 'jug ste/ de yang gang sbyin na yid ches kyi nges pa sbyin/ gang la sbyin na bka' yin min du rtog pa'i the tshom can de la sbyin/ tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas spyin na phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i sgo nas sbyin pa'o/ /gnas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa bzhi ni mdun chos nyid kyi rtsa gsum dkar po dbyibs zlum 62

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpo waṃ/ g.yas ye shes kyi rtsa 'od ser po dbyibs gru bzhi ma/ g.yon yon tan gyi rtsa gcig 'od dmar po dbyibs zla gam ya/ rgyab rang rgyud kyi rtsa gsum 'od dmar nag gru gsum es mtshan pa/ dwangs ma lnga'i thig le ni/ sa'i dwangs ma rtsa dar dkar gyi skud pa lta bu rta rnga bcu gshags tsam/ de'i dbus na chu'i dwangs ma rgya mtshal cog la'i khu ba lta bu/ de'i dbus na me'i dwangs ma me long nyi ma la bzhag pa'i ngad pa tsam/ de'i dbus na rlung gi dwangs ma gser sa 'og na yod pa'i rlangs pa nam mkha' la rgyu ba tsam/ de'i dbus na nam mkha'i dwangs ma sang sang sems dpa' go 'byed pa'i rnam par gnas pa/ de lta bu'i dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi dbus na ye shes snying po'i thig le stong gsal 'gags med yi ge waṃ dbyibs kyi rnam par gnas pa de ni ston pa phun tshogs te/ de nyid mar me gsal byed gzhan la ltos mi dgos pa bzhin rang gi rang la bde ba gsal bar ston pas na ston pa'o/ /'khor rtswa 'dab la rgyu/ zhes pa'i thad/ chos nyid kyi rtsa la kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang / ye shes kyi rtsa la yid kyi rnam shes/ yon tan gyi rtsa la nyon yid/ rang rgyud kyi rtsa la sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas so/ /pad+ma las bzhi'i dbyibs can ni gnas yin te kha gru bzhi/ sgo gru gsum/ dbang phyug gi sna rtse zlum po skye gnas zla gam nor bu'i dbus na rtsa sa ya phrag gsum gyi bcud 'dus pa kun rdzob kyi thig le waṃ gyis mtshan par bzhugs pa ston pa/ ma dā sdom byed dang ma nu yid la 'jug pas byed pa sdom pa'i yid/ 'di don rtsa rlung gi byed pa sdom pa'o/ /rlung rub pa dang / sdom pa sogs byed pa'o/ /rtsa kha kha mu kha dang rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa gnyis dkyil krung du bsnol nas byang sems dkar 63

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdamar phan tshun zhal mjal nas 'du shes gsum ldan gyis mtshan rtog sdom par byed pa'i gsang ba'i rnam shes kyi reg bde nyams su myong ba'i cha nas 'khor dang thabs lam gyi sems lnga zhes pa/ rtsa khams nas khams dang po g.yo ba g.yo ldang / rtsa lam nas 'jug pa 'jug pa/ rtsa gnas dang po rnams nas khams dang lhan cig tu bde ba snga ma 'jig cing phyi ma 'byung ba 'jig 'jug /bde ba snga ma las phyi ma lhag pas phyi ma la smon pa smon pa/ dbu ma'i mar sne nas khams dkar dmar zhal mjal zhing lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po skyes pa na 'dod don mthar phyin byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o/ /mngon byang lnga'i skabs/dkar cha dag pa sku/ dmar cha dag pa gsung / dran rig dag pa thugs/ rtsa khams dag pa yon tan/ rlung khams dag pa phrin las/ zhesadang / yang las rlung dag pa yon tan rdo rje/ cha mnyam dag pa phrin las gnyis la sbyor/ yang sku rdo rje rnam snang / gsung snang mtha'/ thugs mi bskyod pa/ yon tan rin 'byung /phrin las don grub bo/ /khams dkar po mas nas dang / dmar po spyi gtsug nas brtsegs pa'am dag pa las yas bab dang mas brtan gyi bde ba mthar phyin nas mngon par byang chub par 'gyur ro/ /dkar cha thur du 'gro ba gyen du song ste dkar cha chu'i rang bzhin spyi bor dag pas sku rdo rje thob/ dmar cha me'i rang bzhin gyen du 'gro ba thur du song nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtser 'gags pas dmar cha dag pas gsung rdo rje thob/ dkar dmar bar gyi 'brel byed pa'i rlung dag pas thugs rdo rje thob/ de gsum 'gyur ba myong ba'i shes rig dag pas ye shes rdo rje thob ste sku bzhi'i ye shes lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pas na/ ston 'khor 64

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdagongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa ni thun mong ma yin pa 'i gleng bslang ngo / /gsungs/ 'og min thad don gyi dang / rig pa'i/ gsang ba'i/ 'jig rten gnas kyi/ dbang phyug chen po'i 'og min dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ gsung rgyun las/ chos kyi dbyings la grags te/ de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten gnas so/ /rnam rtog dang mtshan ma gang gi 'og tu ma gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa chos dbyings de rtogs pa'i rang rig pa'i ye shes la bya ste gnyis 'dzin gyi 'og tu ma gyur pas so/ /gzhan tu na longs sku'i zhing dang cha mthun par lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la'ang de ltar grags pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/yum gyi mkha' la grags te/ ston pa gsang ba'i sku'i bzhugs gnas yin cing /mtshan ma'i rtog pa rang rgyud pa'i 'og tu ma gyur bas so/ /bzhi pa ni gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun gyi ya mtha' gtsang ma ris kyi lha lnga'i dang po ste/gzugs can gyi gnas gzhan gyi 'og tu ma gyur bas so gsungs/ lnga pa dbang phyug chen po'i 'og min ni/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi gzhung longs sku'i gnas su gyur pa 'og min chen po'i/ /de yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni rang nyid gang na gnas pa'i rang snang yin pas ma dag pa'i zhing spangs pa'i pha rol na dag pa'i zhing gzhan blos btsal du med de/ /rgyas pa las/ yang dag shes pa'i rang rig blo med na/ /sogs ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs/ yang zin bris las/ dri ma mtha' dag dang bral bas chos dbyings mthar thug don sgyi de yul can bde ba'i ye shes rigu pa'i— rdo rje btsun mo'i pad+ma gsang ba'i gnas gtsang gi 'og min 65

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'ajig rten— stug po bkod pa dbang phyug po'i 'og min/ rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams sogs ltar ro/ /'grel chung las/ gzhan yang gzhi dang rgyu dang sogs/ gsang bdag zhal lung sogs na gsal bar bzhugs pas ma bris/ye shes kyi de nyid la rang bzhin zhes pa rang snang gi dkyil 'khor de nyid ye shes nyag gcig las grub pa'i cha nas rang bzhin zhes mdor na ye shes kyi rang bzhin las grub pas na rang bzhin no/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa zhes pa/ dbyibs dang kha dog sogs kyi rnam pa la ngo bo zhes btags pa dang / rang bzhin chos sku'i phyogs nas zhes pa/ gong bstan gyi rang bzhin dang gcig yin/ gzugs kyi rnam pa la btags pa dang ngo bo gzugs sku'i phyogs nas bstan pa gnyis gcig yin no/ /ston pa'i rang bzhin skabs/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi don sgrib byed kyi zhen pa dang bral bas nar son zhing de'i ngo bo mngon du gyur bas na de bzhin nyid du sogs/ de'i dbang gis rang byung ye shes la spang bya ma grub pas na mi 'gyur/ mi bslu bas na yang dag pa dang / chos nyid de yi klong na 'bras bu sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rdzogs par rang snang bas nang yon tanā ma btsal lhun sgyuḥ sogs/ gzung du med pas sgrib bral gyi ye shes mtha' dbus med par brdal bas na/ mtha' dbus tsha sogs/ spangs rtog sa sogs/ sgrib pa'i cha shas phra mo tsam yang mi gnas pa dang / shes rab khyad par can dang dmigs med snying rje'i stobs kyis srid zhi sogs/ yang na sogs/nas mtshan ma'i yul can gang gis mtshon du med pa/ rnam rtog gis ji bzhin mtshon du med pa'i 'bras bu la mnga' mdzad pas bdud bzhi bcom pa dang che 66

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃba'i yon tan thams cad la mnga' mdzad kyang rang gi ngo bo tshig gis ji bzhin bstan du med pa'i— mnyam pa nyid mngon du mdzad ces pa/ 'ukhor 'das mnyam pa nyid kyi don mngon du mdzad pas chos thams cad la spyad bya spyod byed du 'dzin pa'i zhen pa dang bral ba'i sno nas longs spyod pas na spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin zhes kyang bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/mnyam pa nyid lhag pa'i bden dbyer med du chos thams cad dus gsum du mnyam pa'i tshul mngon du sogs sbyar/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i sogs phyogs dus kyi bsdus pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi che ba'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i cha nas sku lnga dang / chos brda sprod pa'i cha nas gsung lnga/ mi g.yo ba'i ngos nas thugs lnga/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i ngos nas yon tan lnga/gzhan don mdzad pa'i phrin las lnga sde/ 'bras chos nyer lngar snang bas gcig gi rang bzhin dang bral/ 'bras chos nyer lnga po de rang byung gi ye shes su 'dus shing ring lnga yang rigs drug par 'dus pas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid chen po dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /zhal rgyun ltar na/ phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba thams cad rigs lngar 'du zhing de dag khyab bdag rigs drug pa la 'du bas phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin pas gcig dang / de thams cad rigs drug pa gcig yin pas du ma dang bral ba ste/ lhag bden spyi yi steng nas go dgos gsungs/ zin bris las/longs sku gcig gi zhing khams bshad pa dang gtan la phab pas longs sku 67

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthams cad kyi zhing khams bshad pa dang gtan la phab par 'gyur yang thams cad chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar min pas gcig dang bral/ sangs rgyas gcig gi phrin las dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las mi 'dra ba med pa sogs kyis du ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ zhes so/ /zhal rgyun tu/ rtag khyab tu bzhugs pa— lhag bden de gnyis la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pas gnyis sgyu med pa'i sogs— gsungs so/ /zin bris las/ ma/dun dang rgyab sogs— bde gshegs rang snang la sku mdun dang rgyab ma grub cing gdul bya'i snang ba la ris med par zhal tha ler gzigs pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes kyis chos kun gzigs pa'i rtags so/ /longs sku'i bdag nyidatre thun mong mtshan dpe phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan sogs so gnyis/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang sogs dpe byad brgyad bcu mnga' ba'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi mtshan dpe la'ang phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po phyi'i mtshan dpe ni/ ston pa'i thugs me long sor rtog bya grub mnyam nyid ye shes bzhi po re re'ang bzhi bzhir phye ba'i ye shes bcu drug gi rtsal sems dpa' bcu drug /de'i yul chos dbyings bcu drug las sems ma bcu drug ste mtshan so gnyis dang / sems dpa' bcu drug por ye shes lnga'i rtags rigs lngas dbur brgyan pa'i lha brgyad bcu ni dpe byad brgyad cu'o/ /gnyis pa nang gi mtshan dpe ni/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab mtshan 32/ mgrin pa'i 16/ snying kha'i 4/ lte ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi'i stong pa'i rtsa phri lhag 60/ de dag bsdom pas dpe byad do/ /gsum pa ni/ rten nyi zla gnyis kyis dbye bas dga' ba mtshan 32dang / zla ba mas brtan gyi dga' la 68

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃye shes lnga lnga'i ros khyab pa ni dpe byad yin no/ /snying rje po dang / mi dmigs pa'i shes rab la thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i dmigs med snying rje dang shes rab bo/ bzhugs tshul dag zhal lung du gsal bas der blta'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen g.yas/dril bu pad+ma ral gri g.yon/ /zhes pa/ ye shes lnga dbyer med pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba dang / chos nyid de bzhin nyid la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa dang /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa dang / mi mthun 'joms pa'i nus pa mthar thug pa rnams rim bzhin mtshon/ zhes dang / rnam thar gsum mthar thug pa brnyes pa'i rig pa nyid sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par shar ba'i brdar dkar dmar mthing ba'i zhal gsum ni/ sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'am skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar zhal g.yas dkar/ gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'am gdul bya la rjes su chags pa'i brdar g.yon dmar/ thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'am de bzhin nyid dbyings las slar mi ldang ba'i tshul du mnyam par bzhag pa la 'gyur ba med pa'i brdar dbus mthing ba'o/ /zhes so/ /zhal rgyun du rnam thar sgo gsum la sbyar ba de yang rnam 'jog tsam las g.yas zhal gyis stong pa nyid kho na las gzhan gnyis mi mtshon zhes pa'i don min gsungs/ ༈ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po/zhes pa'i thad/ gsung rgyun las/ kun mkhyen pos dbus su rig bdag mtshon byed gdan 'khor lo seng ge byung ba'i phyir dang / yum nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ma byung ba'i phyir dang / zhi ba'i mdangs 'phrog pa'i khro bo'i skabs 69

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsu gtso bo budha he ru ka byung ba'i phyir dang / dkyil 'khor 'di yang ye shes rang snang ba gzhi la gtso 'khor ma 'khyugs par 'chad cing snang ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo rnam snang du 'jog rigs te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud kyi sde tshan gcig pa 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'grel pa pad+ma dkar po las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad mthing ga dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid mi bskyod pa dkar po dang / zhes so/ /gzhan yang rnam snang gtso bo yin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rigs yin pa dang thun mong min pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs par gnas so/ /gzhan las rnam snang gzugs te sku'i rigs dang mi bskyod pa thugs su bshad pa ni/ thun mong pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ste/ rigs lnga spyi tsam sku'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las gzhan du 'phros pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /zhes dang / zur bas ni/ dkyil zhabor gyi gtso bo rdo rje mi bskyod par 'dod de/ glang chen rab 'bog gi rgyud las/ don dam par sems can gyi rnam par shes pa gnas su dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid ces pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi bskyod pa zhes dang / nyi 'od seng ges/ kun gzhi mi bskyod pa la rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po zhes gnas skabs 'dir bya'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje las rim las/ rnam shes nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems phyir mtshan nyid ma skyes pa/ /mi bskyod yab yum rang bzhin las/zhes gsungs pa ltar mi bskyod par bzhed/ dogs spong la yum dbyings phyug ma ni/ rnam shes yul nam mkha'i khams dang sbyor ba dang / gdan gyi zhabor lo ni/70

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrig bdag mtshon byed kyi mtshan ma ma yin gyi/ rig lnga ye shes lnga'i phyag rgya ste/'grel chung las/ gzhi yang tshad med 'khor lo ste/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin yin/ /zhes so/ /seng khri yang thugs gtso bor ston pa'i phyir rdo rje'i rigs dang sbyar ba tsam du zad do/ /ye shes ni rgya cher 'grel las/ zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin rnam par shes pa'i phung po yongs su dag pa thugs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes so/ /khro bo'i skabs su'ang / bhud+dha he ru ka gtso bo ma grub ste/ paṇa grub kyi man ngag rnams su rgyud zhabrugs pa bsdebs nas gtso bo badz+ra he ru kar bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / mi bskyod rgyal po mdun na gnas/ /zhes pa/ rigs drug pa'i mdun dkyil 'kho+or gyi dbus kyi lte ba'i steng du gnas so/ /gzhan rigs bzhi rnams ni phyogs bzhi na gnas so/ /zhes so/ /dad pas nyan pa'i lha chen rnams/ /zhes pa'i thad/ zhal rgyun la/ rgyud nyan pa'i dad pa'i 'khor lha chen rnams sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang sngags kyi lam gyis ston pa dngos su mthong nus pa'i 'khor dang gnyis te/ dper na phar theg tu longs sku'i 'khor la sangs rgyas kyi mthus nyan rang yang yod chog par gsungs pa ltar ram/ yang na rang snang gzhan snang gi 'khor gnyis yod pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/drang srong khros pa lok+ṇi pā la lta bu/ mi thung byis pa gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje lta bu/ dpal chen rngam brdzid che mchog he ru ka lta bu'o/ /gnas tshod la/ sangs rgyas sprul pa yin par bshad kyang / zhes pa ni/ ru tra rang snang gi 'khor yin pa'i sgrub byed/ dper na 'og min gyi rten brten pa rang snang 'ba' zhig yin pa 71

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhin du dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i rten brten pa yang de bzhin dang / rdo rje'i lus la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ mdor na lam 'bras gnyis ka'i skabs na de ltar yod cing lam 'bras gnyis mtshungs dgos pa'i phyir/ snang tshod ltar bshad na mdo dgongs 'dus dang bka' thang gnyis rgyas bsdus tsam ma gtogs shin tu mthun zhes gsungs/ 'dod gzugs gnas lnga ma gtogs/ 'dod khams pas gzugs khams pa dbang du bsdu na mi 'thad pas 'di rgyud rnam dag min zer ba yod kyang skyon med de/ spyir de ltar yin kyang / dmigs bsal rig sngags kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir mi 'gal te/ dper na dmag gi rgyal po rig sngags kyis dbang du bsdus pa mi 'gal ba bzhin/ zhes dang / dbang phyug nyer brgyad gdul bya 'dul byed gnyis kar gtong tshul/ gzhi snang bar do'i skabs su snang ba'i dbang mo dang /'bras dus su dkyil 'khor gyi khyams na gnas pa'i dbang mo dang / dregs pa can gyi chung ma dur khrod na gnas pa'i dbang mo dang gsum las bar ba 'dul byed tha ma gdul bya yin zhes dang / thub pa drug tu bzhag go zhes pa'i thad rin po ches/ dud 'gro 'dul byed du sprul pa'i sku la klu'i rgyal po dang / ri dwags dbang po sogs dud 'gro'i rnam pa can dang / yid bzhin nor bu 'dod pa sbyin shing bem po'i rnam can dang / mchog sprul mtshan dpes spras pa'i rnam can sogs mang du yod kyang / dkyil 'khor la 'god dus de thams cad dud 'gro 'dul byed kyi sprul skur rig /bsdus nas lha gcig 'god/ de'ang bshad ma thag pa de thams cad kyi nang nas sku'i rnam pa'i cha nas mchog tu gyur pa ni 72

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmachog sprul rnam can rang yin pas de'i rnam par 'god pa yin/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba de dud 'gro 'dul byed kyi thub pa yin yang / dud 'gro'i rten can gtan nas min no/ /de'i sku'i rnam pa'i chos mchog tu gyur tshul ni/dag pa'i rnam can yin phyir ro/ /zhes gsung rgyun las so/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po zhes pa la/ las dbang gis skye ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa gnyis las skabs 'dir phyi ma'o/ /sprul sku'i 'khor rnam bzhi dge bsnyen pha ma/ dge slong pha ma'o/ /gdams ngag rjes bstan zhes pa/ man ngag khyad par can gsar du ston pa ni gdams ngag dang / gdams ngag thob zin pa la yang yang nges par bya ba'i phyir de'i don zhib par slar yang rjes su 'dom pa ni rjes bstan no/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ni smon lam yongs su rdzogs/ gdul bya yongs su smin/zhing khams sbyang ba'o/ /sgron ma bkod pa'i dus/ chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus so/ /snang gsum gyi bag chags sam 'pho ba'i bag chags/ rlung sems dang khams phra ba yul la 'pho ba'o/ /snang gsum gyi bag chags zhes pa ni/ khams dkar dmar nag gsum gyi snang ba ste/ snang mched thob gsum la bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhal rgyun du/ phra mo'i bdud bcom pa ni/ ma rig bag chags dang / zag pa med pa'i las/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus/ bsam mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba bzhi/ nyon bdud dang / lha bdud dang / phung bdud/ 'chi bdud phra mo zhes gsungs/ lo chen gyis bder 'dus bsnyen yig tu/ phung lnga lhar dag pas phung bdud bcom/ rang rig pa'i rtsal gyis nyon mongs pa ye shes lngar dag pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ de la 'dod lha'i bar chad kyis mi 73

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grolagyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃtshugs shing sems nyid skye shi las grol ba lha'i bu'i bdud dang 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ zhes gsungs/ 'di gnyis zhar byung gi gleng gzhir 'gyur zhes pa la/ zin bris las/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i khro sprul gnyis kyi gleng gzhi dngos su ma bstan kyang shugs bstan du bzhed pa la dgongs so/ /gleng gzhi nyer len gyi rgyu dang / gleng bslang lhan cig byed rkyen lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / nyi zla byang chub kyi sems zhes pa/ngo bo ye shes/ rnam pa bdud rtsi'o/ /sems ye shes su bskyed pa zhes pa/ ma dag pa'i sems dag pa ye shes su bskyed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dir ston pa kun tu bzang po sogs thad/ gsung rgyun las/ 'og min gyi rten can dbang gsum pa bskur yul de la khams dkar dmar yod pa mi 'thad do/ /der ma zad 'dod pa'i lha la yang rlung 'pho ba tsam las khams med par gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na dogs spong khu rdul rlung gsum sogs kyis bstan to/ /lo chen rin po che'i bzhed pas sogs de'i phyogs nas/ 'dir zhal rgyun du/ 'di rgyud smin nas dbang gis bag chags tsam gyis khams drug ldan gyi lus ltar bya ba byed par gsungs/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos grol ba'i thig le zhes pa'i thad bla ma'i gsung lhan thabs las/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam pa rnams kyis kyang mthar sngags bla med lam la ma brten par 'tshang rgya mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ las mtha' rnam 'byed las/ bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su yang / /mgo dang rin chen sogs sbyin pas/ /snang ba rnam gsum ma dag phyir/ /byang chub dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams su yang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod sogs kyis/ /snang ba rnam gsum ma dag 74

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃphyir/ /byang chub dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams su yang / /sngags kyi sku yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /snang ba gsum po ma dag phyir/ /byang chub dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum po dag pa na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thetshom med/ /ces gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad dang po gnyis kyis phar phyin gyi theg pa dang / de nas tshigs bcad gcig gis bskyed rim tsam dang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyis snang ba gsum dag par byed mi nus pas bla med byang chub mi 'thob par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni snang ba gsum gyi skabs su gnyis snang gi 'khrul ba yod la/ de gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags ma lus pa ma dag bar du gtan nas ldog pa med/ des na de gtan ldog pa'i tshul gyis sbyong ba la lhan skyes kyi bde bas de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs nas sgom pa dgos shing / de yang bla med kyi theg pa las gzhan na med pa'i don no/ /grol ba'i thig le las kyang / ci phyir shākya thub pa yis/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags kyang / /'di don ma rtogs ne+e raljar/ /ci yang ma yin ting 'dzin gnas/ /de tshe bde gshegs kun gyisakyang / /thal byung blo can de bzlog ste/ /nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med rab bstan to/ /nam phyed dus na brgyal ba ltar/ /de nyid bsgoms pas tho rangs dus/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag rtogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdag nyid ston pas dka' spyad kyi mdzad pa la gnas pa'i tshe na nam mkha' gang ba'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis ci yang ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di lta bu'i bla med mi 'grub po/ /zhes thal byung gi blo can de bzlog par gsungs pa ni/ rtogs bya chos dang gang zag gi bdag 75

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmed phra mo chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa yin kyang / rtogs byed yul can gyi blo dag bya glo bur ba'i sems yin pas 'di nyid kyi steng na stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa ci tsam gom pa byas kyang snang gsum dri ma phra mo sbyang mi nus pa'i phyir dang / dag bya glo bur ba'i lus sems shin tu dag pa'i rgyal ba'i chos gzugs kyi sku'i dngos kyi nye rgyu byed mi nus pa'i phyir na ci yang ma yin pa dang thal byung gi blo zhes dman pa'i sgras de tsam gyis chog 'dzin bzlog par gsungs pa yin la/ bla med kyi lam gang nas bzhugs pa ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med de bstan to/ /zhes nam mkha'i dkyil ltar spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang zhig /snang ba gsum gyis bsdus pa'i gnyis snang phra mo'i dri mas dag pa zab pa rim pa bzhi pa'i don gyi 'od gsal dang de bzhon pa'i rlung gis bsgrubs pa'i zab dang rgya che ba gnyis med zung 'jug gi gdams pa bstan par gsungs pa yin no/ /nam phyed dus na brgyal ba ltar/ /de nyid bsgoms pas tho rangs dus/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag rtogs/ /zhes gosungs pa ni/ de lta bu'i gdams pa'i don bsgoms pas brgyal ba'i tshe kun rtag rags pa dang bral ba ltar/ kun rtog gi spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i don gyi 'od gsal mngon sum du byas pa des chos thams cad de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs shing bsgoms par byas pa'i mthus/ lam gzhan gyis sbyang bar mi nus pa'i snang gsum gyi dri ma phra mo shes sgrib kyis bsdus pa de nyid lhag ma med par sbyangs te tho rangs kyi dus na 'od gsal de'i bzhon pa'i rlung gis 76

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmi slob zung 'jug gi sku grub nas sangs rgyas par bstan to/ /man ngag snye mar/mchog tu mthar thug sa la gnas kyang nges par thabs 'di la ltos so zhes brjod par bya ste/ dper na nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gnang ba'i shes rab kyi dbang las shākya'i mgon po byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa la byang chub thob pa'i ched du mtshan phyed na stong pa bzhi dang / ji ltar yang bcom ldan 'das 'di kho nas rdo rje snying po la thig le mchog ma las dbang bskur ba byin pa bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang mthun par don gyi 'od gsal dang zung 'jug gi rim pa grub dgos pas de gnyis dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i lam yin pas/ dbang gsum pa sher dbang dang bzhi pa tshig dbang bskur dgos gsungs pa ltar rigs pas grub bo/ /ma dag rgyu las sgyu lus gnad kyi lam rnams bsgom mi dgos te sa bcu pa'i srid pa tha ma des bskal chen grangs med gsum du bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa des sgyu lus man chad kyi dod thub pa'i phyir na rgyal sras mthar lam pa des bum dbang nyid kyi lam bskyed rim dang / gsang dbang gi lam dben gsum sgyu lus dang bcas pa nas 'jug mi dgos pas/ bum dbang dang gsang dbang yang de la bskur mi dgos par grub po/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ ngal gso'i spyi don legs bshad rgya mtshor/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'tshang rgya tshul ston pa'i skabs su grol ba'i thig le'i lung de nyid drangs nas bshad pa ltar byas tshe byang sems mthar lam pa de bla med du 'jug tshe dbang gsum pa nas 'jug pas chog dgos par mngon yang bka' sde zur ba'i bshad srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis 77

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasang dbang nas 'jug dgos par gsungs pa gnyis mi mthun par snang ba 'di ci zhe na/ grol ba'i thig le la sogs pa 'di gsar phyogs dang mthun par bzhad pa yin mchan gzhung chen po gzhan gyi gsang dbang gi lam dben gsum sgyu lus dang bcas pa yin pas gong bshad ltar rgyal sras mthar lam pa de mi slob lam du 'jug pa la dbang gsum pa'i lam rim pa bzhin don gyi 'od gsal la 'jug pas dbang gnyis pa nas 'jug mi dgos par bzhed la/ rgyud 'di'i bshad srol gyi dbang du byas tshe gsang dbang gi lam rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bsnun pa'i rang lus thabs ldan gyi lam rnams yin pas/ mthar lam la des kyang rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum la dmigs pas gnad du bsnun dgos pas/ gsang dbang dgos par bzhed kyang / rdzogs rim gyi lam la 'jug mtshams la mi 'dra ba chen po min no/ /zhes 'gal med du 'chad pa'o/ /yang na ston pa yab yum snyom par zhugs nas khams dkar dmar gyi rdzas gnang ste ched du brjod pa'i 'bras dbang dang gsang dbang chos mthun pas gsang dbang gi tha snyad du mdzad pa ma gtogs gsang dbang dngos ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i lan snga ma dang 'di gnyis gang bder dpyad dgos gsungs/ mthar lam pa zhes pa'ang / lo chen gyis sa bcu'i khyad par lam la gnas pa la bshad/khyad par lam thams cad ni/ sa bcu'i ye shes mnyam bzhag thun gcig skyes phan chod do/ /zhes gsungs/ dbang phyi ma gnyis la yang dogs pa gcad rgyu yod pa des shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ mkhas grub chen po gzhan gyis bzhed pa'i dbang gsum pa ni/ phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la snyom par 78

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzhugs pa las rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i yasababs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi stong nyid dang sbyar ba'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de nyid dbang gsum pa dang / de'i dus su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum kyi skur gsal ba dang sems bde stong dbyer med du song ba gnyis dus gcig tu tshogs pa de dper byas te/ thugs bde chen des stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa sku dag pa sgyu ma'i sku mtshan dpe bzhin lag gi rnam can du dngos gnas la grub pa gnyis dus gcig tu tshogs shing dbyer med du song ba'i slob pa dang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sku thugs zung 'jug de nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad pa de nyid bzhi pa tshig dbang du ngos 'dzin par mdzad la/ rgyud 'di'i bka' srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis dbang gi dus su slob bu rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba las thig le yas babs kyi dga' ba bcu drug dbang gsum pa dang / mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug dbang bzhi pa dbyer med bde ba chen po'i dbang zhes dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ba'ang de gnyis kyi lam ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra bas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chen po rnams kyis bzhed pa la dbang gsum pa'i lam ni rim pa bzhi pa'i don gyi 'od gsal dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lam zung 'jug gi lam yin par bzhed pa dang / rgyud 'di'i bka' srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis dbang gsum pa'i lam gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi lam dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lam 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes sngags bla med kyi 'phags lam de yin par bzhed pa la shin tu mthun pas don gyi gnad la 'gal ba cher med 79

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ do/ /'chad gang bder dpyad gsungs pa las/ rang rang gi bzhed gzhung rnams dang shin tu mthun pas dbang gnyis lam 'jog lugs mi 'dra bas yin no/ /zhes pa 'di 'thad pa yin snyam/ zhes gsungs/ ༈ zin bris las/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhi ba'i zhabs la/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsungs pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gdams pa 'jam dpal zhal lung / de'i 'grel ba slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim ston pa sgrub thabs kun bzang / rdzogs rim ston pa grol ba'i thig le ste ye shes zhabs lugs gsungs/ klu sgrub kyis gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel ba mdo byas dang mdo bsres gnyis te/ snga ma rtsa rgyud kyi tshig re re nas sbyar ba med/phyi ma la yod de'i rdzogs rim ston pa la dpal rim pa lnga pa ste/ 'di la gsang 'dus 'phags lugs gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/ dbang gi lam 'jog tshul mi 'dra bas zhes pa gsung rgyun las/ gsar rnying gnyis kas bum dbang tshogs lam du 'jog tshul 'dra yang / gsar phyogs nas gsang dbang sbyor lam/sher dbang mthong lam/ tshig dbang sgom lam du 'jog /'dir ni gsang sher gnyis ka sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du 'jog pa'o/ /dbang phyi ma gnyis la dogs gcod ces pa grol thig ltar/ dbang phyi ma gnyis mthong lam phan chod nas 'jog pa khams lugs yin no/ /sbyor lam nas 'jog pa zur lugs so/zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun la/ bdag byin rlabs kyi lam rtsa thig rlung la gnad du bsnun pa'i lam gsang dbang gi lam dang / gzhan lus la brten nas yas babs kyi lam dang / mas brtan dbyer med bde ba chen po'i dbang gi lam du 80

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhag pas/ gsang dbang gi lam 'di ltar na khyab che bas khyad par yod ces gsungs/ ༈ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i yon tan mdzod kyi rang 'grel las/ sa bcu'i mthar sngags la 'jug par gsungs pa'i don/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi dang brgyad/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang po gsum dang bcu gcig gi bar la gdul bya drang ba'i phyir rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa bcu gcig tu btags pa yin pas/ sngags kyi theg pa la rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi pa nas 'jug par/ mtshan brjod kyi lung gis bsgrubs te gsungs/ de bzhin tu mkhan po yon dga'i yon mdzod 'grel ba las lung rigs du ma'i sgo nas bsgrubs yod la/ khyad par spyod bsdus kyi 'grel ba dang /rnam snang mngon byang sogs la brten nas bsgrubs pa'i dang po ni/ gang tshe tha ma'i drod gyur nas/ /bzod pa chos mchog bar du ni/ /rab 'bring sbyor ba bcu gnyis te/ /rab tu dga' ba bcu gsum pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang / rigs pa yang so skyes 'ching ba kun ldan gyi rgyud la sngags lam skye ba/ 'phags pa sa thob pa'i rgyud la mi skye zhes bshad na ha cang thal ba dang / der ma zad phyi 'gyur chos skad nang mthun par smra ba dag kyang so skye'i rnal 'byor dang / 'phags sa mthon po'i rnal 'byor stobs nus che chung gi khyad par gnam sa lta bur khyad zhugs pa la dod thub byed pa ha cang thal zhes nang phan tshun dgag pa sogs rnam grangs mang po'i sgo nas bkag ste 'phags lam nas sngags kyi ye shes nyid mngon du gyur bar gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yang / thun mong gi 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas tshul la sbyar te/ ci phyir shākya thub pa yis/ /grangs med 81

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasum du tshogs bsags kyang / /sogs drangs/thun min theg chen mdo ltar na/yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas de/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid/ /sogs kyis sgo nas grangs med mang po'i gong nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa dang / mi pham chos rjes yang 'phags lam nas sngags kyi ye shes nyid brnyes par gsungs pa sogs bsgrigs nas/ thun mong dang thun min gyi khyad par rang lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa gzur gnas rnams kyis dpyad par zhu'o/ /e ma ho ye nas gsang ba'i chos/ /sogs— zhes pa'i don ni/ ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la skyo ba'i tshul gyis e ma hā+o zhes rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid la 'bras bu che ba'i yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub kyang / de'i don la thog ma nyid nas ma rtogs pas ye nas gsang ba 'i chos so/ /de nyid sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos thams cad kyang 'bras bu mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gnas la phyin ci log gi shes pas bslad nas rang gi rang bzhin ma rtogs pa ni rang bzhin gyi gsang ba'o/ /gnas lugs de yang yul sems dang rgyu 'bras la sogs pa gnyis chos thams cad las ngo bo nyi da kyis grol te yul du byar med kyang ma rtogs pas de ltar blta ba ni rab tu gsang ba'o/ /de yang sems nyid las gzhan zhig gud du yod pa min kyang sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pas bsgribs twe rang la gnas pa gzhan las 'tshol ba ni shin tu gsang ba ste/ de ltar gsang ba bzhis chod nas ma rtogs pa'i gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung bar rigs zhes zhus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/yang zin bris las/ gnyug ma'i steng na 'bras chos thams cad ye rdzogs su 82

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃganas pa ngo ma shes pa ye gsang / sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos kun ye shes rang snang las mi gzhan kyang glo bur 'khrul rtog gi dbang gis de 'dra'i rang bzhin ma shes pa rang bzhin gsang ba/ snang ba de thams cad gnyis chos mtha' dag dang bral yang de ltar ma rtog pa rab gsang / chos rnams sems nyid las gzhan du med kyang 'byul ba'i dbang gis gzhan du 'tshol ba shin tu gsang ba'o/ /smin ma g.yo ba sogs kyis spyan 'gyur ba/ phyag rkyong ba/ sku'i gzengs bstod pa/ 'od zer spro ba rnams so/ /gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i ye shes yul dang bcas pa ye nas rnam par dag pa'am sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dang / gang gis gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs lam rim/ gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dang / ji ltar gnad du bsnun pa'i tshul lta bu'i de'i khyad chos legs par shes na sogs la sbyar/zhes gsungs/ 'ching grol med pa'i gnas lugs sogs thad/ zhal rgyun du sems kho na gtso bo yin par lan cig sogs skabs/ theg chen mdo las/sems 'dul ba ni bde ba 'dren/ /sems 'dul ba ni legs pa ste/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon tu gyur/ /zhes dang /sems dge mi dge'i dbang gis ni/ /sems dmyal mtho ris 'jig rten na/ /mtshon na rin chen shing bzhin no/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa las kyang / sems spang nas ni las kyang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / yid bzhin mdzod las/sems kyis 'du byed sems kyis las kun byed/ /sems la snang zhing sems kyis btags pas na/ /zhabrul ba'i sems gdul slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba sems la thug pa'i sgo nas las bsags/ des 83

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃganas ris tha dad pa'i 'khor ba dag snang ba dang / dad pa sogs yid dge ba'i dbang gis rnam byang phyogs yang 'byung ba yin pas thams cad las sems gtso bo yin par gsungs/ phra ba'i sems zhes pa tshogs brgyad las 'das pas so/ /sems kyi rdo rje zhes pa/ mtshon bya don gyi chos bdun dang ldan pa nyid sems can gyi rgyud la 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa nyid yin la/ de ltar rtag tu bzhugs pa yang rang 'joms byed kyi gnyen po med pas yin no/ /zhes dang / 'od gsal zhes pa/ phar theg tu stong pa nyid la bdag 'dzin gyis dmigs tshul dag pas bdag 'dzin dang de'i rtsa ba can gyi nyon mongs dag pas na 'od gsal zhes zer/ 'dir gnyug ma'i ye shes nyid chags sdang rmongs sogs sgrib pa'i ngo bor gtan nas skye mi srid pas sangs rgyas nas sems can bar skad cig tsam yang bzang ngan med pas na 'od gsal zhes btags pa dang /rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes pa'ang / lam sgom stobs lta bu'i bde chen gyi ngo bor skyes pa lta bu min par gdod nas ngo bo bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du lhan cig skyes pas lhan skyes dang / sems thams cad kyi 'char gzhi sems dang lhan gcig tu bzhugs kyang rang nyid sems las ma skyes pa'i lhan skyes la sogs pa'i zhes pa'i skabs/ gnyug ma'i ye shes dang / ye grol rig pa sogs mtshan mang du yod la/ dngos po don rkyen gyis bcos bsgyur byas pa min par yin lugs la gnyug ma zer ba dang chos thams cad rang snang du rig pas na rig pa dang spang byas gtan ma bcings bas ye grol sogs su btags par gsungs/ bcings grol med pa'i— zhes pa/ sems rags pa rnams las nyon 84

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsdug bsngal gyi ngo bor skye bzhin pa'i skabs na'ang 'od gsal ba'i ye shes kyi ngo bo la cung zad ma sbag ma bslad par bzhugs pas na gang gis ma bcings bas na da grol yang mi dgos pas bcings grol med pa ste/ byams pa mgon pos/'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /ye shes rang gi gnas lugs stong pa nyid/ces pa'i thad/ zhal rgyun du/ rig pa nyid mngon du gyur na chos kyi dbyings rang stobs kyis mthong bya mthong byed kyi spros pa med par mngon sum gzigs pas na rang rig pa zhes brjod do/ /byang chub sems zhes pa'i thad/rgyud 'di nas bstan pa'i ye shes de sgrib pa'i dri mas gtan ma gos pa dang / gsal ba sku dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs pas byang chub dang /ngo bo ye shes yin pas sems zhes brjod la/ kun rdzob byang sems nyid/ byang chub min zhing byang chub 'dod pa tsam yin par gsungs so/ /bden pa gnyis la spyir 'jog tshul mang yang / zhes pa/ bye mdo dang dbu sems phyi rgyud rnams so/ /bde gshegs zur chung bas/chos rnams sogasathad/ cho 'phrul chu chab rom lta bu la go dgos/ gnas tshul ye shes yin yang snang tshul phyin ci log tu song ba chab rom chu min yang gshis chu yin pa bzhin no gsungs/ 'dir bstan gnyug sems don gcig pas dgongs gzhir ma zad brjod bya yang 'di kho na yin zhes bzhed la/ zhes pa ni/ yid bzhin mdzod 'grel pad+ma dkar po'i rim khang bco brgyad pa'i 'grel bar/don 'di mdo sde'i yang bka' tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs su gtso bor gsungs pa la/ rgyud kyi dngos gzhi yin pas/ 'dir de'i 85

gasku khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrang bzhin rtogs par byed pa ni rgyud bla ma'i mya ngan 'das pa dang / sgyu 'phrul chen po la sogs pa'i gnas ji lta ba bzhin bshad pa las/ gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de nyid sems can gyi rgyud la rang chas su yod pa'i nges don/ rgyud bla ma dang chos dbyings bstod pa bzhin tu bshad pa ni/ sa 'og gter dang bum nang mar me dang / /pad nang sku 'drar mkhas pas shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa drangs pa dang / gang 'dir ston pas chos kyi mdzod gsungs pa/ /kun gyi snying po 'od gsal rtse mo'i lam/ /lhun grub gzhi yi gnas lug yin zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas kyi bka' tha ma dang man ngag tu lhun grub gzhi yi gnas lugs 'di mchog tu bsngags pas shes par bya'o/ /zhes sogs theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod/ grub mtha' mdzod dang / nges don shing rta chen mo sogs nas tshul de dang mthun par gsungs so// ༈ sngags kyi khyad chos yin zhes bzhed do/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ zur 'debs las/ nang rang rig 'gyur med la de bzhin nyid du byas pa ni snying po'i mdo dang / rgyud bla ma sogs de dag gi dgongs 'grel rnams dang mthun yang / 'dir rang rig de bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byas pa ni/ bla med rgyud kyi khyad chos yin no snyam du sems te/ dus 'khor las/srid gsum phra rags gzugs min 'dir ni rnam par shes pa'o de bzhin rnam par shes pa nyid med do/ /sangs rgyas shes rab gang du'ang gnas pa ma yin zhes pa'i tshig ni sangs rgyas pa rnams ston par 'gyur/ /gang gis 'gyur med dang bral mi rnams kyis ni stong pa nyid de bzung nas stong par blta byed pa/ /de nas gtso bo gang gi 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba dag ni sngags kyi theg 86

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpar bstan/ /zhes so/ /mi pham rin po ches rgyud bla ma'i dogs bshad/ sprin dang rmi lam bzhin chos thams cad stong par gsungs nas/ de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi chos nyid kyi dbyings de bde gshegs snying po yon tan ye ldan gyi khams su gsungs pa'i dgos pa ci zhes dris pa la/ sems zhus pa sogs nyes pa lnga spang pa'i don du gsungs/ de ltar gsungs pa de 'dra'i khams yon tan med kyang yod pa'i rgyus tshig drang don nam/ nges don gang yin na/ drang don yin na rgyud bla ma'i rang tshig dang dngos su 'gal/ nges don yin te byang chub tu sems bskyed nas phyir mi ldog pa 'jig med rtag pa'i lam theg chen rtogs rigs thun min yin no/ /de yin par yang / yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyi sogs kyis bshad do/ /las nyon rnam smin gyi bsdus pa'i 'khor ba'i chos rnams dbyings la ye nas mi ldan de rang bzhin rnam dag yin pas 'bral rung dang / zag med mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi yon tan thams cad mkha' go 'byed dang / nyi ma la 'od bzhin 'bral mi rung bar rang gi chos nyid la ldan te/ gshegs snying ni stong rkyang tsam min te/ stong nyid 'od gsal yin/de chos thams cad kyi ye thog gzhi yi gnas lugs yin/ zung 'jug bden pa dbyer med kyi gnas lugs rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yin la/ de ngo bo nyid kyis srid zhir mi gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan lhun grub yod pa/de rtogs pas theg lam gyi yon tan thams cad 'byung ba yin no/ /las nyon rnam smin gyi phra ba gang zad phan chad spang bya gtan med pa ni/ ma rig bag chags kyi sa sogs bzhi yin/ de spang ba ni sangs rgyas kho na'i sa yin la/ de 87

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhi spangs na mthar thug gi yon tan stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya mtsho mngon du 'gyur ba ni dbyings kyi yon tan nyid mngon tu gyur ba yin pas/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi rigs kho na yin gyi nyan rang sogs kyi ma yin te/ sangs rgyas pa'i yon tan dang dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na khyi phag sogs sems can rnams kyi sems kyi rgyud la stobs bcu'i ye shes yod dam zer na/ stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi yon tan de'i rgyud kyis gshegs snying la ye nas yod do/ /kho rang gi chos nyid kyi yon tan yin pas khams yod na yon tan yod mod kyi mngon tu mi 'gyur te/ ral gri la gcod pa'i bya ba yod kyang / shub tu chud pa la gcod pa'i bya ba mngon gyur du med pa dang / me long la gzugs brtan 'char rung gi yon tan yod kyang sgrom du bcug pa la mngon gyur du mi 'char ba dang 'dra ste rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i rgyud la yod pa'i sgrib pas khams kyi yon tan mngon du mi snang ste/ der ma zad de'i rang sems kyi chos nyid rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yod kyang mngon du ma gyur na yon tan ci la mngon/ de'i phyir mngon gyur du med pa 'di la bsams nas/ stobs bcu skye rung gi rgyu tsam yod kyi dngos su med zer ba yod pa'ang dpyad tshul de'i dbang du de ltar skye rung gi rgyu de 'dus byas sems kyi cha yin na sems yin tshad stobs bcu bskyed rung du sgrub dka' la/ sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas sbyangs stobs kyis sems nyid rang gi byed pa yin na/ 'di 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings kyi yon tan yin pas/smin pa'i rgyu ru mi rung ngo / /'di lta bu'i khams de sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gnyug sems gsungs pa de yin/ de nam yang rgyun chad pa med la ngo bo 88

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃstongapas dmigs mtshan gang yang med kyang / stong rkyang min te mtshan ma med pa'i rang 'od gsal ba yin no/ /sgrib pa ma zad pa'i sems rgyud kyi gshegs snying la stobs bcu'i ye shes mngon gyur du med pa ni bdag cag kyang 'dod mod/bla med chos kyi yon tan dbyings de la med pa min kyang / mngon du mi 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /khams rang gi ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ye ldan min na/ de 'dra'i khams de yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi rigs su mi 'grub ste/stong rkyang bzhin no/ /des na chos dbyings 'od gsal lam/ rang byung ye shes sam/ gakhug sems 'od gsal lam/ bde gshegs snying po zhes pa rnams don gcig ste/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin te/ sgrib bcas kyi rgyud la yod tshe sangs rgyas rung gi rigs dang sangs rgyas tshe mngon gyur yin/ sangs rgya rung yin kyang 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid la snga phyi'i khyad par gnas tshul la med de ngo bo 'gyur med yin pas so/ /snang tshul la gnas gyur ba'i tha snyad brjod rung ngo / /de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod par bstan pas nyes pa lnga spang nas bla med byang chub la phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /nyes pa lnga po gshegs snying sems can thams cad la yod par ma thos pa las 'byung / mthar thug theg gcig 'grub pa'i gnad 'di yin la/ rdo rje theg par sems nyid ye sangs rgyas pa'i gnad kyang 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang de/ /shes bya thamalocad rnam kun stong ngo zhes/ / gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs/ /sems zhus sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag min 'dzin yang 89

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdag chos la skur/ /bdag cag lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don yang / rje mi pham pa'i phyag mchan las/mi brtan zhing rang bzhin med pa sprin dang / nyams su myong yang rang bzhin med pa rmi lam dang / rnam par snang yang rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan bzhin bka' bar ba yum rgyas 'bring sogs dang der shes byu thams cad ni rnam kun tu stong pa'o zhes gsungs nas yang 'khor lo tha ma 'dir rgyal ba rnams sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi snying po gdod nas lhun grub tu yod ces ci ste gsungs te yod med mi 'gal lam/ zhes dang / yang khams de 'phags pa mchog gis kyang rtogs par dka' na byis pa rnams la de bstan pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ de yi lan nyid bstan pa'o/ /de gnyis mi 'gal te/sngar gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos rnams la bden pa med par gsungs pa dbyings ngo bo stong pa'i cha nas bstan pa yin la 'dir bde gshegs snying po yod par gsungs pa yang ngo bo bden par yod ces gsungs pa ma yin te/ rig pa ye shes rang bzhin gsal ba'i cha nas bstan pas de gnyis mi 'gal bar ma zad gcig grogs su gcig 'char bas zung du 'jug pa dang / dgos pa khyad par can lnga'i ched du yod par bstan pa dang / lnga gang zhe na/ rang la sems bskyed skye ba'i gegs don dam pa'i dbyings rang la yod par ma shes nas byang chub bsgrub par mi nus snyam du sems zhus pa dang / lam la mi spro ba'i nyes pa dang / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i gegs gzhan rgyud la gshegs snying yod par ma shes pas sems can 'di dag dman no snyam du dman la brnyas pa mi gus 90

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i nyes pa dang / /yang dag pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi gegs rang gzhan kun la gshegs snying yod par ma shes nas bcos ma glo bur gyi dri ma dbyings la gdod nas med pa la yod par sgro btags te yang dag min par 'dzin pa'i nyes pa dang dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i yon kho rnams yod pa la med par snyam te yang dag chos la skur pa 'debs pa'i nyes pa dang / bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i gegs bdag gzhan rang bzhin chos dbyings mnyam par ma shes pas bdag la chags pa lhag par 'phel ba'i nyes pa ste skyon nam nyes pa lnga gang zag gang dag la yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs / rin po ches gter bla ma la gsungs pa ni/ sems zhus sogs don/ bdag kyang bde gshegs snying po rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems dang ldan pas dri ma glo bur pa sbyong ba'i thabs la bslabs na bla med byang chub gdon mi za bar 'thob nus so snyam nas zhum pa spong pa dang 1/ rgyud nyes byas chen pos zil kyis mnan cing nyon mongs 'chol nyog tu spyod pa'i sems can rnams kyang gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal gyi snying po can du gnas pas nges par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro snyam nas sems can dman pa la brnyas pa spong ba dang 2/ 'bral rung glo bur ba'i sems la mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du 'gro ba'i shes rgyud gnyug mar zhen pa'i sgro 'dogs spong ba dang 3/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gang ga'i bye ma snyod kyi gzhir gyur cing mos pa lan re skyes pas kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon khyad par can 'jog pa'i sems kyi gnad gsang mthar thug gzhan yod pa la/ da lta rang cag la mngon 91

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdu gyur pa'i sems kyi pha rol na de 'dra gang yang med do zhes skur ba 'debs pa spong ba dang 4/ bdag gzhan snod bcud bde sdug sogs glo bur gyi zhabrul snang ci tsam shar yang sems kyi gnyug ma'i gzhis la mnyam pa nyid du shes nas bdag la lhag par chags pa'i skyon bsal te zhen med kyi gnad dang ldan pa'i dgos pa dang 5/ zhes pa 'phral gtam tsam mo/ /'phags pa thogs med kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel bar/ sprin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin khyod 'dir sogs drangs nas/ nyan rang gis kyang bde gshegs snying po phyogs gcig mthong bar bshad pa/ khyod ltar na/ nyan rang rnams kyang lhan skyes kyi ye shes rtogs pa'i gsang sngags par khas len dgos so zhe na/ nyan rang gis sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gzigs shing / sems kyi nang na gshegs snying yang yod pas de tsam la bshad rung ste/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong na chos thams cad mngon sum du mthong mi dgos/ da dung yid bzhin mdzod 'grel dang shing rta chen po las g.ya' chod/ sprin dang rmi lam sogs zur 'debs las/ 'khor lo bar bar nyon mongs sprin dang / zag bcas kyi las rmi lam gyi longs spyod dang / nyer len gyi phung po sgyu ma dang sprul pa ltar rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang ma grub pas rdzun pa'i snang ba tsam du gsungs nas/ yang 'khor lo tha ma 'dir sems can gyi rgyud 'dir sangs rgyas kyi snying po 'di lta bu yod par gsungs pa mi 'gal lam zhe na/ zhes dris pa'i lan du sems zhus sogs don bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po sems can thams cad la rang chas su yod pa 'di ma mthong bar bdag ni yon tan dang 92

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbralazhing nyes skyon kyi phung po chen po yin pas bdag lta bu'i byang chub ga la 'grub snyam nas sems zhum pa dang / bdag nyid la byang chub kyi sems skyes kyang byang sems ma skyes pa'i sems can gzhan las dman pa'i 'du shes kyis khyad du gsod pa dang / bdag gzhan gyi rgyud 'di mtha' gcig tu nyes skyon can du bden par sgro 'dogs pa dang / yang dag pa'i chos sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes mtha' dag gi sems can gyi rgyud 'di stong par bzung nas skur ba 'debs pa dang / bdag la chags pa'i dbang gis bdag ni gzhan las lhag ces dang nga rgyal skyes pa'i nyes pa lnga spang ba'i rnam gcod kyi dgos pa'i ched du/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi rgyud na gnyug ma'i 'od gsal sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod lta bu de yod par ston pa'i man ngag gi mchog de bstan pas/spro dang ston pa bzhin gus dang / /shes rab ye shes byams chen skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag nyid kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na nges par 'tshang rgya'o snyam du dga' zhing spro ba dang / /sems can gzhan mtha' dag kyang gshis sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid yin no snyam du ston pa bzhin du gus pa dang / ma dag 'khor ba'i phung khams 'di dag thams cad kyang dag bya glo bur ba 'bral rung kho na'i bdag nyid du shes pa'i shes rab dang / rang bzhin rnam dag gi dbyings 'od gsal bas sems can thams cad la khyad med du khyab par nges pa'i ye shes dang / bdag gzhan thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i bdag gnyis du mnyam par shes pa'i byams pa chen po skye ba de yongs gcod kyi dgongs pa lnga dang ldan par bstan no/ /rgyud bla ma'i 'grel bar yang bcom ldan 'das de 93

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni skye ba'am na ba'am 'chi 'pho ba ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul las 'das pa'o/ /rtag pa/ brtan pa/ zhi ba/g.yung drung zhes gsungs pa sogs gshegs snying rtag brtan du lung dang 'grel tshig du mar bstan kyang / de'i don shing rta por ni/ dri ma med pas gtsang ba/'pho 'gyur med pas bdag dam pa/ dus thams cad du gnas pas rtag pa/sdug bsngal thams cad pa'i 'khor bar lhung yang sdug bsngal gyi zil gyis mi gnon pa'i phyir bde ba'i pha rol phyin pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi ngo bo dri mas ma bslad cing yon tan ye rdzogs su yod pas ye shes de nyid bzang ngan sna tshogs su 'gyur ba med pas brtan pa/ dus nam yang rgyun chad pa med pas rtag pa/ dri mas ma bslad pas zhi ba/ skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral ba'i g.yung drung gi bdag nyid yin par dgongs pa yin no// ༈ de bas kyang ches bshad dka' ba 'ga' zhig /zhes pa'i thad/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel par/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin yongs su dag pa lta ba'i gnad yin pa ni 'dir gang gi sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po cung zad mthong ngo zhes gsungs pas/ yang dag pa ni ji lta ba bzhin gyi ye shes kyis mthong bar 'dod do/ /de skad du/ sprin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin 'dir khyod phyogs gcig blos gros can/ /blo mig dag pa'i 'phags rnams kyis kyang thams cad mthong ma lags/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod chos sku gang dag blo gros mtha' yas pa/ /shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings 94

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkhyab pa de dag gis kun mthong / /zhes pa'i thad du/ shing rta chen po las/gnas lugs ma mthong ba'i skye bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zin pa rnams dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas theg pa po mos pa dang / sa la ma zhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyis mos pas don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa dang /sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pas phyogs gcig tsam rtogs la/ ji lta ba bzhin tu ni sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan gyis mi mthong ste/ zhes gsungs/༈ yang zin bris las/ sprin dang rmi lam— sogs nas/ gsungs zhes sher phyin gyi mdo stong phrag brgya ba la sogs pa de dang der shes bya thams cad sprin dang rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin du rnam pa thams cad du rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i stong pa zhes glo bur ltar gsungs nas/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa 'dir rgyal ba rnams sems can thams cad la sems kyi rang bzhin nam gnyug mar gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs te/ gsungs mi rigs par thal/ glo bur ba yin pa dang rang bzhin nam gnyug ma yin pa gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rtsod pa dang / sems can thams cad la de 'dra'i bde gshegs snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs te/ dgos pa med par thal/ byis pa rnams la bstan yang rtogs mi nus pa'i phyir te/ dkon mchog gsum po 'di yi rigs/ /thams cad gzigs pa rnams kyi yul/ /de la rnam bzhi go rim bzhin/ rgyu bzhi yis ni bsam mi khyab/ /ces pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes de ltar bstan pa la dgos pa med par rtsod pa'i lan du/ sems zhus sems can dman la sogs gsungs/95

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzhes gsar du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gegs bdag la sangs rgyas kyi rigs sam sa bon med pas bla med byang chub 'thob mi nus snyam du sems zhus pa dang 1/ byang sems kyi spyod pa sgrub pa'i gegs sems bskyed pa kha cig bdag gis byang chub 'thob nus la sems can gzhan gyis mi nus snyam pa'i sems can dman pa la brnyas pa dang 2/ gnas lugs sam gzhug ma'i ye shes kyi don rtogs pa'i gegs gnyug ma 'am yang dag min pa'i glo bur ba la yang dag par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs dang 3/ yang dag pa'i chos gnyug sems rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa med do zhes skur ba 'debs slad dang 4/ sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu bdag gzhan brje ba'i snying rje chen po'i gegs rang gces 'dzin dbang gis bdag la chags pa lhag par yod pa'i skyon lnga po de dag spangs nas gsar du sems bskyed pa sogs kyi yon tan de dag bskyed pa'i don du sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung gi gshegs snying sems can thams cad la yod par gsungs so/ /mdo phyi mar bstan pa'i gnyug sems yul yul can gyi spros pa dang bral ba de nyid/ mdo snga mar bstan pa'i spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings yin pas na snga phyi mi 'gal bar shes par byos shig ces pa ste/ mdo phyi mar bstan pa'i rang bzhin nam gnyug ma ni gnyug sems kyi dbyings mthar thug dang / mdo snga mar bstan pa'i glo bur ba ni kun nyon gsum gyi mtshon pa'i kun rtog yul dang bcas pa yin pas mi 'gal bar gsungs te/ yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyis stong sogs gsungs so/ /gsung rgyun las/gshegs snying la rtag pa'i chos nyid ces pa/ gsar phyogs nas/ rtag brtan 96

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃtherazug gi rnam pa ma yin par rgyun gyi rtag pa la go dgos/ phar theg nas semasarags pa'i steng nas stong nyid sgom pas ngo bo nyid sku'i nyer len gyi rgyu dang / sems rags pa'i steng nas tshogs bsags pas gzugs sku'i nyer len gyi rgyur 'dod pa'o/ /de bas ches bshad dka' ba zhes pa/ gsar phyogs kyis gshegs snying stong nyid la bzhed pas de ni nyan rang la'ang rtogs pa yod/ de lta na nyan thos kyi stong nyid bstan pa'i sde snod rnams gshegs snying ston pa'i sde snod yin par thal zhe na/ nyan rang gis rtogs pa'i stong nyid ni skar ma'i 'od lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba de gnyis mi 'dra'o/ /zhes so/ /mi pham chos rje'i bzhed pa ltar na/ byang sems kyi gshegs snying tshes gcig gi zla ba cha shas mthong ba lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyis yongs rdzogs mthong ba'i khyad par gsungs pa 'og nas bshad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ rnam pa gcig tu na zhes pa nas/ zhib tu dpyad par bya'o zhes pa'i bar rin po che nyid kyi dgongs pa red gsungs/ ༈ da ltar gson lus la gnas dus kyang zhes pa'i thad/ zhal rgyun du/ tshig don mdzod sogs las bshad pa ltar gyi sems kyi gnas ngo bo ro rkyang bzhon pa las rlung dang 'grogs pa'i sems rnams/ rig gdangs mi phye bo las rlung rta long ba zhon nas yul bgrod pa'i dpes mtshon pa'i don rig gdangs nyid las gzhan min la/ gal te rig gdangs dang ma 'grogs na yul shes pa'i bya ba sogs gang yang mi byed par gsungs so/ /zin bris las/ chos thams cad rtog pa'i cho 'phrul/ rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal gyi cho 'phrul/ da lta nas rnam rtog 97

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthams cad kyi srog na 'od gsal nyid bzhugs pa de nyid bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo sprad de lam du byed pa rgyud 'di'i khyad chos/ da lta'i rtog pa thams cad kyi srog na 'od gsal yod na/ 'od gsal rnam rtog gnyis skud pa dkar nag bsgrim pa ltar yod dgos pas shes rgyud gnyis su thal lo zhe na/ dper na chu grang bas bcur de chab rom du song ba'i sra 'thas te chu min kyang de'i gshis chu yin pas nam zhig zhu ba na chu'i ngo bor zhu 'gro ba bzhin du/ 'khrul ba'i yo lang sna tshogs kyi gtso bo kun rtog rags pa sna tshogs pa mched pa 'di dag gi srog gam gshis na 'od gsal yod pas de bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo sprad de mngon du gyur tshe kun rtog thams cad 'od gsal gyi klong du thim 'gro bas 'od gsal dang rnam rtog gnyis gcig mngon tu gyur ba na cig shos bag la zha 'gro ba srang mda'i mtho dman lta bu yin gsungs/ ༈ dhu ti'i rtsa 'khor sogs thad/ rdzogs rim dus dhu ti'i nang kho nar 'char ba yin yang theg rtse sogs kyi lugs ltar na/ye shes dang dwangs ma'i rlung rig gi cha re yod pa rnams rjen la bton nas mnyam par bzhag mthus dhu ti kho na min par lus thams cad la khyab pa'i tshul du 'char ba'i khyad par gyis rtsod ldan du chos kyi rgyal po'i mthus bde skyid khol bu dang kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi phun tshogs ltar rgya che la mtha' brtan pa'i khyad par lta bu yod ces rin po che nas gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/ dus 'khor ltar na stong sang tsam min par stong gzugs snang ba dang bcas pa 'char ba dang /de bzhin du 'dir yang stong gzugs dang zab pa'i phyogs gyi khyad par dang /'char ba'i gnas kyang rags pa'i rtsas gar khyab ye shes kyi rtsas khyab pa dang /98

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrlung rags pa'i cha rnams ye rlung du shar nas 'od gsal mu mtha' med par 'charaba'i khyad par che'o gsungs/༈rnam byang phyogs kyi gzhi byed lugs gtīyang yod ces pa gsar phyogs ltar na bla med lugs la/mnyam gzhag 'odagasalade'ibadenastongasgomapadang rjesathobatudagamadagagisgyulusatu / — sgomapa ste chos gzugs gnyis kyi bsgrub gzhi'o//zhes gsungs rgyun dang /phyi ma'i gnas lugs sogs/gsung rgyun las/gong du ltad pa'i ye shes rang snang gnyis brtan pa'i phyi ma'o//phyi ma'i gnas lus sogs sems dang ye shes gang yang min pas rang snang dngos ma yin yang /snang srid dag mnyam du bsnyan pa rnams kyi dgongs don gtan la dbab pa'i phyir thams cad rang snang gi phyogs su bsdus nas bstan pa'o//༈'das pa snang yang phyo+or bar zhen pa zhes pa'i skabs/des thag khra sprul snang basmo tu 'das pa snang yang phyin ci log tu zhen pa ste/thag khra'i spu nyag re re dang tshogs pa gang yang sgrul du ma song bzhin dbang shes stil ba la sprul snang bzhin/ye shes dang de'i snang cha la yul dang yul can rang rgyud par snang nas phyin ci log tu zhen pa ni sbyang bya'i gtso bo/zhes dang /de la lhan skyes kun btags gnyis skabs/phar theg ltar grub mtha'i kun btags ma yin pa dang yin pa'i khyad par lta bu la go rgyu min par/'od gsal tsho ngo ba'i dbyings la rmongs tsam gyi ma rtogs pa'i ma rig pa dang /snang sems rang ngos grub par zhen pa'i log rtog gnyis las gtso bo phyi ma'o//zhes gsungs/zhal rgyun las/ā+o ma'i ye shes las med/'di la ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen sdu'i ye shes gnyis yod/'dis yul
