g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgazigs tshul mthar thug pa ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di nyid kyi dper 'os pa 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag nyid yin par dus 'khor gyi spyi don mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa yod ces gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/ skyed byed thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rnam pa gsum gyis thun mong dang mchog gi sems lnga sngon skyes sam da lta skyes pa'o/ /'dir sems lnga dag gi khyad par zhal lung sogs na gsal lo// ༈ tshogs spyod bzhin no/ /zhes pa ni/ 'og sgo gtso bor ston pa'o/ /spyir thabs grol lam gyi khyab che chung ni/ grol lam kyi skabs su lam gyi khog shing mtshan nyid gsum gtso bor bstan pa dang / thabs lam gyi skabs su rang gi dgos chos rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bsnun pa tsam las ma bstan pas grol lam khyab che ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ grol lam ni rin po che ko tu bha sogs thad zin bris las/ grol lam khe nyen chung la/ thabs lam ni khe nyen shin tu che ste/ dper na gser 'gyur gyi rtsis stabs legs na srang gang gis lcags srang stong yud tsam gyi gser du bsgyur yang nyes na lcags de tsam thal bar bsgyur ba ltar yin gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches thabs grol gyi lam de gnyis kyang thabs shes kyi byed pa tsam gtso che chung gi sgo nas bzhag gi gcig shos la cig shos med pa ma yin la/ gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba la don gcig par shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / thabs lam rim gyis pa steng sgo dang cig char ba 'og sgo'i man ngag la brten nas gsungs so// 2 zin bris las/ rgyud 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dpe thun mong gi lam gyis rgyud sbyang ba sngon du btang nas/ smin byed 100

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyi dbang zhus/ dbang srog dam tshig gis bzung ste lam rim gnyis la bslab/de la sngon du lta ba gtan la phab dgos/ de'ang rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba tsam kho na min par gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i yul gyi rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam bzhag de la ji ltar gnad du bsnun tshul/ de ltar gnad du bsnun pa'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod par byas/ de nas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la dngos su slob pa ni rkyen 'jug pa'i ma/tshan nyid ting nge 'dzin te/ bskyed rim sngon du btang ba'i rdzogs rim la thabs grol gnyis las/rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa med par bzhag stobs kho nas rang gnas kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ de'i stobs kyis ye shes kyi snang cha gnyug ma'i rlung gis bskul te gzhi snang stong gzugs kyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar te lam du byed pa grol lam de ni rtogs dka' ba dang lam bul ba yin/ rtogs sla ba dang lam myur ba ni thabs lam ste/ de la rang lus thabs ldan dang / gzhan lus thabs ldan gnyis kyi dang po ni/ snying kha'i mi shigs pa sad pa lam gyi gnad yin pas/ de gtum mo'i me sbar te sad dgos/ de'i tshul ni rang nyid gsang chen rigs gcig rdo rje 'chang ngam kun tu bzang po lta bur byas te/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun bcas/ spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba bzhi dang / lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du gtum mo la a shad kyi gnas dang / de'i 'og tu sbyor byed rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ lus kyi rtsa 'khor drug gsal btab ste/ steng rlung mnan 'og rlung drag tu 'then te rlung gnyis kha sbyor nas bzung / lte ba'i a thung zhes pa ngo bo khrag gi dngas ma bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ rnam pa tsher ma rno sa 101

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnas bcad pa'i bcad kha gyen bstan lta bu/ reg bya tsha ba zhig gsal te/ de la rig pa gtad de bzung nas ro rkyang du rgyu ba'i rlung sems thams cad dbu mar 'drong ba'i rkyen gyis a thung lhag par 'bar te spyi bo'i haṃ yig bskul bas byang sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba rim bzhin rtsa gnas rnams su yas bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba rgyas te mar me gsos na rang 'od mched nas 'ong ba ltar snying ga'i mi shigs pa sogs dngas ma stobs su gyur/ dwangs ma de dag gi lhan cig byed rkyen gyis ye shes kyi gdangs bskul te stong gzugs kyi snang ba sna tshogs shar ba la gzhi snang zer/ de la sku mthong thob gnyis yod/ snying po sgyu ma man chad la lha sku yid ngor shar ba yin pas sku mthong ba dang / phyag rgya gcig pa man chad la/ dbu ma'i nang du bsgoms stobs kyi mig dbang gsar du grub dpe dngos su mthong bas lha sku thob pa zer/ de 'dra'i gzhi snang de nyid slob lam rnams su rim gyis lam du byas te snang ba de rgya je che je bzang je dag je brtan du song ste slob pa mtha'i 'od gsal gyi tshe/ snang ba thams cad gnyug ma'i dbyings su thim pa'am zad de dbyings de'i ngang du song tshe rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam yin/ skabs der snang ba zad pa bzhin du rang lus 'od du dwangs ba'am zad de skad cig gnyis pa nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan du bzhengs tshe rgyun mtha'i rnam grol lam zhes nam mkha' ma zhig bar du chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du sprul sku phrin las dang bcas pa 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams su spro ba ni mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu mthar thug gi dus yin no/ /mig dbang la bstan du yod pas lus snang ba 102

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adod khams/ dbang po gzugs can la bstan du yod cing mig dbang la bstanadu med pas ngag phyed snang / dbang po gzugs can la spyir bstan du med pas yin/ mi snang sogs gsung rgyun las/ yul dbang shes gsum skabs kularags pa dang / dbang po de las phra ba/ rnam shes de las kyang phra bas na/de dag la khams gsum zhes brjod do/ /'dod gzugs gzugs med rnams snga ma la ltos phyi ma dag phra ba'i khyad par dang mtshungs pas na de dag gi tha snyad sbyor/ zhes gsungs/ ༈ 'khor lo gsum gnyis sogs thad/ zin bris las/spyi bo'i thig le haṃ yig gis mtshan pa nyid dbab ldog byed pa bde ba chen po'i yeshes kyi rten byed pas de'i gnas spyi bo'i rtsa 'bor 32 la bde chen sgyu 'khor lo/ mgrin pa'i thig le bza' btung longs spyod na ro drug myong ba'i rten byed pas de'i gnas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor 16la longs spyod skyu 'khor lo/ snying ga'i mi shig pa'i thig le ni de la gnad du bsnun nas sad na rnam byang gi yon tan gyi chos mtha' dag gi rten byed pas de'i gnas rtsa 'khor 8la chos skyu 'khor lo dang / dang po/ mngal du chags pa na lte ba'i thig le chags te/ de las phung khams rags pa 'phrul ba ste mched pas na de'i rtsa 'khor 64la sprul ba 'i 'khor lo ste zhes sbyar/ zhes gsungs/ ༈ zur 'debs las/ sa bon drug po rtsa 'dabs kyi skabs sam mtha' na gnas so/ /de yang snying khong stong gi dbus na rtsa'i dwangs ma rtsa 'dab rgyus pa bldad pa 'dra ba brgyad yod pa rtsa bzhir 'dus te/ mdun gyi gsum chos nyid kyi rtsa ste skye ba med pa rang snang ba'i las byed pa/ g.yas kyi gcig ye shes kyi rtsa ste ye shes 'char ba'i las byed do/ /103

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgayon gyi gcig yon tan gyi rtsa ste mngon shes dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams snang ba'i las byed pa/ rgyab kyi gsum rang rgyud kyi rtsa ste shes pa rnams me+ong zhing 'joms pa'i las byed do/ /rtsa de dag gi sbubs na 'od bzhi dang de'i khrod na sbyang bya dang sbyong byed kyi sa bon rnam shes dang bcas pa rnams gnas te/ chos nyid kyi rtsa la 'od zlum po dkar po sbyang bya su dang dri/ sbyong byed o/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes so/ /ye shes kyi rtsa la 'od gru bzhi ser po/ sbyang bya a dang dri/ sbyong byed hūṃ/ yid kyi rnam shes/ yon tan rtsa la 'od zla gam dmar po/ sbyang bya pre dang du/ sbyong byed ā ༷ nyon mongs can gyi yid/ rang rgyud kyi rtsa la 'od gru gsum dmar nag la sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa nyid dang bcas pa gnas so/ /'dir chos nyid dang ye shes rtsa'i 'od dkar po dang ser por gnas pa dpe chung rang gnas kyi lugs te/ bi ma mi dra'i gsang thig las ni/ chos nyid ser po dang / ye shes mthing gar bshad do/ /de ltar snying ga'i dkyil 'khor rtsa chen bzhi dang ldan pa de'i nang na dwangs ma lnga'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i dbus su ye shes snying po'i thig le stong gsal 'gag med bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bzhugs te/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas na/ /zhi ba'i dkyil zhalor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /sku ni snang la rang bzhin med/ /cha phra 'od gsal snying por bzhugs/ /zhes dang / brtags gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen por gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes dang / rim lnga las/rtag tu snying la gnas pa ni/ /thig le gcig la 'gyur ba med/ /de sgom byed 104

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'iskye bo la/ /nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de la dwangs ma lnga ni gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /lnga po'ang yum lnga ye shes lnga sku lngar gnas te/rtsa'i dwangs ma ni 'byung ba sa ste/ yum spyan ma/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mngon byang gi sku'o/ /khrag gi dwangs ma chu ste ma ma gī/ mnyam nyid longs sku'o/ me'i dwangs ma ni gos dkar/ sor rtogs rdo rje'i sku'o/ /rlung gi dwangs ma ni sgrol ma/bya grub sprul sku'o/ /nam mkha'i dwangs ma ni dbyings phyug ma/ stong pa nyid chos kyi sku'o/ /ye shes snying po'i thig le ni/ rig pa'i dwangs ma sems nyid 'od gsal ba ste/ yum lnga 'dus pa bya ba mo dang / ye shes lnga 'dus pa rang byung gi ye shes dang / sku lnga 'dus pa bde gyi skur don gyis 'gyur zhing / der ma zad dwangs ma drug po'ang gnyis gnyis ro gcig tu 'jug pas phra ba'i sgo gsum mam/rdo rje mi shigs pa gsum du 'gyur te/ sa chu gnyis sku rdo rje/ me rlung gnyis gsung rdo rje/ mkha' sems gnyis thugs rdo rje ste/ dpe chung rang gnas las/ mi shigs ye shes thig le ni sogs ltar ro/ / zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun la/ rdo rje me long gi lung don/ lus can sems can kun gyi snying la gnas pa'i ye shes rgyu rkyen las 'das rang byung ye shes zag med kyi gzugs kyi skad dod/ rgyu la rang bzhin la ba'i go ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /rang bzhin rlung khams sems mi shigs pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i bde chen nam mkha' lta bu srid zhir mi gnas chos sku'i rang bzhin can no/ / zhes dang / dpe chung rang gnas lung don/ gcig dang du ma'i spros pa thams cad las 'das pa/ sna tshogs su snang yang ngo bo sgra rtog gis ji bzhin mtshon du med pa'o/ /sku sgrib byed 105

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyi las o gyi steng du gsog pa dang / zhes pa'i skabs/ nye dwangs 'di dag la rags pa pha ma'i khu khrag gi cha dang las rlung dang / der brten bag chags kyis bgo gzhi kun gzhi dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid kyi rlung khams sems bcas dang gnyis 'dod dgos pa 'dra ste/ kun rtog gis lha bsgom pa sogs kyis bag kas 'dzin pa'i phyir dang / ye shes kyi cha'i stong gzugs snang ba'i nus pa 'dzin pa sogs yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ brda bzhi dang phyag rgya bzhi'i thad/ gsung rgyun las/ brda bzhi ni/ sa ma ya stu+o nam dus la bab ces yum gyis bskul/ sa ma ya hoḥdus yin no zhes lan byin/ slar rwa ga ya r+sho bdag chags so zhes bskul/ rā ga yā ma'i chags par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan byin no/ /de ltar brda dang brda lan ma shes na mkha' 'gro'i gnas su song na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsgral nas tshogs 'khor byed par gsungs/ phyag rgya bzhis snyom par zhugs pa ni/ dza zhes pas lus kyi cha rnams reg /hūṃ zhes pas lag pa dang brla 'khyud/ bam zhes pas mkha' gsang dam du sprad/ho zhes yab kyis gsor yum gyis bskyod pa la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgug pa/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba 'ching ba/ yan lag phan tshun sdom pa bsdam pa/ yab yum bde nas tshim pa myos pa ste rags pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /dmar cha gyen du drangs ba dgug pa/ rlung gi byed bcing gis stobs kyi gcun pa 'ching ba/ thig le phyir mi ldog pa bsdam pa/ yab yum kyi gsang ba'i rnam shes bde bas tshim pa myos pa ste phra ba'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /lhan skyes gnyis 'brel ba zhes pa/ rten gyi sgo nas yab yum kyi lhan skyes gnyis/ brten pa'i sgo 106

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnas yas bab dang mas brtan gyi lhan skyes gnyis so/ /'jog tshul khyad par canagazhan gsungs so/ /zhes pa'i thad du zhal lung du/ lam rim las/ 'di ying lam sgrub sbyor ba yi/ /zhes pas/ lam gyi dus kyi dang sgrub pa'i dus kyi dang sbyor ba'i dus kyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ lta ba rtogs nas stong chen dang kun ting la gnas pa ni bsnyen pa/ phyag rgya gcig spro ni nye bsnyen/ yo byad lnga'i tshogs sgrub pa ni sgrub pa/ de 'bras zag med kyi rig 'dzin thob ma rag pa ni sgrub chen te/ lam rim las/ byang chub sems rtogs 'apyob pa ni/ /bsnyen pa'i dam pa yin pa'i phyir/ /sems chos snying rje man chad do/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /de phyir gcig dang spros pa'o/ /sgrub pa nyid ni bar chad med/ /dus kyi tshogs mtha' sgrub chen po/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ zla ba gcig la sgrub pa rdzogs pa ma yin pas zla ba drug la sogs pa ci tsam byed pa la cha brtsi ba yin mod kyi/ 'o na 'dir zla ba gcig lta bu la dper byas te brtsi na/ de las/ zla phyed phyed zhal nye bsnyen pa/ /lha gsal 'phro 'dus snang du rung / /bco lnga mar phyed sgrub pa ste/ /'phro 'du bsnol mas bsgrub par bya/ /zhag grangs tshang nas rtag byung na/ /dngos grub bzlas kyang sgrub chen po/ /zhes pas cha rkyen rnams tshogs nas sgrub pa la 'jug ma thag pa ni bsnyen pa/zhugs nas zla ba phyed yan chad ni nye bsnyen/ tha ma'i zhag gcig ma gtogs pa'i phyed man chad ni sgrub pa/ nub tha ma la dngos grub len pa ni sgrub pa chen po ste/ sgrub byang las/ rim pa shom dang 'brel ba'i phyir/ /bsnyen pa zhes su brngod pa yin/ /gsang sgor zhugs nas byin ldan pa/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa zhes su 107

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbarjod/ /gang yang bar chad mi g.yel bar/ /dam pa'i gzhung gnyis 'dzin pa na/ /sgrub pa zhes su brngod pa yin/ /rnal 'byor srod kyi rtsal 'chang ba/ /sgrub pa chen po de brngod do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ yum btsal te chas su zhugs pa ni bsnyen pa/ de byin gyis brlabs pa nye bsnyen/ rol nas dbab bzung gi dgongs pa ni sgrub pa/ nyi zla rdo rje'i lces len te ldog bkram gyi dgongs pa ni sgrub te lag len sbyor mchod bzhin no/ /de'ang lam rim las/ gsum pa mchod pa'i skabs bzhin shes/ /zhes so/ /spangs nas rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa sogs thad/ spang zhes pa mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa spang ba dang / yang na dgug pa dang bsdams pa mi shes pa spang ba'o/ /rdo rje zhes pa skyil krung ste de la gsum/lus rdo rje skyil krung gi yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /rtsa rdo rje skyil krung ni/yum gyi dbu ma'i mar sna yab kyi dbu mar drangs te sad par byas pa'o/ /rlung rdo rje skyil krung ni/ yum gyi dbu ma'i rlung yab kyi dbu mar drangs ba dang / khams rdo rje skyil krung ni/ thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa'o/ /rin po ches/ thal rgyud las/ spangs nas rdo rje dbyings phyug bcas/ /dgug dang bsdam pa ma shes na/ /zhes thabs lam 'og sgo'i skabs rtsa 'ching ba gal che gsungs pa 'di 'bor mi nyan/ zhes gsungs so// ༈ 'di la dang 'dis rtog pa zhes pa ni/rnam rtog 'di'i yul du gyur pa'am rtog pa des gzhal ba'i phung po khams dang skye mched la 'di la dang / rnam rtog 'dis rtog par byed pas na 'dis rtog pa zhes so/ /snga ma yul la yul con gyi ming gis btags pa'o/ /rtogs pa shin tu myur ba ni rnam byang gi dbang pa lnga'am nang nas gtso bor shes rab kyis 'jug 108

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa ches myur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis mtshan nyid gsum gyi bar gzhan gyis ma chod par yun shin tu thung ba la rtogs gom mthar phyin par byed pa la cig char ba zhes brjod pa yin gyi de'i rgyud kyi mtshan nyid gsum gyi snga phyi'i rim pa med pa min te/ 'gal me'i 'khor lo bzhin no/ /sbyang rno rang rno sogs zhal lung na gsal bas ma bris/ gtan tshigs kyi sna rtse tsam zhes pa rtags sgrub sogs rgyas par bkod pa la mi ltos par sbyor ba gcig bkod pa tsam gyis mngon sum du rtogs pa la go dgos gsungs/ 'dir thun min gyis kun rdzob sems bskyed kyang lta ba'i phyogs nas 'jog zhes pa'i thad/ zin bris las/ sngar gzhi rgyud skabs lugs 'dir sems dag gi gnad gsang dz+wo rje'i ye shes 'di kho na byang chub chen po'i ye shwes skyu snying por bzhed nas byang chub sems zhes byu gsungs pa de'o/ /snying po zhes pa de dngos la byed kyi sa bon lta bu la go rgyu min gsungs/ yang zhal rgyun du/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par rtogs pa'i rang lugs thun min gyi sems bskyed dang mnyam bzhag ye shes 'od gsal ba nyid brtse ba'i snying rje'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pas/ rjes thob tu rkyen phra mos bskul ba'i sgo nas 'gro kun gnas lugs ji lta bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa'i sgo nas 'khrul rtog glo bur ba bsal nas bdag gi sems can ched du sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa rang shugs la 'ong ba ni thun mong sems bskyed kyang tshang bar gsungs so/ /gsung rgyun la/ 'dir thun min gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed ces pa/ snang cha sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rtogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ma dag pa'i zhen 109

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsnang gtan la phab pas chos nyid gtan la phebs par 'gyur ba'i skabs/ sgyu 'phrul 'di'i skabs kyi snang zhen gcod lugs ni/ rin po ches gter chen la gsungs pa/ des nyi ma sprin gyis bsgrib pa'i skabs 'od drod dang ldan pa yin kyang / sgrib byed sprin gyi dbang gis 'od zer drod ldan du mi 'char ba yin la/sprin dang bral tshe 'od zer mtha' dag drod dang ldan par dngos su 'char la/ de yang sngar drod med gsar du drod dang ldan par song ba min par tha snyad kyi yin tshul gsal ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'char gzhi'i 'od gsal ba'i rig pa nyid tshogs brgyad glo bur ba'i sprin gyis sgrib tshe/ sems kun gyi gshis ye shes yin par mi snang bar ma dag rang rgyud par snang zhing zhen la/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas snying dbus kyi 'od gsal sad nas mngon du gyur tshe/ de'i ngor sems thams cad 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba ni/ dpe gser gling du phyin pa lta bu yin la/ 'di dus yul nas thams cad ye shes 'ba' zhig tu shar ba ni/ sngar ye shes min pa gsar du ye shes su song ba min par gnas lugs ji bzhin pa nyid mngon du gyur ba yin no/ /rig pa sad stobs kyis yul can thams cad ye shes su shar yul yang ye shes kyi ngor snang bas yul gyi steng na ma dag pa bsal rgyu med par thams cad dag pa 'ba' zhig las med pa myong bas grub pa yin no/ /zhen snang ni rjes thob rgya yan pa'i ngor snang sems rang rgyud pa zhakhrul rtog tu snang ba 'di tsam las gzhan med pas/ ngo shes ma shes tsam mam/rig pa sad ma sad tsam mam/ zhes gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad chos can dang / de'i rang bzhin chos nyid kyi ye shes gnyis ni/110

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgacig tha dad gang du dang khas blang bya min par/ dgongs 'grel las/ 'du byed khams dang don dam mtshan nyid ni/ /gcig dang tha dad bral pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /gcig dang tha dad du yang gang rtog pa/ /de dag tshul min lta la zhugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung bzhin klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs la/de'i phyir de gnyis tha snyad du gcig ma yin te/ sems rtogs pa tsam gyis sems kyi chos nyid ye shes mi rtogs pa dang / chos can dang chos nyid yin pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ /don dam par tha dad min te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes yin pas/ ye shes rtogs dus sems kyang de las tha dad du ma dmigs pa'i phyir dang / ye shes rtogs tshe sems rang grol du 'char ba sogs kyi phyir na'o/ /zhes so/ /'di thad/ bla ma 'jigs 'od nyid kyi zhal rgyun la gsung sgros thun min ltar na/ ye shes rang dbang gi snang ba chos can/ dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu gnas pa yin te/ de'i snang cha la ma dag pa'i snang ba ma dmigs pa'i phyir zhes dang / dpal sprul gsung rgyun la/ snang ba 'di chos can/lha yin te/ ye shes rang snang yin pa'i phyir/ 'di skabs kyi lha ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug gi ye shes nyid yin la/ lha de nyid tshogs brgyad kyi rnam par bzhengs pa'i ye shes rang snang gi cha yin pa'i phyir zhes par go dgos zhes dang /rdzogs chen lugs la snang ba thams cad kyi chos nyid rig stong 'dus ma byas pa de 'bras bu yongs dag lha'i ngo bor dang po ngo shes/ bar du yang yang bskyangs bas rtsal rdzogs pa'i thabs la slob cing / mthar brtan pa thob tshe sgom stobs kyis snang ba lhar grub pa'am shar ba yin no/ /bshad pa mang pos snang ba lhar 111

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmi 'grub kyi/ dang po sems dang rig pa gnyis su phye nas rig pa rkyang ded du bskyang ba ni snang ba lhar sgrub pa'i sgo yin/ bar du snang lugs 'khrul ba cung zad log nas sems rig gnyis med chu dang rlabs ltar mthong nas sems rig gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrogs lhod pas rtsal gyi 'char sgo la dgag sgrub mi dgos par gu yangs la blo bde ba'i dbyings kyi nam mkha' la rig pa'i mkha' lding g.yo ba na snang ba lhar 'grub pa'i mgo rtsom pa yang yin/ mthar brtan pa thob pa mthar thug pa na gser gling du sa rdo phal ba btsal kyang mi rnyed pa sems rig dang chu rlabs ltar rtogs par ma zad/ snang sems kyang de ltar rtogs pa dang gnas lugs dang snang lugs ma bu 'phrod de snang lugs kyi 'khrul cha dbyings su zad pa na slob lam gyi snang ba lhar sgrub mthar thug yin zhing / mthar rig pa dbyings su 'khyil/ rig gdangs sku dang zhing khams su smin/ rig rtsal rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su grol ba na snang ba lhar grub pa bla na med pa'o//zhes gsungs so/ /zin bris las/ thag khra sprul du snang ba chos can/ ji ltar snang ba ltar gyi sprul gyis gdod nas stong ste/ khyod yul mi gsal ba sogs kyi rkyen las snang gzhi thag pa la sprul du bzung ba'i snang ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ /don ni log rtog zhabrul ba'i dmigs yul du gyur ba'i ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched chos can/ ji ltar snang ba ltar grub pas gdod nas ye nas stong ste/khyod gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi snang ba las phyir gol te ma rig pa mched phyin chad kyi snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zhal rgyun yin/ zhes so/ /ston pa chos longs rdo rje mngon byang gi sku bzhi dang / 'khor ye shes rgya mtsho sogs bzhi po rnams ni 112

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang gro' gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃldog chas phye la/ sku de dag rang rang gi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa'i stobs kyis/ 'khor rnams kyi sku de dang cha 'dra ba'i rtogs pa khyad par can thob pas/ rang rang gi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa la gsung gis brda sprad pa'i tha snyad sbyar ba yin no/ /chos sku'i chos thams cad skye ba med pa la mnyam par bzhag pas 'khor gyis kyang de dang cha 'dra rtogs pa dang / longs skus sku gsum ngo bo dbyer med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pas me long la pra phab pa ltar longs sku mthong ba tsam gyis rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa phra mo ngos zin pa dang / rdo rje'i skus sku gsum ngo bo dbyer med pa la mnyam par bzhag pas 'khor rnams lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med kyi don dang / mngon byang gi sku lnga ye shesalnga'i ldog cha tha dad pa la dgongs pa gtad pas 'khor rnams spros pa mtha' dag gi sbubs las grol ba'i 'od gsal mngon sum rtogs gsungs/ longs skus smin pa zhes pa gsung rgyun las/ rgyun mtha' ba des longs sku mthong ba tsam gyi rang rgyud kyi dri ma ngos zin no/ /sprul skus mos pa zhes pa mos spyod pa rnams la'o/ /zhes dang / sku gsum dbyer med kyi cha nas dang sku gsum gyi ldog cha ma 'dres pa'i cha nas rdo rje dang mngon byang gi sku'o/ /zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa dpal sprul nas/ spyir dbang rnon ni rtags sam gtan tshigs tsam la brten pa'i shes rab kyis grol ba dang / 'dir dngos lnga sogs kyi ye shes mtshon nas rtogs pas grol tshul gnyis dbyibs mtshungs du yod pas dngos lha sogs gtan tshigs mtshan nyid pa dang 'adha ba las btags te/zhes so/ /bzhed pa gnyis po gang la'ang 'thad mi 'thad kyi cha gnyis zhes pa/113

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasung rgyun las/ zhen snang med ces pa mi 'thad de/ shes sgrib phra mo yod pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs min zhes pa 'thad ldan no/ /zhen snang gcad rgyu yod ces pa 'thad/ gtan tshigs dngos yin gsungs pa mi 'thad/ de gtan tshigs btags pa ba yin no/ /zhes dang / skye med mtshoni pa zhes pa/ nam mkha' mthong ba tsam gyis chos rnams skye med du rtogs pa dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan gyi dri ma mthong ba tsam gyis rang rgyud kyi dri ma ngos zin pa dang / nyi ma'i snying po mthong ba tsam gyi gsal ba'i ye shes mngon sum rtogs pa dang / brag cha thos pa tsam gyi grags stongs dbyer med kyi don rtogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshangs dbyangs gcig thos pa'i tshe na rang gi mos pa shes nus pa bzhin dngos po gcig nyid mthong ba'i tshe na/ dgongs don sna tshogs shes nus so/ /zhes gsungs/ ldem dgongs brda'i tshig sogs thad/ zhal rgyun du/ khams gsum gyi srog gcad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i nang du rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba la go ba dang chos thams cad brag cha lta bu'o/ /nyin par gyi snang ba nyi ma las gzhan du ma gyur ba'o/ /zhes pa dag longs sku'i dang dbyer med dang / mngon byang gi gsung gi mtshan gzhir bzhag gsung / tshig don mthun pa'i gtan tshigs kyi skabs su sgra mi 'gal zhes pa'i don ni/ ci yang min pa dang / yin pa gnyis tshig 'gal ba ltar ma yin pa go ba las/ gzhan tshig don mi mthun pa ni/rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos 'gal ba la go na 'gal rtags mtshan nyid par 'gyur bas/ tshig don mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag gzhag tu med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gtan tshigs thad/ mi pham rin po ches mdzad pa'i man 114

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃngag lta phreng gi mchan 'grel nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ rgyu gcig par rtogs pa dang / yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang / byin gyis rlabs kyi rtogs pa dang /mngon sum par rtogs pa'o/ /de yang rtogs pa bzhi 'di la rim cig char gnyis kyi bshad pa 'byung yang 'dir rdzogs pa chen po rang byung gi ye shes thig le nyag gcig tu gtan la phebs pas cig char ba ltar du bshad do/ /de la rgyu ste rang bzhin nam gzhi gcig par rtogs pa ni chos thams cad don dam par ma skyes pas zhes ma skyes pa'i rang bzhin du so so ma yin pa dang / kun rdzob tu snang ba bden stong sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du so so ma yin pa ni theg pa chen po thun mo nga du grags pa dang / ma skyes pa nyid ma skyes bzhin du chu zla ltar sgyu ma dag sna tshogs su snang zhing rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pa dang / sgyu ma ltar snang ba nyid snang bzhin du'ang ngo bo med de ma skyes pas na kun rdzob dang don dam par dbyer med pas zung 'jug rang byung gi ye shes rgyu gcig par rtogs pa ni lung zab mo las drang ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /mdor na rang byung ye shes byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ni snang stong dbyer mi byed pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ zhabor 'das thams cad de'i tshul gcig las mi 'da' ba ni rgyu gcig pa'o/ /yig 'byu'i tshul gyis rtogs pa ni de lta bu'i snang stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin de nyid kyang gdod ma nas sku gsung thugs 'bras bu'i chos su sangs rgyas par bstan pa ste/de la chos thams cad ma skyes pa ni a yis mtshon te gsung gi rang bzhin/ ma skyes pa nyid sgru mar snang zhing bya ba byed nus pa ni o yis mtshon te sku'i rang bzhin/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rig pa sgyu ma'i ye shes mtha' dbus med pa ni o 115

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgyis mtshon te thugs kyi rang bzhin du rtogs pa'o/ /de yang gdod nas snang stong zung 'jug gi ye shes de la bsal bzhag gi bri gang nam yang med cing / de nyid rang bzhin rnam par dag pas 'khor ba ye sangs po yin la/ de nyid kyi rol ba ni gdod nas dkyil 'khor gsum du gnas pa yin par ni yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'o/ /byin gyis rlabs kyis rtogs pa ni/ rtogs pa rnam pa gnyis po de'i mthu dang byin rlabs shes pa ste/ dper na ras dkar po la dmar por byin gyis rlob pa'i mthu btsod ma yod pa bzhin tu/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs pa'i mthu yang rgyu gcig pa dang —yig 'bru'i tshul gyi mthus byin gyis brlabs par shes shing rtogs pa'o/ /de la chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin mod kyi rtogs pa gnyis dang mi ldan pa rnams la/ des phan 'dogs par mi 'gyur la/ de gnyis dang ldan na ni phan thogs par snang bar 'gyur bas/ rtogs pa gnyis kyi mthus chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlabs pa ltar snang bar 'gyur bas byin gyis brlabs par rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon sum par rtogs pa ni/spyir dbang po'i mngon sum sogs yod kyang 'dir shes rab kyi dbang po'i mngon sum ste/ de yang so sor rtog pa'i shes rab nyid la go bar bya ste/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par gnas pa de yang yin zhes pa'i lung dang bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang 'gal ba'ang ma yin pa ste/ dper na bsregs bcad brdar bas gser yin min/ skyon yod med/ gser bzang ngan shes pa bzhin du/ lung gis spyi la mi 'khrul/ lung la drang nges ldem dgongs sna tshogs 116

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa la man ngag gis de'i skyon bsal bas yid ches lung dang man ngag yod kyang tshig tsam gyi sgra phyir 'brangs bas blo'i gting du nyams su ma lon pa yang yod pas/lung dang man ngag gi tshig tsam la brten pa'ang ma yin par so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab bam rang gi rig pas blo'i gting du yid ches pas mngon sum du rtogs pa'o//zhes 'dis ni lung gi don spyi phyin ci ma log pa shes par 'gyur la/man ngag gis lung gi dgongs pa gzhan du 'dren pa gcod cing /shes rab kyis mngon sum du rtogs pas thos pa tsam la sogs pa nyid du zhen pa sel zhing gcod par byed pa yin no//de ltar lam gyis yid ches pa ni/rtogs pa rnam bzhi'i don de nyid shes shing rig pa nyid rnal 'byor ba'i lam ste/de'ang mtshan nyid theg par rgyu sngon du bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid kyis nam zhig na 'byung ba'i dus la ltos pa lta bu ma yin gyi/da lta nyid du shes rab kyi dbang pos rang gis mngon sum du rtogs shing yid ches pa'o//zhes dang /rin po ches/yongs su dag pa'i lha sku thams cad skyed pa'i sa bon ni gsang sngags kyi yi ge ste/sangs rgyas thams cad ming tsam la gnas pa la gtug nas le'u bzhi par rgyas bshad mdzad/phung sogs cir snang thams cad skyed pa'i sa bon ni chos kyi dbyings sam sems kyi gnyug ma'i khams te/'dir 'od gsal gyi bsam mi khyab bam mi rtogs pa'am spros pa med pa'i bzhugs tshul gyi cha'o//de nyid ni yid skyob pa'i man+d+ra thams cad kyi mthar thug ste/phyag rdor dbang bskur du chos kyi dbyings la lha sngags phyag rgya sogs mang por brtags nas dngos grub kyi don byed par gsungs pa lta bu/7de glo bur ba'i spros pas stong ba'am

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdag pa yin cing / gang snang thams cad de'i ngang las mched pa ni snang ba thams cad ka nas dag pa'i mched bzhi'i sa bon mthar thug nas dag pa dang gdod nas dag pa'o/ /de'i phyir dbyings de ni sa bon gyi sngags de la/ de'i rnam 'gyur rang snang ris med sngags kyis mig basbrur ba'i rang snang gi sgyu ma lta bur mched na ni lha'i sku ste os mtshon/ de ltar dbyings dang de nyid snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba thams cad sngags bla med kyi rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi dkyil 'khor gcig tu'am rang bzhin rnam dag gi sku gsung ngam lha sngags kyi yo lang kho na gnas pa de rtogs byed kyi thugs ni yin gyi rnal 'byor gyi dus na min gsungs pa dang / g.yung gis snga ma snga ma'i rgyun gyis phyi ma phyi ma bstan yod snang shar ba dpyod ces dang / yang rgyu gcig pa'i skabs ma dag pa na ye shes kyi bzhugs tshul ltar na ri rwa lta bu dang / dag pa'ang snang tsam las med pa yin pas dbyings ngor gang yang ma grub pa la go dgos/ rgyu gcig gi gtan tshigs la brten nas rgyud 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i don dam dkor bdun gyi bdag nyid dbyings mngon sum du rtogs te gnyis chos spros mtshan gyis dben par rtogs pa dang / de yang ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rtogs pa dang / ma dag pa thams cad las 'das pa'i shin tu dag pa'i bdag nyid can du gzigs pas/ dbyings ye 'bras bu don dam dngos su rtogs pa ste/ de yang rgyud 'di'i dbang du btang nas zab mo'i lam dang mthar thug chos sku thams cad 'di ngo 'phrod pa kho nas 'ong gsungs/ yig 'bru'i gtan tshigs skabs/ ngo bo nyid ye med na chos thams cad ji ltar snang zhe na/118

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃming tsam gyis bzhag pas na yi ge'i rnam 'phrul tsam mo/ /yi ge de'ang gnas snang mi mthun pa'i 'khrul ba phyin ci log gis bslad nas gtan ma zhugs na des gang btags dang cir sprul gyi snang ba thams cad kyang snang tshul phyin ci log las 'das pa'i shin tu rnam dag gi snang ba 'ba' zhig tu zad pas snang srid thams cad gdod ma'i sdod tshul la gsungs/ gsang sngags kyi sgyu 'phrul kho nar gnas te gsung gsang sngags kyi yi ge bya ba phyin log gis bslad pa dang bral ba'i dag pa'i yi ge dag pa rab 'byams kyi rnam 'phrul dang byed las can de la byed pas so/ /snang tshul sems rang snang gi yi ge la 'khrul ba'i ming tshig mtha' med srid kyang gnas tshul ye shes rang snang gi ming drig la gsang sngags kyi yi ge'i sprin min pa med pa'o/ /'di le'u bzhi pa dang / yig 'bru'i gtan tshigs skabs mkho min dpyod/ ces gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/ yig 'bru'i tshul gyis gtan tshigs dpe rang snang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum mthong ste/ lam gyi skabs rgya che ba sangs rgyas gzugs sku'i dngos rgyu dang /'bras bu'i skabs kyi gzugs sku mthar thug pa nyid 'di ngo 'phrod pa la ltos/grol lam cig char ba'i thad na/ sku gsung thugs su snang ba'i dag pa'i chos kun ma lus gsung o yig rol bar mtshon nas rtogs/ 'di la dper brjod/ sems nyid chos can/ gshis dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ yo bzhin zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar yi ge a u ma gsum gyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mtshon la/ de'ang a yig gis ni dbyings ci yang ma yin pa mtshon la/klad gor gyis dbyings la ye shes 'bral mi srid ces pa'i ye shes mtshon la/119

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ.u yig gis ni ye shes la snang cha lhun grub tu yod pa mtshon no/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtan tshig thad/ 'dir bden gnyis dbyer med kyi tshul mngon sum du rtogs pa ni/ lam dus sku thugs zung 'od gsal rang gi mkhyen cha'am rig pa'i cha ste/ des rtogs tshul yang dbyings dang yul snang gnyis char rig cha nyid las mi gzhan par mngon du gyur nas rtogs bya gnyis ka rtogs byed kyi klong du rdzogs pa a o gnyis char oṃ la rdzogs pa lta bu'o/ /oṃ gyi don ni/gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems la ltos/ /snang ba thams cad rang snang yin/ /ye shes rig pa ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa dang gcig red/rtogs dus snang rig dbyings gsum khyab brdal du 'dres nas mtha' dbus med pa'i 'od gsal du 'gyur bar ma zad dbyings ma rtogs rang snang snod bcud rgyud gsum rang rgyud par zhen pa'i dus nyid nas shes pas gar khyab rig pa'i bdag nyid gcig gis tshul gyis khyab cing rig pa rang gi ngo bo bzang ngan du mi 'gyur bar mtha' dang dbus med pa ste zab cing rgya che/ rgya chad phyogs lhung med par gdal ba ste/sems rang snang rnams sems rang snang dang ye shes rang snang gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i ye shes rang snang min yang / mthar gtug na ye shes kyi rang snang yin dgos/ rang snang zhes pa'i skor thams cad snang ba snang yul gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i snga ma rang la sbyar na 'grigs che/ kun mkhyen chen pos snang ba 'di rnams bag chags smin pa'i snang char bshad pa'ang de ltar dgos/ snang yul dag ma dag gam phyin ci log yin min snang ba dag min gyis phye ba thal 'gyur ba'i yang log rnam bzhag dang kun rdzob bden pa gnas snang mi mthun pa'i steng nas 120

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbashad lugs lta bu ste zhar byung ngo / /rang snang thams cad dag pa'i lha'i rang bzhin nam ngo bo nyid yin lugs ni/ dag pa'i dus su rnam snang du 'ong rgyu de ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis bslad tshe tha mal ba'i gzugs phung du 'char ba rdzogs so/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la rtogs pa bzhi'i yid ches tshul yang gtso bor 'di dang rgyu gcig pa gnyis su snang / rgyu gcig par chos thams cad ces pa ni gong du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ces pa dang gcig red/ don dam 'od gsal gyi dbyings la 'jig 'das kyi mtshan ma'am spros pa gnyis char mi dmigs/ kun rdzob rang snang gi ngor de gnyis so so'i bya ba byed nus su shar ba'i rten 'brel du mnyam/ de gnyis dbyer med du mnyam pa rnams red pas 'dis mnyam pa dang / yig 'bru'i dag par rtogs pa bstan 'dra/ 'di'i stong mnyam snang mnyam gnyis char dbu ma ltar mi 'jog par bla med lugs kho na ltar 'char ba 'di gtsang ṭīka na gsal/ mnyam lugs snga ma gnyis thun mong ba dang / phyi ma gcig thun min du rong 'grel gnyis na snang ba ni srid zhi gnyis bden mnyam rdzun mnyam tsam thun mong theg par yang bzhed kyang / de gnyis bden pa gnyis kar 'od gsal las phyi rol du ma gyur bar gcig pa'am dbyer med pas bzang ngan med par mnyam pa 'di bla med kyi thun min yin zer ram snyam ste/ kun rdzob tu'ang dbyer med de/ /lta ba mtho dman de tsam mo/ /zhes pa lta bu red dam brtag /don dam ma skyes pa a dang / kun rdzob sgru ma/ o gnyis rig pa 'od gsal gcig pur rdzogs pa'i o 'di bden gnyis dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen po zer rgyu de yin pa 'dra/121

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbyin gyis brlabs par rdzogs pa'i thad dpe la lar ye nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlabs pa'i zhes snang yang / ye nas zhes pa med pa'i dpe dag par snang / de'ang rtogs pa snga ma gnyis kyi phung por byin gyi rlob nus pa ste/ rtogs pa de dag gi stobs kyis rtogs bya'i don de dag mngon du gyur 'ong ba'o/ /de'ang rtogs pa gnyis po'i stobs kyis ma dag pa'i lam tha mal ba'i snang zhen glo bur ba gnyis ka nub nas gzhi dus su gzugs tshor sogs tha mal gyi snang bar 'ong rgyu de rnam snang rin 'byung sogs kyi snang zhen du go 'pho ba skye shi bar do sku gsum du sgyur zhing rlobs pa lta bu/ de'ang ras dkar po lta bu ni phung sogs rang bzhin rnam dag /dmar po ni glo bur rnam dag gam rtogs pa mngon gyur/btsod ni rtogs pa gnyis red/ ras nag po sogs la tshos kha chen po gzhan du sgyur mi btub/ dkar po kho na gang 'dod du btub/ de bzhin tu gang snang thams cad rang snang ris med yin pa'i gnad kyis yongs su dag pa'i lhar bsgyur nus pa sna tshogs nor bu lta bu red/ de'ang snang ba yin tshad mthar gtug na ye shes rang snang kho nar nges pa la thug /lar skye 'chi bar do'ang thabs mkhas kyi zin na sku gsum du 'ong zhes pa tsam gyis 'di'i lugs kyi lhar sgrub la dran pa rnyed dka'/ de'i kha bskor phyogs bsgrur nas gdod nas sku gsum dngos su 'ong rgyu de 'khrul rgyus rnyog nas tha mal ba'i skye shi bar dor 'char zhes pa'i stong bas 'gro dgos/ 'dir sgyu ma ngal gso'i le'u dang por ma dag gzhan dbang nub ste dag pa'i gzhan dbang 'ong tshul gsungs pa'ang dran par bya/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa gsum po'ang thos bsam rkyang bas go yul tsam gyis ni gong du 122

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la rtogs pa bzhi'i lam gyis yid ches zhes gsungs pa'iyid ches mtshan nyid rdzogs par mi 'gyur gyi rtogs pa de gsum gyi don thos shing bsam nas 'di cig char ba red pas rtogs pa mthur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis me dang spra ba phrad pa ltar snang sems rang rgyud par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs rang zhig ste rig pa yul med rang gsal du bud pa'i steng nas dag mnyam chen po'i bzhugs tshul la myong stobs kyis gting sleb pa las yid ches rnyed pa shes nas dad pa thob pa zhes pa lta bur gyur dus/ lta ba'i lag rjes 'jog thub pa red pas shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi lam dngos la slebs pa'o/ /'di ni mngon sum par rtogs pa ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la yid ches pa zhes pa'i rtogs par 'jogs pa la rtogs pa snga ma gsum po'i khyad par 'di lta bu dgos zhes bye brag tu phye nas bstan pa'o/ /rong zom pas so sor rtog pa'i dus na zung 'brel du slob pa dang / mthar thug sku thugs zung 'jug gi dngos rgyu 'di yin pas 'di la sgyu lus sgrub tshul lta bu med par rang lugs kyi sbru 'phrul drwa ba'i sku 'di nyid ngo 'phrod pa gal che gsungs/ bden gnyis dbyer med rtogs byed nyid 'od gsal pa'i ye shes blo bral nyid yin par bstan pa 'di lam so so rang rig pa'i ye shes dang mthar thug rgyal ba'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyid bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di skor rgyas pa gtan tshigs kyi 'grel ba bka' drin 'khor du med pa rje btsun bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa las shes par bya'o// ༈ rin po ches/ g.yo med sgyi dgong pa shar ba na/ de 'dra'i rnal 'byor ba de'i blo ngor chos thams cad dbyer med du sangs rgyas pa de gdod gzhon nu 123

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃma'i sogs — dbu ma'i skabs su stong pa dang rten 'byung gnyis gcig grogs su gcig song ba bzhin du/ 'dir dbyings ci yang ma yin pa'i gnad kyis cir yang snang ba dang / cir yang snang ba'i gnad kyis dbyings ci yang ma yin pa ni gnad kyi dbyings su ci yang ma yin pa ni ches shin tu 'thad gsungs/ snod bcud rgyud gsum zhes pa'i thad/ rgyud rnam shes tshogs brgyad ni/ grub mtha' mdzod las/ de'ang kun gzhi ni rtog med dwangs ma phyed pa lung ma bstan yin pa/kun gzhi'i rnam shes gsal ba tsam ris su ma chad par gnas pa'i cha zhes dang /yang rtog pa dang dpyod pa chags sdang ni yid shes dang nyon yid ces dang /dwangs ma phyed pa'i rtogs med kun gzhi/ cung zad gsal dwangs tsam kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ gzugs sgra sogs yul lnga rags pa dang dbang shes so so ma snang ba sgo lnga'i rnam shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa/ngo bo mi rtog pa'i cha nas kun gzhi/ rig tsam gsal tsam gyi cha nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ shes pa gcig la ldog pas phye ba yin pa 'dra la/ kun gzhi 'thib shing dwangs ma phye ba/ de las cung dwangs ba sgo lnga ma mched pa'i skabs kyi shes pa me+ongs pa la kun gzhi'i rnam shes zer ba 'dra ba zhig kyang thos pa 'dra yang / snga ma nyid legs pa yin snyam mo/ /'di dag gnas gyur ye shes lngar 'gyur tshul ni/grub mtha' mdzod kyi theg chen lam gyi 'bras bu rten sku brten pa ye shes 'chad skabs la/ ma dag pa'i dus kyi rnam shes tshogs brgyad rten kun gzhi dang bcas pa log pas ye shes su shar ba la/ kun gzhi dag pas chos dbyings/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag pas me long lta bu'i ye shes/ yid dag pas mnyam pa nyid/ nyon yid dag 124

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpas so sor rtogs pa/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes dag nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/sku gsum la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ kun gzhi dbyings su nub pa ni chos kyi dbyings so/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes dbyings su nub pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dbyings su nub pa ni/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /zhes so/ /'di dag gnas 'gyur zhes pa'ang snang tshul gyi ma dag pa'i cha ye shes su shar ba la go ba las nyon mongs rang mtshan ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba mi srid de ye shes dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir dang / spang byar bshad pa'ang snang tshul la dgongs pa dang / ye shes lnga po lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i khams kyi yon tan yin pas da gsar du sgrub dgos rgyu zhig rang lugs su 'dod pa'i mkhas grub su yang med pas na/ ngo bo gdod nas ye shes su 'dod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun la/ sems nyid chos can/ gshis dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ dper na o bzhin/ zhes pa lta bu'i cig char du lhag bden gnyis rtogs gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/ yum lha dang yab lha zhes pa/ 'byung bzhi'i reg bya ste yul yin pas yum la bzhag pa dang / 'byung gyur gzugs kyi phung po ni yul can yin pas yab la bzhag go/ /gzugs phung tsam yang tshor ba sogasaḥ zhes pa/ gzugs phung gcig gis yang phung po'i phyi ma rnams kyi don byed nus pas na ro mnyam zhes brngod pa/ gzung phung de la tshor phung zhes mi brdo+od de ldog cha tha dad du 'jog dgos so/ /dpyad rgyu che yang zhes pa/ mdo 125

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃphyogs nas gshegs snying bstan pas 'dir bstan gyi ye shes bstan par 'dod dgos so/ /'dod na lhag pa'i kun rdzob bden pa bstan par yang 'dod dgos/'dod na thun min bden gnyis 'jog par dka' yang / skyon med pa'i tshul ni/rgyud bla ma'i bshad bya rtsa bar bstan pa'i mdo bzhi ni/ gshegs snying bstan pa'i mdo/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i mdo/ dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo/ byams pa seng ges zhus pa'i mdo rnams dmigs bsal du byas nas/mdo phyogs spyir btang la ltos te thun min du 'jog pa lo chen gyis bzhed pa'o//rmā sgyu de nyid ces pa zin bris las/ dbyengs bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba yum dbyings phyug ma yin la/ de'i sa bon rmā dang / de'i de nyid dbyings yin pas der bsdus pa la chos de dag snyi gyi de nyid sogs zhes dang /grub mtha' ni/'jal byed rtags sam gtan tshigs rnams la brten nas/ gzhal bya dag ma dag gi tshogs don de nyid gdod nas rnam dag tu shar ba la grub mtha' (nyer)/zhes gsungs/ lam rim las/ rgya mtsho dwangs ba'i sogs/ rlung rkyen gyis byung pa'i rlabs sogs dang phral ba'i rgya mtsho dwangs ba'i nang du gza' skar gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar du sgra la brten pa'i don spyi yid la byed pa'i rtog pas yul 'jal ba ltar min par gnas lugs mtshan nyid pa de so so rang ri ga pa'i mngon sum gyis dmigs gtad kyi yul dang bral bar sems nyid rang gsal gyi tshul du sgro skur lung ma bstan gsum mam/ lta ba'i yul/ blta byed kyi mkhan po/ lta ba dngos gsum dang bral bar mthong ba dang / kun rtog gi grub mtha' gzhan gyis mi bsgul ba'am dkri mi nus pa'i nges pa gting nas rnyed 126

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'ilta ba la gdengs sgyu byas pa ste gdengs bcas te thos bsam brtan po sogs sngon du song nas sgom pa la lta ba mthar phyin pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /zhal rgyunadu/ sgra tshi+og la brten pa dang kun rtog gi yid la byed nus pa min par/rang rig mngan sum 'di dang 'di' snyam pa lta bu'i dmigs bral ba rang gsal gsum bral rtogs bya rtogs byed rtogs pa pos mi bsgul bar ram ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyis mi bskul bar yid ches pa sa gdengs su gang byas pa thos bsam brtan pa'i lta ba mthar phyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ lam gyi 'od gsal shar na chos nyid kyi dbyings mngon sum du mthong bas ma khyab pas/zhes pa'i thad du/ zhal rgyun du/ 'od gsal nyid mngon du gyur yang / dpe sprin srab mos sgrib pa'i nyi ma lta bu sbyor lam gyi dus dang / 'phags sa nas kyang yongs rdzogs mthong ba ni sangs rgyas kyi sa las mi 'ong ste/ mdor na dbyings ye gnyis ka'i yin lugs ci bzhin pa mngon du gyur pa ni sangs rgyas pa'i sa las mi 'ongs zhes gsungs so// ༈ mi pham rin po ches/ don gyi ye shes zla ba lta bu mngon du mthong ba'i tshe na don gyi ye shes dngos mthong ba yin yang / tshes gcig zla ba zla ba dngos yin kyang da dung bco lnga'i bar rgya cher mthong ba yod pa bzhin/ sgom pa'i lam du don gyi ye shes mthong ba cher 'phel te/ mthar thug bco lnga'i zla ba mthong ba ltar mthong ba yongs su rdzogs pa sangs kyi go 'phang 'grub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ rin po ches/ tshad pheb dus ngo bo'i steng du btsan sa zin pa yin par gsungs/ lhun grub ye shes sgron ma nyid/ /rang bzhin gsal ba spyan gyi mchog /ces pa'i thad/ 'jigs 'od zhal rgyun las/ rang 127

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhin gsal ba spyan gyi mchog /ces pas gsal ba'i rang bzhin 'dir bstan dbyings yin zhing / dbyings mngon sum du gzigs pas shes rab kyi spyan gzhan las mchog ces pa red/ yid las 'das pa'i shes rab zhes pa'i yid glo bur ba'i shes rab dang / de las 'das pa'i shes rab gnyug ma'i shes rab yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ gsang 'dus sogs thad zin bris las/ stong gzhi'i rlung sems las dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i sku sgrub tshul gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud sde dngos sam de dang brjod bya phyogs mthun gang rung gi rgyud de pha rgyud/ pha rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud/ thabs kyi rgyud/ mkha' 'gro pha'i rgyud rnams don gcig rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung pa'i don de bden pa dang ro gcig du gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes gtso bor ston zhing sgyu ma'i sku sgrub tshul gtso bor mi ston pa'i rgyud sde dngos sam de dang brjod bya phyogs mthun gang rung gi rgyud de ma rgyud/ ma rgyud rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyud rnams don gcig /bden stong gnyis med kyi rgyud sde dngos sam de dang brjod bya phyogs mthun gang rung gi rgyud kyi rgyud de gnyis med rgyud/ de dang ma ning gi rgyud don gcig /stong pa snang ba/shin tu stong pa mched pa/ rab tu stong pa thob pa/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal/ zhes so/ /dag rdzogs smin gsum zhes pa/ mar skye 'chi bar do gsum dag /yar 'bras bu sku gsum rdzogs pa ste/ dgag sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jog pa dang / smin pa ni bskyed rim de nyid rdzogs rim smin byed kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'o/ /de yang bskyed rim gyi stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor dang / snying rje sgyu ma nas bzung ste spros bcas kyi 128

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbar 'bras bu chos gzugs gnyis kyi brgyud rgyu byed pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi 'od gsal dang stong gzugs gnyis kyi 'bras bu chos gzugs gnyis kyi dngos rgyu byed pa'o/ /dngos phywa sgyur ba'i laX zhes pa/ rdzogs rim yin la/ rgyun rma/tha'i bar chad med lam gyi rnam grol lam la 'phos nas 'bras bu lam la nying ma/tshams sbyor ba'o rdzogs pazhi bskyedu pa zhes pa/ stong chen la goms pas 'od gsal mngon tu gyur te/ rjes su snying rje sgyu ma sgom/ pa lta bu/ bskyed palngi rdzogs ༷ zhes pa bskyed rim gyi snying rje sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas/ rdzogs rim kyi ye shes la go 'phos nas ma bcos pa'i snying rje sgyu mar song ba lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs/ lha zhe gnyis zhes pa/ rig lnga yab yum bcu/ sems dpa' yab yum 16/ kun bzang yab yum 2/ thub pa(tsho/ sgo ba yab yum brgyad dang zhe gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun las/ spyi mgrin snying gar rnam snang spyan gzigs mi bskyod rgyal po/ dkar/ dmar/ mthing / 'khor lo/ pad+ma/rdo rje 'dzin pa longs sku'i chas can/ ye shes sems dpa' rgyan dang phyag mtshan spang ba dang / rnam snang sogs rigs tha dad bzhi'i gco bo rdo rje mi bskyod pa gcig tu gyur pa'i rab tu phye ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rang gi rigs chung gis bskor ba'i rigs tha mi dad pa'i gtso bo so sos byed pa tshom bur bshad do/ /rigs chung gi sems dpa' bzhi bcu'i mtshan sdom ni/ dbus kyi rigs chung sems dpa' rdo rje dang / /de bzhin rin chen chos dang las bzhi'i yum/ / rim bzhin brtan 'bar sdud bskyod bzhi po sbyar/ /sems dpa' rgyal po chags pa legs bzhi shar/ /yum ni sgeg mo bdug pa lcags kyu sgron/ /rin chen nyi ma rgyal 129

g.yu khog bla mchos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum / hūṃmatshan bzhad bzhi lho/ /yum ni ma le me tog zhags bde ma/ /chos dang rnon po 'khor 'e1 smra ba nub/ /yum ni glu sgron lcags sgrogs gsal bkra ma/ / las dang srung ba gnod sbyin khu tshur byang / /gar byug dril khrol 'bebs ma yum bzhi ste/ /dang gcig ma gtogs yab yum thams cad kyi/ /mtshan gyi thog mar rdo rje re re sbyar/ /zhes so/ /khro bo'i rigs chung sdom/ ni/ /bud+dha'i lubor ni byams pa thugs rje dang / /lo ka gsum la snying po btags pa dang / /btang snyom yab yum pad+ma he ru'i 'khor/ /rgyal bar rol bar sem/sa zad 'byung ba bzhir/ /byed par btags pa yab yum karma'i 'khor/ /sgrol byed mthar byed rol pa nyams myong bzhi/ /yum bcas badz+ra 'khor ni rdo rje dang / /rin chen pad+ma karma bzhi po la/ /snying po btags pa yum bcas rat+na'i 'khor/ /rdo rje rol ba rdo rje srin po dang / /rdo rje lha mo sna tshogs rdo rje rnams/ /yum bcas rigs lnga'i rigs chung khro mo'i 'khor/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas stong dang sogs kyi bkod lugs rnams gsang bdag zhal lung na gsal bas ma bris/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod dang brgyad 'chang ba/ /rnal 'byor mthar ldan shin tu bsten/ /zhes pa/ lta sgom spyod pa'i mdzod dang ldan pa dang / /dbang bzhi'i chu bo yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /blo rim dang 'tshams par slob ma rjes su 'jin pa'i don gnyer dang ldan pa dang / rgyud gsum gyi don dang las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub pa la ma/khas pa dang / lag len gyi man ngag shes pa dang / nyams myong gi drod dang ldan pa ste brgyad do/ /zhes so/ /zin bris las/ lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med 1 30

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrtogs pa'i lta ba dang / spros bcas man chad mthar phyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa las mi 'da' ba dam tshig gis mdzod de dam pa'imadzod gsum dang ldan pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa dbang gi/ bka' rgyud pa lung gi/ bla ma brgyud pa byin rlabs kyi/ rang rig pa nyams kyi chu bo ste/ chu bo bzhi dang ldan pa'am/ yang na byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo zhes rtsa lhung gi nyes pas gtan nas ma gos shing sbom lhung byung yang phyir bcos kyis sor chud pa/sgrub pa'i las kyi gnyer kha 'dzin pa la spros bcas man chad mthar phyin pa'i steng du yi dam lhas gnang ba thob pa'am dngos nyams rmi lam du rtags gsar ba thon pa dang ldan pa/ yang na phyi'i dgra bgegs kyis bar chad bzlog pa/nyon mongs lam du slong ba/ bde sdug ro snyom pa/ snying rje dang phan sems kyis slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i gnyer kha bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgyud dang zhes pa phyi nang gi de nyid bcu shes pa'am/ yang na rgyud sde'i don la mkhas pa/ cho ga dang sgrub pa'i las kyi ngo bo grangs go rim sogs la mkhas dgos te/ dper na so thar gyi las chog go rims sogs nor na las mi chags pa bzhin tu dbang gi ngo bo grangs sogs nor na dbang mi thob pas man ngag zab mo nyams myong gi drod dang ldan pa ste khyad par gyi chos brgyad 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor ba zag bcas spros pa mthar phyin pa dang ldan pa bsten par bya zhes pa'o/ /ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyes shes shing yo byad ldan/ /zhes ston pa rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa gsum gyis mchod pa la brtson pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi rtogs pa gsal ba'am/ yang na brtson pas sgo 131

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasum sbyang ba stong chen sogs bzhi'i ting 'dzin gsal ba/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga/yan lag gi dam tshig bcu dang sdom pa ma nyams pa/ rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i/bskyed pa rkyen gyi/ bzlas pa las sgyi sngags rnams dang / sku phyag rgya/ gsungs chos rgya/ bca' ba las rgya/ dam tshig phyag rgya ste phyag rgya bzhi shes pa dang / ldi+o byad lnga ni/ dam tshig lta ba ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub sems dang snying rje ste/ /lhag pa'i yo byad lnga rdzogs bya/ /zhes lam gyi yo byad lnga'o/ /yang na sgrub pa rdzas kyi yo byad/ bza' bca' btung ba'i/ rgyan dang bgo ba'i/ glu tshig sgra yi/bro gar 'du 'phro'i a li ka li'i yo byad de lnga dang ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /las rim sgyu ting 'dzin lnga po/ ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs ba/mchod pa 'bul ba/ bshags pa bya ba/ dngos grub gsol ba/ dam bca' ba/dzab bzla ba/ bdag dam tshig pa/ lha ye shes pa 'od zer spro bsdu ste gsal ba gsum/ phra yang sogs thad/ spyod bsdus las/ gzugs phra ba dang rags pa dang / /khyab pa yang dag thob pa nyid/ /rab tu gsal ba nyid bstan dang /dbang phyug nyid dang 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /zhes brten pa phra ba lha spro ba/ rten gzhal yas khang rags pa spro bsdu/ drug ces pa yang 'dug /rang lus kyis 'jig rten khyab par sprul nus pa/ de lta bu'i yang dag thob pa dkyil lubor spro ba'i bdag por gyur pa/ rab tu gsal ba/ lha chen po sogs zil gyis gnon nus pa brtan pa ni rang nyid ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la spyor nus pa/ dbang phyug nyid gdul bya tshar gcod rjes 'dzin la dbang bsgyur thon pa/ 'dod dgur bsgyur ba stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang cha 'dra thob pa'o/ /dngo sa 132

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgrub skyu pho nya'i dbang gis zhes pa dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang phur srung bcu gnyis rnams sa/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya'i khyad par 'dad tshul yang yad da//༈ phramo'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa/ ma dag pa'i snang zhen gcod byed dngos rdzogs rim yin mod/ de'i sngon du de 'dra'i snang zhen yid ngor gcod dgos pas/ ma dag par snang ba'i gnyen po tha mal gyi phung khams skye mched tham/sa cad ye nas dag pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyag gcig tu blta ba ste/ rnam pa gsal ba dang / ma dag par zhen pa'i gnyen por/ rnam pa gsal ba de'i skabs su sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid du nga rgyal ba rnam dag dran pa ste/de lta bu'i khyad par gnyis tshang ba'i bskyed rim thun mthar 'khyol gyi bar du bar ma chad pa la slob dgos/ de'ang 'dzin stangs gzhan gyis bar bcad pa tsam min gyi ma dag pa'i snang zhen gyis bar ma bcad pa dgos la/ de ltar slob pa la bzhi ste/ rags pa'i dkyil 'khor yud tsam la gsal mi nus pa de srid du las dang po ba'i gnas skabs dang / de ltar nus pa na ye shes la cung zad dbab pa'i gnas skabs dang / yud tsam la phra ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal nus pa ye shes la cung zad dbang ba'i gnas skabs dang / bskyed rim la ma ltos par ting nge 'dzin tsam la brten nas gzhan don rgya chen byed nus pa ye shes la yang dag par dbang ba'i gnas skabs dang bzhi'o/ /de dag gi skabs su bying rgod gcod dgos pas bying ba'i gnyen por thugs ka'i sngags las 'od zer spro bsdu dang dbugs 'byung rngub bgrang ba sogs kyi sems gzengs bstod pa dang /rgod pa'i gnyen por phra thig gi rnal 'byor la slob pa ste/ dang po gnyis kyi 133

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃskabs su dbu ma'i yar mar gyi sna rtse gnyis po gang rung du thig le tshad yung 'bru tsam pa/ kha dog mthing ga ngo bo lha yin pa'am dbyibs zlum po ste khyad par gsum ldan la sems 'dzin pa thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phyi ma gnyis kyi skabs su/ rang nyid gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rjer gsal ba'i yum gyi mkhar thig le phab ste/ de'i nang du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa spyan gyi dkar nag gi cha tshun chad ma 'dres par gsal nus pa'i tshul dang / thig le'i nang gi gsang 'dus yum mkhar yang de 'dra gsal nus pa tsha bu'i tshul dang / de'i yang de ltar nus pa yang tsha'i tshul du gsal nus pa na phra mo'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa yin par gsungs so/ /gong gi rim pa bzhi'i gnyis pa'i skabs su bskyed rim thob pa ma yin zhing / gsum pa'i skabs su de thob par 'jog gsungs/ bying rgod gcod pa yang zhi gnas tsam 'grub pa'i ched du min gyi 'dir bstan gyi bskyed rim mthar phyin pa na/ zhi gnas zhar la grub yod pa yin gsungs/ sgyu lugs sgyi khyad mi 'adha bas 'byed dgos sam/ zhes thad/ zhal rgyun las/ dang po dpyod pa'i dus bde chen don du gnyer nas de rjes dngos grub don la sbyin sreg sogs brgyud dgos/ phyi bas ni dang po nas dngos grub don du gnyer nas 'od zer dkar pos dngos grub kyi snod rung du bya ba dang 'od zer dmar po'i spros bsdus dngos grub sdud pa sogs thabs du ma'i sgo nas dngos grub thob ched du tshogs sgrub byed pa'i de'i rjes mjug tu sbyin sreg sogs la mi ltos par 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin 'grub ces gsungs/ 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin ni/134

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adodapa las 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i lha/ lha dbang brgya byin gyi rnam pa'i rig 'dzin dang / chags bral tshangs pa'i lus lta bu'i rig 'dzin 'grub ces gsungs/ bzhag thabs gnyis thad/ zin bris las/ ngang ma shor ba la go dgos pas spyi blugs/ gsal mi gsal min pas so ma shor ba/ zhes dang /de byang bar goms pa na zhes pa'i thad ces gsungs/ snang ba thams cad 'od gsal gyi rtsal 'ba' zhig tu blta ba la bsre ba zer/ zhes dang / zhal rgyun la/stong gzugs rig ngor snang ba'i gnyis 'dzin bral ba la go dgos pa dang /stong gzugs kyi snang ba de dag la rang snang du blta ba'o/ /rang lus kyi 'du shes zhag nas rtse gcig tu stong gzugs kyi snang ba dag ma dag la mnyam du mnyam par bzhag pa na sngar las kyang lhag par mched de rtsal rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ snang ba thams cad 'od gsal gyi rtsal 'ba' zhig tu gong smos ltar bsgoms pas snang ba thams cad dbyings mi dmigs pa dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i bde ba'i ye shes kyi yo lang 'ba' zhig tu 'char/ de dag gsal brtan pa'i khyad par thob pa'i tshe/ thun mthar 'khyong gi bar du mi g.yo bar gnas nus pa'i stong gzugs las rung sogs/ dang po nas stong gzugs kyi snang ba gang shar lha sku phyag rgya gcig par dngos su bsgyur ro snyam pa'i 'phen pa'i rkyen cung zad song nas/ de bzhin du nyin mo'i ting 'dzin gang la slob pa de nyid mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor du khyer tshul skabs la gnyis te/ rlung stobs dang 'dun stobs kyis 'byer ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/rnal 'byor dang po'i skabs sad dus su rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum 135

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbyas stobs kyi stong chen 'od gsal mngon du gyur nus pa des snying ga'i rtsa gsal te/ de la sems bzung ste gnyid la zhugs pa na/ gnyid kyi stong bzhi 'am snang mched thob gsum gyi ye shes 'od gsal dang bcas pa ngos zin nas bde stong sbyar te/ lam gyi stong du dngos su bsgyur nus pa/ de'i mjug tu 'od gsal las g.yo ba'i mgo rtsom pa dang / g.yo na yang ngos zin nas 'phen pa'i rkyen cung zad tsam gyi rkyen las nyin mo'i stong gzugs kyi snang ba dang rmi lam gnyis sbrel te snying rje sgyu ma dngos goms nus shing / de phyag rgya gcig spros su yang bsgyur nus la/ 'di'i stong chen sogs bzhi ni de dag mtshan nyid pa yin zhing / 'di dus kha sna'i dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'gag par gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ rlung stobs kyis gong ltar mi nus pa'i gang zag gis de ltar nus ched du slob pa ste/ 'di'i mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gsal te/ gnyid kyi stong bzhi ngos zin par bya'o snyam pa dang stong chen sogs la rim bzhin 'jug par bya'o snyam du 'dun pas dmigs 'og tu bcug ste gnyid pa na gnyid kyi stong bzhi sogs ngos zin mi nus pas stong chen sogs mtshan nyid pa mi 'ong yang de dag rjes su mthun pa la goms pa na ring por mi thogs par/ snga ma ltar 'ong ba yin gsungs/ grub dbang rin po ches/ dgongs rgyan dang sdom ṭi ka sogs mang por stong chen gyi skabs su/ sad pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal dang / mtshan mo gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal gnyis sbrel te nyams su len par gsungs shing /snying rje sgyu ma'i thad du sad rmi gnyis kyi snang ba mthong bar bshad pa'ang snang ba de dag stong gzugs su lam khyer byed pa'am/ tha mal pa la snang ba de gnyis 136

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'achar ba'i dod du stong gzugs mthong zhes par mngon pas/ des ni rnal 'byor dang po gnyis gnyid rmi gnyis kyi skabs su skyong tshul bstan no/ /rmi lam du 'ong rgyu rnams stong gzugs ye shes kyi snang bar 'char zhes bstan pa dang / de ltar sharaba'i stong gzugs de rim gyis phyag rgya gcig spros su'ang 'char bar go nga bzhin bshad pas/ phyag rgya gcig spros rmi lam du sbyang tshul thon no/ / gzhi la srid pa bar do ma grub gong chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char ba lta bu'i rmi lam ma mthong ba'i sngon du lhun grub kyi gzhi snang mthong bar man ngag snying thig tu gsungs pa dang / 'di'i steng sgo rnal 'byor ba'i gnyid thug gi rgya spros gnyis mthun dgos te/ 'di'i stong gzugs dang / chos nyid bar do'i snang ba gnad gcig par dgongs rgyan dang shing rta chen mor bshad pas so/ /zhes dang yang lam rim lung skabs/ gang dag dngos kun rang rig phyir/ /'chi ba don dam bden pa ste/ /sogs kyis bskyed rim pas mos ngor dang / rdzogs rim pas yongs su 'chi ba chos skur sbyong byed stong chen/ bar dor longs skur sbyong byed snying rje sgyu ma sogs sgom par bstan pas/ stong chen dang 'chi ba bsre ba sogs kyis 'thob bo/ /'on kyang 'di'i sad pa dang skye ba sbyong byed ni rmi lam dang bar do sbyong byed du'ang mi 'gal bas/ snying thig tu/ 'chi ba dang / chos nyid bar do'i lam khyer gnyis po kho nas bar do dang skye ba kun sbyong bar bzhed pa dang mthun no/ /bar chad med pa'i ting 'dzin zhes pa/ skye ba dang lam gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/lta ltang (lam)lo tshod bstun par 'dod ces pa/ gsung rgyun las/ lha rje kha rag pa sogs kyi bzhed pa ni/ zag bcas 137

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzag med kyi lam dgu po 'di dag la rgyu'i theg pa'i sa lam dang gung sbyar te/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin tshogs lam chung ngu dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang /kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin tshogs lam 'bring po yang dag spong bzhi dang /phyag rgya gcig pa la tshogs lam chen po rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi dang spros bcas sbyor lam chung ngu drod rtse gnyis dang / tshogs sgrub sbyor lam/ chen po'i bzod pa chos mchog gnyis dang / rnam smin mthong lam dang po/ tshe dbang sa dang po'i bden pa mthong ba dang / phyag chen sa gnyis pa nas dgu pa'i bar dang / lhun grub rig 'dzin sa bcu chos kyi sprin dang lo (lam) tshad mnyam pa yin gsungs/ sa dang po mthong pa'i tshe nyon sgrib kun btags lhan skyes gnyis kyi khyad par ma phye bar mtha' dag spang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs /(pru lta der tshogs bsgrub kyi dus su lha tshom bu gcig pa sogs zhes pa'i thad/ zur 'debs las/ le'u bcu gcig par tshomi bu gcig pa dang / gsum pa dang / lnga ba rnams la brten nas tshogs sgrub byas pas/ rim par mthong lam nas rgya dang / tshe dbang nas lhun grub dang tshe dbang nas rdo rje 'chang la sbyor bar gsungs so/ /rtog (charig 'dzin skabs/ zin bris las/ 'di'i gdul bya dbang po rno rtul gnyis las/ so skye'i sar phyag rgya gcig spros su stong gzugs grub pa na/ snga mas stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo'i stobs kyis mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po 'dren pa'i ched du tshogs spyod byas nas bde chen ye shes des rang lus bem po'i cha sbyangs pa'am zos te dwangs ma'i las su gyur ba na tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang / phyi mas dgos pa de'i ched du tshogs spyod byas kyang bde ba chen po 'dren ma nus pa'i 138

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdabang gis rang lus ma dag kyang nyon mongs pa'i zag pa dang bral ba'i 'phags lam brnyes pas rnam smin rig 'dzin zhes bya/ ༈ tshe dbang rig 'dzin skabs/rin po ches/ rtog tshogs sgyu drar bshad pa'i khams drug ldan gyi rdo rje'i lus kyi dwangs ma stobs su gyur cing / snyigs ma'i de las gyur pa'i lus khams skye gnas kyi zag pa zad pa'i dbang gis/ phar phyin dus sa thob dus thams cad du mnyam bzhag gi rtog pa dang mthun pa/ zhes pa ltar/ 'dir yang las rlung gi 'khrul rgyus dkrug pa'i sems mi gsal ba rnams mnyam rjes kun tu shas cher dwangs shing / gzi byin chos kyi dbyings ltar tshad gzung dang bral ba'i 'od gsal sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyis snang sems thams cad non cing kha dog basbrur ba ni/ gsang 'dus las/ sgyu lus thob nas lus sems phra rags kyi 'brel rags pa chad nas mi rgyu ba dang dod mtshungs pa'am/ yang na zung 'jug thob nas 'brel phra mo chad pa'i dod do/ /'di rgya mtsho las/ 'byung bzhi dwangs ma la brten pas/ /rig pa'i bde bar chad med/ /rnam rtog 'gyu bas rlung dwangs bas/ /bde chen nam mkha'i mtha' ltar gnas/ /zhes le'u bcu bzhi par bshad pa dang phyogs 'dra'o/ /'dir g.yung gi gsung na/ bden pa'i phyogs gcig mthong ba rnam smin/ bde chen don dzo+ogs par mthong ba tshe dbang /mthong zin goms byed phyag chen gsungs pa dang / spyod bsdus las/ sems dben pa la bden pa mthong ba 'di/ /zhes dpe'i 'od gsal la spros pa phyogs re khegs pa'i cha nas don dam 'od gsal zhes brtags pa ltar btags 'dug pa'am ma 'bor/ zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ lam rim las/rdo rje 'khor 139

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlo rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri'i rig 'dzin 'gyur/ /sa gnyis pa nas lnga pa'i bar la rdo rje'i rig 'dzin zhes bya ste/ rang gi ngos skal gyi sgrib pa 'ardzoms pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i rdo rje dang mtshungs/ sa drug pa dang bdun par sher phyin lhag par spyod pa dang thabs la mkhas pa'i stabs kyis 'khor lo bskor ba dang tshar gcod pa dang rjes 'dzin gyis gzhan don sgrub pa la mkhas pa'i 'khor lo'i rig 'dzin dang / brgyad par rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dbang ba'i 'dod pa thams cad grub pas rin po che/ dgu par yul gang la chags pa med par sems can gyi don byed par pad+ma'i rig 'dzin dang / bcu par phrin las khyad par can gyi sems can gyi don dpag med mdzad pas ral gri'i rig 'dzin gsungs/ zur 'debs las/ phung khams rags pa sbyong tshul la dgongs sogs/ zhal lung las/ 'dir rgyal ba g.yung ni/ dus 'khor las mtshan ma gsum mthong bar bshad pa'i ma ma dang po las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i ya gyal gcig 'gag pa ni mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba thob pa chos nyid bden pas cha shas mthong ba yin la/ mtshan ma bar ma ni las rlung gcig 'gags gnyis 'gags kyis stong brgyad brgya 'gags pa na gsang 'dus kyi rtsa mdud gcig grol ba dang chos nyid bden pa mngon du mthong bas sa dang po non par bshad pa ltar/ 'dir yang rnam smin bden pa'i cha shas dang / /tshe dbang rig 'dzin mthong ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhal rgyun du sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i lung don las/ sngags bla med kyi sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar gyi yon tan rnams rgyu ci'i dbang gis 'byung zhe na/ ma dag pa'i rtswa rnams 'bri ba ste rtsa dwangs 140

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃma'i dbang gis sa yi yon tan rnams skye'o/ /de ltar yon tan skye ba ni/ rlung rags pa nyi khri chig stong drug brgya log pas de zhon pa'i rtog pa rags pa de'i grangs log pa yin la/ de ltar rlung sogs ma dag pa'i sgrib pa'i cha rnam/sa log pas ni mi 'gyur bde chen gyi cha nyi khri chig stong drug brgya skye ba las/ de ltar 'ong bar 'dod la de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sbyang gzhi rlung khams sems rags pa 'grib pa dang / sbyong byed bde chen shin tu phra ba 'phel ba'i dbang gis srid pa'i snang ba 'grib cing 'gag /myang ngan las 'das pa'i snang ba 'phel ba yin la/ de yang gang la brten nas 'byung na/ lus kyi rtsa 'khor spyi mgrin snying kha gsum yod lte ba dang bzhi 'am gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo dang lnga ste de 'dra'i dbye bsdu byed don sku gsum dang / sku bzhi dang / sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga sogs mtshon bya'i dbang gis so/ /de 'dra'i dbu rkyang 'khor lo dang bcas pa la mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pas mdud pa gnyis re grol nas sa re thob par gsungs la/ rtsa mdud gcig la rdzogs pa'i skabs su sa bcu'i tha ma ste smad kyi ye shes kyis steng 'di'i ye bab dang mas bab gnyisakyi lhan skyes kyi khams dkar po spyi bor brtan/ dmar cha nor bu'i rtser brtan pas sangs rgyas par grags shing bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs/ zin bris las/ rim bzhin dwangs snyigs kyi rtsa rlung skye 'bri'am 'phel 'grib las srid pa dang myang ngan 'das 'phel 'grib byed/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ 'khor lo bzhi yi rlung sems las rung tshe nas bzhed ces dang / de dag so so'i yon tan rlabs che ba/stong phrag bcu gnyis la sogs rgya che ste/ rtsa 'dabs phra mo'i mdud pa rab grol 141

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbs/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin nyon mongs rlung sems nub/ myang 'das rang bzhin ye shes rlung sems 'phel/ /de ltar sa bcu'i bsgrod pa de dag las/dbu mar ro rkyang mdud pa nyi shu gcig /gnyis gnyis grol ba sa bcu re re thob/ /tha mas gtsug tor rtse mo'i sa mchog 'grub/ /ces so/ /rang 'grel las/ lam bzhi yon tan rdzogs pa'i yon tan 'char zhing dbu ma la ro rkyang gnyis kyi mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pa'i gnyis gnyis grol ba na sa bcu re re'i yon tan 'char la/ tha ma grol bas sangs rgyas kyis sa 'grub par slob dpon bi ma lā dang pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i mkhas grub chen po rnams bzhed do/ /zhes dang / de la rlung sems las su rung ba dang 'byong pa gnyis las/ der tshud dus las su rung ba yin la/ 'byong ba ni de dag gi rtsa phran dang bcas pa'i mdud pa grol dgos so/ /zhes so/ /sa mchog grub ces pa'i thad kyi 'grel bar/ rtsa gsum mdud pa'i dang po gnyis grol bas sa dang po thob pa nas sa bcu'i bar dang / tha ma grol nas gtsug tor rtse mo'i sa mchog rdo rje 'grub po/ /zhes dang / shing rta chen mor/ 'khor lo drug gi rim pa dang sbyar na gsang ba ye shes kyi/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi/ dbu ma bde ba chen po/gtsugs tor nam mkha'i/ snying kha chos kyi/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ste drug tu yod pa las/ sgyu 'phrul ba ltar na ma dag pa'i rigs drug gi sa bon drug sbyang gzhir gnas pa la/ sbyong byed thub pa drug dang pha rol phyin pa drug gi rang bzhin gyi sbyangs bas ye shes lnga bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes dang drug 'thob/'khor lo re re dang de'i bar re ste bcu gnyis su rlung dag pas sa bcu gnyis 142

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrdzogs pa'i mthar bcu gsum pa ye shes chen po'i sa rdzogs par 'dod cing sogs gsungs/ lam bzhi'i yon tan rim bzhin 'char/ /zhes pa/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol bas tshogs sbyor gyi yon tan 'char/ sangs rgyas sprul sku'i zhing khams mthong / snying ga'i rtsa mdud grol bas lhag mthong gi yon tan 'char longs sku'i zhings khams mthong / mgrin pas sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi/ spyi bos dag pa sa gsum gyi/ rtsa mdud tha ma nyer gcig pa grol bas 'bras bu mthar thug gi sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba tshad med par 'char/ sangs rgyas chos sku'i zhing khams mthong ba yin/ rang lus za tshul rags bshad zhib bshad kyi khyad par ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig ces pa'i thad/ dus 'khor gyi bzhed pa ni/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo la brten nas/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo'i nang du thig le dkar po rdog po gcis/ gnas gzhan dang gzhan du mi g.yo bar gnas pa la mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig dang po skye zhing / thig le des lus kyi bem po'i cha nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i cha gcig za zhing zad par byed la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig des kyang zhag gcig la dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i nang nas gcig bsad nas 'gag par byed do/ /de ltar thig le dkar po de nor bu'i rtse nas dbugs re re bsad nas 'gag par byed pas bem po'i cha nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dang / dbugs kyi cha nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rnams rim gyis 'gags par byed do/ /de lta bu'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba de nyid kyis stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig re re la'ang spang bya bden 'dzin bag chags dang bcas pa'i dngos gnyen bar 143

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃchad med lam re dang / rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya las grol ba'i rnam grol lam re re 'ang yod pas gnyis gnyis su phye ba yin no/ /nor bu'i rtse nas gsang gnas kyi bar thig le'i phreng ba sum stong drug brgya brtsegs pa las rim par skyes pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'ang sum stong drug brgya skye ba'i phyed snga ma chig stong brgyad brgyas sa dang po dang / phyed phyi ma chig stong brgyad brgyas sa gnyis pa dang / de bzhin du gsang gnas nas lte ba'i bar la thig le sum stong drug brgya brtsegs pa las skyes pa'i mi 'gyur bde ba'i bde ba'ang sum stong drug brgya skyes pa'i phyed snga ma chig stong brgyad brgyas sa gsum pa dang / phyed phyi ma chig stong brgyad brgyas sa bzhi pa dang / lte ba nas snying kha'i bar sngar bzhin thig le brtsegs pa las mi 'gyur ba sngar ltar skyes pa'i chig stong brgyad brgya snga mas sa lnga pa dang / chig stong brgyad brgya phyi mas sa drug pa dang / snying ga nas mgrin pa'i bar la sngar bzhin thig le brtsegs pa las skyes pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chig stong brgyad brgya snga mas sa bdun pa/ chig stong brgyad brgyas phyi mas sa brgyad pa dang / mgrin pa nas dpral ba'i bar du thig le sngar ltar brtsegs pa las skyes ba'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chig stong brgyad brgya snga mas sa dgu pa phyi mas sa bcu ba/ dpral ba nas gtsug dor gyi bar thig le sngar bzhin sum stong drug brgyad brtsegs pa las skyes pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sum stong drug brgya'i phyed snga ma chig stong brgyad brgyas sa bcu gcig pa ste sa bcu'i khyad par lam/ phyed phyi ma chig stong brgyad brgyas sa bcu gnyis pa ste sa bcu'i bar chad med lam du 'jog go/ /thig le dkar po nor bu'i rtse nas gtsug tor bar 144

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnyi khri chig stong drug brgya mi g.yo bar brtsegs pa ltar/ thig le dmar po yang de rnams dang dus mtshungs su gtsug tor nas nor bu'i bar du rim par nyi khri chig stong drug brgya g.yo med du brtsegs par byed do/ /yid bzhin mdzod 'grel las/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gung mthun par byung ste/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rlung sems rim pa bzhin ldas su rung ba las/ tshogs dang sbyor ba dang / mthong ba dang sgom pa'i lam bzhi rdzogs pa'i yon tan 'char zhing dbu ma la ro rkyang gnyis kyi mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pa'i gnyis grol ba na/ sa bcu po re re'i yon tan 'char la/ tha ma grol bas sangs rgyas kyi sa 'grub par slob dpon chen po bi ma mi dra dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i mkhas grub rnams bzhed do zhes gsungs pas/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i dgongs don yid bzhin mdzod rtsa 'grel nas bshad pa dang / dus 'khor nas bshad pa gnyis rags bshad zhib bshad kyi khyab par ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig par gong ma bzhed par gsungs so/ /(| rtone kun mkhyen lugs kyi skabs kyi/ rdzogs rim gyi lhag mthong rnyed pa yan chad gcig /ma mtha' rdzogs rim gyi stong chen legs par rtogs pa yan chad gcig bzhag dgos/ des de gsar du mthong bas mthong lam gyi sgra sbyar ba yin no/ /zhes so/ /lung rigs skyu gnod byed yod tshul sogs ma spros la/ zhes pa rnams ni/ gzhan dag mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chig stong brgyad brgya tshan dang pos mos spyod pa dang / tshan pa gnyis pa rab dga' bar bzhed pa dang / la la snga ma dang 'dra la chig stong brgyad brgya'i tshan pa dang pos skad cig gi tha ma nas sa dang po'i mgo 'dzin par bzhed do/ /145

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃ'adi'i lugs kyi sa bcu gnyis kyi dang po mos spyod kyi sar yod pa mi 'thad do/ /'di'i dang po'i bde ba'i skad cig ma chig stong brgyad brgya tshan pa dang po mos spyod gyis sa yin na/ 'di'i lugs kyi sa bcu pa bde ba'i skad cig ma chig stong brgyad brgya tshan pa bcu yod pa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros yin dgos na/sa bcu'i dbang phyug dpal phyag na rdo rje de sa dgu par 'gyur te/ 'grel chen las/ phyag rdor gyi las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ma 'gags pas 'di'i lugs gyi sa bcu gnyis ma thob par bshad pa'i phyir dang / nyi ma dpal gyi yon tan 'geng ba las/ de ltar 'khor lo ser po sa gnyis 'thob pa'i rim pas sa gnyis kyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na gsang ba'i 'khor lo dbugs 'byung ba dang / 'jug pa brgya phrag drug lhag pa'i stong phrag gsum 'gog pa'i rab tu dga' ba dang dri ma med pa gnyis yin no/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo de bzhin dbugs 'gag pas 'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro ba gnyis yin no/ /de bzhin kho nar snying ga'i chu skyes su thub dka' ba dang mngon du gyur pa'i sa gnyis so/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang mkhas pa'i gsung rab rgyud gsum gsang ba rnam 'byed kyi dgongs pa btsal na/ mi 'gyur ba 'i bde ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rdzogs te sbyor ba bcu gnyis kyi rlung 'gags nas ye shes kyi sku 'grub la/ de'i sngon mi 'grub pas/ ye shes kyi sku de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas na sa dang po'i thog ma nas bzhed par mngon/ gal te de ltar yin na/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug phyag na rdo rje yang sa dang po rab tu dga' ba ma thob par thal bas ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje las rlung sum 146

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃstong drug brgya 'pho ba'i dus sbyor gnyis ma 'gags par 'grel chen las gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten khams le'i mdor bsdus gnyis pa las/ nags kyi ri dwags kyi bdag po zhes pa bzhin du rol ldan na gnas pa gnod sbyin chen po rnams kyi bdag po 'dam nang du ni ro zhes pa dbugs 'byung ba dang 'jug pa gsum stong drug brgya'i dman pa'i nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rnams 'gags pa'o/ /de 'di la yod pa ni/ chos kyi sprin gyi sa ste de la gnas pa ni ro ldan na gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ lta (khe kun mkhyen lugs kyi rnam smin rig 'dzin thad/ zhal rgyun du/ rdzogs rim sgyu rtogs pa cher byang ba dgos kyis/ zhes pa'i byang tshad ni/ grub mtha'i skabs su bshad pa ltar rdzogs rim la brten nas 'od gsal mngon du rtogs shing 'od gsal de'i char 'gyur ba'i shes rab sad de/ 'od gsal gyi dbyings stong pa nyid don spyi'i sgo nas rtogs pa'i sbyor lam pa zhig ste/ 'di rnam smin rig 'dzin mtshan nyid pa dang mthong lam pa dang 'phags pa btags pa bar gsungs/ (gi (6 zur lugs snga phyi'i skabs/ phyis kyi bka' sde zur ba'i lugs la de ltar rnam smin pa des tshe 'dir rgya chen grub pa zhig yod na ni/ de 'dra des rang lus kyi steng nas rgya chen 'grub pas/ 'o na khyod kyis rnam smin pa yin na 'chi dus kyi shin tu phra ba'i rlung de sgyu lus su bzhengs te bar dor rgya chen 'grub dgos kyis khyab pas sgyu lus kyi rten la rgya chen 'grub pa yin pas rags lus 'di rgya chen du 'byer ba med pas lhag bcas lhag med kyi rnam bzhag mdzad pa dang dngos su 'gal zhing zhes so/ /dpal sprul rin po ches/ rgya mig ni thel tshe'i ngo'i ri mo 147

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang / rgya sa ni sa cha sogs rgya 'debs sa de yin no/ /rgya mig rgya sa ji bzhin du/ /phyag rgya thob la ma rag pa/ /zhes pa ni/ dper na rgya mig de bskos phor ri mo ji ltar yod pa de rgya sa 'jims pa la btab pa'i tshe legs par dod yod kyang brko phor nas ma byung bar du mngon du mi snang ba ltar sngags bla med kyi sbyor lam pa de 'chi ba'i 'od gsal gyi tshe sngags kyi mthong lam grub pa mnyam bzhag gi tshe sems don dam 'od gsal gyi lha sku grub te nyon sgrib spangs nas lus yi dam lha'i zung 'jug gi skur mngon du gyur ma rag yod kyang dngos su grub pa med la/ 'od gsal de rnam smin gyi lus las ldang ba na zung 'jug gi sku de mngon du grub pa yin no/ /zhes so/ 'bras rgyud kyi bla med kho na la grags pa'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun skabs/ mi pham rin po che'i shan 'byed las/ngo bo nyid sku de ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dag pa gnyis ldan pas de'i mkhyen cha ye shes chos sku/ gzugs sku rnam gnyis nyi ma dang 'od zer bzhin du 'du 'bral med pa yin pas gzugs sku'i dbang du byas na longs sku nges pa lnga ldan gyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sogs kha sbyor bdun gyi bdag nyid yod par khas len dgos te/ kha sbyor bdun ni/ ngag dbang grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ ces gsungs/ 'og min du sa bcu ba'i byang sems la chos kyi longs spyod rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / ye shes kyi rang bzhin can gyi mtshan dpe'i sku rang gi btsun mo dang kha sbyor du bzhugs pa dang / zag med kyi bde ba chen pos rgyud yongs su gang ba dang / rang bzhin gyi ngo bo nyid 148
