g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmedapa dang / snying rjes yongs su gang bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang /de'i mdzad pa nam mkha' ji srid du rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / 'gog pa med pa mi gnas kyi myang 'das so/ /de ltar yang btsun mo'i bde ba dang ldan pa sogs rgyud rang mtshan pa'i chags spyod smad pa'i tshul can ma yin te/ sku rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'i bye brag 'khor 'das kyi chos kun la bdag po chen po'i tshul du mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i zag med kyi bde ba chen po la mnga' dbang 'byor ba yin pas/ 'bras chos nyer lnga lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /spyan sogs snye mched drug ldan gyi sku mtshan dpe bzhin lag tu snang yang mig sogs la bdag gir 'dzin pa sogs yod mi dgos la/ yum dang gdan khri gzhal yas sogs 'dod yon gyi rnam pa thams cad de bzhin te/ sprol bral don gsal po'i rgyud las/ sku mdog phyag mtshan gdan khri la sogs pa/ /snang yang yang dag don du grub pa med/ /chos sku'i yon tan tsam du snang ba yin/ /rtsal mdang ma 'gags cha tsam shar ba yin/ /mkhyen pa'i shes rab tsam las gsal ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ sku la che chung gi tshad du snang yang gang yang khyab pa'i chu zla lta bu la rdul phran gyi tshad bsags pa med pa sogs shes par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku la ris su phye ba'i rgyud rang mtshan med kyang dag pa'i gdul byar snang ba'i longs sku de yang sangs rgyas yin pa dang / kha sbyor bdun ldan du khas len pa la skyon gang yang med de/ rgyud sde chen po rnams kyi dgongs pa rnam dag yin no/ /der ma zad sprul pa'i sku la'ang / kun mkhyen chen po'i rmig don mdzod du/ gdul bya'i ngor snang ba'i sprul ba'i sku de yang bem stong 149

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgazugs brnyan lta bu ma yin par ye shes gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don lhun grub tu mdzad pa ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ye shes yod pa dang sangs rgyas yin par khas len dgos kyi de sangs rgyas min pa dang ye shes med par nam yang skur pa 'debs mi rung ngo / /mdor na/ thal 'gyur las/ tha dad rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /de phyir sku lnga'i ye shes te/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /don la de bzhin gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /zhal rgyun la/ gsung lnga'i nang tshan gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag pa nyid gsung lnga'i nang tshan gyi chos sku'i gsung zhes btags pa'o/ /thugs lnga rang phrin sgo nas sku lnga'i khungs su sbyor zhes gsungs/ ye shwes kun mkhyen lta ba dgu zhes pa rnams kyi don ni/zur 'debs las/ chos nyid bden pa dbyer med mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa thob pa/ chos nyid bden pa dbyer med kyi rang rig pa'i mngon sum du sgro 'dogs pa dang bral bar byas la yid ches gdengs shes rab ste rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba/ snang ba'i rnam pa kun ma spangs bar ldan pa rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan gyi stong pa chen po'i don de mthong zhing go ba'i ngang las gnas pa de stong pa chen po'i lta ba dang / yul yul can gnyis med pa rang rig pa'i snying rje po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi/ ye shes sgyu ma'i ngo bor shar ba ni kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin snying rje chen po'i lta ba dang / 'bras bu yi dam lha gcig snang stong gnyis med du gsal ba phyag rgya gcig pa'i lta ba dang / rtog tshogs thams cad lha du ma'i dkyil 'khor du gsal bar rtogs pa phyag rgya spros pa'i lta ba dang / bar chad med pa'i lam du yo byad lnga snang la rang bzhin med 150

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpar spyad pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs pa mthong ba sbyor lam tshogis sgrub pa'i lta ba dang / don lta lus snang sems gsumazad pa yin nam gsungs mngon du byas shing rtag par tshe la rang dbang bsgyur ba mthong lam tshe dbang gi lta ba dang / dgongs pa mnyams pa nyid kyi don la mi g.yo ba sgom lam phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba dang / dga' ba bcu drug ye shes lnga yi lam du kun mkhyen pa lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi lta ba ste dgu'o/ zhes gsung rgyun las/ dad brtson gyi spyod pa bdun gyi dang po ni/ mi pham rin po che'i bka' brgyad kyi rnam bshad dngos grub snying po las/ gsang sngags kyi bslab pa'i mtha' bcu 'am drug tu 'du ste/ rgyud thos pas grol/ sgom kun nas sdud/ mdo gcig tu bsdus/mkhas pa'i phul tu phyin par bslab pa bzhis sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ste/thog mar rgyud la man ngag gi don zab mo ma thos na blang dor gyi dmigs mi 'byed pas rgyud thos pas grol ba rta pho sgrog bkrol ba lta bu gzhir bzhag /de yang thos pa nyung ngus shes rab rgya chen po grol bar mi nus pas thos pa'i sgo mang du btsal te/ sgo kun nas sdud pa bung ba tshang tshol ba lta bus mang tu thos par bya/mang du thos kyang leg len gnad du ma khel na rang rgyud mi grol bas mthar thug pa'i man ngag gi gnad zab mo nyams 'og tu chud par byas nas mdo gcig tu sdud pa tshong pa khe tshol ba lta bu'i don gnad phog par bya/ de ltar byas nas thos pas rgyud kyi don shes/ lung gis rgyud don nyams su blang / man ngag gis yid ches nas the tshom med pa'i gdengs dang ldan par bslab pa'i sgo nas mkhas pa'i phul tu phyin pa ri mthon po'i rtser phyin pa lta bu zhig bya ste/ de bzhi ni gsang 151

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsngags la bslab pa'i tshul lo/ /de bzhi'i steng du bslab bya'i yul gyis cha nas bslab pa'i mtha' drug tu gsungs ba bsnan nas bslab pa'i mtha' bcur bzhed do/ /de la bslab pa'i mtha' drug gang zhe na/ rim pa dbang gis bsgrod/gzhi dam tshig gis bzung / thag lta bas gcod/ nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis blang / la spyod pas dor/ don man ngag gis sgrub po ste drug go/ /de la rim pa dbang gis bsgrad pa ni/ gsang sngags gyi dbang thab pa dang gsang ba'i dbang thob nas nyon mongs pas mi brdzi ba'i las can du gyur pa rgyal pos rgyal sa zin pa lta bu'o/ /gzhi dam tshig gis bzung ba ni bla ma mnyes par byas la ji skad gsungs pa'i dam tshig las mi 'da' ba zhing sa gshin po lta bu dngos grub kyi lo tog skye rung ba'i las can no/ /thag lta bas bcad pa ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gis sems su 'du la sems ye nas sangs rgyas pa rang byung gi ye shes su rtogs nas bya rtsol re dogs bral te bag yangs su rgyu ba khyung nam mkha' la lding ba lta bu'o/ /nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis blang ba ni shes rab kyis dmigs pa'i don la ting nge 'dzin gyis g.yeng ba med par rtse gcig tu byas pa nor bu rin po che len pa lta bu'o/ /la spyod pas dor ba ni mnyam bzhag skabs bya ba'i las thams cad spangs nas sgom pa'i las la 'jug pa dang /rjes thob tu blang dor med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi lta ba zab mo dang mthun par 'jigs med tu rgyu zhing phrin las sna tshogs la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'jug pa glang po che chur 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /don man ngag gis sgrub pa ni gang ched du bsgrub pa'i don la gnad du 'byor ba'i man ngag gis the tshom chod pas gdengs 152

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang ldan par sgrub pa nyams su blangs bas/ ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i dus na bdud bzhi chom nas sku gsum thob pa rin po che nyos pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar mtha' drug la bslab cing sher ting gi yo byad gnyis la longs spyod pa ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'o/ /zhes so/ /rig 'dzin bzhi'i spyod pa gsang bdag zhal lung na gsal lo// ༈ 'grel chung las dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bshad pa /zhes pa ni/ 'grel chung las/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa bcu gnyis te/ /de bzhin nyid dang rang bzhin dang / /thugs rje 'dul ba'i dkyil zhabor dang / /ti nge 'dzin dang gzugs brnyan dang / /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dang / /byang chub sems dang lhag byang sems/ /tshogs dang lhun grub dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes so/ /don dam pa'i gzugs brnyan sogs nas rnam par shar ba'o/ /zhes pa 'dir lha rje mda' tig don dam pa'i gzugs brnyan kun rdzob lha'i dkyil 'khor du 'byung ba la bzhed/ lha rje glan ston rnam rtog phra rags kyi lha sprub yum du mtshon pa de'o gsungs/ nyang ṭika pa ni/ snga ma'i bzhed pa de gnyis char yang / 'og min na bzhugs pa dang / 'di ltar bsgoms pas gsal ba gnyis 'dra ba'i phyir gzugs brnyan no gsungs/ de gsum lung ni mthun par/rgyas pa las/ gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor yang dag ni/ /chen po rig pa thabs su rtogs/ /so so'i mtshan nyid shes rab rtogs/ /gnyis gnyis 'brel ba thabs chen yin/ /zhes so/ /zhal rgyun du/ sa brtags/ sa bslang sogs zhal lung 239 na gsal bas shes par 'dod na de las rtogs par bya'o/ /grwal tshul sgyu phyag sogs kyang der gsal lo/ /rdo rje phur ba'i lugs dang /153

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbaka' brgyad bder 'dus kyi lugs dang / sgyu 'phrul gyi lugs rnams las skabs 'dir sgyu 'phrul gyi lugs yin la/ bdag sras gzhan sras thams cad rgya mtsho'i lung don/ rgyu dang rkyen sogs kyis gsar du bskyed pa lta bu min pas rang byung ye shes gshis kyi bzhugs tshul sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid can de'i yin lugs dngos dang mi 'gal zhing mthun pa'i 'bras smi nyid la lam du shes te/ de yang da lta nas sad par mos pas/ rten brten pa ma/ lus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thig le ste gra zur med bzhin du 'bras bu'i skabs kyi lha rnams thams cad bdag gnyug ma'i 'od gsal sgyu sras su bsnom par bya'o/ /'dir bdag gzhan zhes pa/ bdag dri bcas kyi 'od gsal nyid bskyed gzhir bzung nas/gzhan 'bras dus kyi lha zhes gnyis kyi rnam par bskyed pa ni bdag gi sras su gzhan bya ba zhes pa yin la/ de ltar bsgom pa'i dgos pa gzhi'i yon tan rnam par sad byed kyi thabs 'bras bu lam byed la goms pas/ yon tan thams cad sad de 'bras bu mthar thug pa thob pa'i phyir na'o/ /gnyis pa/ rnam smin gyi cha 'dzin pa gang gis rang snang ye shes kyi lha gang la shar sgo nas lus rtogs sbyang bar gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis lus rtog spyang bar byas nas hūṃ yig tu bsgyur ba thugs ka nas byang sems kyi ngo bor 'od du zhu nas de dang 'dres nas yab yum gtso 'khor bde chen ngang du 'od du zhu nas thams cad dbyer med pa de dag gi sras su bdag nyid gyur ba la dgongs pa gcig la gnas par bsnom dgos zhes dang / kun tu rtog pa'i gshis ye shes 'od gsal las mthar thug gi 'bras rgyud 'byung ba'am mngon du gyur 154

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdagos pa la/ de 'byung ba la da ltar lam sgom pa dang / de yang bdag sras gzhan sras gang yin kyang 'bras smi lam byed du song ba'i khyad par las myur lam zab mo'i byin rlabs sam de'i mthus 'bras bu zung 'jug gi go 'phang dang dngos su 'brel ba yin pas/ des na 'od gsal gyi bskyed gzhir byas pa las byung ba'i gzhan lha zhes gnyis kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i sras kyi tshogs kyi ngo bor bdag bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na rtog pa kun rtog de'i gshis lugs gnyug ma ye shes yin pas de yi bsgrub gzhi byas nas sngags bla med kyi lam thams cad byung bas 'od las byung / 'byung lugs ni gzhi ye shes lam dus sku gsum gyi ngo bor bskyed cing / 'bras smi sku gsum dang rnam mthun du bsgom pa'i khyad par las des byin rlabs kyi mthu las mthar thug 'bras spri dang lam gzhan brgyud pa la mi ltos par dngos su 'brel bar byed pa'i gnad kyis bde bar gshegs pa rgyal ba rnams kyi sras su bdag rtog tshogs rnams bsgom mo/ /zhes pa zhal rgyun yin nges yin no/ /bzhugs tshul lha gan sa sogs zhal lung 2((0 na yod/ drug pa byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor thad/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni/ srog 'dzin/ gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ me mnyam/ thur sel dang lnga'o/ /byed 'a sa kyang rim bzhin srog gnas pa dang / dbugs 'byung rngub dang /lus gnas pa dang / /drod 'bebs dang / 'gro 'dug gshang gci khu gsum 'byin sdom gyi bya ba byed pa/ gal te log na/ brgyal spyo shi ba sogs dang /stod nad dang / pho ba'i nad dang / smad kyi nad rnams bskyed cing / de dag lus kyi snying ga skog ma/ tshigs thams cad dang / lte ba gsang gnas gsum gnas 155

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃso/ /yan lag gi rlung lnga ni dbang po la gnas shing bskyed pa sogs kyi bya ba byed pa ste/ rgyu ba'i gnas ni spyan yin te/ /rnam par rgyu ba rna ba la/ /yang dag rgyu ba sna dang ni/ /rab tu rgyu ba lce la gnas/ /nges par rgyu ba lus 'di nyid de/ /zhes so/ /zin bris las/ rtsa rlung rtags bcu mkhan chos kyi rgyal po'i ri chos las/ sa chu me rlung bzhi dbu mar 'dus pa las rim par du ba 'tshub pa dang / phyur zhing dud gdangs chags pa lta bu dang / smig rgyu ltar shig shig pa dang / chu rgyug cing char zim 'bab pa lta bu dang / srin bu me khyer ltar 'od tsag tsag dang / dmar phrom nam mkha' la skye zhing yal ba dang / 'du 'phro byed pa lta bu/ mar me 'bar ba dang / sgron me'i phreng ba bsgrigs pa lta bu dang / nam mkha' la rlung 'du ba lta bu'o/ / nyin zhag gcig la dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i dbang du btang na de 'pho ba bcu drug byas na chig stong sum brgya lnga bcu'o/ /'di skor 272 zhal lung na yod ces gsungs/ dbang skabs rin po ches 'dir sngags sdom skye dus ni dam tshig byin pa'i mjug tu yin la/ byang sdom ni zhal lung du sngon rabs pa'i gsung sgros drangs ba ltar na dkyil chog gi sngar phog nas byed pa lta bur snang la/ lus dbul dgos pa gsum phyir byed pa'i skabs su thob rgyur byas kyang rung snyam ste/ dam tshig gsum bkod bzhin no/ /dbang gi grangs bzhir rgyud phyi ma las te/ der dbang dang po la bum dbang zhes ma bshad cing / nyan dbang sogs la mtha' rten chu dbang mi 'dug pas slob dpon gyi dbang zhes bya ste gtso bo'i sgo nas btags pa'o/ /dbang de dkyil 'khor pa las 'thob par bya dgos te/ gzhan du dkyil 'khor bzhengs 156

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsgrub kyang der dbang bskur bar 'dod nas min dgos la/ dal kyi lhas dgongs gtad mdzad pa'i tshig zin yang cher ma thon yang / 'jug pa'i 'og dbang dngos gzhi mtshams sbyor na dkyil 'khor pa la mchod bstod byas nas bdag gi slob ma 'di dag la dbang bskur byed pa la byin gyis rlobs pa'i grogs mdzod/ ces gsol ba 'debs par bshad pa des thon snyam ste/ de dgongs pa gtod ched yin pas so/ /phan dbang la bcur phye ba'i rgyu mtshan gsal bor ma bshad kyang / le'u bcu par rgyal po sbyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes gsungs pa ltar phan dbang gis chos kyi rgyal po'i chas su bcug nas rigs lnga'i rgyal thabs la dbang ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs nas/ nus dbang dang zab dbang gis rim gyis chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang ba'i nus pa dngos su bskyed pa yin la/ de'i tshe rgyal po rnams la rgyal po'i che rtags gtso bo dbu rgyan cod pan/rgol bas mi tshugs pa'i go cha/ bza' btung sogs 'dod yon/ srid na mtho ba'i rtags gdugs sogs yod pa dang bstun nas bzhag pa/ dus 'khor du byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhes pa bzhin no snyam ste dpyad/ dbu rgyan rin po che'i khang bu rin chen rigs kyi lha gnas 'thad pa nas/ bza' btung lus brtas byed yin pas sku'i rigs rnam snang gi rab gnas 'thad pa'i bar du yang dpyod tshul dgos 'dra yang mi gsal bas blo gzu bor 'gro'am snyam/ phan dbang dang nyan sgom gyi dbang rdo rje slob ma'i dbang du don gyis 'gro yang tha snyad mi byed/ 'chad phrin gyis ngag gi thig le la rgyud 'chad pa'i byin rlabs skyed ched 'od dpag med kyi dbang bskur nas gnang ba lton pa dang / las kyi thig 157

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ le la byin gyis brlabs nas las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i mthu bskyed pa'i sgo nas slob dpon du 'os pa'i gzhi bsgrubs te/ gdod slob dpon gyi dbang dngos ster ba yin pas de gsum slob dpon dbang gi phyogs su 'gro bar bshad/ /'di'i dbang bzhi pa'i thal rgyud kyi tshig na/ bde chen las bsgrubs pa'i mtshan dpe la ngo sprad yod pas/ chos gzugs kyi zung 'jug la ngo 'phrod rgyu gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di dag gzhung na yod kyang der mi gsal ba 'dir gsal bar bris/ chas bcu zhes pa/ rgyan chas rtags la bcu yin te/ /dbu rgyan bum pa snying po lnga/ /cod pan go cha phreng ba rgyan/ /thod phreng rtags gsum me dpung ngo / /nus pa'i dbang ni lngar nges te/ /nyan sgom 'chad las rab 'byams dbang / /sgrub pa'i dbang la bco lnga ste/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga dang / /rak+ta rgyal mtshan gdugs kha ṭaṃ/ /phur pa rdor dril rnge'u chung / /yungs dkar gzungs ma phreng ba dang / /tshe dang bza' btung ming dbang ngo / /zab dbang gsum ste gsang ba dang / skyonas rab ye shes bde chen po/ /zhes so/ /byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun ni/rdo rje snying 'grel las/ byis pa skyel ma rnams kyis ni/ /chu yis zhabrud pa'i dbang bskur byed/ /de yi gtsug phud rab 'jog pa/ /cod pan du ni yongs su btags/ /de yi rna ba 'bug pa sogs/ /dar dpyang dbang bskur byed par bshad/ /byis pa smra dang dgod pa ni/ /dril bu rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro/ /lnga pa longs spyod brtul zhugs yin/ /ming ni ming gis dbang bskur yin/ /klog pa la sogs rjes gnang ba/ /bu dag gis ni rab tu ster/ /de ltar rnam pa bdun gyis ni/ /dbang bskur bdun du 158

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrabatu grags/ /zhes so/ /zhal rgyun las/ dbang dus su skyes pa'i mas brtan dga' bzhi 'di dag gis rgyun goms na/ slob pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen dang stong gzugs kyi sku dang / mi slob rig 'dzin gyis sku thugs zung 'jug 'grub par ngo sprad de/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang da lta'i dga' bzhi sku thugs kyi bdag nyid du gnas pa yin pas/ de goms na sku thugs dngos gnas 'grub par 'gyur bas na de ltar ngo sprad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'og sgo'i rnal 'byor skabs rin po ches yas bab kyi dga' ba bcu drug theg chen thun mong ba'i sa lam dang / phar phyin bcur sbyar zhing / mas brtan gyi bcu drug gsang sngags nang gi sa lam dang sbyar ba ni/ rdo rje las rim las/ pha rol phyin dang sa mtshan nyid/ /mtshungs phyir rdzogs par bshad pa yin/ /zhes mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'am chos mtshungs kyi sgo nas yin par bshad do/ /phar theg tu thun mong ba'i phar phyin bcu'i rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba'i gnas skabs las sa bcu sogs 'jog pa bzhin du/ 'dir sa lam thams cad bde chen gyi rtogs pa de nyid gong du 'phel ba'i rim pa'i steng nas 'jog par mtshon pa dang / dga' ba bcu drug po bde ba'i gnas skabs kyi khyad par las phye ba bzhin du/ sngags bla med kyi sa lam rnam kyang bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor na 'phar ba'i gnas skabs kyis phye ba dang /da lta bde ba na 'phar ba'i gnas skabs la dga' ba bcu drug tu phye ba 'di ltar/ma 'ong bar bde chen 'di'i rgyun 'phel ba'i gnas skabs rnams rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcur 'ong zhes bshad na mun sel gyi dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod thad du 'grigs mchan/ phyag rgya dang snyom par 'jug thengs gcig gis dga' 159

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃb bcu drug po rdzogs par nus pa bzhin du/ bde chen gyi lam la brten na sa dang lam thams cad ches myur ba kho nar rdzogs par 'gyur zhes mchog gi bde ba'i rnal 'byor skad cig ma tsam yang lam bsgrod pa'i nus pa phul du byung bar shes ched/ gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba thun gcig la sa bcu lam lnga tshang bar bsgrod pa lta bur bstan pa ste/ bde stong gi lam gyi che ba bstan pa'o/ /zhes dang /mdor bsdu na dwangs snyigs kyi snang ba thams cad mi shigs pa gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul yin yang / da lta snyigs mas bskyed pa'i sems dang snang cha'i steng nas tha mal ba'i zhen pa rtsal shugs mched de 'khrul ba yin zhing / de sbyong ba la dang por bskyed rim gyis sems de ka'i steng nas snang zhen de sdud pa'i sgo btod nas/slar rdzogs rim gyis dwangs ma'i sems mthar thug pa gsal zhing rjen par phyung ste/ de'i rang snang gi steng nas dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin sbyangs te sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa yin no/ /sems can gyi shes pa'i cha thams cad snyigs ma'i snang bas 'phrog pa'i skabs ni mi srid de/ gnyug sems snang ba de dang mi 'grogs pas so/ /dwangs ma'i snang bas ni shes pa'i cha ma lus pa bsgyur du yod de/ sems gzhan thams cad dwangs ma'i snang ba'i rnam pa can gyi gzugs sems kho na la bsdu ba'i skabs yod pa'i phyir te/ rang byung kun ngam lhun grub kyi ces so/ /de ma thag rkyen dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la sogs 'jug tshul bco brgyad bsdus nas/ zhal lung 306 na yod/ gsang dbang gi lam pa dang bum dbang gi lam pa 'gal ba sogs mi bzhed dam snyam zhes pa'i thad/ zhal rgyun du/ bskyed rdzogs spel ma'i skabs kyi stong chen sogs la gsang dbang gi 160

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlamadang / bum dbang gi lam gnyis ka yod do/ /rdzogs rim dang bskyed rim gyis bsdus pa'i de gnyis rgyud ldan yod pa'i phyir/ tshogs sgrub dus su shes rabam la brten pa'i lam yang yod la/ bskyed rim gyi cha phra mo yang yod pas/bum gsang sher gsum gyi lam pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa dang / 'phags lam du gsang sher dang dbyer med bde ba chen po'i dbang gi lam pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod la/ bum dbang gi lam pa dang gzhi mthun med do/ /de yin na so snyes sa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsang sher dbyer med gsum gyi lam pa gcig yod do/ /rim bzhin steng 'og gi sgo'i lam dang 'phags lam rnam gsum gyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so/ /dam tshig thad/ rin po ches/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig lngas rtsa lhung ston pa min te/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig bzhin yin no/ /yan lag la/ nang dug lnga'i rnam rtog ci shar yang de la ma dag pa'i snang zhen gyis spong bsgyur gzhan mi byed par nyon mongs pa de rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i gnas lugs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa'i gnad kyis mi bskyod pa sogs rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gdod nas dag tshul sngags bla med spyi'i gang shar bde stong du lta lugs bzhin du bltas nas/ gang shar gyi nyon mongs thams cad bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i grogs kho nar 'khyer ba dang / phyi'i 'jig rten na shin tu dme smad par grags pa'i rdzas lnga yang dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bdud rtsir byas nas bde chen gyi bcud len du bsten pa/ lnga tshan gnyis pa yang dag dug lnga ni/ log pa'i dug lnga po 'khor 'das so sor mi rtog pa'i gti mug sogs su blta ched bzhag gam dpyad/ rgyud 'dir chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas 161

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpar mthong zhing goms pa rnal 'byor lam gyi srog tu yang yang rtsal bton gyis ston la/ de'i tshe phyi rol gyi rdzas ma dag pa phyi sa sogs dang / nang rnam rtog ma dag pa dug lnga lta bu'ang dag pa rab 'byams kyi rnal 'byor gcig pu'i grogs su 'khyer ba 'di nyid kyi sgos kyi dam tshig tu bstan pas kyang lam gyi srog de nyid dang rnam pa kun tu 'bral mi rung zhes bstan par nges pa rnyed do zhes gsungs/ spyir dam tshig gi rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang zhes pa ni/ rgyud gzhud spyi'i lugs kyi dam tshig sogs zhal lung na gsal lo// ༈ dam tshig bco lnga la dbye tshul zhal lung sogs na gsal lo/ /rnal 'byor spyi khrus sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa ni/ glang chen rab 'bog gi rgyud las/rtogs pa gcig khol du phyung ba kalpa dum bu'am rgyud dri med bshags rgyud las gsungs pa ltar yo ga gsum gyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis nyams chags dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa'i spyi khrus med du byung ba na rag dong sprugs kyi man ngag la brten nas phyi yo byad tshogs kyi bskang bshags/ nang phung po rten gyi bskang bshags/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi bskang bshags nya stong tshes brgyad la byas pas de tshun chad kyi nyams chags rtog sgrib thams cad dag par gsungs la/ de ltar ma nus na'ang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan nas brjod pa yi dam du bgyis pas kyang nyams chags thams cad dag par gsungs te/ gang zhig sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal na/ /nyams chags kun kyang byang 'gyur te/ /mtshamasamed lnga yi sdig kyang 'byang / /na rag gnas kyang dong sprugs te/ /rig 162

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang bshags pa'i rgyud chen bzhi ste/ yang dag don gyi sbyang phyir rtogs pa lta ba'i sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung lta ba'i klong bshags/ lha mi'i gcug sbyang phyir sgom pa bskyed rdzogs kyi sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung ye shes sku mchog /rtsa ba dang yon lag gi gcug sbyang phyir bsrung bya dam tshig gi sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung dam tshig nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro'i gcug sbyang phyir gdung ba smre sngags kyi sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bshags pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang dus 'khor dang snying po rgyan sogs las gsungs pa rnams sdom ṭika las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang phyi yo byad tshogs kyi bskang ba/mar me dang tshogs gtor sman raka brgya rtsa brgyad bcas gdung ba'i sems kyis bshags pa nang phung po rten gyi bskang ba/ dkar cha sman/ dmar cha rak+ta/ rtsa khams gtor ma/ rlung sems kyi cha mar me/ gsang ba sems kyi bskang ba/ rang byung rig pa'i gshis bde sman/ ngo bo stong pa rak+ta/ zung du 'jug pa gtor ma/ rang bzhin gsal ba sgron ma sogs kyis sgo nas nya stong tshes brgyad sogs la bshags/ de ma nus na phyag gi bkol byang tsam rgyun du yi dam du bya'o/ /gnas rdzas thabs sgyi sogs zhal lung na gsal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ rin po tshes/ bro gar gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ rkang pa'i bro dang / lag pa'i gar zhes pa ste/ bros ri brag dang sa 'og gi 'khrul 'khor sogs la thogs pa med par 'grul lam/ gar gyis nam mkhar 'aspyo bar 'gyur zhes sgyu 'phrul ba rnams gsungs so/ /bro phyag rgyar 'jog na'ang rung ste/ sgyu 'phrul las rkang gnyis 163

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃchos dang las kyi sems dpar gsungs nas yan lag thams cad dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u zhes gsungs pa sogs kyi rkang pa brgul bskyod phyag rgyar bstan no/ /zhes dang / glu bro de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ glu ni yul snang thams cad bde nyams su myong bar byed pa'i bde ba de yin/ bro ni bde ba de nyid yul gyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su shar ba'i cha ste/ 'di gar mkhan dag dang ri mo bzang ltar snang / /gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig bu nyid/ /gcig pu'i nyams ni du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /zhes par mang mthun/ de'i tshe blo ngor snang ba thams cad bde ba'i gar du byed pas bros brdzi bya zur du mi 'char mod/ gnas tshod la de 'dra'i rnal 'byor gyi bro 'dul byed dang / yul gyi phra men ma gdul rgyu/ yul gyi rgyud 'phung bar byed pa'i gdug rtsub bre'i de nyid kyis bcom nas dngos grub kyi grogs su khol bar byed pa 'dul lugs su song yod do/ /'di ni rnal 'byor bla med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i rol rtsed sbyang tshul rmad du byung ba'o/ /'di klong du gyur pa na lha dbang dang / mi'i rgyal srid kyi gnas dang / mkha' spyod dang / sa 'og bde ba can sogs gang du bsgrod par 'dod kyang de dang der dgongs pa gtad de bro gar byas pas thogs med du mnan 'gro ste/ mnan pa sa nas sa mnan zhes pa ltar der sleb pa'i don no/ /zhes dang / bde chen gcig pu de nyid/ zhing zhing dwangs ba dang / dga' zhing spro ba dang / chags shing zhen pa dang / khro zhing rngam pa ste las kyi stong sems tha dad du nyams bsgyur ba'i bsam pa'i khyad par bzhin du bro gar gyi spyod pa yang rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan mdzad do/ /zhes dang / bro 'dis snang ba dbang du 164

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbyed par ma zad dbang du byas pa de las nam yang mi ldang bar zil gyis gnon cingarengs par yang byed cing / phyag rgyas btab pa'i don du 'gro ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes dang / glu ni 'gro ba'i yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs dang / gar ni gdul bya ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pa zhes dang / glu gar gyi de nyid gcig yin kyang rkang stabs dang sngags tshig gi sgo so sor shar nas rim bzhin sku'i mdzad pa dang gsung gi mdzad pa'i sgos dngos grub kyi re ba rdzogos par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sgrub pa'i skabs yon tan 'byung ba'i dngas grub drug ces pa rgyud las/ bdud rtsir 'gyur zhing 'byung ba dang / /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel zhing / /longs spyod 'byung zhing ngan song sbyong / /ci yang gzhan du 'gyur ba 'grub/ /ces pas/ zas dug can bsgyur gzhi la yi ge bkod de 'phro 'du'i sgo nas dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba dang /'dod bya gzhan yang ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin 'grub pa dang / nad zhi ba dang /longs spyod 'byung ba dang / ngan 'gro'i sgrib pa sbyong ba dang / bye ma las gser dang sol ba las ljon pa sogs snang ba mi mthun pa gzhan du 'gyur ba rnams so/ /'byung ba'i dngos grub lnga/ /nam mkha' rdo rje sra zhing 'byung / /'bar nas me yang 'tshig pa dang / /chu 'gyur 'bab pa'ang de bzhin de/ /'jig rten khams ni 'thor ba dang / /thams cad stong zhing lhung bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' la rdo rje'i skas bsgoms pas sra ba'i skas 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du lag mthil la yi ge ram̐ ye khaṃ bkod pas ye shes kyi me chu rlung du 'gyur te/ tha mal gyi me nyid kyang sreg par byed pa dang / chu'ang dag par byed par dang / rlung yang 'thor 165

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbar byed la/ yi ge e bkod de 'phro 'dus sbyangs na 'jig rten khams kun stong zhing gzhol phyogs su lhung bar 'gyur ba nyid do/ /phran tshegs dngos grub brgyad ni/ dgug dang gtang dang bcing dang dgrol/ /gso dang bsad dang pham pa rgyal/ /zhes pas dgra bgegs 'gugs pa dang / gling khams gzhan du gtang ba dang / rig sngags kyis bcing ba dang / klu yi byad du bcug pa grol thabs dang / nad gso ba tshe gso ba'o/ /bsad pa dgra bgegs bsad pa/gzhan gyi g.yul pham pa/ rang gi g.yul rgyal bar byed pa'o/ /mchod pa'i skabs/ rta mgrin gsang ba'i yum bcas bskyed/ /ces pa ni/ rgya gram gyi lte bar rta mgrin dmar po pad+ma dang rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin pa/ ra bzhi la rim par/shar du mi pham dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon thod khrag /lhor khro gnyer ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa dang g.yon thod khrag nub tu ro lang ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrogs dang g.yon thod khrag byang ral gcig ma ljang gu g.yas dril bu dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'o/ /sngags kyis rak+ta'i rgya mtshor byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ma brlabs na/ phyi mchod la mtshon na/ yon chab la dri za nye ba'i 'khor/ me tog la me tog tshe rgyal/ bdug spos la nag po dri ldan/ snang gsal la grib gnon rkun po/ dri chab la bdug pa'i dri 'phrog /zhal zas la log 'dren gdong brgya ba zhes bya ba'i bgegs 'jug par bde gshegs 'dus pa las gsungs pas mtshon te nang mchod rnams la'ang 'bag rtsog gi dri mas sbag pa'i skyon gyis rtsa gsum dang dam can la sogs pa dbang du 'du bar mi nus pa'i skyon yod do/ /zhing bcu sogs gdug pa rnams brlag 166

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i zhing bcu ni/ gsal bkra las/ dkon mchog slob dpon sku dgra gnyis/ /dam nyams log dang 'khu ba dang / /'du bar 'ong dang yongs la gnod/ /dam dgra ngan pa'i ngang tshul can/ /ngan song gsum dang bcu po ni/ /rnal 'byor kun gyis dang du blang / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bstan pa'i gnod byed dkon mchog sku dgra dang / bla ma'i sku dgra dang / dam tshig nyams nas gso bar mi byed pa dang / sngags kyi theg par zhugs pa las log pa dang / bla ma dang mched la 'khu ba dang / sngags spyod la 'du bar mi dbang bzhin du rku thabs su gnaspopa dang / sems can yongs la gnod par byed pa dang / dam ldan gyi dgrar gyur ba dang / mi dge ba'i las kho nar 'jug pa dang / yang na rgyud las/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang / /theg chen chos la smod pa dang / /bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang / /rdo rje'i nang du dbyen byed pa/ /sgrub la bar chad byed pa dang / /gang zag dam las log pa dang / /snying rje med pa'i srin po dang / /mu stegs log ltar gtong ba dang / /sgrub pa po la do bsdo ba/ /'di rnams bsgral ba'i zhing bcu yin/ / zhes gsungs so/ /phyag rgya'i skabs dang thal ba'i lung / /ra dang 'dab ma'i thig le rnams/ /rang gnas kyi sogs thad zhal rgyun las/ ra 'dab ma zhes pa yum mkha' pad+ma/ yab kyi gsang ba rdo rjer bsgom pa ltar/ g.yas thabs kyi yig 'bru bkod pa'i gzhi la ra dang / g.yon shes rab 'bru lnga bkod pa'i gzhi la 'dab ma zhes brjod do/ /bsnol ba dang ma bsnol ba zung bcas kyi phyag rgya bcing ba'i dgos pa/ bde ba thams cad spyir 167

g.yu khog bla ma chos dpyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbasdu na rigs 'dres ma 'dres gnyis su 'du bas de'i ngo bor bsdom pas rnal 'byor pas phung khams lha'am bdag nyid du brtan par gnas pa'i ched du'am mngon du gyur ba'i don du'o/ /zhes gsungs/ 'on te grol lam gyi dngos grub bsgrub tshul lta bu dang bstun na zhes pa'i thad/ rin po che nyid kyi gsung las/man ngag 'di'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim thabs grol gnyis kyi khyad par/ mtshon byed kyi thabs rdzogs rim pa'i zhu bde myong ba tshun chad thabs lam dang / mtshon bya don rig stong gdod ma'i gnas lug dngos la reg pa na grol lam du bzhed ces gsungs pas/ gtso bor mtshon bya don gyi gnas lug rtogs pa'i lam gyis mthar rang gi yin lugs dngos gsal bar sad pa'am mngon du gyur ba mthar thug pa na sangs rgyas pa zhes brngod pa yin/ nying dgos dang rgyud kyi brjod bya don gyi gtso bo gnyis bdag gcig 'brel yin zhes pa nges pa lhag par 'drong ba zhig yod ces zer ram dpyad/ chos mchog zhing la ngal ba'i sa bon 'ga'/ /bskyed las rgyu mthun sdong po cher rgyas te/ /zab lam ro brgya'i 'bras ster nyan bshad kyi/ /yal 'dab phyogs dus khyab par ster gyur cig /phyi snod gsang chen rgyud sde'i mdzod du gyur/ /nang bcud 'gro kun rig 'dzin tshom bur sad/ /brtan g.yo mtha' dag sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gcig tu byang chub shog /ces rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i bka' yi bskul ba ldog tu ma phod par/ slob ming bas gsung sgros rnams phyogs bsgrigs 'dra ba zhig byas kyang rang nyid shes rab chung zhing rgyud shin tu rmongs pa'i dbang gi bsgrigs tshul rnams la nongs par gyur ba ci mchis pa dang /168

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzhal rgyun yin snang shar yang brjed nges che ba'i dbang gis don min du song ba sogs nyes pa thams cad bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma dam pa dang / chos kyi spyan ldan thams cad la 'jigs shing zhus pas bzod par gsol bas mi sgrib par mdzad pa dang / dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad khul bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang chen bstan pa'i rtsa ba chos rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad rab tu brtan cing 'dus pa'i tshogs kun nas kun tu rgyas te gsang chen bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la dus nam yang mi nub pa'i rgyur gyur ba dang / bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams dang skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing dus kun tu mnyes pa gsum gyis sgo nas bka' bzhin du bgyid cing gsang chen snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du spel ba'i snang byed chen por gyur cing 'gro kun gdod ma'i mgon po'i sa la dbugs dbyung ba'i mthun 'gyur dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang rgyal ba sras bcas yongs kyis mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin du 'grub pa gyur cig /dge'o/ /bkra shis so//༈ gzhung 'di'i dbu zhabs kyi don ni dag mnyam bde pa dbyer med yin la/de la sbyang gzhi dang / sbyong byed / sbyangs 'bras gsum yod pas/ dang po ni/yun ring nas ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang du song ba'i so skyes rang ga ma'i glo bur nyag gcig gi 'khrul ngor ye nas dag pa la ma dag par snang ba dper na dung ser snang lta bu de sbyang gzhi/ gnyis pa/ dag pa ye nas yin pa la yin par shes pa'i thabs zab mo gzhung 'di nas bstan pa'i bskyed rdzogs thabs grol gyi lam mam rgyud kyi dngos po bcu sogs sbyong byed/ gsum pa/ ye nas dag pa 169
rab 'byams yin pa la yin par shes pa snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang ngam dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med pa las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i gsal brtan dag gsum thob pa'o// //

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i zin bris gsang ba'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde'u migasnga 'gyur gyi che ba drug ni/ rong zom pa chos kyi bzang pos/ dang po spyan 'dren pa po yon bdag gi che ba/ snga 'gyur ba'i yon bdag 'phags pa rig gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum yin pas phyi 'gyur gyi yon bdag dang mi 'dra/ gnyis pa gang du bsgyur ba'i gnas phyag bzhes gtsug lag khang gi che ba/ sngon sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bsam yas sogs chos 'khor stod smad yin pas da lta'i grong dgon phag phug dang mi 'dra/gsum pa sgra bsgyur lo tsā ba'i che ba/ sngon sgra bsgyur be+e ro tsā na ska cog zhang gsum/ me gnyags/ gnubs sogs sprul pa'i lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i chos yin/da lta brda sprod gzhung dum re shes pa la lo tsār btags/ dbyar mang yul du bsdad/ dgun bal yul du yug re phyin nas bsgyur ba dang mi 'dra/ bzhi pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i che ba/ sngon zhi ba 'tsho/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ pad 'byung / bi ma la sogs sangs rgyas dang sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang 'phags rnam kyis spyan drangs pa'i chos yin/ da lta gser 'dod du 'khyams pa rnams dang mi 'dra/ lnga pa phyag rten me tog gi che ba/ sngar gser sha ba'i rlid bu dang bre la gzhal nas zhus pa'i chos yin/ da lta mchan nas gser zho re gnyis bton nas zhus pa dang mi 'dra/ drug pa bsgrur bya chos kyi che ba/ sngon 'phags yul du sangs rgyas 171

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyi bstan pa gra ma nyams dus bsgyur bar ma zad/ 'phags yul na med pa'i rgyud byang chub sems dpa' dang grub pa dang rig 'dzin dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzung ste dag pa'i zhing na bzhugs pa dang / 'dzam gling gi bye brag o rgyan dang sing ga la yi gling sogs nas slob dpon pad+ma dang bi ma la sogs grub pa'i khyu mchog rnams kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas blangs nas bsgyur ba yin/ 'gyur yang sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams sprul pa'i sku yin pas don ji lta ba bzhin du gtan la 'bebs pas go sla zhing byings 'jal ba la rlabs che/ phyis kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis don bsgyur ma nus par rgya dpe'i go rim ltar sgra bsgrur byas pas tshig grim la go dka'/ byings mjal ba la rlabs chung bas mi 'dra ba yin gsungs/ ༈ pha rgyud kyi pha rgyud sogs gsum ka'i skabs su rig pa 'od gsal byang chub kyi sems nyid lha skur 'char ba la slob par khyad med kyang /gtso bor rdul tshon dang ras bris sogs phyi dkyil la brten nas bdag sras dang gzhan sras rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed dang bzhi bskyed sogs bskyed chog shin tu rgyas pa'i rnam bzhag ston pa ma hā'i ma hā ste 'dus pa lta bu'o/ /phyi dkyil la brten nas lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yod kyang gtso bor rang gi rdo rje lus kyi grong khyer gdod nas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gnas pa nyid ngo shes pa'i skad cig dran rdzogs lta bur lhar gsal ba rtsal du bton pa'i rgyud de ma hā'i a nu'am pha rgyud kyi ma rgyud ces bya'o/ /'di'i mtshan gzhi ni mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo dang 'khor lo bde mchog lta bu ste/ rje yab sras kyis pha ma gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhir bde mchog yin kyang / rang 172

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlugs rig 'dzin gong mas pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las pha rgyud kyi phyogs su drangs nas pha rgyud kyi ma rgyud ces bzhed la/ ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhir mdo tshogs chen 'dus pa lta bu 'jog phyi dkyil sogs kyang yod mod/ gtso bor rang rig pa'i ye shes skye ba med pa bden pa dbyer med kyi rang bzhin nyid lha'i zhabor lo sgom pa'i tshul rtsal du 'don pa ma hā'i a ti'i ste pha rgyud kyi gnyis med kyi rgyud ces bya'o/ /'di ma hā skor gsum du phye ba'i a ti yin gyi/ spyir ma hā ma nu a ti zhes pa'i a ti ma yin te de yin na bskyed rdzogs rim 'jug gi spros pa la mi ltos kyang / 'dir rim gnyis rim can du 'jug pa'i phyogs ste/rgyud gsang ba'i snying po lta bu'o/ /'di nyid gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa'i gnyis med ni/ skor snga ma gnyis kyi 'jog byed gnyis rtsal 'don du med pa la go dgos/ pha rgyud kyi ma rgyud ces pa'i ma'am shes rab kyi ldog pa ni/ rang gi shes rab kyi gshis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la dbab pa'i cha ste/ dmigs rnam thams cad bsdus nas stong nyid bsgom pa la shes rab ces zer ba lta bu'o/ / pha rgyud kyi pha rgyud ces pa'i pha'am thabs kyi ldog pa ni/ snang cha lha'i 'khor lo spros pa'i rnam grangs shin tu rgyas pa la bya ste/ spyin sogs rgya che ba'i nyams len rnam grangs shin tu mang ba la thabs zhes zer ba lta bu'o/ /ma hā'i a ti'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ni/ ma hā'i ma hā sogs kyi gdul bya las ches dbang po rno bas/ rim gnyis la rim can du 'jug pa'i rtsol bcos kyi nyams len yod kyang / bskyed rim sgom tshul khyad par can gyis rgyud myur du smin pa dang / rdzogs rim kyang dang por rtsol bas bsgrub pa'i cha yod kyang mthar rtsol 173

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmed kyi lam skyong ba zhig 'byung zhing / de'i tshul gtso bor 'chad pa yin pas/des na dang por rtsol bas rim can du 'jug tshul ma hā dang 'dra zhing / mthar lam rtsol med kyi skyong tshul rdzogs chen dang mthun pas ma hā'i a ti zhes bzhag pa yin gsungs/ gal te 'di snyam du/ bde mchog ma hā'i a nur 'jog pa mi 'thad de/ rgyud de'i 'grel ba dang man ngag rnams su rdo rje'i phung po rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du lhun gyi grub tshul gtan la phab nas de'i steng nas lam bsgrod tshul sogs 'chad dgos pa la/ mkhas pa rje yab sras kyis ma gsungs ba'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyud de'i nyams len 'dus pa dang mthun par rim can du bgyid tshul bshad kyang / rig 'dzin gong mas gdod nas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gnas pa lam du 'byer tshul rgyud de'i don du khas blangs ba dang 'gal mi dgos te/ gnyis ka'ang rgyud de'i dgongs par gnas pa'i phyir te dper na phyag na rdo rjes bde mchog stod 'grel du dus 'khor ltar bshad pa dang / la ba pas sbas rgyud ltar bshad pa dang / kye rdor gyi rgyud rdo rje snying pos dus zhabor du bkral zhing / grub chen mtsho skyes kyis sbas rgyud du bkral ba dang / 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma na ro bas sgron gsal ltar bshad kyang / dbang mdor bstan thad dus 'khor ltar bshad pa dang / 'jam dpal sgyu drwa rigs ldan pad dkar gyis dus 'khor du bkral zhing / paṇa dri med bshes gnyen gyis rdzogs chen du bkral ba sogs rgyud de dang de'i dgongs pa yin chog pa bzhin te/ bi ma mi drwa sogs ni sngags bla med kyi 'phags lam grub pa'i gang zag yin dgos la/ de lta na rgyud don mngon shes 174

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyis 'chad nus pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ ༈ che ba brgyad kyi skabs/rgyud 'di theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse zhes gsungs pa dang / rdzogs chen gyis yong rtse ma yin pa gnyis mi 'gal te/rdo rje 'chang gis gsang ba'i snying po'i tshed du bya ba'i gdul bya de la/ rgyud 'di'i gong mar gyur pa'i rgyud cig med pa ltar ston gyi 'di gong na rdzogs chen gyi rgyud yod ces ston mi rigs pa'i phyir/de 'dra de la de ltar ston rigs pa'i gdul bya ma yin pa'i phyir/ dper na phar phyin theg pa'i gdul bya de la theg pa chen po gsang sngags ma bstan pa lta bu ste/des na don la rgyud 'di'i gong mar gyur pa'i rgyud khyad par can yod pa dang /gdul bya de'i ngor rgyud 'di theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtser song ba gnyis mi 'gal lo// ༈ rtsa bshad mi 'gal te/ zhes pa'i thad/ thog mar byung zhing 'chad byar gyur pa dang / rjes la byung zhing 'chad byed du gyur pa gnyis ka yin pa yod par tha' / rgyud phyi ma de de yin pa'i phyir na rnam pa gcig tu skyon med de/rgyud phyi ma de bshad rgyud gzhan gyi thog mar byung zhing 'chad bya yin pas rtsa rgyud du gtogs la/ le'u nyer gnyis po la ltos na rjes la byung zhing 'chad byed yin pa'i phyir/ des na thog ma kho nar byung zhing 'chad bya kho nar gyur pa rtsa rgyud dang /rjes kho nar byung zhing 'chad byed kho nar gyur pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis 'gal la/thog mar byung zhing rtsa rgyud tsam dang / rjes la byung zhing 'chad byed kyi rgyud yin pa tsam 'gal mi dgos te/ dper na rtsa rgyud nyid las/ grub pa'i zhag dang tshes grangs ni/ khusmyud las smos pa bzhin du'o/ /zhes pa thog mar byung zhing 'chad bya yin la/ zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /zhes sogs rjes la byung zhing 'chad 176

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbyed yin mod kyang / gnyis ka rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung yin pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ ma hā'i a ti las chos thams cad sangs rgyas par bshad pa las lhag cig rdzogs chen gyi skabs su'ang cher med pas de'i cha nas dpyad na theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse dang lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel zhes brjod na legs la/ lta ba de skyong tshul dang lam gyi yan lag mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas rgyud sde la mchog dman so so'i gdul bya'i ngor mchog dman 'jog tshul yod kyang mi 'gal lo/ /spyir gsar rnying gi sngags kyi dgongs pa ma 'dres par so sor rang thad rang thad nas 'chad shes pa zhig dang / don gyi gnad gcig tu 'bab pa dang / gnas skabs skyong tshul sogs tha dad pa zhig gi sgo nas 'chad shes pa 'di gal che gsungs/ ༈ da lta gshis spang rtogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin kyang / sgrib byed zhakhrul ba ma bral ba'i gnas skabs su sems can zhes bya la/'on kyang sems can yin pa'i gnas skabs na yang gshis sangs rgyas yin pa mi 'gal te/ chu gcig nyid rnyogs ma'i chu yin pa dang gzhis dngas pa'i chu yin pa gnyis ka dus mnyam du yod pa mi 'gal la/ dwangs pa'i chu de rnyogs pa min la/ rnyogs pa'i chu de dwangs pa min pa bzhin no/ /gshis sangs rgyas yin kyang 'gro ba de sangs rgyas yin mi dgos te/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi myang 'das rgyud ldan yin yang myang 'das rgyud ldan yin mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /rang rgyud na sangs rgyas yod na ci'i phyir rang la mngon du mi 'gyur zhe na/ rang rgyud na yod na mngon du gyur mi dgos la/ mngon gyur du med na med mi dgos te/'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi dus kyi byang chub kyi sems yod tshul sogs 176

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhin no/ /gal te gshis la rnam mkhyen yod na rnam pa thams cad da ltar mkhyen dgos so zhe na ni/ chab rom gshis mnyen zhing gsher ba'i chu yin na da lta mnyen zhing gsher ba'i chu mngon gyur yin dgos zhes smra ba dang 'dra'o/ /'o na gshis lugs ma rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhig yod par thal/ khyod kyis gshis sangs rgyas yin rung gshis ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyis gshis lugs rtogs kyang gshis lugs ma rtogs pa de sems can yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi gzhi mthun yod par thal lo zhe na/sangs rgyas ni gshis lugs mthar thug gi steng nas 'jog la/ sems can ni 'khrul ba'i kun rtog gi gzhan dbang can 'di la 'jog pas skyon med do/ /'o na stong nyid la gnyis snang nub pa'i ye shes 'od gsal gyi gshis la rang chas su yod dam zhe na/ yod de/ gshis sangs rgyas yin na gshis la rnam mkhyen yod dgos/ de lta na ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i chos sku yod dgos pa'i phyir/ des lam zhugs dang lam ma zhugs dang / skye 'phags kyi gzhi mthun khegs tshul sogs kyang des shes thub/ da ltar gdul bya'i ngor gzugs sku gnyis snang nas phrin las mdzad par thal/ gshis de sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/'o na khyod rang la da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dus gsum gyi 'gro ba'i don byed par thal/ sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grigs/ 'dod na ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya la da ltar phrin las 'jug pa'i skabs yin par thal/dus gsum gyi 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'jug pa'i yul gyi gdul bya de da ltar ma skyes pa'i phyir te/ ma 'ongs pa 177

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyin pa'i phyir/ des na ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya'i don du 'jug pa'i phrin las rdzogs par yod kyang da ltar mi 'jug pa mi 'gal ba bzhin/ gshis la 'bras chos kyi yon tan thams cad yod kyang phyi gsal du med pas da lta phrin las ma mdzad kyang skyon med de/ phrin las mdzad pa la mngon du gyur dgos pa'i phyir/'o na sems can gyi rgyud la zhakhrul ba skye mi rigs par thal/ gshis la gnyen po'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par yod pa'i phyir na skyon med de/ gshis su yod kyang de yod pa tsam gyis de'i rgyud na gnyen por yod par 'jog mi nus te/rnyogs ma'i chu'i gshis dwangs pa yin pas gshis dwangs par 'jog thub kyang chu de dwangs par 'jog mi thub pa bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas kyis ma dag 'khor ba'i skyed gzhi byed par thal/ gshis kyi sangs rgyas des ma dag pa'i 'khrul gni byed pa'i phyir zhe na/ gshis des 'khor ba'i snang ba bskyed pa min gyi gshis de ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis zhabrul snang 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ phar phyin theg pa'i skabs su/ bskal grangs med gsum du lam goms dgos kyang /rdzogs chen sogs su de mi dgos par thun mong gi lam la blo legs par sbyangs nas de nas rig stong snang cha dang bcas pa'i nyams len rtsal 'don byas pas chog pa sogs kyang gshis na lam thams cad yod pas sad byed kyi thabs re las gzhan mi dgos pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ 'o na stong gzugs kyi sku de'ang gshis kyi rgyal ba'i sku'i yon tan sad pa yin dgos la/ de lta na sku des shes bya thams cad mkhyen nam zhe na/ ma yin te shes bya thams cad mngon du gyur par mkhyen pa la ye shes kyi nus pa ci yod rdzogs par sad 178

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdagos la/ de 'dra'i sku'i snang ba de gzhi'i yon tan cha shas tsam snang ba yin gyi sku'i yon tan rdzogs par ma sad pa'i phyir gshis kyi yon tan rdzogs par sad pa dang dri ma lhag med du zad pa dus mnyam mo/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i skabs/gzhi'i rig pa nyid chos gzugs kyi sku'i 'char gzhi yin pas gzhi snang sku dang zhing khams kyi snang ba shar ba phyogs su bsdu rung yang de'i skabs dbyings nang gsal gyi yon tan rig pa phyi gsal du ma rdzogs pas/ gzhi snang la gzhan du bzung nas 'khrul ba lugs rgyud du mched pa yin no/ /des na gshis la yon tan thams cad rdzogs par yod kyang / de nang gsal du yod pa yin no/ /'dir nang gsal zhes pa ni/ yon tan de dag mngon du gyur ma rag pa lta bu las mngon du ma gyur pa zhig la go dgos/ de yang sangs rgyas yin la yon tan mngon du ma gyur ba zhig med de/ sangs rgyas yin na mngon gyur du yod dgos pa'i phyir/ des na yon tan mngon gyur du med pa'i sgo nas kyang da lta gang zag de sangs rgyas yin mi dgos par 'grub la/ gzhan yang / ji ltar mi dbul khyim nang sa 'og na/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ dbul bo de gter yod lugs kyi ngos nas phyug po yin kyang / de la phyug po mi zer te dbul bo yin pa'i phyir te/ phyug dbul gyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ ༈ rig stong gi lta ba rtogs pa la'ang zhib tu phye na/ stong nyid ma rtogs la rig cha man ngag bzhin du legs par ngo 'phrod pa zhig dang / rig stong dbyer med du ngo 'phrod kyang gshis kyi 'dug tshul gyi rig pa rjen par ma thon pas stong nyid mngon sum du ma rtogs pa zhig dang / kun rtog gi shub nas thon te stong nyid 179

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmangon sum du rtogs pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur kyang gshis kyi bzhugs tshul gyi yon tan gyi cha gzhan mngon du ma sad pa'i skabs sogs du ma dbyer rung la/ 'dir ni gtso bor rig stong gnyis med du rtogs pa 'ba' zhig yin no/ /spyir rig pa ni chu'i grang ba lta bu dang / kun rtog thams cad gshis kyi 'dug tshul ma yin pas chu'i tsha ba lta bu yin la/ de yang snga ma ni gnas tshul mthar thug ste/ de la sgrib byed med na dag pa rab 'byams kyi brtan g.yo'i bkod pa 'char ba dang sgrib byed kyis 'char du ma btub pa yin la/ sgrib byed 'di dag don la yod pa zhig snang ba ma 'khrul bas snang ba min kyang / don la med pa zhig snang ba 'khrul snang du grub pas de lta na kun rtog yul bcas gshis la ma grub pa'i glo bur ba yin pas theg pa 'dir med snang 'khrul ba zhes bya'o//༈ kun rtog dang bden dngos gnyis char gyis stong pa'i gshis kyi rnam pa'i bzhugs lugs 'dus pa sogs su ma bstan par lam de'i 'gros rang lus thabs ldan la brten nas ye shes lam du byed pa'i bsgrod tshul phyogs gcig yin pas dang po nas de 'dra'i rig stong gi lta ba ngo sprad pa ma gsungs pa yin gyi/de 'dra'i tshul gcig med par mi bzhed la/ 'dir ni dang po nas gshis rig stong gi lta ba'i yin lugs dang po nas ngo 'phrod dgos te rgyud 'di'i lam gyi gzhung shing lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ ༈ gzhi'i 'od gsal shar ba'i skabs kyi gzhi snang gi snang ba de ye shes nyid kyi rang snang yin kyang blo de'i ngor snang tshul rang snang du snang mi nus par yul yul can rgyang chad pa'i gnyis snang can du 'brel te rang snang la gzhan du bzung nas rim gyis kun rtog 'khyul ba mched de da 180

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃltar gyi ma dag pa'i snang ba 'dir snang song ba yin/ de'i gnad kyis da lta'i yul snang 'di dag gi steng na yang sngar gyi ye shes rang snang du gyur pa'i gzhi snang sad pa'i snang cha re yod dgos pas/ yul can kun rtog thams cad kyi gshis 'od gsal gyis khyab pa bzhin/ yul snang 'di dag thams cad la yang ye shes kyi snang cha re yod dgos so byas pa la/ 'di snyam du/ da lta ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di la dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang cha re yod na/ da lta nas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'dod dgos so/ /zhe na/ ye shes kyi snang cha la chos nyid bar do'i snang ba lta bu dag pa'i snang ba yin kyang kun rtog sa bon dang bcas pa gtan ma spangs pa'i skabs kyi de dang / de gtan log tu song ba'i khyad par du byas pa'i 'bras bu'i dus kyi snang cha gnyis sogs yod pas/ ye shes snang cha gang yin 'bras dus kyi snang cha yin mi dgos te/ ye shes kyi snang cha dang dag pa'i snang ba tsam du mnyam yang khyad thang chen po yod/ ༈ yul can 'od gsal la sgrib byed kyi kun rtog rim gyis zad pa dang gshis je mngon du song ba'i tshe/yul snang ye shes kyi snang cha yang mngon du gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen zad pa'i dbang gis nus pa brtas nas gang snang dag pa'i 'khor lor 'char ba zhig 'byung ngo / /des na de ltar yul snang la yod pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba de gshis kyi rang snang yin pas/ yul snang sad pa ni yul can la ltos pa yin te/ yul can ma dag pa'i dbang gis yul dman pa sna tshogs su snang la/ yul can rnam par dag pa mthar thug gi dbang gis rang snang longs sku'i bkod pa'i rol mo 'byung ba yin no// ༈ 'o na kun rtog dang de'i gshis 'od gsal gnyis ngo bo gcig 181

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyin nam zhe na/ 'od gsal gshis kyi 'dug tshul dbang btsan par byas na/kun rtog rnams med snang 'khrul ba yin pas ngo bo 'di yin zhes bzhag tu med de/ dung gi dkar po dang ser snang gnyis ngo bo gzhan ma yin pas gcig ces ming 'dogs chog pa ltar yin no// ༈ thos grol ni rgyud 'di'i man ngag yin kyang / zur lugs dang mi mthun te/ de las chos nyid bar do'i skabs zhi khro'i lha tshogs pra phab pa bzhin 'char ba'i ngo sprod rdzogs chen nas 'byung ba bzhin yod do/ /des na kun mkhyen gyis a ti'i ma hār bkral ba dang gu ru'i dgongs pa yin pas thos grol yang phyogs bcu mun sel dgongs pa'i babs mthun/༈ tañtsa chen po sde bco brgyad ni/ dpal 'phreng dam pa'i 'grel ba slob dpon ku ku rwa dzas mdzad par/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i gzhi dang de'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i rgyud sde lnga/ sgrub pa lag len du bstan pa rol pa'i rgyud lnga/spyod pa'i yan lag tu 'gro ba'i rgyud lnga/ cho ga ma tshang ba kha skong bar byed pa rgyud phyi ma lta bu gnyis/ de thams cad kyi bsdus don lta bu'i rgyud chen po gcig dang bco brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar smin gling yab sras kyis bzhed de/ /dang po la sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi rgyud zla gsang thig le/thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po/ phrin las kyi rgyud karmā mā le dang lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ he ru ka rol pa'i rgyud/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud/ snying rje rol pa'i rgyud/ bdud rtsi rol pa'i rgyud/ phur pa bcu gnyis pa 'byung ba'i rgyud dang lnga'o/ /gsum pa la/ ri bo brtsegs pa/ ye shes rngam glog /dam tshig bkod pa/ ting 'dzin rtse gcig glang chen rab 'bog 182

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgi rgyud dang lnga'o/ /bzhi pa la/ rnam snang sbru drwa dang / 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pakhro'i phreng ba'i don bsdus dang gnyis so/ /lnga pa ni/ spyi rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'o/ /sngags kyi spyi don las/ tan+d+ra sde bco brgyad du phye ba ni/ sku'i rgyud gsum/ gsung gi rgyud gsum/ thugs kyi rgyud gsum/ yon tan gyi rgyud gsum/ phrin las kyi rgyud gsum/ spyi rgyud gsum ste bco brgyad do/ /de la sku'i sku rgyud glang po rab 'bog /sku'i gsung rgyud glang po chur 'jug /sku'i thugs rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi sku rgyud ri bo brtsegs pa/ gsung gi gsung rgyud pad+ma dbang chen/ gsung gi thugs rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi sku rgyud rtse mo 'dus pa/ thugs kyi gsung rgyud gcig las 'phros pa/ thugs kyi thugs rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi sku rgyud sgron me 'bar ba/ yon tan gyi gsung rgyud bdud rtsi sa ma ya 'bum sde/ yon tan gyi thugs rgyud dpal mchog dang po/ phrin las kyi sku rgyud dpal phreng dkar mo/ phrin las gyi gsung rgyud ma mo rgyud lung / phrin las kyi thugs rgyud ta ma la 'bum sde/ spyi'i sku rgyud thabs zhags/ spyi'i gsung rgyud sa ma ya bkod pa/ spyi'i thugs rgyud gsang ba sgyu 'phrul lo/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ gsang 'grel phyogs bcu'i mun sel las/sgyu 'phrul sde bzhir bzhed de/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang snang dbyer med du ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang / las tshogs rgyas par ston pa rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang / rol pa mngon du ston pa lha mo sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang / theg pa kun la khyab par ston pa 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la yang brgyad de/ sems dang ye shes 183

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrang snang bar ston pa dpal gsang ba'i snying po dang / phrin las rdzogs par ston pa bzhi bcu pa dang / dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ston pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad pa dang /dbang bskur ba gsal bar ston pa sgyu 'phrul bla ma dang / dam tshig mchog tu ston pa sgyu 'phrul le lag dang / yon tan rgyas par ston pa sgru 'phrul brgyad cu pa dang / lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gsal bar ston pa rdo rje me long dang /bskyed rim gsal bar ston pa rgya mtsho dang / thabs lam gsal bar ston pa thal ba dang sde brgyad do/ /zhes so/ /zur lugs pa phal cher/ sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad dang / bshad rgyud sde bzhir dbye bar mdzad de/ dang po ni/ zhabor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang snang dbyer med du ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ las tshogs rgyas par snyon pa rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ sde snod yongs la khyab par ston pa 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyas par ston pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad pa/ phrin las rdzogs par ston pa bzhi bcu pa/dbang gtso bor ston pa bla ma/ yon tan mthar phyin par ston pa brgyad cu pa/dam tshig mchog tu ston pa le lag dang brgyad do/ /gnyis pa ni grol lam rim cig char du ston pa ye shes snying po dang / rdo rje me long dang / thabs lam rigs cig char du ston pa rgya mtsho dang thal rgyud do// ༈ shan 'byed las/ gzhan yang dbu ma dang ma 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa rang lam kho na nyams su blangs kyang thar pa mi thob zer ba la brtag pa/ rdo rje theg pa na thabs grol gyi lam gnyis ka bshad pas/ grol lam gyi bdag med gnyis rtogs des mi grol na dbu ma la'ang mtshungs te/ don la khyad med pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te de dbu ma'i yin no 184

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzer na/ dbu ma'i skabs su gang zag gi bdag med bstan pa nyan thos kyi yin par 'gyur bas/ gang zag gi bdag med ma rtogs na 'khor ba las mi grol ba'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi grub mtha' dang ma 'brel na dbum pa'i lam la'ang thar ba med par mtshungs so/ /des na nyan thos kyi grub mtha' sngon song min na rdo rje'i theg pa la thar lam med smros shig gal te dbu ma pa'i lam na gang zag gi bdag med ci smas/ chos kyi bdag med kyang rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir nyan thos kyis der ltos mi dgos snyam na/ rdo rje theg pa ni bde ba pos khyad par du byas pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid khyad par 'phags pa yod na dbu ma'i de lta ci smos/ rnam kun mchog ldan khyad par ba phung po rnam dpyad kyi stong nyid las 'phags pa'i sngags kyi khyad chos su bshad de/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ srid gsum phra rab gzugs min 'dir ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /de bzhin rnam par shes pa nyid med de/ /sangs rgyas shes rab gang du'ang gnas pa ma yin zhes pa'i dzig ni sangs rgyas pa rnams ston par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'gyur med dang bral mi rnams kyis ni stong pa nyid de bzung nas stong par lta byed pa/ /des na gtso bas gang zhig 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba dag ni sngags kyi thag par bstan/ /zhes dang / phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de dang 'dra ma yin/ /zhes so/ /bde ba'ang 'gyur bde myong ba'i bde ba ni lam gyi rten tsam yin gyi/ bde min te mi rtag pa'i phyir ro/ /in+d+ra bho dhis/ bde chen mi rtag ma yin te/ /bde ba chen po rtag tu 185

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrtag /ces gsungs/ des na tshor bde 'gyur ba can min te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i ka dag lhun grub dbyer med kyi rang bzhin la/'gyur ba'i zug rngu thams cad bral kyang rang gi ngo bo 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes 'khor ba'i zag bcas kyi bde ba dang sdug bsngal kun gyis ma gos pa la/ gang snang bde bar 'char ba las zug rngu sogs yong ye med pas bde chen dang 'du 'bral med pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /2che ba brgyad ni/ khog gzhung gsal sgron las/ rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /gzhan las 'phags pa'i che ba brgyad/ /ces pa ltar/ rgyud thams cad gyi rgyal po yin pas nges par che ba gzi ldan gsal ba'i nyi ma lta bu/ theg pa thams cad gyi yang rtse yin pas che ba dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab lta bu/ bstan pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs yin pas che ba 'byung ba nam mkha' lta bu/ lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel yin pas che ba nam mkhas snang srid kyi go phye ba lta bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i zhe phug yin pas che ba rgyal po'i bka' gsang thob pa'i mi lta bu/'bras bu thams cad kyi thug sa yin pas che ba yid bzhin nor bu rin chen lta bu/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gshegs shul yin pas che ba stong lam gyi shul lta bu/ ma 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnam kyi lam yin pas che ba khri lam lta bu ste brgyad do/ /de las dang po ni ji ltar nyi ma'i snang ba ni snang ba thams cad kyi rgyal po yin pa bzhin du rgyud 'di nyid kyang rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po'o//gnyis pa ni/ ji ltar lhun po'i rtser phyin na ri phran thams cad mig 'og tu tshud pa ltar rgyud 'di'i don rtogs na theg pa thams cad kyi don 'dir 'dus pa'i 186

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃphyir de thams cad shes par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni ji ltar nam mkha' las 'byung ba bzhi shar nas snod bcud chags pa ltar/ rgyud 'di'i byin rlabs las bstan pa dang theg pa thams cad 'phros pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ ji ltar nam mkhas snang srid go phye ba ltar/ mtshan nyid dang rgyud thams cad kyi don dang 'bras bu thams cad 'dir 'dus shing 'dis ston pas na lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ ji ltar rgyal po'i bka' gsang thob pa'i mi ni rgyal po'i blo'i gtad sa yin pas 'bangs rnams blon gzhan la rag lus mi pa bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba dam pa'i mthar thug 'di las mi 'da' bas 'di'i don rtogs na thegs gzhan la rag mi lus dgos pa'o/ /drug pa ni ji ltar yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin chen ni 'dod rgu thams cad ster ba'i mchog mthar thug tu grub pa bzhin du/ bstan pa dang theg pa thams cad kyi mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di kho nar thug pa'o/ /bdun pa ni ji ltar gang du 'gro ba'i lam po cher der slebs pa thams cad kyis phyin pa ltar/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad lam 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ ji ltar gnas der slar 'gro 'gyur rnams kyang lam de la 'gro ba bzhin du/ ma 'ongs pa na 'tshang rgya 'gyur rnams kyang lam 'di kho na la brten nas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /spyir ma hā yo ga'i rgyud rnams rgyan bdun gyi sgo nas 'chad pa he ru ka galbe'i rgyud las gsungs te/ ma hā yo ga'i rgyan bdun yang / gleng slong ba dang sangs rgyas tshul/ /rgyas bshad mtha' dang bshad pa'i tshul/ /dbye ba'i rnam pa gang zag 187

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsnod/ /bden pa'i dgongs pas shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /ma hā yo ga'i rgyud las kyang khyad par rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa zhes rgyud lung man ngag dang mthun pa'i mtshan tsam gyi nges pa las kyang bla na med pa'i rgyud don rnams kyi gsang ba rtogs par 'gyur ba rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po 'di nyid 'grel tshul la/ man ngag a ti yo ga ltar bkral ba dang / bskyed pa ma hā yo ga ltar bkral ba'i bshad srol gnyis su 'du ba yin no/ /de'ang dang po ni/ slob dpon nyi 'od seng ge dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams sogs kyi dgongs pa'o/ /phyi ma ni/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs dang / zur pa'i bka' srol 'dzin pa phal che ba'i dgongs pa yin no/ /ji ltar 'chad na/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis mtshon dpe dang sbyar te 'chad lugs gsum ni/ mda' ltar rtse mo nas bzung ste 'chad pa zhes bya ba/chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa gzhi gsang ba'i snying po/ de nyid bskyed rdzogs gnyis su med pas nyams su len pa lam de kho na nyid/ de'i mthar thug sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa 'bras bu gzhi thog tu nges pa ste mtshan gyi nang du chos thams cad gzhi lam 'bras gsum du bsdus nas 'chad pa dang / mdung ltar rked pa nas bzungs ste 'chad pa zhes bya ba la/ le'u lnga par/ shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor ba'i gzungs/ /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /zhes gsungs pas/rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin/ lam gyur gyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi ste mtshan nyid gsum du dril nas 'chad pa 188

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang / ral gri ltar yu ba nas bzung ste 'chad pa zhes bya ba/ rtsa rgyud le'u tha ma'i sho lo ka gnyis kyi don/ gzhi rang bzhin gyi snang ba/ log rtog zhabrul pa'i snang ba/ gdul bya lam gyi snang ba/ 'bras bu bde gshegs kyi snang ba bzhir bsdus nas 'chad pa dang / bka' sde zur pa'i bshad srol ni/ chos lnga'i sgo nas 'chad de/ rang bzhin dngos po'i gnas tshul/ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i snang tshul/ thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs tshul/ brtse bas thugs rje skye tshul/ 'gro don ji ltar mdzad tshul dang lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa yin no/ /da lta'i 'chad tshul ni bi ma la'i khog gzhung las/ rab la mtshan bstan 'bring la phye/ /tha ma 'bru gnyer bkrol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs ltar rab la mtshan bstan zhes pa dbang po yang rab la rgyud kyi mtshan bstan te bshad pa dang / 'bring la dbye zhes pas dbang po 'bring rnams la rgyud kyi spyi don rnam par dbye bas bshad pa dang / tha mar 'bru gnyer dgrol ba'o zhes pas dbang po tha ma rnams la 'bru re re'i sgo nas bkral te bshad pa'o/ /dang po dbang po yang rab rnams la rgyud kyi mtshan bstan pa ni/khog gzhud las/ rab mtshan tha snyad gsum du grags/ /sgyu 'phrul snying po lung gi spyi/ /lag gi rtsa bzhin dbu zhabs rtogs/ /zhes pas bstan/ de la/ rab mtshan tha snyad gsum du grags/ /zhes pa ni/ dbang po yang rab la bstan pa'i mtshan de la rnam pa gsum du yod ces pa'i don yin/ gsum po gang zhe na/ sgyu 'phrul snying po lung gi spyi/ /zhes pas bstan/ sgru 'phrul zhes pas rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes pa rgyud dang mthun pa'i mtshan/ snying po'i zhes pas gsang ba snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'o zhes pa man ngag dang mthun pa'i mtshan/189

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlung gi spyi zhes pas mtshan nyid dang rgyud thams cad kyi lung gi spyi zhes pa lung dang mthun pa'i mtshan no/ /lag gi rtsa bzhin dbu zhabs rtogs/ /zhes pas dbang rab kyis mtshan tha snyad gsum so de la brten nas rgyud don rtogs tshul bstan te/ lag gi rtsa bzhin zhes pas dpe bstan/ dbu zhabs rtogs zhes pas dpe can bstan te/ dper na sman pa mkhas pas nad pa'i lag gi rtsa la brten nas lus mgo mjug gi nad thams cad ngos zin pa bzhin du/ dbang rab des kyang rgyud lung man ngag gi mtshan gsum la brten nas rgyud dbu zhabs kyi don thams cad bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur bas na dbu zhabs rtogs zhes bshad pa yin gsungs/ de ltar mchan gsum gyi dang po rgyud dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang 'chad pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi mtshan thun mong du bstan pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste zhes pa la mtshan gyi zur gnyis te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bshad pa dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po rdo rje sems dpa' la'ang zur gnyis te/ rdo rje bshad pa dang/ sems dpa' bshad pa gnyis/dang po rdo rje zhes pa'i don ni/ bshad rgyud me long las/ tha dad med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes pas bstan pa yin/rdo rje ni rang bzhin dbyer mi phyed pa'i shes rab stong pa nyid yin la/ de yang rdo rje de rang bzhin gang dang dbyer mi phyed ce na/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang dbyer mi phyed pa yin la/ stong pa nyid la rdo rje zhes bya ste/ mnyam sbyor las/ rdo rje stong pa nyid du bshad/ /ces so/ /mtshan gyi zur gnyis pa sems dpa' zhes pa ni/ chos rnams ma lus gnyis med pa'i/ /rang rig byang chub 190

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsems nyid do/ /zhes pas bstan/ de yang sems dpa' zhes pa sa twa'i sgra las don drug tsam la 'jug ste/ sems can dang / dpa' ba dang / snying stobs che ba dang / brtan pa dang / bsdus pa dang /rtogs pa rnam la 'jug pa las/ 'dir brtan bsdus rtogs gsum la 'jug pa'i skabs yin te/ dang po brtan pa'i don ni/ gong gi shes rab stong pa nyid de'i snang cha thabs rig pa rang byung gi ye shes yin la/ de ltar dbyings dang ye shes de gnyis me dang tsha ba bzhin du gdod nas zung 'jug chen por bzhugs shing sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du rang bzhin la bzang ngan med cing / dus thams cad du ngo bo gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gnas pas na brtan pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bshad pa'o//gnyis pa bsdus pa'i don ni/ de nyid kyi phyag rgyas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la btab pas mnyam pa nyid du bsdus zhes pa ni/ de nyid chos thams cad kyi srog tu song bas dbus na gnas shing sems nyid kyi klong du brtan g.yo'i chos kun mnyam pa nyid du bsdus pas na bsdus pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' yin no/ /gsum pa rtogs pa'i don ni/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gis lam thabs grol gnyis la 'bad pas sems sangs rgyas su rtogs pa de la rtogs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' 'am 'bras bu'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bstan pa ste/snga ma gnyis gnas tshul la ltos nas bzhag pa dang / phyi ma ni snang lugs dri bral gyi cha nas bzhag pa yin la/ lam dus kyi rim gnyis kyi rdor sems yang 'bras bu'i rdor sems dang cha 'dra tsam du shes dgos gsungs/ des rgyud la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes btags pa'i don song / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la rdo rje 191

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsems dpa' zhes btags pa'i don ni/ sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes de nyid kyi ngo bo mtshan med stong pa nyid yin kyang / sems can gyi blo la ltos nas rig pa nyid ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i tshul du mtshan ma'i phyag rgyar mngon par snang ba'o//'chad pa'i skyes bu la rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan btags pa ni/ spyir rgyud 'chad pa'i skyes bu rigs lnga ste/ 'dir ston pa kun tu bzang po'i mdun na bzhugs pa'i thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul 'chad pa'i skyes bu rdo rje mi skyod pa la yang de ltar du grags so/ /zur gnyis pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes pa'i mtshan ni/ sbru 'phrul rdo rje las/ thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i don/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes ni bzhir bshad do/ /zhes pas/ de la bzhi las/ dang po/ rtog tshogs sbru 'phrul drwa ba ni/'byung ba lnga la sgyu ma dang phung po lnga la 'phrul ba dang / de gnyis rten dang brten par 'brel ba la drwa ba zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa nges don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni/ shes rab stong pa nyid la sgyu ma dang / de'i rang mdangs ma 'gags pa'i thabs rig pa rang byung gi ye shes la 'phrul ba dang / de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du 'brel ba la drwa ba zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa drang don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni nges don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs su gyur pa ste/ de'i mtshon byed lha yab yum zung du 'jug pa ste/ stong pa nyid mtshon byed lha yum/ rig pa'i ye shes mtshon byed lha yab/ zung 'jug mtshon byed lha yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pas na/ lha yum rnams ni sgyu ma dang / yab rnams ni 'phrul pa dang / yab yum kha spyor bde ba'i skur bzhugs pa drwa ba'i don no/ /de yang gang drang na gang zag mtshan ma'i blo can de drang / gang du drang na nges don sgyu 'phrul dra ba de la drang / tshul ji lta 192

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbu'i sgo nas drang na lha yab yum thabs shes phan tshun 'khril sbyor gyi phyag rgya'i brda dang rtags la brten nas drang pa yin no/ /bzhi pa lha rtogs dbyer med kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni/ rtog tshogs kyi rang bzhin lhar 'phrul pa dang / lha'i ngo bo rtog tshogs su snang yang rang bzhin lha yin pa las ma g.yos pa'i phyir na lha rtog dbyer med ces bshad de/ sgyu ma ni rtog tshogs/ de nyid rang rig rtogs pa'i thabs kyis lhar shar ba ni 'phrul ba/ lha rtog rang bzhin gnyis su med par 'brel ba ni drwa ba'o/ /gnyis pa che ba la mtshan du btags pa lung gi mtshan ni/rdo rje las/ so sor bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ /'dir ston 'dis ston 'di phyir ston/ /don kun 'di la yongs rdzogs pas/ /lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin/ /zhes pas/ 'dir ston zhes pa ni/ ston pas gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tsham par bstan pa'i chos ni rgya mtsho'i rgyud de/ don zab cing gting dpag dka' ba rgya mtsho lta bu/ tshig rgya che zhing mtha' yas pa de thams cad kyi brjod bya rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid kyi nang du rdzogs par ston pas na/ 'dir ston zhes bshad do/ /'dis ston zhes pa ni/ bstan pa dang theg pa thams cad kyi don ma lus pa rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid las 'phros te ston pas na 'dis ston zhes bshad do/ /'di phyir ston zhes pa ni/ theg pa'i sgo gang nas zhugs kyang mthar thug theg pa 'di las mi 'da' bas theg pa gzhan thams cad 'di nyid kyi lam stegs kyi tshul du gsungs pa yin pas lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin te/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje las/ dri ma med pa'i lung nyid las/ /las dang ye shes spyi nyid kyi/ /rdzogs pa'i rdzogs phyir lung nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa 193

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃltar las kyi lung mtshan nyid sde gsum/ ye shes lha'i lung phyi rgyud sde gsum/ bya bral rdzogs pa'i lung nang rgyud sde gsum ste/ de dag gi lung gi spyir gyur pas na lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin no/ /gsum pa don rang gi ngo bo la btags pa man ngag gi mtshan ni/ glegs bam gyi klad du bkod pa'i mtshan la/ gsang ba snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'o// ༈ gzhan yang mtshan nang ltar thabs lam steng sgo dang sbyar te 'chad pa la gnyis las/ dang po snying ga'i 'ukhor lo dang sbyar te bshad pa ni/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus na dwangs ma chen po lnga dang / de'i dkyil na ye shes kyi snying po'i thig le ye nas gnas kyang rang gsang thabs kyis chod nas ma mthong ba ni gsang ba/ de nyid la gsang sngags kyi zab gnad thams cad 'dus pas snying po/ thabs kyi man ngag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su blangs bas ye shes kyi snang ba de nyid gsal bar sad pa de kho na nyid/ snying po'i thig le de gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi srog tu nges pas na nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan bzhi dang 'khor lo bzhi sbyar te bshad pa ni/ lte ba'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus na dbyings phyug lnga'i thig le yi ge a'i rnam par gnas pa ni gsang ba/ snying ga'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dwangs ma lnga'i dbus na ye shes snying po'i thig le bzhugs pas na snying po/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi dbus na mkha' 'gro rngam ma'i thig le e yig gi rnam par gnas pa ni de kho na nyid/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis kyi dbus na kun tu bzang po'i thig le haṃ yig gi rnam par gnas pa de la nges pa zhes bshad do/ /gsang ba ltar 'og sgo dang sbyar te 194

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhad pa ni/ rtsa gnas kyi thig le bde ba'i ye shes kyi ro dang bcas pa rang chas su yod kyang ma shes pas gsang ba/ thig le de la phung khams thams cad kyi bcud 'dus pas snying po/ thabs lam zab mos gnad du bsnun pas lhan snyes kyi rang zhal ji bzhin mthong ba de kho na nyid/ thig le de nyid gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ga'i gnad srog tu nges pa la nges pa zhes bshad do/ /2 de yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud ces bya ba yang dag par brngod par bya ba don gyi rgyud dang / rjod par byed pa sgra'i rgyud gnyis su gnas pa las/ don ni/gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba ni/ /sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /tshogs pa 'dus par rab brjod de/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mngon brjod byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ skal ba can ma yin pa dag la gsang bar bya ba nyid kyi phyir/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs la gsang ba zhes bya la/ de yang zhing phyogs gcig pa dang /gdul bar bya ba phyogs gcig pa'i dbang du byas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ma yin par/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs pa'am 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can zung du 'jug pa'i sku la rdo rje 'chang chen po 'am sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya'o/ /de ni mthar thug pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ de rjod par byed pa'i rgyud la yang rgyud rnams kun gyi spyi bo zhes bshad do/ /rdo rje 'chang zhes bya ba yang / sgron ma gsal ba las/ rig thams cad kyi bdag nyid thog ma dang tha ma med pa/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa chen po skyes bu'i gzugs ye shes kyi sku/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid can/ 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ sku 195

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasum gyi bdag nyid can/ theg pa gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ dus gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ bden pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can/ zhes gsungs pas na/ 'dus pa kha cig gi rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ci yin pa 'tshol zhing / sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin no/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smra ba ni/ de ltar bshad pa'i sgron ma gsal ba'i don thugs su ma chud pa las yin par snang la/ 'on kyang gzugs rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba la sogs pa dang 'dra bar/ btags pa'i dbang gis de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ci yin pa 'tshol ba ni/ rigs drug par rnam par bzhag pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sku mdog la sogs pa gang yin pa de yin par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar slob dpon klu sgrub slob mar bcas pa rnams kyis kyang 'dus pa chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyi don gyi gtso bo yin par bzhed la/ deng sang la la dag rgyud gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i rang dbang can nyi tshe ba zhig tu khas len pa ni theg pa dman pa la mngon par zhen pa'i bag chags las byung ba yin no/ /de bzhin du dri ma med pa'i 'od du yang / de bzhin gsol ba 'debs pa po ni dpal 'dus par/ de nas phyag na rdo rje de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas byin gyis brlab par 'gyur bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rgyud thams cad kyi bla na med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal 'dus par sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par brjod pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ zhes pa de lta bu la sogs pas phyag na rdo rjes gsol ba btab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/196

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdus kyi 'khor lo 'grel ba dang bcas pa yang gsang ba 'dus pa 'chad byed du 'gyur ba yin par bzhed pa yin no/ /dpal kye rdo rje yang / sems ni 'dus pa'i gzugs can no/ /zhes kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'dus pa la mngon du phyogs par gsungs so/ /slob dpon nag po pas gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba'i gzhung brtsams pa yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i de kho na nyid bde mchog 'khor los gsal bar 'chad do zhes bzhed pa yin no/ /'di bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su lo tsā ba lce bkra shis zhes bya bas bsgyur nas/ bla ma rnying ma ba dag gis tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad po'i gtso bor yang 'chad cing / bod kyi slob dpon snga mas 'grel ba mdzad pa yang yod/ phyis su ni lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po la sogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang bcas pa rnams so/ /zhes deb ther sngon po las gsungs so// ༈ theg chen gyi mdo rnams las/ bde gshegs snying po stobs sogs kyi yon tan ye ldan du gsungs pa de nges don yin yang / sems can phal pa khyi phag sogs tha mal pa'i rgyud na stobs bcu'i yon tan mngon gyur du yod pa lta ci/ rgyun zhugs zhig gi rtogs pa tsam dang / so skye phal ba zhig gi shes rab kyang mngon gyur du yod pa bsgrub tu med pas yon tan ye ldan gsungs pa drang don du byas nas sangs rgyas kyi rgyu tsam du khas len pa'i lugs de 'dzin pa dang / sngags nang pa gzhi 'bras dbyer med du bshad pa la'ang de'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yod pa tsam la dgongs so/ /zhes dang / 'bras bu rnam dag rigs lnga la sogs pa'i lha'i rnam pa tsam lam du byed kyi/ de dang de dngos ma yin te/ bskyed rim pas bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin par 197

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmos pas bsgom dgos kyang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan til 'bru tsam yang bdag la med pas phung khams sangs rgyas dngos ma yin no snyam du bsam pa dang / sngags kyi rdzogs rim gyi sgyu lus dang / 'od gsal gyi snang ba bsgom pa sogs kyang gzhi dbyings 'dus ma byas kyi ngo bo nyid lam du byed pa min par/'dus byas sems kyis de dang de'i rnam pa bsgoms pas sems yongs su dag pa'i gnas skabs na skad cig ma'i sems 'gyur ba can des chos thams cad mkhyen pa dang / de rgyun gyi rtag pa'i rdo rje'i sku dang / de myong byar gyur pa'i bde ba'i tshor ba dang ldan pa'i bde chen gyi sku dang / de'i phrin las sna tshogs mngon par 'du byed pa dang / des chos thams cad mkhyen pa po dang mkhyen bya gnyis su 'byed pa'i sgo nas shes pa dang / de 'khor ba las rnam par grol ba dang / rnam grol de lta bu'i ye shes gzigs pa po yin no snyam du 'khor ba'i skyon gyis dag pa'i phung po lnga skad cig dang du ma'i chos can bdag tu mi 'dzin yang rgyud tha dad du phye ba zhig gi gang zag khyad par can zhig la sangs rgyas su 'dzin pas ni/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sku'i phyogs tsam ma shes te/ sangs rgyas zhes pa'i gang zag rang rgyud pa zhig tu rnam par bzhag pa'i grub mtha' snying la 'chang bas mdo sngags kyi lam gyi rnam bzhag thams cad de ltar 'chad cing sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi sku rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba la skyon brjod pa ni theg pa chen po'i dgongs don la phyogs su ma phyin pa yin no/ /zhes dang / des na stobs sogs kyi yon tan ye ldan/ ral gri tshad ldan la gcod pa'i yon tan/ me long dwangs ba la gzugs brnyan snang ba'i yon tan/ nor bu la 'od dang dgos 198
