g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrnams spyong byed mngon byang lnga pa chos dbyings ye shes dang mi skyod pa'i ngo bo sku yongs rdzogs su bsgom pa rnams so/ /'di'i dag rdzogs smin gsum ni/ 'gro ba'i lus rten khyad par can khams drug ldan gyi mi lta bu la khams kyi sbyang gzhi rtsa thig rlung sems rags pa'i cha mngon gyur du yod pa thabs kyis zin pas grol bar 'gyur te/ dang por dbang gis smin par byas nas/ rtog bcas kyi lam bskyed rim gyi dus su mngon byang lnga bsgom pa'i tshe na'ang gnad du bsnun bya'i gtso bo dkar dmar sems gsum yin pa'i phyir 'khor ba dang mthun pa'i rnam pa lam byed kyis sbyang bya srid pa'i rang bzhin khu rdul rlung gsum sems dang bcas pa'i cha thams cad rnam par dag pa rgyal ba'i bzhugs tshul dang mthun par mos pa lam byed bsgoms pas 'bras chos lnga dang ye shes lnga'i yon tan thams cad gzhi la rdzogs/ de gnyis ka snang ba dang / mched pa dang /nyer thob dang / 'od gsal dang / zung 'jug la sogs pa'i rdzogs rims gyi smin byed du 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa mngon byang bzhi bskyed la/ dang po la spros bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ de'i ngang las de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la zhen med sgyu ma lta bu'i snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ste/ 'dis mar sbyang bya rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog tshogs thams cad 'khrul stobs kyis nub pa'i 'chi srid dang / slar yang las rlung mched pa'i stobs kyis bar do'i snang ba yad yud du 'byung ba bcas dag yar chos sku dang longs sku gnyis gzhi la rdzogs par byed/ bar du 'od gsal dang sgyu lus gnyis kyi smin byed du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo stong 298

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes rnam pa lha'i sa bon gyi rnam par bsgom pa ste/ 'dis dri za nye bar len pa bar do'i rnam shes de pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su zhugs shing 'dres pa'i cha sbyong zhing dag sprul sku gzhi la rdzogs/ dpe'i 'od gsal las sgyu lus kyi lha skur ldang ba'i smin byed du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni sa bon gyi yi ge nyid thugs rdo rje phyag mtshan gyi rnam par gyur zhing de las sku yongs rdzogs su bskyed pa ste/ 'dis khu rdul rlung sems kyi cha 'dres pa de rlung gi byed las kyis mer nur ltar gor mkhrang gyur khyab 'jug nya dang rus sbal gyi rnam pa dang mig sogs dbang po dang yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa de byang zhing dgazung 'jug ngo bo nyid sku gzhi la rdzogs/ don gyi 'od gsal zung 'jug gi lha skur ldang ba'i smin byed du 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ lha mngal 'byin gyi sa bon spro ba'am/ min kyang gnas gsum la yi ge bkod de rgyas gdab pa ste/ 'dis byis pa de btsas nas dbang po yul la sad de sna tshogs pa'i dngos po spyod pa'i zhen pa dag sangs rgyas kyi lhun gyis grub pa'i 'bras bu gzhi la rdzogs/rdzogs rim pa slob pa'i zung 'jug gi lha skur ldang nas 'dod yon gyi snang ba la zhen med du rol bas rig pa'i rgyan du 'char ba'i smin byed du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed ni/ snga 'gyur gter ma'i phyogs 'dir mngal skyes sbyong byed bsdus pa 'di nyid ming zhing de lta na/ 'di'i sbyang bya bar do'i rnam shes de pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su zhugs nas rim gyis lus rdzogs pa dang mthun par/ sbyong byed gzhal med khang gi dbus su pad+ma dmar po'i gdan/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil zhabor nya 299

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgang ba gnyis brtsegs pa pad+ma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa'i gdan la sa bon rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yi ge bab pa bar do'i rnam shes ma'i mngal du dkar dmar tshogs pa la 'jug ma rag gi gnas skabs de yin/ sa bon lha gang yin gyi phyag mtshan du bsgrur ba ni khams dkar dmar gyi dbus su rnam shes zhugs nas khu rdul sems gsum gcig tu 'dres pa de sbyong / de las 'od zer spro bsdu ni mngal gyi lus de nyid 'byung ba bzhi'i byed las kyis phung khams skye mched rim gyis grub pa dang / phyag mtshan de yongs su gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni mngal gyi sems can de rnams lus rdzogs nas btsas pa'i bar gyi bag chags rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin la/ de ltar bskyed tshul 'dis skye gnas gzhan gyi bag chags kyang zhar la sbyong bar nus so/ /mdor na rdo rje'i cho ga dang pos bar do'i rlung sems pha ma'i khu rdul gyi dbus su dang por zhugs pa ltar gsung yig 'byu/ gnyis pa mer nur ltar 'khrang gi gnas skabs ltar thugs phyag mtshan/ gsum pa gor nya rus sbal nas lus rdzogs te btsas pa ltar sku yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /drod gsher skyes sbyong byed a nu yo ga'i dgongs pa spros med kyi bskyed rim ni/ sems can drod gsher las skyes pa rnams ni mngal skyes ltar yun ring du smin mi dgos par/ drod gsher gnyis lhan du 'dus par rnam shes zhugs pas de'i mod la gzugs kyi dngos po yongs su rdzogs par 'grub pa bzhin/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i sras bde ba chen po rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin du shes pa lung chen a nu'i lta ba las ma g.yos 300

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhin du/ rtsal snang snying rje'i 'phen pa gtad pas drod gsher skyes rnams gnas lus la sred pa'i bag chags sbyang ba'i phyir/ gang bskyed bya'i lha'i snying po brngod pa tsam gyis/ don dam shes rab kyi dbyings stong nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong nas kun rdzob bden pa'i snang cha rten dang brten pa'i lha'i phyag rgya yongs su bsgom zhing bde stong dbyer med kyi lam la slob pa ste 'di la yul snang bden med du shes pa sgyu ma'i bskyed rim zhes bya'o/ /rdzus skyes spyong byed man ngag a ti yo ga'i dgongs pa dang mthun par shin tu spros med kyi bskyed rim ni/sems can rdzus te skye ba rnams gsal stong gi cha la rnam shes zhugs pa tsam gyis lus yongs su rdzogs par grub pa ni drod gsher skyes las kyang myur ba ltar de sbyong byed kyi lam yang / rdo rje dril bu las/ sems can rdzus te skye ba bzhin/ /sa bon med par rnam par bsnyom/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di ltar snang grags rtog tshogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ye nas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pas ma bskyed lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsol bral 'bras bu'i sa la da lta nas gnas pa man ngag a ti yo ga'i lta ba'i ngang las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul du skad cig gis gsal 'debs pa'o/ /༈ dkon mchog 'grel las/ 'di ltar rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ dang po dam tshig byin brlab pa/ /brtags pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'o/ /dbu ma rdzogs par bya ba dag /'di ni rnal 'byor cho gar bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de la dang po'i tshig ni gzhung lugs la 'jug pas gzhud lugs 301

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang po ste/ nyan thos pa'i gzhung ngo / /de dang mthun pa byin gyis brlab pa'i rnal 'byor te/ ji ltar zhe na/ 'dir bdag gi de kho na nyid la bdag gi ni phung po lnga blos rnam par ma phye ba'o/ /de kho na nyid ni mu stegs can gyis bdag dang bdag gi la sogs pa kun tu brtags pas stong pa/ phung po khams dang skye mched kyi chos tsam med par skur pa gdab tu mi rung ba 'di ni bdag gi de kho na nyid do/ /de ni byin gyis brlab tu rung ba'i gzhi ste/ de la byin gyis rlob par byed pa ni lha'i dngos po'o/ /de yang chos nyid dag pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang / rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i ye shes dang / sgra dang yi ge dang / gzugs la sogs pa'i lhar rtog pa rnams so/ /'dir phyi rol gyi gzugs gyi blo mi gtong bas gzhung lugs dang po nyan thos dang mthun pa yin te/de lta bus 'dul ba'i gang zag gi dbang du gsungs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i thabs yin no/ /yongs su brtags pa'i rnal 'byor ni rnal 'byor spyod pa pa dang sgo mthun pa yin te/ 'di ltar bdag gi de kho na nyid kyang gzung ba dang 'dzin par kun tu brtags pas stong pa sems dang sems las byung ba rang rig pa gang gis kyang gzung bar bya ba ma yin pa gang la yang 'dzin par byed pa ma yin pa/ skad cig ma rgyun 'brel bar gnas pa 'di tsam med par skur ba gdab tu mi rung ste/ de yang 'di ltar gyur na ni 'phags pa nyid dang khyad med pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang so so'i skye bo'i skabs su yang 'di ltar rtogs shing goms pa las rim gyis lha'i skur bskyed par bya'o/ /'di ni sems dang ye shes rang snang ma gtogs par yul gud du mi dmigs pas rnal 'byor spyod pa dang 302

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmathun pa ste/ 'di ltar 'dul ba'i dbang du gsungs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /jogs pa'i rnal 'byor ni dbu ma dang sgo mthun pa ste/ bdag gi de kho na nyid kyang btags pa tsam ste/ de la bdag ni phung po lnga la blos ma phye ba tsam mo /de'i de kho na nyid ni spros pa thams cad yongs su zhi ba tsam ste/ 'di ltar rten gang yang dmigs pa med do/ /de las sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs su 'phrul yang rten med cing ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /༈ grol lam rim gyis pa'i spyod pa la bdun las/ dang po dad brtson gyi spyod pa 'di la gsang sngags kyis bslab pa'i mtha' bcu 'du ba yin te/ dang po rgyud thos pas grol ba ni thog mar rgyud lung man ngag gi don zab mo ma thos na blang dor gyi mig mi 'byed pas rgyud thos pas grol ba rta pho sgrog bkrol ba lta bur gzhir bzhag dang / gnyis pa sgo kun nas sdud pa ni/ de yang thos pa nyung ngus shes rab rgya chen po grol bar mi nus pas thos pa'i sgo mang po btsal te snyo kun nas sdud pa bung ba tshang tshol ba lta bu'i mang du thos par bya ba dang /gsum pa mdo gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ mang du thos kyang lag len gnad du ma khel na rang rgyud mi grol bas mthar thug pa'i man ngag gis gnad zab mo nyams 'og tu tshud par byas nas mdo gcig tu sdud pa tshong pa khe tshol ba lta bu'i don gnad du phog par bya ba dang / bzhi pa mkhas pa phul du phyin pa ni/ de ltar byas nas thos pas rgyud kyi don shes/ lung gis rgyud don nyams su blangs/man ngag gis yid ches nas the tshom med pa'i gding dang ldan par bslab pa'i sgo nas mkhas pa phul du phyin pa ri mthon po'i rtser phyin pa lta bu zhes bya ste/ de 303

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbazhi ni gsang sngags la bslab pa'i tshul lo/ /lnga pa rim pa dbang gis bsgrod pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi dbang thob pa dang gsang ba'i dbang thob nas nyon mongs pas mi brdzi ba'i las can du gyur pa rgyal bu rgyal sa zin pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa gzhi dam tshig gis bzung ba ni/ bla ma mnyes par byas la ji skad gsungs pa'i dam tshig las mi 'da' ba zhing sa gshin po lta bu dngos grub kyi lo tog skye rung ba'i las can no/ /bdun pa thag lta bas bcad pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la sems ye nas sangs rgyas pa rang byung gi ye shes su rtogs nas bya rtsol re dogs dang bral te bag yangs su rgyu ba khyung nam mkha' la lding ba lta bu'o/ /brgyad pa nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis blang ba ni/ shes rab kyis dmigs pa'i don la ting nge 'dzin gyis g.yeng ba med par rtse gcig tu byas pa nor bu rin po che len pa lta bu'o/ /dgu pa la spyod pas dor ba ni/ mnyam bzhag tu bya ba'i las thams cad spangs nas sgom pa'i las la 'jug pa dang / rjes thob tu blang dor med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi lta ba zab mo dang mthun par 'jigs med du rgyu zhing phrin las sna tshogs la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'jug pa glang po che chur 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /bcu pa don man ngag gis bsgrub pa ni/ gang ched du sgrub pa'i don la gnad du 'byor ba'i man ngag gis the tshom med pa'i gding dang ldan par sgrub pas nyams su lon na ting 'dzin thob pa'i dus nas bdud bzhi chom nas sku gsum thob pa rin po che nyos pa lta bu ste bslab pa'i mtha' drug go/ /gnyis pa shes rab dang mthun pa zhes stong chen gyi dus su thun mtshams kyi bya ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i shes rab 304

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃkyi rtsal sbyang du 'byer ba dang / gsum pa thabs dang mthun pa zhes snying rje sna ma'i skabs su snang spyod ye shes sgyu ma'i yo lang du blta ba dang / bzhi pa phyogs gcig pa ni phyag rgya gcig pa'i ste/ mnyam bzhag tu zung 'jug phyag rgya gcig pa bsgom zhing / rjes thob tu'ang de'i yun bsring ba'o/ /lnga pa spros bcas kyi spyod pa zhes mnyam bzhag tu gang bsgom gyi lha'i ting nge 'dzin des snang ba tham/sa cad la rgyas btab ste log rtog 'khrul ba'i snang ba zil gyis gnon pa dang / drug pa tshogs kyi spyod pa zhes tshogs sgrub kyi dus su dag mnyam bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor 'khor yug tu skyong ba dang / bdun pa zag med rig 'dzin thob nas rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pa zhes nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i phrin las kyis gzhan don rlabs po che spyod cing rang rgyud kyi rtogs pa gong du spor ba'o/ /spros bcas tshogs sgrub/ spros med rnal 'byor pho mo gtso bo yab yum tsam tshogs pa la brten pa/ shin tu spros med ni yab mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen nyid yum rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang / kha sbyor spyod pas zag med kyi lam la sbyor bar byed do/ /cho ga'i bya ba la ltos pa'i spyod pa gsum ni/ spros la shin tu dga' ba na tshod gzhon pa/ yo byad mang ba sogs spros bcas/ de dag 'bring la spros med/ chung ba la shin tu spros med/ sgom bsam la ltos pa'i spyod pa gsum ni/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim/ zung 'jug gsum gyi skabs so/ /dus la ltos pa'i tshogs spyod gsum ni/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ nyin re'am zla ba re re'am/ /de bzhin lo ni re rer yang / /zhes so/ /gnas kyi sgo nas dbye ba sdom 'byung las/ rang gi khyim du spyod pa dang dur khrod du spyod pa dang 305

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzhing rnams su rgyu ba/ zhes so/ /las dang po ba'i dus su ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa ma thob pa'i bag dang ldan pa'i gzob pa lhur len pa dge sbyong gzhon nu'i spyod pa lta bu/ mnyam rjes bsre bar nus pa na rtogs pa rkyen thub tu byed po spyon pa brtul zhugs kyi spyad pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa cher thab nas rtags pa la bri gang med pa na gzhan phan kho na la bslab pa rgyal po sa 'dzin gyi spyod pa lta bu'o/ /a ba dhu ti ste kun 'dar gyi spyod pa ni/ gnyis snang gi rnam rtog 'joms par byed pa dang / bden 'dzin g.yo zhing 'dar ba dang skrod par byed pa yin te/ sa paṇa gyis rgya skad a ba sgru ti'i sgra/ /gnyis spangs sam ni kun 'dar yin zhes so/ /kun bzang gi spyod pa ni/ des bya ba ci byed thams cad bzang ngan gang du snang yang dus kun tu ngo bo bzang po 'ba' zhig yin pa'o/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa ni/ nyon mongs las dngos su rgyal zhing bdud bzhi po rnams btul ba dang / sems can gyi don la stobs dang ldan pa dang /shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang 'joms bzhin pa yin pas so/ /a wa zlo ti ste kun 'dar gyi spyod pa'am gsang ba'i spyod pa la spros med shas che/ kun bzang gi spyod pa la spros bcas spros med cha mnyam/ phyogs las rnam rgyal la spros bcas gtso bor spyod pa yin no/ /de la a wa lha ti'i don/ a wa lha no ti ste sdig pa skrod pa zhes kyang 'gyur/ gnyis spangs dang kun 'dar zhes su'ang 'gyur te/ sam bu ṭi las/sdig bcom byed pa 'di myur thob/ /ces dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi gnas//rnal 'byor pas ni sgom byed pa/ /a ba dha ti'i spyod pa bshad/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /zhes gsungs pas ldag pa dag pa dang gnyis snang gi rnam 306

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrtog dang por 'joms byed yin pa dang / mtshan 'dzin nam bden 'dzin g.yo zhing 'dar ba dang skrod par byed pa'i don no/ /kun bzang gi don ni/ des bya ba ci byed thams cad bzang ngan gang du snang yang dus kun tu ngo bo bzang po 'ba' zhig yin pa'o/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal ni nyon mongs las dngos su rgyal zhing bdud bzhi po rnams btul ba dang / sems can gyi don la stobs dang ldan pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang 'joms bzhin pa yin pas so/ /'di dag dang po gnyis gtso bor sbyor lam skabs dang phyi ma gtso bor 'phags lam la sbyor mod/gsum char la skye 'phags gnyis ka yod do/ /༈ yab yum lhar bskyed pa lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar rlob pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes kyi ye shes bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te gsum ldan gyis brda bzhi'i bsnol mar bskul ba ni/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes chags pa'i brdas bskul bar/ sa ma ya ho/zhes lan gdab/ slar yang rā ga ya ho/ zhes sbyor ba'i brdas bskul bar/ rā ga ya mi/ zhes lan btab so/ phyag rgya bzhis snyoms par zhugasapa ni/ dza ༷zhes pas lus kyi cha shas rnams reg /hūṃ zhes pas lag pa dang brla 'khyud/ baṃ zhes pas mkha' gsang dam du sprad/ ho zhes yab kyis gsor yum gyis baspyo+od pas dga' bzhi'i ros rgyud yongs su gang zhing drim par bsam mo/ /de lta bu yun ring du goms pas snang ba thams cad bde bar 'char/ rtsol med kyi bde ba/'dzag med kyi tshul khrims/ zag med kyi nyams myong khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa na de'i bogs dbyung ba la brten nas dpe'i ye shes mngon du bya ba'i phyir 307

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlas kyi phyag rgya la bslab par bya ste/ bshad rgyud thal ba las/ spangs nas rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa/ /dgug dang bsdam pa ma shes na/ /rdo rje'i bskal ba mtha' yas par/ /chos sku thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa dang / rdo rje zhes pa skyil krung ste/ de la lus rdo rje skyil krung ni yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /rtsa rdo rje skyil krung ni yum gyi dbu ma'i mar sna yab kyi dbu mar drangs te sad par byas pa'o/ /rlung rdo rje skyil krung ni yum gyi dbu ma'i rlung yab kyi dbu mar drangs ba dang / khams rdo rje skyil krung ni thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa'o/ /rags pa'i phyag rgya bzhi ni/ phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgug pa/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba 'ching ba/ yan lag phan tshun sdom pa bsdams pa/ yab yum bde bas tshim pa myos pa'o/ /phra ba'i phyag rgya bzhi ni/dmar cha gyen du drangs pa dgug pa/ rlung gis byed bcing gi stobs kyis gcun pa 'ching ba/ thig le phyir mi ldog pa bsdoms pa/ yab yum gyi gsang ba'i rnam shes bde bas tshim pa myos pa'o/ /༈ bsgral ba'i skabs/ thog mar rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi dgongs spyod zab mo'i sgo nas rtogs pas bdag bsgral bar byas nas/ de'i 'og tu las ngan gyi gdul bya la snying rje chen po mtshungs pa med pa dang / mnyam nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rab chen po phul du byung ba'i stobs kyis thugs rje'i gzhan sgrol ba dang du len pa yin la/ de yang thun min gyi tshad med bzhi ni/ snying rje khros pa'i tshul gyis gdug pa can rjes su 'dzin pa byams pa/ shin tu brtse ba chen pos myur du sgrol ba'i snying rje/ shes pa gnas su spar zhing phung po tshogs su 308

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃstob pa dga' ba/ gdul bya yal bar mi 'dor ba'i btang snyoms so/ /gsal ba gsum ni/ mi ldog pa'i phyir du sgrol mkhan gyi rnal 'byor pa lhar gsal pa/mi rdug pa'i phyir du sgrol byed kyi phur pa yaka ki lar gsal ba/ mi 'byams pa'i phyir du bsgral bya'i rū tra dngos su gsal gdab pa'o/ /lha gsum ni/ lta ba'i gding gis zin pa stong nyid gyad kyi lha/ bskyed rim gyi ngar dang ldan gnyen po ye shes kyi lha/ zung 'jug las pho nya 'gyed pa spyod pa las kyi lha'o/ /lta sgom spyod gsum ni/ rang bzhin gyis sgrol ba'i lta ba/ snying rjes sgrol ba'i sgom pa/ dbang po yul dus kyis sgrol ba'i spyod pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis sbyor sgrol zhes pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gnyis su med par rtogs pa ni sbyor ba/ des gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa las sgrol ba ni sgrol ba ste/ lam rim las/gnyis med dbyings su sbyor ba yin/ /zhes so/ /de yang slob dpon ni mkhas tshul lnga dang ldan dgos te/ rang bzhin gyis sgrol ba'i lta ba la mkhas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrol ba'i sgom pa la mkhas pa/ dbang po yul dus kyis sgrol ba'i spyod pa la mkhas pa/ thabs chen gsang bas sgrol ba'i gdams ngag la mkhas pa/ mngon spyod zab mos sgrol ba'i mdzad spyod la mkhas pa'o/ /dbang po yul dus kyis sbyor sgrol zhes pa ni/ yul phyir snang yum dang / dbang po nang nas 'char ba yab ste/ lha yab yum gnyis med du sbyor ba ni spyor ba/ des tha mal gyi rtog tshogs rang sar dag pas sgrol ba ste/ de nyid las/ dbang po yul dus rig pa rnams/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rjes tshogs/ /zhes so/ /rdzong 'phrang srog gsum ni/ lta ba blo 'das kyi rdzong / sgom pa yeng med kyi 'phrang / spyod pa nges 309

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmed kyi srog go/ /dgongs pa gsum ni/ las ngan gyi bag chags thams cad ye shes kyi 'od kyis sbyong bar bsam pa'i khrus lung / pha rol po'i tshe bsod bdag gi tshe yi gsos su bstims pa tshe lung / dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes 'og min du rgyal ba yab yum gyi sbyor 'tshams su 'phangs te rigs kyi sras su bsgyur ba gnas lung ngo / /'tshengs pa gsum ni/ pha rol gyi tshe bsod rang la khug pas bdag rnal 'byor pa 'tshengs pa/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pas bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams 'tshengs pa/pha rol dgra bgegs kyi las ngan rgyun chod nas bde bar gshegs pa'i sras su gyur pas gzas po 'tshengs ba'o/ /'tshengs pa rnam pa lnga zhes pa ni/ tshe lung gi dgongs pas sgrol mkhan gyi rnal 'byor pa 'tshengs pa/ khrus lung gi dgongs pas bsgral bya'i gzas pa po 'tshings pa/ gnas lung gi dgongs pas 'og min du sbyor mchod kyis 'tshengs pa/ snyigs ma'i sha khrag gis dkyil 'bor pa'i lha rdoṭā+os/ /'tshengs pa/ gnod byed dang bral bas bstan pa rin po che 'tshengs ༈ sa bslang ba la/ snang ba mi las bslang ba dang / mi snang ba lha las bslang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sa de'i bdag por gyur pa'i rgyal po sogs la rin gzhal te bslang ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni bde bar gshegs pa dang sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas la bslang ba'o/ /dbang du bya ba ni/ zangs phur pad+ma he ru ka dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis pad+ma dang zhags pa/ 'og ma gnyis phur bu bsgril ba dbal zla gam can du bskyed do/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs 310

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnas dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la btab pas phur bu las byung ba'i 'od kyis sa gzhi thams cad khyab cing bdag gi dbang du gyur bar bsam mo/ /sbyang ba ni las rim las/ sbyang ba las me sngags phyag rgya/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dag par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ las dang bya bas sbyang pa la lto 'phye brtag pa dang / gter sba ba dang / 'bru lnga spos sogs lnga tshan drug gi lde gus byug pa'o/ /mes sbyang pa ni/mtshan ma rnams shin tu ngan par mthong na gzhan du sprong ba'am/ yang na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tshul bzhin du bya'o/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang pa ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la nyi ma'i dkyil zhabor re re'i steng du hūṃ mthing ga re res mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan par bsam la o badz+ra ha na ha na kro dha hūṃ phaṭa zhes brjod cing sa la lan gsum bsnun pas rdo rje dang hūṃ gi 'od kyis sa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs nas ye shes rang snang gi gzhir gyur bar bsam mo/ /ting nge 'dzin gyisasbyang pa la/ mtshan med ni/shu n+ya ta'i sngags kyis sa dang sar 'dzin pa'i 'khrul rtog thams cad stong nyid de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su rnam par dag par bsam la/ mtshan bcas ni/ hūṃ gi sgra ring por brjod pas rang rig hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po hūṃ yig mthing nag gis mtshan pa las sa bon spros te/ 'byung lnga rim brtsegs kyi steng du/ zhi khro gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang byed kyi gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa'o/ /bsrung ba ni/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros/rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla bre/ phyi rol bskal ba'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po rtsib brgyad la sogs dang bcas pa gsal/ phyogs bcu'i 311

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbagegs rnams bkug nas khro bcu'i phur pa gdab pa dang mtshon cha lnga'i rwa bas bsrung bar bya'o/ /bzung pa ni lha tshogs yab yum rnams rol pas 'od sa gzhi la thim pas/ sa nyid dkyil 'khor kyi rang bzhin du gsal bar bsam pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi tshad la gsum las/ bsdus pa'i tshad ni khru gang pa dang /bzhi pa'o/ /'bring po ni khru bcu gnyis pa dang bcu drug pa'o/ /rgyas pa ni nyi shu pa dang / nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ /thig gi skabs su/ de yang spyir thig zhes pa mi 'gyur ba'i don te/ de'i rgyu 'gying phur dang / bskor phur te phur bu gnyis dang /srad bu yang gnyis las/ ye thig gi rgyu/ zhi ba la pad+ma'i rtsa ba'i pad skud pad+ma'i rgyus pa dang khro bo la rgyus chen te/ gnyis ka'i dam thig gi rgyu ras bal gtsang ma dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa zhes dang por btsal ba'i dus na bdag po'i lan gcig ci smras pa ltar rin byin pa ni/ rin la ma gtsegs par byas pas dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa zhes bya'o/ /de yang ye shes kyi skud pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'am lnga sgril dang / dam tshig gi skud pa dgu sgril lam sum sgril du bya ba'o/ /gdab tshul kyang thig g.yog rig ma dngos sam der mos pa la thig sna gtad de yab yum lhar gsal bar byas pas dam thig sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du sa la btab nas/ sku gsung thugs re re'ang ye shes lnga dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ ye thig dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi'i steng gi nam mkha' la gdab pa'o/ /tshon gyi rgyu ni/ rab kyis rin chen sna lnga dang / 'bring gis 'bru sman kha dog bsgrur ba dang / tha mas dri ma med pa'i rdul tshon kha dog lnga la bya ba'o/ /grangs ni kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga'am/ /lnga yi tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /zhes so/ /tshon 312

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdagye lugs ni/ 'dul ba'i cho ga bzhin du dgye/ /zhes so/ /dgos ched ni/las rim las/ ma mthong me+ong la ye shes sogs/ /bstan phyir tshon lnga dgye bar bya/ /zhes so/ /mtshan ma 'god pa ni/ sku gsung thugs ldan gzugs kyis 'god/ /ces dang / yang na rngam glog las/ gtso bo gzugasasu rdzogs par bri/ /'khor rnams phyag rgya dag tu bya/ /phal ba la ni yig 'bru'o/ /zhes so/ /rab gnas la gsum las/ skad gnyisashan sbyar las/bi shaṃ pad+ma'i rtsa ba'am pad skud/shā lu kai /ut+pala'i rtsa ba/ bṛrnya rtsa ba'am thag pa/ mṛ ṇa la/pad+ma'i rtsa lag gam pad sna la pad skud cesaso/yan lag gi rab gnas ni/ las bum/rdor dril/ thod chu/ thig chen rnams dang / yan lag can gyi rab gnas ni/ bum pa/ slob ma/ lha sta gon gsum gyis bsnyen no/ /dkyil 'khor rab gnas ni/ las khrigs rnam pa dgu la sogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /sbyin sreg ni sa chog gi tshe mtshan ma ngan na zhi ba/rab gnas kyi che rgyas pa/ dbang bskur ba'i gong du dbang / slob ma sta gon gyi tshe kun rmi ltas ngan na drag po bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga ni/rdo rje las rim las/ dbang phyug 'jug dang bzod gsol dang / /khrus gdab dri dang lus dbul dang / /bgegs bskrad lhar slob dam tshig sbyin/ /de nyid dbab dang chu nan dang / /bsgrag dang rin chen dor ba dang / /lha dbab pa dang nan tan dang / /mig dbye dkyil 'khor legs bsnyan dang / /tshogs mchod yon dang rnam bco brgyad/ /'di yi yan lag rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes chos bco brgyad po rigs bsdus na gnyis te/ slob dpon 'jug pa'i chos gnyis dang /slob ma 'jug pa'i chos bcu drug go/ /dang po/ slob dpon rang nyid slob ma 313

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'ajug pa ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'am/ yang na rigs pa'i me tog dor ba'o/ /gnyis pa gang ltar yang slob ma 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa dang bzod par gsol bas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dgyes nas gnang ba sbyin par bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa las rim bcu drug las/ dang po phyi rol du slob ma la khrus bya/ gnyis pa gdong g.yogs bcings te snyim pa me tog gis bkang la gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa 'dod don dri lan byas nas slob dpon gyi drung du drangs/ bzhi pa dus gsum kyi rgyal ba la lus dbul/ lnga pa slob bu'i tshe bsrung la bgegs bskrad/ drug pa sgrib pa bral nas lhar bskyed de go bsgo lus srung bya/bdun pa rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig sbyin/ brgyad pa dam tshig de nyid tshig gis dbab/ dgu pa khe nyen gyi sgo nas chu nan bya/ bcu pa skrag pa dang dogs pa med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis mid du byung ba'i dam tshig gzhung bzhin spyod cig par bsgrag /bcu gcig pa lha dang las 'brel brtag phyir me tog dor/ bcu gnyis pa me tog de spyi bor bcing pa la 'og min nas yi dam gyi lha bkug pa sngar chu nan gyi lha dang gnyis med du bstim pa phyi'i lha dbab/ gsang mtshan 'dogs shing lha'i snom thabs ston pa nang gi lha dbab/ bcu gsum pa lha sgom pa la nan tan byed par gdams pa ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs phyin chad sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs pas yi dam gyi lha dang skal pa mnyam pa'i phyir/ye shes de nyid don du gnyer nas bsgrubs na tshe 'dir mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa'o/ /bcu bzhi pa mig dbye ba ni ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal te ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mthong bar bsam la mig phye zhing gdong g.yog pa dgrol 314

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃba'o// bco lnga pa dkyil 'khor gyi don rtags bshad cing lha ngo bstan pa'o/ /bcu drug pa slob mas yon dbul te/ de dag ni slob bu 'jug pa'i chos so/ /slostu/rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku 1 la mi 'tshe zhing bka' mi gcog pa dang / bla ma'i yum la mi spyod 2 pa dang / dad pa can 2 gyi tshogs mi bcag pa dang /dkon mchog dang mkhas 4 pa'i dkor la mi 'bag cing chang myos par mi btung ba dang / rdo rje mched kyi yum 5 la mi spyod pa dang / mtshan ngan gyi rig ma 6 mi bsten pa dang / mtshan nyid mi ldan 7 pa'i dam rdzas mi bsten pa dang / mkhas pa'i yon tan la mi 8 smod pa dang / snod min la gsang 9 chos mi ston pa dang /mtshan ldan gyi gzungs 10 ma dang snod ldan gyi slob ma mi spang pa dang / don bde stong dang 11 rtags yab yum mi 'bral ba dang / mched la kyal 12 ka tsam du yang nang 'thab mi byed pa dang / gzhan gyis spyad pa'i lhag 13 mi spyad pa dang /bla ma'i gdan 14 sa mi rloms pa dang / rang gzhan gyis mtshams mi 15 'bral ba dang / ting nge 'dzin bying rgod kyi dbang 16 du mi gtang ba dang / bzlas pa dang cho ga mi tshig gis 17 bar mi gcod pa dang / dbang rtags kyi phyag rgya las mi 'da' 18 zhing brda mi brngod par bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ba'i dkyil 'khor mi 19 dkyugs shing skye bo'i mthu bzlog mi byed pa dang / slob dpon gtsug tu bkur 20 ba las nyams par mi bya ba rnams so/ /༈ rtsa lhung bcu bzhi las dang po ni/ slob dpon la yang dang yang du smod par byed pa/ des kyang dga' bar byed pa/ 'gyod par mi byed pa/ phyir 'chos par mi byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ saṭ+wāṃX rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bka' sdom

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasum gang rung gi bcas pa yin pa/ de la shes bzhin du 'gal bar byas pa/khyad du gsod 'dod kyi kun slong yod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang bskur thob pa'i rdo rje'i spun yin pa/ sngags kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa/ der 'du shes pa/ zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs nas de'i skyon brngod pa / brjod pa de thos nas don go ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems can gang yang rung ba zhig la dmigs nas 'di bde ba thams cad dang bral na snya ma pa'i sems bskyed nas byams pa btang ba'o/ /lnga pa ni/ bdag gis sems can mtha' yas pa'i don du byang chub bsgrub par mi nus snyam nas smon sems spong ba'o/ /drug pa ni/ rang gi grub pa'i mtha' gsang sngags dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' phar phyin theg pa ste bka' de gnyis la smod pa'am sun 'byin pa byas na'o/ /bdun pa ni/ ma smin pa'i sems can ni dbang gis rgyud rung bar ma byas pa ste skal med ces kyang gsungs/ 'di la nag po bas snod kyis ma smin pa ni log sred can no/ /cho gas ma smin pa ni bum dbang ma thob pa'o/ /cho ga rdzogs pas ma smin pa ni gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes ma thob pa'o/ /nyams pas ma smin pa ni rtsa lhung sogs byung ba phyir ma bcos pa'o/ /zab mos 'jigs pas ma smin pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i de nyid ma thob pa ste ma smin pa lngar bshad do/ /de la gsang ba sgrogs par byed na'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ phung po sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid du gsungs pa la rang gi phung po la rgud par bya ba'i bsam pas gdung ba'i thabs gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas gdung bar byas pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/stong nyid zab mo la som nyi za ba ste yid ma ches nas spangs pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/316

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgadug pa can de la mdzo' bor byas nas lus ngag gis byams par byed na'o/ /'di ni de la mdza' bar byas pa'i lhung ba yin gyi sgrol nus med pas mngon spyod ma byas na rtsa lhung du ston pa min no/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ don dam par ming sogs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i chos rnams snyong pa nyid la ming sogs kyi mtshan ma der rtog pa byas na'o/ /'di la nag po bas/don rang gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i rtogs pa'i chos ming tshig yi ge dang brda dang brjod pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes la yin min rtsod pa dang yod med du rtog pa dang gzhan lung rigs kyis brid nas the tshom za bar 'jug pa la 'chad do/ /dngos grub snye ma las/ chos bdag med pa'i lta ba yod bzhin du ma bsnyangs par zhag gcig 'das na rtsa lhung bcu gcig pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ rang gi bla mas slob ma la bgo bsha' byas pa'i gdams pa la rab tu dad pa can la 'dun pa bzlog 'dod kyi bsam pas de'i sun 'byin pa byas na'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ tshogs 'khor ram dpa' ba'i ston mo 'am dpa' mo'i ston mo'i cho ga tshul bzhin du byed pa'i tshe dam rdzas bza' btung sha lnga la sogs pas bstabs pa'i tshe mi gtsang ba'i bsam pa'am the tshom zos nas dang du mi len pa'o/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ bud med kyi tshul 'dzin pa'i rdo rje phag mo sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams dang bud med mtshan nyid pa gang yang rung ba zhig go/shes rab ni bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin la/ rang bzhin ni 'dir 'byung ba'i don te rnal 'byor pa dh+ri de skyed par byed pa'i byed pa por gsungs pas so/ /yul de la smod par —da na'o/ / 317

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༈ bdag gi de kho na nyid ni/ mthar thug gi lha dang sngags ye shes 'grub pa'i rgyu 'du 'bral med par rgyud la gnas pa de yin la/ de thog med kyi dus nas 'khrul snang gi bag chags mthu bstas pas/ ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi snang ba 'dis bsgrib yod pa la lha'i de kho na nyid kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe/ thog mar stong chen de bzhin nyid kyi rnal 'byor gyis stong par sbyangs nas/ de'i rang rtsal snying rje sgyu ma lta bu mkha' khyab tu sad pa'i stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rtsal las/ rang gi rig pa de rgyu'i hūṃ yig dang he ru ka la sogs pa'i rnam par shar ba las/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs nas dkyil 'khor gyi zhabor lo yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar bkra lam gyis gsal ba de snang ngos nas gsal brtan gyi tshad brgyad dang ldan pas yul gsum gyad du gyur pa lta bu la/dbyings ye zung 'jug gi lta ba lha'i phyag rgyar shar ba kho na yin pa la gsungs/gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ni/ man+t+ra zhes pa'i sgras yid shes bde myur du skyob pa'i don du gsungs pas/ gang skyob na yid shes/ gang las skyob na mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa las/ tshul ji ltar skyob na bde zhing myur bar skyob/ thabs gang gis na dbyings ye zung 'jug chos nyid don gyi lha de 'du 'bral med pa la gsungs/ sngagasakyi mtshan nyid ni/ngo bo bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs yig 'brur snang ba/nges tshig ni/ byin rlabs mngon du 'byin pas sngags bzlas brjod kyi de kho na nyid ni/'byung 'jug gnas gsum gzhom med rdo rje'i bzlas pas/ bzla bya'i sngags kyi rang sgrar sbyangs pas de kho na nyid du smin pa'i tshe/ phyi nang gi sgra ru snang ba sngags su grol/ sngags grag stong du smin pa'i 'bras bu la bya/ 'phro 'dus de kho na nyid 318

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃni/ thugs srog las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros pas don gnyis byas te sku gnyis bsgrub pa'o// ༈ bla med kyi rgyud 'dir rang gi lta ba'i ngang du 'jog pa ni bdag gi de kho na nyid/ rdzogs rim ngang dbyer med par lhar bsgom pa ni lha'i de kho na nyid/ rtsa ba bskyed dang las sngags dang / /zhes gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid/ kri ya ltar na gzhi la gzhol ba bdag mdun lhar gsal ba/ sems la gzhol ba lha'i thugs kar zla dkyil sgom pa/ sgra la gzhol ba zla dkyil gyi steng du sngags phreng rang sgra dang bcas pa'o/ /gsal ba gsum dang / zhal nas zhal du zhugs pa sogs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi spro bsdu sogs ni 'phro 'du'i de kho na nyid do/ /'di gnyis ni ra rtsang mkhan po gnyis kyis gsungs pa lags/ ༈ zla gsang thig le las/ bdag gi de nyid mnyam bzhag dang / /de bzhin lha yi de nyid dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya'i de nyid ni/ /de yi dkyil 'khor mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes so// ༈ dang po bdag gi de kho na nyid ni/ lhag pa'i bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs pa'i lta ba/ gnyis pa lha'i— rten brten pa'i dkyil zhakhor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa gsal ba/ gsum pa gsang sngags lha'i snying po srog lta bu ni gsang sngags yin la sngags de yang bsgom pa dang bzlas pa gnyis kyi tshul gyis bsgrub pa ste sa bon dang sngags phreng bkod pa sogs dang / bzhi pa bzlas brjod kyi rdor bzlas la sogs pa/ lnga pa 'phro 'du'i— thugs srog las 'od zer spro bsdu'o// ༈ bdag gi de kho na nyid ni dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med/ lha'iḥ stong pa chen po nas rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha sku shar ba'i bar ro/ /gsang sngags lha'i snying po'i srog ni sngags yin pas thugs srog gi yig 319

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'abru la sngags phreng gis bskor ba de la rang ming gi rang gdangs sgrogs pa la sems bzung ba'o/ /bzlas brjodatre rtsa bskyed las gsum gyis nang chun gcig dril du bzlas pa'i tshe skyon brgya spong ba dang / dbyings drug po gang rung skabs dang bstun nas bzla ba'o/ /'phro— phyag rgya gcig pu'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las tshogs sgrub kyi dngos grub len dus kyi bar 'phro 'du yod tshad rnams yin gsungs/ sngags kyi yan lag ni/ 'grel chung las/ snying gar ye shes sems dpa' bsgoms pa'i snying gar nyi zla'i dkyil dam tshig phyag rgya bzhag ste de steng yig 'bru bzhag zlos tshe spro bsdus bzlas pa sngags kyi yan lag yin zhes so/ /sngags gsum ni/ rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags sa bon gyi yi ge/ bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags bskyed rim gsal 'debs dus brjod rgyu/ bzlas pa las kyi sngags bzla bya yin/ phyag rgya ni rang lus lhar bsgom pa phyag rgya chen po/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dang ting 'dzin sems dpa' phyag mtshan sgom pa la sems gtad pa dam rgya/ sngags phreng bkod pa sogs dang sngags bzla ba chos rgya/mchod bstod sogs bya ba las rgya ste bzhi'o/ /༈ skyed lung 'di yang khyed bla ma ral gri'i stong thun spyor/ chu bar gyi glan shākya bzang po sprul nag gi stong thun sbyor/ nag mo ri'i mda' tig chos shāka dug sdong gi stong thun sbyor ba las/ rje sgro phug pa phyi ma ltar bzhed do/ /de yang ji skad du/ gzhi la spong bar byed pa ni/ /skye bo'i sdum ra'i dug sdong 'dra/ /sbyong bar byed pa'i lam pa ni/ /'tsho byed mkhas pas mthong ba 'dra/ /bsgyur bar byed pas gsang sngags pa/ /bram ze rigs sngags grub pa 'dra/ /dbang du byed 320

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i nang pa ni/ /me byas zas su mthong ba 'dra/ /rang sar 'jogs pa'i rdzogs chen pa/ /'byung chen ltos kyi sa gzhi 'dra/ /zhes/ dper na rgyal po'i bza' shing gi rwa bar dug gi sdong po skyes pa la/ 'bangs blun po kha cig dug shing gi ro mngar la chags te bza' shing spangs nas dug shing la longs spyod pas nad gyis mnar zhing srog 'tsho ba'i skabs med pa ltar dge bcu spangs te dug lnga rang rgyud par spyad pas thar pa'i srog 'chad par byed do/ /'bangs de rnams kyi nang nas kha cig gis/ dug shing dang bza' shing gi khe nyen shes nas bza' shing la spyod na'ang / dug shing gi khrod nas 'phags par ma nus pa ltar/ dkar po'i las sad pa kha cig dge 'bras mtho ris dang / sdig 'bras ngan song las mi 'da' bar yid ches pas mi dge bcu spangs nas dge bcu spyad kyang 'khor ba las nges par 'byung mi nus pa ni lha mi'i theg pa/ las dang las kyi 'bras bu chud mi za ba dang zhes gsungs/ yang 'bangs kha cig gis/ dug shing gi sdong po 'di rtsa ba nas bton te rgyang ring por dor zer/ dpe de bzhin du phung lnga du ma dang skad cig mar rtogs pas 'khor ba las nges par 'byung yang / gzung yul rdul phran 'dzin sems skad cig ma don dam du 'dod pa nyan thos kyi theg pa la nyon mongs pa spong ba'i thabs so/ /yang 'bangs kha cig dug sdong rtsa ba nas 'don mi dgos te/ bcad mtshams la khro chu khol ma blug pas slar skye bar mi 'gyur zer ro/ /de bzhin du gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs kyang 'dzin rig skad cig ma don dam du 'dod pa rang rgyal gyi theg pa la nyon mongs pa 'gogs pa'i thabs so/ /yang 'bangs de rnams kyi nang nas sman pa zhig na re/321

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdug shing rtsa ba nas 'don pa dang sdong po gcod pa gnyis ka blun pa ste/ 'di ni sman mar gyi rgyur rnyed dka' ba zhig go zer nas dug shing la sman sbyor byas pas nad sel zhing ro tsa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro zer/ don dam du bdag med gnyis rtogs pas nges par 'byung ba byang sems kyi theg pa la/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog chos nyid du sbyong ba'i thabs so/ /yang 'bangs rnams kyi nang nas sngags mkhan zhig byung nas dug shing 'dul ba la sman gyi 'dul sbyong 'di tsam byed ci zhig dgos zer nas/ sngags btab pa tsam gyis sngar gyi sman mar las kyang mchog tu gyur pa zhig byung la/ dpe de bzhin du sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul gyi sgo nas/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog lha'i rang bzhin du dbang bsgrur bas dge sdig gi las kyi 'bras bu mi gos pa kri yog sde gsum gyi theg pa la/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog lha dang ye shes su bsgrur ba'i thabs so//yang rma bya zhig byung nas dug shing gi sdong po mthong bas/ shin tu dga' zhing zos pas lang tsho rgyas shing sbu sdug mdangs dang ldan par gyur la/ dpe de bzhin du nyon mongs pa spyad kyang mi 'ching zhing ye shes lngar gsal bas na gos par mi 'gyur ba sngags nang pa gnyis kyi theg pa la nyon mongs pa dbang du byed pa'i thabs so/ /de ltar sdum ra'i sa gzhi de la dug skyes pa/ bcad pa/ sman gyis sbyangs pa/ sngags kyis bsgyur ba/ rma byas zos pa sogs gang la'ang dga' mi dga'i rtog pa med cing dug ma skyes kyang dgag sgrub med pa bzhin du/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa rang byung gi ye shes rang shar ba la las dang las kyi 'bras bus gos su med pa la a ti rang lugs kyi theg pa ste/322

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃṭ+wāṃtā ḍiṭ+wāṃsna rom̐/ tha/ snyad las 'das pa ni ston pa drug pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa'i ༈ byang sems rnams skye ba bzhes pa'i rgyu bzhi ni/ mos spyod kyi sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi skye ba phal cher las kyi rgyu las skye ste/ de dag sems la dbang ma thob pas gang du bsam shing smon lam btab pa der gdon mi za bar skye nges pa med la/ re 'ga' smon pa ltar skye ba'ang yod mod kyi/ gtso cher bsod nams kyis tshogs bsags pa'i las kyis bdag gzhan la phan par 'gyur pa'i gnas su skye ba dang / sa dang po dang gnyis pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni smon lam gyi dbang gis lha mi byol song yi dwags dmyal ba'i gnas gang dang gang du sems can gyi don byed pa der smon lam btab pa bzhin skye ste/ lo nyes chen po byung ba'i dus su nya dang glang chen sogs kyi lus blangs nas rang gi shas sems can tshim par byed/ nad kyi bskal pa bar ma sogs kyi tshe nad sel ba'i sems can dang rigs sngags grub pa dang /sman pa chen po'i lus blangs nas nad sna tshogs zhi bar byed/ sa gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi byang sems rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi skye ba 'dzin pa ste/ de dag sems kyi ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba'i bsam gtan bzhi thob kyang des 'bras bu gzugs khams su mi skye bar 'dod khams su skye ba dang / gang dang gang du bsam par ting nge 'dzin gyis skye ba 'dzin to/ /dag sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams ni gnas gang dang gang du skye ba ci dang ci lta bu ston pa la rang dbang yod pa yin pas dbang 'byor ba'i dbang gis skye bar 'dod pa yin te/323

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃde dag gis sprul pa'i sku dga' ldan nas lhums su gshegs pa la sogs pa yang ston cing skye ba sna tshogs su ston to/ /byang sems mos spyod pa smon lam gyis skye ba'ang yod mod phal cher las dbang gis skye/ sa dang po dang gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi skye ba'ang yod mod phal cher smon lam gyis skye/ sa gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar ting nge 'dzin dang / dag sa pa rnams dbang bcu thob pas dbang 'byor ba'i dbang gis skye ba yin no/ /nyan thos kyi rigs ma nges pa theg chen la zhugs nas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba la gnyis yod do/ /rang gi theg pa'i don bden pa mthong ba rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong gsum dang / bden pa ma mthong ba so skyes mos spyod pa'i gang zag gang yin pa'o/ /bden don mthong ba la yang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba phyir mi 'ong dang / 'dod khams la 'dod chags dang bral ba min par rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong ba rnams so/ /nyan thos 'phags pa srid pa la rgyab kyi phyogs nas srid par mi skye bar byed pa 'phags lam thob pa theg chen la zhugs na 'khor bar skye nas rdzogs smin sbyang ba skal ba grangs med gsum gyi bar du sgrub dgos na srid pa zad byed kyi lam thob pa de dag 'khor bar ji ltar skye zhe na/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ma bral ba rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong gnyis ni theg chen la zhugs tshe skye ba 'dzin pa'i tshul sems can sdug bsngal ba la snying rje'i dbang gis gang dang gang du sems can gyi don bya bar 'dod pa de dang de dag du skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam gyi dbang gis de dang der skye ba mtshan nyid pa rab tu sgrub par byed de skyes nas sems can la phan pa dang bde ba byas nas tshogs gnyis bsags 324

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃshing mthar 'tshang rgya bar byed do/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba ni 'dod khams su phyir mi 'ong ba dang ldan pa'i phyir rang nyid 'dod khams su mi skye yang ting nge 'dzin gyi sprul pas 'khor bar snye ba bstan nas tshogs bsags pa sgrub par byed cing 'tshang rgya'o/ /nyan thos theg chen la zhugs pa de ni so skye theg chen la zhugs pa las dman zhing / sngar rang don la goms pa'i sems dang ldan zhing myang 'das la'ang dga' bas theg chen gyi 'bras bu la rtogs pa bul ba yin par 'dod do// ༈ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa las/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dri ma med par grags pa la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na dgon dung gi phyogs su me tog ut+pal dang / pad+ma dang /ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / dri mchog rnams mi skye ste/ 'dam dang chu gling du bskyed na me tog ut+pal dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar po dang /dri mchog rnams skye'o/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du 'du ma byas nges pa thob pa'i sems can rnams la ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams mi skye'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i 'dam dang chu gling du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams skye'o/ /zhes so// ༈ skad gnyis shan sbyar las/ ma sa mya ngam thang ste/ chu med pa'i sa thang gi ming / dha nā dgon dung / dha na ni skam la'am thang gi la/ /༈ gnas lugs mdzod 'grel las/ de yang chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa dang ye nas lhun gyis grub pa dang / rgya chad phyogs lhung med pas phyal ba dang / rang byung gi ye shes gcig pu'i ngang du bsdu ba dang bzhi/ zhes dang / theg mchog mdzod las/ de yang ngo bo ka dag la ltos nas khregs chod kyi dam tshig tu 325

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'akhor ba'i chos su snang ngo cog snang srid snod bcud phyi nang thams cad ye nas med pa smig sgyu'i chu la sogs pa sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du shes pas snang ba la bden zhen grol ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /phyi nang yul med du rtogs pa'i ngang la sems 'dzin gyi 'jur bus ma bcings ba'i rig pa phyal ba bar med chen por skyong zhing / zhen 'dzin gang yang mi bya bar sgo lnga har sangs yul med kyi rig pa rten med du rjen la phud nas phyal phyal gtong ba ni phyal ba zhes bya ste/ snang btags chos nyid du grol ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /rang bzhin lhun grub la ltos nas thod rgal gyi dam tshig tu/ rang byung gi ye shes la yon tan lhun gyis grub pas tshogs la ma ltos par rang ngo shes pas 'grub par thag bcad nas/ 'od lnga rang gsal lhun grub kyi ngo bo snang ba bzhi'i nyams len dang mi 'bral bar byas pas/ sangs rgyas rang chos su grub ste/ gzhan nas 'tshol mi dgos pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /rkyen snang dang bde sdug byung tshor dang rnam rtog snang ba dang rig pa/ ci shar/ ci snang / ci rig kyang rang byung gi ye shes gcig pur thog chod pas/ thams cad rang grol lhun mnyam chen po'i dgongs pa las mi 'da' zhing / ngo bo chos kyi sku ka dag dang lhun grub khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis su med par/ chos nyid zad pa la sha ra ra 'ol la la ye re re sangs sangs sangs gtan srid zin pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /༈ rlung sems dbu dmar thim pas snang ba gsum lugs ldog tu shar te de'i rim pa dang mthun par rang bzhin brgyad cu'i kun rtog 'gags nas slod byed rkyen gsum dang bral ba'i nam mkha' lta bu shin tu mtshon par dka' ba'i 326

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'od gsal gyi gnas lugs de'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa dang / de'i ngang las chu las nya ldang ba ltar snang ba gsum lugs 'byung du shar bas nyer len gyi rgyu byas/ rlung 'od zer lnga pas lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i lha'i skur ldang ba yin no/ /rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lha sku de nyid mtshon byed kyi dpe bcu gnyis ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i lung ltar na/ ngo bos ma grub kyang rgyu rkyen tshogs pa ltar las snang bas sgyu ma lta bu dang / gar yang khyab pa chu zla lta bu dang / sha rus sogs bral yang lus su snang ba'i gzugs brnyan mig yor ram grib ma lta bu dang / sprul pa spro bsdu mang po byed pa smig rgyu lta bu dang / rlung sems tsam las grub pa rmi lam lta bu dang / rnam smin gyi lus dang rgyud gcig kyang tha dad ltar snang ba brag cha lta bu dang / rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang /gcig yin kyang du mar ston pa mig 'phrul lta bu dang / khams lnga'i dwangs ma las grub pa'am kha dog gsal la ma 'dres pa 'ja' tshon lta bu dang / rags pa'i lus sprin dang 'dra ba'i gseb na zhing khams snang bar byed pas 'od glog 'gyu ba dang 'dra ba'i glog lta bu dang / stong pa'i ngang las rnam rtog med bzhin thol gyis rang shar du bskyed pa chu las chu bur rdol ba lta bu dang / yan lag dang nying lag cig char rdzogs pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'o// ༈ kun rdzob sgyu lus la mtshon na de las kyang chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gsungs pas/tshig tsam gyi don pha rol du phyin pa dang mthun zhing / lha sku sgyu ma lta bu sogs bskyed pa dang / rlung sems kyi lha sku sgyu ma lta bu sogs rdzogs pa dang / lhun 327

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgrub kyis rig gdangs lta bu rdzogs pa chen po dang mthun pa'i tshul du go rim bzhin tshig don dang / spyi don dang / sbas don dang / mthar thug gi don gyi gnad la 'jug pa dang / don dam 'od gsal la mtshon na/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa 'od gsal tsam phar phyin las kyang bstan pas phar phyin dang mthun pa'i tshig don/ bskyed rim 'od gsal du zhugs pa lta bu bskyed pa dang mthun pa'i spyi don/ rdzogs rim gyi stong bzhi'i drangs pa'i 'od gsal lta bu rdzogs pa dang mthun pa'i sbas don/ rim pa gnyis pa'i gnyis pa chos thams cad ye nas stong pa'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs pa dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ka dag gi rtogs pa rdzogs pa chen po dang mthun pa'i mthar thug gi don gyi gnad la 'jug pa ste/ de bzhin du zung 'jug kyang so so'i skabs kyis shes par bya ba gnad kyi don yin la/ gzhan du tshig tsam gyi don dang / mdo sngags thun mong gi spyi don dang / rdzogs rim sbas don dang /mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i don gyi tshul bzhir bshad pa ni yongs su grags pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ tshul bzhi las/ tshig gi tshul/ 'od gsal tsam phar phyin las kyang bstan pas phar phyin dang mthun pa'o/ /spyi'i tshul ni/ phar phyin theg pa'i sa lam sngags kyis kyang brjod byar bstan pas thun mong yin pa'o/ /sbas pa'i tshul ni/ gong ma'i yul du gyur pa 'og ma'i yul du ma gyur ṭ+wāṃ kā+o/ she//tha ṭ+wā+oṃ/ thu/ga gi tshul ni/ de las gong du bog dbyung du med pa sangs rgyas ༈ phyi mchod ni/ dngas bsil mngar ba'i zhal skyems mchod yon/ phyag 328

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ /zhabs bsil byed rnyog bral gyi zhabs bsil/ rnam bkra'i me tog spyan/ dri zhim bdug spos shangs/ snang gsal mar me spyan/ dri ldan ma'i chab thugaloka /bcud ldan zhal zas ljags/ snyan pa'i rol mo snyan dbang rnam la mchod pa ste/de dag gi mtshon don kyang rig pa'i ye shes nyid rnam par bkra bas me togadamigs med kyi snying rje'i rtog pa bsreg pas spos/ lhan skyes 'od gsal gyis ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bas mar me/ shin tu zab pa'i don dbyings rig spros bral gyi ye shes su shar bas chos thams cad la khyab pas byug pa/ des kun rtog gi dri ma 'khrud pas zhabs bsil/ ting 'dzin zag med kyi ro myong ba ni zhal zas dang mchod yon/ grags stong gzhom med kyi sngags sgra ni rol mo'o /nang mchod thun mong ba ni/ mtshon byed bam gtsang ma la rang byung du gnas pa'i dam rdzas mig lce rna ba sna snying ste dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen bsreg gsur gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen skra la sbar ba'i mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha chen gyi zhal zas sogs te de dag gi mtshon don lus can rnams la rang byung du grub pa'i rdzas sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi rten gzugs can dwangs ma'i dbang po lnga ni rang yul la ma 'dres par dbang byed pas rnam bkra'i me tog tshil chen gyi rgyu sha ste de nyid kyi snyigs ma drir 'gyur bas tshil gsur gyi spos/ zhun chen gyi 'bras bu khu ba las lus kyi bkrag mdangs su 'gyur bas zhun me/ mkhris pa ni dri mdzod yin pas byug pa/ bza' btung sogs 'ju ba'i dngas ma khrag dang shar smin te phung khams skye mched kyi lha rnams gso bar byed pa'i phyir zhal zas so/ /nang mchod khyad par ba la sman gtor rak+ta gsum las/ sman mchod ni/ 'khor 329

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adas kyi chos thams cad ma bcos rang byung gi bdud rtsir gnas pa'i phyir rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar tshul bzhin grub pa'i dam rdzas chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang las byung zhing gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa sel ba'i bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud len rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi ngo bor grub pa nyid mtheb srin nyi zla'i ga'us bcus te phul bas lha rnams mnyes par mos pa dang / lha rnams kyi gnas gsum nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rnam par 'phros nas bdud rtsi'i steng du gnas pa mtheb srin gyis blangs te rang gi gnas gsum dang lce la bzhag pas rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub thob par mos pa ste/ sbas don gyi dbang du byas na bdud rtsi lnga ni phung lnga'i dwangs ma/ sha lnga ni dbang lnga'i dwangs ma ste/ de dag 'dzag med du bcings pa las 'chi med grub pas na bdud rtsi'o/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ phyi mchod rnam dag dbyings kyi gtor gzhung du/ nang bcud gtor rdzas bza' btung gi dngos po mkho dgu'i longs spyod 'dod yon lnga'i sprin chen por spros te phul bas/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can las byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus bcud drangs shing gsol bas thugs dam bskang bar mos te/ nges don du yul lnga'i bza' ba dang / rnam shes kyi btung ba rnams 'od gsal gyi klong du gsol zhing thim par mos pa'o/ /rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba ni khams gsum du chags shing zhen pa'i kun rtog ste/ des 'khor ba 'grub par byed pas na 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir chags rtog thams cad khrag gi rnam par bsdus nas chags med bde chen gyi ngang du bcom ste dwangs ma'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba 'khor 330

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃb skye med kyi dbyings su sgrol ba'i dam rdzas nyid zhabor 'das mnyam nyid kyi dbyings su 'bul ba ste/ nges don du mkha' gsang gi rtser nyi zla'i 'gros bcings pas 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod par byed pa'o/ /de ltar phul bas 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho lhag med du gsol bas 'khor ba'i gnas stong par mos pa'o/ /gsang mchod la gnyis las sbyor mchod ni/ snang ba thams cad thabs yab kyi rang bzhin/ stong pa thams cad shes rab yum gyi phyag rgyar gnas pas/de gnyis ngo bo dbyer mi phyed par gnas pa ni chos thams cad rang bzhin gnyis su med par sbyor ba ste snang srid ye sbyor gyi dgongs pa yin la/ de'i rtsal snang rang nyid lha yab yum du gsal te 'du shes gsum ldan gyis mnyam par sbyor bas yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi lugs 'byung ldog gi sbyor bas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i mchod sprin zag bral sgyu ma'i bkod pas phung khams skye mched gdod nas dag pa'i lha yi 'khor lor rdzogs pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'o/ /sgrol mchod ni/ bsgral bya bdag tu lta ba'i dbang gis gzung 'dzin la mngon par zhen pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo thar ba la bar du gcod cing 'bras bu khams gsum gyi 'khor bar 'ching byed yin pas/de thams cad sgrol byed gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang rig pa'i ngo bor rdzogs pa'i mtshon cha chen pos/ rig stong skye med gdod nas dag pa'i chos dbyings mnyam pa chen po'i klong du bsgral ba ni srid gsum ye grol gyi dgongs pa yin la/de'i rtsal snang de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnam smin rtsub mos 'phangs ba'i bdud dang ru tra ma rungs zhing bcu'i tshogs rnams kun slong snying rje po'i 331

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrnam pa sbru ma lta bu'i tshul gyis dbyings su bsgral zhing rnam shes bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor sbyar te dug gsum snyigs ma sha khrag rus pa'i phung po rnams lha rnams kyi zhal du phul bas dgyes par mos pa'o/ /de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid spros bral thig le nyag gcig gi ngang du rdzogs pas/gang la mchod par bya ba'i yul dang / gang gis mchod par byed pa'i gang zag dang / ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul gsum gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbyer med par ro mnyam pas cir snang kun bzang spyod pa'i phyag rgya shāṭ+wā+oṃ /'a/jug bde ba chen por 'bul ba ste mchod pa kun gyi nang nas bla na med ༈ dang po phyag ni/ phyag 'tshal ba'i yul rten gnyis su mi dmigs par rtogs pa don gyi phyag dang / lha rnams kyi yon tan dran nas gus pas 'dud pa brda'i phyag gnyis zung 'brel du 'tshal zhing / lha tshogs rnams kyis lan gnang bar bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa phyag rgya ni 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar ro/ /gsum pa kun bzang ni/ chos thams cad rig pa rang snang du mnyam pa la bzang ngan dang blang dor ma grub pas mchod par ma gyur pa'i dngos po rdul tsam yang med de spyod yul yongs su dag pa kun du bzang po'i mchod pa'o/ /'di dang 'og ma rnams kyi sngags rgya sogs sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /bzhi pa zhakhas bsil ni/bsil chab thogs pa'i lha mos lan gsum du phul bas phyag dang zhabs bsil bar bsam mo/ /lnga pa bzhi bsnol ni/ rdo rje spos ma sogs lha mo dpag med 332

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃspros te/ shangs la bdug spos/ dbu la me tog /spyan la mar me/ thugs kar byug pa rnams kyis mchod de/ mthar lha mo rnams kyang gnas de dang der thim pa dang / skyes lan gyi tshul du lha rnams kyi gnas de dag las lha mo bzhi slar byung nas las sems kyi shangs sogs gnas bzhir thim pas dngos grub thob par bsam pa ste/ de ltar skyes dang skyes lan gyi tshul gnyis bsnol mar byed pas na bzhi bsnol zhes brjod gsungs so/ /drug pa sman mchod ni/ bdud rtsi'i che ba brjod pa sngon tu btang ste/ mtheb srin nyi zla kha sbyor gyi phyag rgyas gtor bas bdud rtsi'i zegs ma nam mkha' la sprin ltar chags pa las ra sa ya ni'i char bab pas lha rnams gzi brjid bskyed cing / de nas rang gi lce la hūṃ dang sman la 'bru gsum bkod la mtheb srin gyis blangs nas lcer bzhag pas gnas gsum du chags te 'phro 'dus sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam pa'o/ /bdun pa gtor ma ni gtor ma 'dod yon gyi lha mo drug gi rnam par phul bas gzugs rdo rje ma dang me long spyan la dang / sgra rdo rje ma dang rgyud mang snyan la sogs dbang po so so la thim nas mnyes par bsam pa'o/ /brgyad pa bdud rtsi gsang nan ni/ gsang nan nam rtsad nan zhes pa skyems kyi brda ste/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gtor mar lan gsum sbreng bas dang pos lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed/gnyis pas nyan thos rnams 'gog pa las bslang / gsum pas rgyal ba rnams gzhan don la bskul ba'o/ /dgu pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa ni/ sprul pa dang bsgyur pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ltar byed do/ /bdag nyid las kyi sems dpa'i thugs ka nas byu yig spros pas sa gzhi dang khang khyim sogs dag 333

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i zhing dang gzhal med khang du byin gyis rlob pa dang / tshul de bzhin du tram̐ las rgyan dang nags tshal/ hrīXlas glu dbyangs/ a las khrus rdzing / o las zhal zas/ mo las gos dar/ hūṃ las bro gar sogs re re 'ang mtha' yas pa sbros te mchod pa'o/ /bcu pa sgrol mchod ni rgyud nyid las/ blong na 'jig rten snying re rje/ /zhes pa ltar zhabrul ba'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje bskyed de rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i ram̐ yig las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas bsgral bya'i snying nang gi sa bon drug bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs nas rnam shes 'od gsal gyi dgongs dbyings su bstim pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa sbyor mchod ni/ lha tshogs rnams rjes chags kyis snyom par zhugs pas bde ba'i 'od zer spro bsdus rgyal ba thams cad mchod cing gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam pa a nu rā ga'i sngags kyis nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /bcu gnyis pa 'dod yon ro mnyam pa ni/ snang srid thams cad 'dod yon gyi lha mor dag pas lha la lha dang chos nyid la chos nyid rol pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa rol mo ye shes ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed pa sems nyid kyi rol par sdud pa ste/ de rnams bsgrigs na/ dang po kun bzang gis 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi rnam pa yin min gyi rnam dbye med par ye shes kyi rang snang kho nar bltas te mchod pa dang / de nas dgus dag pa'i 'dod yon gyi bye brag so sor sprul te mchod pa dang / phyi ma 'dis de dag thams cad ye shes kyi dbyings su ro gcig par bsdus nas mdor na snang spyod ma lus pa dgyes mnyam chen po'i ye shes rtsal 'bar ba'i grogs su 'byer ba nyid mchod pa'i lam gyi gnad yin 334

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpas/ rol mo ye shes kyi mthar ma hā pu dza badz+ra zhes sogs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i rdo rjer nga rgyal bzung ba gsungs te mchod par ma zad bla med kyi rgyud las 'dod yon lam 'khyer gyi thabs mkhas ji snyed bstan pa rnams kyi gnad gzer yang 'di nyid do/ /bcu bzhi pa glu ye shes ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la che ba'i yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa'i glu chos nyid kyi rang sgra'i dbyangs su grags par mos la bstod pa glu drug blang pa'o/ /khro bo la'ang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ dgu pa'i gnas su rak+ta tshar gsum ste lha tshogs rnams mnyes par bya ba'i phyir dang / zhing bcu sogs gdug can rnams brlag pa'i phyir dang / khams gsum gyi gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams thugs rjes sgrol ba'i phyir go rim bzhin du rak+ta'i dwangs ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang / khu ba bsgral byar dang / rtsigs ma dug gsum sha rus kyi rnam par byas te 'bul ba'i ched du rak+ta lan gsum sbreng ba'o// ༈ tshogs kyi skabs su/ phur pa bka' ma'i 'grel chen las gsungs pa ltar/ tshogs pa gsum ni/ dga' ldan lha yi tshogs gsang sngags nang gi lha mthun pa/ dgyes ldan mi yi tshogs dam tshig rtsa ba gcig pa/ 'byor ldan yo byad kyi tshogs bzang la gya nom pa'o/ /gsog pa gsum ni/ gnas dur khrod lta bu'i tshogs khang du/ grub pa thob pa'i bla ma/ lha grangs mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo/ 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod tshang bar gsog pa'o/ /bsang ba gsum ni/ bdag nyid kyi nyesaskyon/ mched lcam gyi nyams grib/ tshogs kyi ma dag pa bsang ba'o/ /sbyang ba gsum ni/ ram̐ ye khaṃ las me chu rlung byung ste sme btsog sbyang ba'o/ /brlab pa gsum ni/ 'bru gsum 335

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgyis bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du brlab pa'o/ /bskyed pa gsum ni/ mchod pa'i dus su 'dod yon lnga/ bshags pa'i dus su ye shes lnga/ bstab pa'i dus su dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu bskyed pa'o/ /yul gsum ni bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la 'bul ba'o/ /dam tshig gsum la gsum tshan bzhi las/ mi bya ba gsum ni rang sems zhabrugs pa'i rtsod pa/ gzung 'dzin skye ba'i zhabrul gtam/theg pa 'og ma'i 'bag rtsog gi rtog pa mi bya'o/ mi smra ba gsum ni/ tshogs rdzas gzhan la che ste bdag la chung / na ning bzang ste da lo ngan/ khar seng mang ste de rang nyung zhes mi smra ba'o/ /mi bsam pa gsum ni/ tshogs rdzas kyi dngos po mthong ba'i tshe bza' snyam btung snyam zhim snyam du mi bsam pa'o/ /mi 'bral ba gsum ni/ lus lha ngag sngags sems ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /tshim pa drug ldan ni/ tshogs zhid rnams mchod pas tshim pa/rnal 'byor pa rnams rdo rje'i bza' btung gis tshim pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo bdud rtsi'i dwangs mas tshim pa/ lus dkyil gyi lha rnams bde stong ye shes kyis tshim pa/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams glu dbyangs kyis tshim pa/ dreg pa las byed kyi 'byung po rnams gtor mas tshims pa'o /༈ sngags mtshan bcas thun mong pa'i lam gyis dbu mar gzhug pa'i thabs las dpe don gyi ye shes 'dren par byed pa la'ang / grol lam bla ma'i man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo sprod la brten dgos te/ de las gzhan du rlung dbu mar zhugs kyang ye shes ngos mi zin/ de ma zin na rlung dbu dmar zhugs kyang ci zhig phan/ don 'od mtshon pa'i sgor ma gyur na rtsa rlung thig le sogs 336

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi rol pa sogs dang khyad med par rgya gar gyi slob dpon in+t+ra bo dhi dang bod kyi rog bde gshegs chen po sogs gsungs/des na thabs lam pa dag gis mi shes su mi rung ba'i gnad ni/ slob dpon shrī seng ha nas bai ro la brgyud pa'i gshin rje'i rdzogs rim mthar thug thabs lam gnad kyi lde'u mig las/ rten gzhal yas khang lus gnas rtsa yi pho brang na/nang gi mkha' 'gro rtsa yi ge tshul du bzhugs/ rtsa gnas yi ge'i pho brang na de kho na nyid stong nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes srog mi shigs pa'i thig le bzhugs so/ /de yang lus gang na gnas pa na rtsa gnas/rtsa gang na gnas pa na rlung gnas/ rlung gang du gnas pa na thig le gnas/thig le gang du gnas pa na spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnas so/ /zhes sogs lus gnas rtsa yi chags tshul/ rtsa gnas yi ge sprin gyi 'khor lo/de na lha gtso 'khor sogs ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul rnams gsal bar gsungs shing / de las rtsa thams cad srog shing gi rtsa gsum la 'dus shing / de yang rang bzhin gnyug ma'i a ba dhu ti gnyis med stong pa'i rtsa yin te cir yang ma grub pa spros bral chos kyi sku/ bshad tshod kyi a ba dhu ti lus dkyil sgal tshig mdun srog shing ka ba ltar gnas te dbyibs dkar 'tsher rlung dang thig le gang gis kyang dben pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo rdul dang / g.yon rkyang ma dkar mo khu bas gang ba/ rtsa gsum po de'ang sku gsung thugs rdo rje ste/ rkyang ma sku/ ro ma gsung / kun 'dar ma thugs rdo rjer gsungs pa dang / sku sogs de thams cad gzhi dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs rang byung gi ye shes phyogs gcig tu 337

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃm nges te/ rgya gar yang ma chad/ phyogs gang du'ang ma lhung ba'i gnad kyi snang tshul yang nges med du shar ba'i phyogs gcig tu chad pa med pa dang / rtsa yig de rnams kyang rang rang gi bag chags dang mthun par shar te/ rgya gar la rgya yig bod la bod yig lha la lha'i yi ge sogs su gnas par bshad/ gzhan yang rlung dang thig le'i rnam bzhag rgyas par gsungs shing / de kho na nyid stong nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs tshul yang / rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni rten byed pas sku rdo rje/ rtsa la gnas pa'i yi ge rnams ni brda sprod pas gsung /yi ge'i pho brang na rlung dang thig le dkar dmar thams cad rang gsal bar byed pas thugs rdo rje/ des na snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi lus la rdzogs par gnas pa las gzhan gud na med do/ /zhes dang /de las rlung la/ 'phen pa las kyi rlung ni dwangs ma phra ba'i srog 'dzin gyi rlung gis yid kyi rnam shes kyi rlung bskyed/ kha nang du bltas nas rang rgyud kyi rtsa la rgyus pas nga bdag tu 'dzin pa skye/ nyon mongs pa'i 'tshub mang / kha phyir bltas te rtog ngan sna tshogs 'gyus nas las sna tshogs bsags pas 'khor bar 'phen par byed/ gsal ba ye shes kyi rlung ni rig pa'i rlung yin te/ rig pa gsal ba cir yang ma 'gags par gsal la gang gis kyang sgrib pa med par gsal ba ste/ gnas ni kun 'dar ma na gnas te mnyam rgyu'i skabs rig pa rtog med dwangs cha dang bcas te 'gyu ba yin/ de ngos bzung ba la 'byung ba mnyam par gnas pa gcig la/ rlung phyir 'gro nang 'gro'i khug pa gcig la gcig tu bgrang ba'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig la nyi khri chig stong drug dang bcu rgyu 338

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃb las/ g.yas nas g.yon du 'pho ba la dang / g.yon nas g.yas su 'pho ba'i skabs 'pho mtshams bcu gnyis po mnyam gnas kyi rlung rgyu bas bcu gnyis po snyigs ma'i rlung yin/ bcu gsum pa mnyam gnas ye shes kyi rlung dbus kun 'dar ma na rgyu ba yin no/ /rig pa'i rlung la dwangs snyigs gnyis las/ dwangs ma'i rlung ni/ gnas dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi dbus/ngo bo srog mi shigs pa'i thig le/ byang chub kyi sems spros bral chos kyi sku/ lam kun 'dar ma nas rgyu dus 'pho mtshams bcu gsum pa la'o/ /snyigs ma'i rlung gnas gsang 'khor/ngo bo rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ lam rtsa 'dabs brgyad/ 'khor brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs/ de las dwangs ma'i rlung 'pho mtshams bcu gsum pa ngos bzung ba ni rlung g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mnyam du sha ra ra rgyu dus/ rig pa gsal stong rtog pa med pa/ ngos bzung zhes kyang stong pa spros med nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams sngar bas lhag pa'i shes pa gcig shar ba de ni nang gi sgra gcan 'dzin rtsa dbu ma'i nang du nyi zla ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung tshud nas rgyu ba'i rtags yin/de ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dngos su shar ba yin/ sems can thams cad la nyin zhag phrugs gcig la thebs re mi 'char mi srid kyang bla ma'i man ngag med pas ngos mi zin/ yun kyang 'ga' zhig la se gol bdun gyi yun tsam las mi 'char ba'ang yod/ bsod nams bsags pa 'ga' zhig la zan re za yun tsam la 'char/ srog rtsol la gnad du bsnun pa'i rnal 'byor pa la nyi ma phyed dang zla ba dang lo la sogs par mi g.yo ba'i nyams shar nas brtan pa thob pa yod/ rlung sgom pa dang / bde ba sgom pa dang / de bzhin du sgru lus/ zhi gnas/339

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'od gsal skom pa sogs thams cad 'di ngos zin cing rtogs par bya ba las med/ 'di ngos zin zhing rtogs pa'i dus rlung a ba sgru tir tshud pa yin/ 'di ni gsang ba'i nges pa'o/ /nang gi nges pa ni rlung g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mnyam du rgyu ba'i dus so/ /phyi'i nges pa ni/ zla ba gzas zin dus dwangs ma kun 'dar gyi rlung rgyu ba'o/ /de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags gsum gyi ye shes kyi rlung ngos bzung nas/ lus gnad bsrang / ma ning gi rlung dal la 'jam par bzung /ma bsgom pa'i mngon sum gsal ba'i ye shes kyi rlung thug phrad gsum du shar ba de/ sgom pa'i mngon sum bzhag phab gsum gyi klod la bzhag go/ 'di'i gnad ngos zin na bskal par bsags pa'i sgrib pa'ang skad cig gcig gis 'dag la/sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yang 'dis mngon sum du gtan la phebs pa yin no/ /gsungs/ des na gnad 'di ngos zin na rig pa rang babs su bzhag pas rlung dbu mar mi zhugs pa ma yin te/ dus 'khor gyi sor bsam dang rdzogs chen gyi bzhag thabs rnams bzhin no/ /de bzhin thabs lam dngos gzhi'i nyams len skabs med du mi rung ba'i man ngag gi ngo sprod drug gsungs te/ dang po mi btang ba gsum gyi srog bzung ba ni/ thig le rdo rje'i kha nas mi btang /yid chags pa'i dbang du mi btang / lta sgom blo yul du mi btang ba'o/ /gnyis pa bcad pa gsum gyi 'khor ba'i rgyun lam bcad pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs rgyud bcad/ 'dod chags kyi gzhi rtsa bcad/ 'khor ba'i rgyun lam bcad pa ste/ de gsum rim par thig le ma shor na/ chags rtog rang sar grol ba/ rang byung gi ye shes mngon du rtogs pas skye shi 'khor ba las grol ba'o/ /340

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ /gsum pa dga' bzhi ngos bzung ba la dbye ba bcu drug las/ go rim la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi ni/ thabs shes kyi 'dod yon lnga la slob pa'i dus su gzugs nas reg bya'i bar gyi bde nyams ci skyes thams cad dga' ba/ mkha' gsang rtsa sprad dus kyi bde ba cher 'bar ba mchog dga'/ nang sprad grub pa'i dus kyi bde ba lhan cig skyes dga'/ kha sbyor bzhi 'dzoms pa'i dus bde ba la mi rtog pa dang ldan pa dga' bral gyi ye shes so/ /gnas la ltos nas bzhag pa'i dga' bzhi la'ang gnyis/ 1 phyi'i gnas la ltos pa/ lus khol bur bde ba skye ba dga' ba/ lus phal cher la khyab snyam byed pa mchog dga'/ lus thams cad la bde ba skyes pa dga' bral/ phyi nang gi dngos po gar bltas kyang bde nyams 'ba' zhig skyes pa lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes so/ 2 /nang gi dga' ba la ltos nas/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i skabs thig le spyi bo nas mgrin par bab dus kyi bde ba ci skyes dga' ba/ de bzhin snying khar bab pa mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes dga'o/3/spang bya la ltos nas bzhag pa'i dga' bzhi bde ba la sems zin te gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa rags rim 'gag pa dga' ba/ de bzhin bdag 'dzin gyi rtog pa rags rim 'gag pa mchog dga'/ rang dang phyag rgyar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'gag pa dga' bral/ nyams thams cad rang snang rang stong rang rig tu rtogs te zag bcas kyi dga' bde rang kha ma'i 'dzin rtogs 'gags pa lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes so/ 4 /rang rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas bzhag pa ni/ bde nyams chung ba dga' ba/ cher 'phel ba mchog dga'/ bde ba la mi rtog pa 341

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdaga' bral/ bde stong gnyis med rang rig ye shes su rtogs pa lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes so/ /༈ ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul ni/ ngag bzlas skad gsang mthon por bzla ba dang / mchu dang lce rtse 'gul tsam gyis shub bur bzla ba dang / rlung bzung ste sngags kyi gzugs dang sgra la sems gtad pa 'gog bzlas dang / rlung 'dzin pa tsam yang mi bya bar yid kho nas sngags kyi gzugs sam sgra gdangs dran pa yid bzlas dang / sa bon gyi nā da las dbugs phyir dbyung ba dang lhan cig hūṃ gi sgras sku'am 'od zer 'phros te don gnyis bsgrub/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe oṃ gyi sgras tshur bsdu/ gnas pa'i tshe āḥ'i sgras nā da la thim pa'am/ yang na rang sngags dang sbyar te rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba sogs kyang yod do/ /bzla tshul dngos ni/ shes na yi ge'i skye gnas sgra'i 'byin tshul lce mchu'i byed rtsol sogs ma zhabrugs par/ yi ge re re nas shin tu myur ba dang ha cang bul ba ma yin pa dang /yi ge ring po rnams thung ba dang / thung ngu rnams ring ba ma yin pa dang / yi ge gzhan lhag pa'am/ yi ge de nyid chad pa ma yin pa dang / gzhan yang sgra ha cang che ba dang / chung ba la sogs pa'i skyon rnams spangs la thun nang du gzhan du gtam smra ba dang glal ba dang lu ba sogs gzhan gyis bar ma chad par bzla bar bya ste/ rngam glog las/ sgra chen ma yin chung ba min/ /mgyogs par ma yin bul bar min/ /drag por ma yin zhan par min/ /yig 'bru yan lag nyams pas min/ /yengs ba ma yin smra bzhin min/ /glal sogs bar du chod pas min/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang sngags kyi sgra /ོ/2 shan sbyar ba shes na don gyi gzungs

g.yu khog bla ma chospodabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'agrub pa sogs kyi dgos pa yod de/ rgyud las/don la the tshomi med pa yi/ /mkhas pa la ni dngos grub nye/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar sbyar ma shes kyang dad mos rtse gcig pas bzlas na dngos grub chen po ji lta ba bzhin 'byung ste/ yang na blun po dad pa can/ /de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ /zhes gsungs shing /sngon gyi grub thob 'dar phyar ba dang sa paṇa gyis 'phrog byed btul ba'i lo rgyus kyis kyang shes so/ /gal te sngags rgya skad du yod pa bod skad du bsgyur ba dang /rgya bod 'dres par yod pa'i bod skad rnams rgya skad du bsgyur ba dang / mkha' 'gro'i brda skad sogs gzhan gyi skad du yod pa brda sprod pa'i lugs dang bstun nas gsar du bcas te bzlas na ni dngos grub med do/ /ci'i phyir na sngon gyi gsang sngags gsungs pa po nyid kyis skad de dang der byin gyis brlabs kyis/gsar du bcos shing bsgyur ba der ma yin pa'i phyir gang gsung pa po de'i bden tshig 'grub par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /spyir yang gsang sngags kyi cho ga sogs la dpyad pas dngos grub ring bar bshad de/ rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge mkhan/ /de la dngos grub shin tu ring / zhes dang / rdzas dang sngags kyi sbyor ba la/ /dpyad na dngos grub mi 'byung ste/ /gal te yid gnyis za gyur ram/ /bsam pa 'gyur ram dad pa nyams/ /de tshe dngos grub nye ba yang / /phyir ldog 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /zhes gsungs/ des na dad mos rtse gcig pas bzla bar gces so/ /sngags phreng bkod tshul/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang rnam 'phrul tshad med pa'i gsang ba zab mo gdul bya'i yul la mnyam por 'jug pa las rgya bod kyi yig gzugs kyi khyad par tsam la byin gyis rlob par 343

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnus mi nus sogs kyi bye bsal ma dmigs pa'i phyir gshar gzab gang rung gi blo la 'char ba gang bder bya ba las gzhan du basbrur mi dgos gsungs/ rtsa ba'i thugs srog sa bon gyi yi ge de'i mdun nas brtsams te bzlas bya'i sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams shin tu phra ba spus bris pa bzhin gsal zhing 'bar ba'i phreng bas bskor ba ste/ de yang rang gzhud dang bstun sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor dgos pa rnams sngags ngo phyir bstan pa dang / phyi nas bklag phyogs ltar yig 'bru rnams langs thabs su g.yon du bkod pa phreng ba ltar 'khor ba'i mgo 'dren o lta bu dang hūṃ hrīḥsogs mjug gi sngags 'bru thug pa/ de yang ring ba'i rigs la mdun nas yig mgo brtsam pa'i sngags mgo nang bstan dang sngags mjug phyi rol du thad kar 'grigs pa'i rim pa gnyis gsum sbrul 'khyil ba ltar bsgoms la bzlas pa'i dus g.yas su bklags thabs su 'khor dgos pa yin/ sngags phreng g.yon su 'khor dgos pa rnams thugs srog gi mdun nas snga ma ltar yig 'bru rnams langs stabs su sngags ngo nang bstan/ nang nas bklags phyogs su g.yas bskor du bkod/ sngags ring rnams phyi nang bskor lugs snga ma ltar bya/ bzla ba'i skabs g.yon du 'khor dgos pa yin/ sngags phreng g.yas g.yon du 'khor tshul/ spyir btang lha yab kyi rigs rnams g.yas 'khor dang yum rnams la g.yon 'khor lta bur 'dug kyang mtha' gcig tu nges pa med pas rang gzhung dang bstun/ yang sngags phreng dngos 'khor mi dgos par de las 'od zer spro bsdu sogs byed pa'i rigs la sngags ngo bstan phyogs gong las bzlog te bkod lugs kyis g.yas g.yon bskor phyogs nyid gtso che 344

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbs de ltar skabs dang sbyar shes par bya'o/ /dzab dgongs bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag bkod pa'i bzlas pa'am zla ba skar phreng lta bu ni/ sa bon dang sngags phreng 'od zer 'phro ba la yang yang sems bzung / de nas rim par lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags sgra sgrogs pa dang sngags 'bru rnams kyang rang sgra dang bcas gdan las cung zad 'phar te thog mar 'od zer 'khor/ de nas sngags phreng nyid rim gyis je mgyogs su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas sangs kyis bsal bar mos pa'o/ /gnyis pa nye bar bsnyen pa 'gal me 'khor ba lta bu'am/ khyogs kyi bzlas pa ni/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig 'phros pa yig 'bru rnams gcig rjes gcig non reg la ma 'byar zhing bar ma chad pa'i phreng ba sngags kyi rang sgra dang bcas pa 'gal me 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin ye shes pa dang dam drig sems dpa'i zhal nas rim par thon pa yum gyi zhal du zhugs thugs rgyud bskul/ sku'i nang brgyud pad+ma nas byung ste yab dang ye shes sems dpa' gnyis kyi rdo rje'i lam nas steng du byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bde phril phril byung ba thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas mchog gi dngos grub thob par mos pa ni ye shes kyi bzlas pa'o/ /gsum pa bsgrub pa'i yan lag rgyal po'i pho nya lta bu'am spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ni sngags bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan nam mkha' gang bar 'phros pa'i rtse las mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thog pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba sras dang 345

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbacas pa la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ lha rnams zag med kyi bde ba chen po'i thugs mnyes par byas/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad sku phyag rgya gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par ram/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par char babs pa ltar byon nas rang gi sgo gsum la thim pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs/ dbang bzhi mig rdzogs su thob par bsam pa ni bdag don byin rlabs bsdu ba'i dmigs pa'o/ /yang 'od zer 'phros te khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can rnams la phog pas las nyon sdig sgrib dang so so'i sdug bsngal thams cad skad cig la sbyangs/ nyan rang byang sems rnams kyang shes sgrib las grol bar byas/ thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas gyur bar bsam pa ni gzhan don phrin las kyi bzlas pa ste 'di'i skabs su las bzhi gang 'dod kyi dmigs pa'ang 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag bung ba tshang zhig pa lta bu ni/lha sngags las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis snod gzhal yas khang / bcud lha'i 'khor lo/ sgra grags sngags kyi rang bzhin/ dran rtog ye shes kyi rol par ༵ gādī dri kā ོོ༵sa/ /la 'dzin med kyi ngang nas bzla ba ni bdag gzhan gnyis med ༈ dbyangs dang gsal byed sogs yi ge lnga bcu rtsa gsum brtsi skabs/dbyangs yig bcu drug /gsal byed so bzhi mgo tig shad gsum rnams so/ /de yang mgo tig shad gsum ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mgo ni ma nor lam yin te/ /346

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃtig ni shes rab ming du smra/ shad ni thabs tshigs su gcod/ /ces pa ltar/mgo ni glang po che'i sna 'dra ba'o/ /tig ni āḥdabang phyug chen po'i mig 'dra ba'o/ shad ni ā ring po mda' lta bu'o/ /sa paṇa gyis/ a de la gsum/ seng ge lta bu'i a/ glang po che'i sna lta bu'i a/ mtshams rnam par gcod pa'i a dang gsum zhes gsungs/ dpe byad kyi mtshon byed ka li bzhi bcu brtsi skabs su gsal byed so bzhi la yi ge lhag po drug snon tshul la/ slob dpon skal ldan rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gtsug nor las/ ḍa lha la ya dang drug bsnan/ a bh+ya ka ra'i man ngag snye ma las/ ḍa lha ya ra la wa dang drug bsnan pa'o// ༈ bzod pa thob pa sgo'i gzungs/ tshig gi gzungs/ don gyi gzungs/ sngags byin gyis rlob par nus pa'i gzungs ste gzungs kyi sgo bzhi'o// ༈ sngags bzla ba'i tshe skyon drug spong dgos te/ sgra myur ches na 'bru 'dres pa'i snyon/ bul che na sbyor ba'i skyon/ sgra drag ches na phog thug 'ong zhing byin rlabs 'gyang / sgra zhan che na nus pa mi thon/ bying rmugs su song na sgra mi dag rgod na g.yengs shing sems 'phros pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba'i skyon 'byung / gzhan yang mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bya/ ji ltar bzla na/ gsal bar bzla ste/ sgra ma 'dres/ ma phral/bar ma chad par bzla/ dag par bzla ste/ sngags chad lhag med par zur phyin par bzla/ brtson par bzla ste rgyun mi chad par chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du bzla'o//༈ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje skye tshul ni bzhi ste/ lung las/ rtag rgyun rang bzhin shugs skye dang / /yul dang gsol ba btab pas skye/ /zhes pa ni/rtag pa rgyun du thugs rje skye tshul dang / rang bzhin shugs kyis thugs rje skye tshul 347
