g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang / yul dang 'phrad nas thugs rje skye tshul dang / bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje skye tshul lo/ /dang po rtag par rgyun du thugs rje skye tshul la yang bzhi las/ de yang rang bzhin thugs rje'i rgyun ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po rgyun chad med par chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mdzad pa med pa'i mdzad pa 'gro ba'i don du gyur pa rgyun chad med par 'byung ba la bya'o/ /'byung ba thugs rje'i rgyun ni/ 'byung ba spyi'i dbang btsan tsam du so so'i nus pas 'gro ba'i don byed pa'o/ /de rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor 'byung ba la bya'o/ /sprul pa thugs rje'i rgyun ni/ gsang snying las/ 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po re rer/ thub pa chen po bcom ldan 'das re res/'dul ba rnams bzhis 'gro ba lnga'i don mdzad pa gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ye shes spyan gyi thugs rje'i rgyun ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyan gyis dus thog mtha' med par 'khor ba'i khams ji srid gzigs pa de srid du thugs rje rgyun dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin shugs kyis thugs rje skye tshul ni/rang byung ye shes chen po ni thugs rje'i bdag nyid ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin te/ dpe nyi ma'i 'od rang tshugs tsam rtsol ba med par 'jig rten du snang ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa yul dang 'phrad nas thugs rje skye tshul ni/ thus rje'i yul ru tra lta bu dang / gzhan yang sdug bsngal can dang 'phrad pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs gdung ba skye ba lta bu'o/ /de ltar ni khams gsum gyi sems can sdug phongs can rgyun mi chad pa thugs rje skye ba rgyun mi chad zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa bskul zhing gsol ba btab pas thugs rje skye tshul la 348

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃganyis te/ rang don du bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa ni/ sdug bsngal can smre sngags bton pas thugs rje skye ba ni sngon byung ru tra'i gdung tshig bzhin no/ /gzhan don du bskul ba ni/ le'u gsum par dam pa'i rigs can lngas bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa'o/ /le'u lnga par gdung ba sel bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'o/ /zhes dang /rdo grub rin po ches/ de yang rtag pa rgyun gyi thugs rje ni chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ rang bzhin shugs kyi thugs rje ni nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu/bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i thugs rje ni gtong phod can la slong mo byed pa lta bu/ yul dang 'phrad pa'i thugs rje ni gdon gyis btab pa'i bu la mas brtse ba lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs// //349

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃ༄tsho/ /gsang snying skor zhal rgyun phyogs bsdus/'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa sems rang snang gi dbang du btang na snang ba snang yul dag ma dag sogs gnyis kyi rnam par yod kyang / ye shes rang snang gi dbang du btang na/ de ltar gnyis su med pa'i rang rig pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'di kho na nyid de/ rig pa nang gsal ltar na ye shes rang gi dbyings kho na las gzhan mi snang ba dang / phyi gsal ltar na ye shes rang snang gi chos thams cad rang snang du mthong pa las gzhan du mi snang bas na rang rig ces bya/ ༈ rdo rje chos bdun mtshon bya don la sbyar na rig pa gting gsal chen po la chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i rtog pas mi chod pa/ bden 'dzin sogs shes sgrib kyi zag pas mi shig pa/ phyin ci ma log par yang dag par bden pas bden pa/ skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral bas sra ba/ rig stong zung 'jug chos sku thig le nyag gcig dus gsum 'pho 'gyur dang bral bas brtan pa/ srid zhi dbyer med du khyab pas thams cad du thog pa med pa/ rang ngo ye nas skyon bral yon tan kun ldan du gnas pas thams cad du ma pham pa'o/ /zhes so// ༈ stong bzhis drang ba'i 'od gsal dang dga' bzhis drang ba'i ye shes/ phyag chen sngags lugs sogs gang yin kyang kun rtog rnams 'gags dgos kyang / 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi sems sems byung gi rtog tshogs ma 'gags bzhin tu rig pa ngo sprad nas kun rtog thams cad ye shes kyi bdag 350

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnyid du grol bar byed pa ni rdzogs chen gyi khyad chos yin gsungs/ spyir mdo sngags gnyis kyi nges 'byung / sems bskyed/ lta ba/ tshul khrims la sogs khyad par che/ mdo phyogs nas 'khor ba la skyo ba'i nges 'byung / sngags nas tha mal ma dag pa'i snang zhen la skyo ba'i nges 'byung dang / mdo na/ snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed sgyu ma lta bu dang / sngags na na mo bdag dang mtha' yas sogs— gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don ma rtogs pa'i sems can la lta ba ni mdo na stong nyid rtogs pa dang / sngags na lhag bden dbyer med rtogs pa/ tshul khrims kyang so thar na gsol bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa so thar gyi tshul khrims/ byang sems na nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdudagyi sems can don byed/ sngags bla med spyi na mi 'pho ba'i tshul khrims/ phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba rtogs na rgyal ba dgyes pa'i tshul khrims zer/ ༈ sngags rdzogs kyi pha rol phyin drug ni/ yul la 'dzin zhen rang sar grol bas sbyin pa/ dus gsum yid kyi 'khrul rtog gi dri mas ma gos pa tshul khrims/ zab mo'i don la mi skrag pas ni bzod pa/ de skrag ni mi dgos 'jug 'dod yod ni red/ gnyugs ma chos sku'i dbyings na rig pas btsan sa bzung pa las gzhan pa'i brtson 'grus shig chos sku rdo rje 'chang gis kyang bsnyan ni ma red/ 'khrul ba'i dbang du mi 'gro bas bsam gtan/ mkhyen cha rtsol med du rgyas pa shes rab zab mo/ pha rol du phyin pa drug dus gcig spyod ni red/ ༈ kha phar bskor nas yul lnga 'byung lnga sogs dag pa yin ni red brdzas nas yul zhig la gzhal bas ni mkhas do ni ma red/ de bas bla ma'i 351

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃman ngag gis nang don gyi ye shes ngo 'phrod na rgya gtor khyer ni red/ de 'dra'i tshul rin po ches gsungs ni red/ gnas snang mthun pa'i mgo brtsams pa sogs rang gi shes yong ni red/ thod rgal ba zhig yin na snang ngor ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum red/ ༈ snang zhen 'di rags mi nyan/ 'di thog mtha' gnyis na med pa glo bur gyi mgron po lta bu zhig las yod ni ma red/shin tu srab pa dung gi ser snang log ma log lta bu tsam las g.yag ro 'dra 'dra zhig gis bcad yod ni ma red/ 'di shin tu srab ni red/ rig ma rig go ma gongo shes ma shes tsam zig mi yod ni lha red na gsungs/ ༈ gsang snying gi skor zhal rgyun du/ rig pa nyid mngon du gyur na chos kyi dbyings rang stobs kyis mthong bya mthong byed kyi spros pa med par mngon sum gzigs pas na rang rig pa zhes brngod do/ /byang chub sems zhes pa'i thad/ rgyud 'di nas bstan pa'i de byang chub kyi sems sgrib pa'i dri mas gtan ma gos pa dang gsal ba sku dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs pas byang chub dang / ngo bo ye shes yin pas sems zhes brjod la kun rdzob byang sems nyid byang chub min zhing byang chub 'dod pa tsam yin par gsungs/ ༈ rin po ches gter chen bla ma la gsungs pa yin/ sems zhus sogs kyi don/ bdag kyang bde gshegs snying po rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems dang ldan pas dri ma glo bur ba sbyong ba'i thabs la bslabs na bla med byang chub gdon mi za bar 'thob nus so snyam nas zhus pa spong ba dang / rgyud nyes byas chen pos zil gyis mnan cing nyon mongs 'chol nyog tu spyod pa'i sems can rnams kyang gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal gyi snying 352

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃpo can du gnas pas nges par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro snyam nas sems can dman pa la brnyas pa spong ba dang / 'bral rung glo bur ba'i sems la mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du 'gro ba'i shes rgyud gnyug mar zhen pa'i sgro 'dogs spong ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos gang ga'i bye ma snyed kyi gzhir gyur cing mos pa lan re skyes pas kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon khyad par can 'jog pa'i sems kyi gnad gsang mthar thug gzhan yod pa la/ da lta rang cag la mngon du gyur pa'i sems kyi pha rol na de 'dra gang yang med do zhes skur ba 'debs pa spong ba dang / bdag gzhan snod bcud bde sdug sogs glo bur gyi 'khrul snang ci tsam shar yang sems kyi gshug ma'i gshis la mnyam pa nyid du shes nas bdag la lhag par chags pa'i skyon bsal te zhen med kyi gnad dang ldan pa'i dgos pa dang lnga zhes pa 'phral gtam tsam mo/ /sems zhus sogs nyes pa lnga spong ba'i don no/ /༈ gsang snying gi phyogs rnams zhal rgyun du/ tshig don mdzod sogs las bshad pa ltar gyi sems kyi gnas ro rkyang / ngo bo bzhon pa las rlung dang 'grogs pa'i sems rnams/ rig gdangs mi 'phye bo las rlung rta long ba bzhon nas yul bsgrod pa'i dpes mtshon pa'i don rig gdangs nyid las gzhan min la/ gal te rig gdangs ma 'grogs na yul shes pa'i bya ba sogs gang yang mi byed par gsungs so// ༈ zin bris las/ chos thams rtog pa'i cho 'phrul/rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal gyi cho 'phrul/ da lta nas rnam rtog thams cad kyi srog na 'od gsal nyid bzhugs pa de ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo sprad de lam

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdu byed po rgyud 'odi'i khyad chos/ da lta'i rtog pa thams cad kyi srog na 'od gsal yad na/ 'ad gsal rnam rtag gnyis skud pa dkar nag bsgril pa ltar yod dgos pas shes rgyud gnyis su thal lo zhe na/ dper na chu grang bas bcur te chab rom du song ba'i sra 'thas te chu min kyang de'i gshis chu yin pas nam zhig zhu ba na chu'i ngo bor zhu 'gro ba bzhin du/ zhabrul pa'i yo lang sna tshogs kyis gtses te kun rtog rags pa sna tshogs pa mched pa 'di dag gi srog gam gshis na 'od gsal yod pas de bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo sprad de mngon tu gyur tshe kun rtog thams cad 'od gsal gyi klo+ong du thim 'gro bas 'od gsal rnam rtog gnyis gcig mngon du gyur ba na cig shos bag la zha 'gro ba srang mda'i mtho dman lta bu yin gsungs/ yang zhal rgyun du chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par rtogs pa'i rang lugs thun min gyi sems bskyed dang / mnyam bzhag ye shes 'od gsal ba nyid brtse ba'i snying rje'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pas/rjes thob tu rkyen phra mos bskul ba'i sgo nas 'gro kun gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin mngon tu gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sar 'god par 'dod pa'i sgo nas 'khrul rtog glo bur ba bsal nas bdag gis sems can don du sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa rang shugs la 'ong ba ni thun mongs sems bskyed kyang tshang bar gsungs so/ /gsung rgyun las/ 'dir thun min gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed ces pa snang cha sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rtog pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ma dag pa'i zhen snang gtan la phab pas chos nyid gtan la phebs par 'gyur ba'i skabs/ sgyu 'phrul 'di'i skabs kyi snang zhen gcod lugs ni/354

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrdo grub rin po ches gter chen la gsungs pa/ dpe nyi ma sprin gyis sgrib pa'i skabs 'od drod dang ldan pa yin kyang sgrib byed sprin gyi dbang gis 'od zer drod ldan du mi 'char ba yin la/ sprin dang bral tshe 'od zer mtha' dag drod dang ldan par dngos su 'char la/ de yang sngar drod med gsar du drod dang ldan par song ba min par tha snyad kyi yin tshul bsal ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'char gzhi 'od gsal ba'i rig pa nyid tshogs brgyad glo bur ba'i sprin gyis sgrib tshe/sems kun gyi gshis ye shes yin par mi snang bar/ ma dag rang rgyud par snang zhing zhen la/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas snying dbus kyi 'od gsal sad nas mngon du gyur tshe/ de'i ngor sems thams cad 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba ni/ dpe gser gling du phyin pa lta bu yin la/ 'di dus yul can thams cad ye shes 'ba' zhig tu shar ba ni/ sngar ye shes min pa gsar du ye shes su song ba min par gnas lugs ji bzhin pa nyid mngon sum du gyur pa yin no/ /rig pa sad stob kyis yul can thams cad yongs su shar/ yul yang ye shes kyi ngor snang bas yul gyi steng na ma dag pa bsal rgyu med par thams cad dag pa 'ba' zhig las med pa myong bas grub pa yin no/ /zhen snang ni rjes thob rgya yan pa'i ngor snang sems rang rgyud pa 'khrul rtog tu snang ba 'di tsam las gzhan med pas/ ngo shes ma shes tsam mam rig pa sad ma sad tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches/ rnam shes tshogis brgyad chos can dang de'i rang bzhin chos nyid kyi ye shes gnyis ni/ gcig tha dad gang du'ang khas blang bya min par/ dgongs 'grel las/ 'du byed khams dang don dam mtshan 355

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnyid ni/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /gcig dang tha dad du yang gang rtog pa/ /de dag tshul min lta la zhugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung bzhin klong chen rab 'byams kyis kyang gsungs la/ de'i phyir de gnyis tha dad min te sems rtogs pa tsam gyis sems kyi chos nyid ye shes mi rtogs pa dang / chos can dang chos nyid min pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ /don dam par tha dad min te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes yin pas/ ye shes rtogs dus sems kyang de las tha dad du yod pa ma yin pa ltar na/ ye shes rang dbang gi snang ba chos can/ dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu gnas pa yin te/ de'i snang cha la ma dag pa'i snang ba ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / dpal sprul gsung rgyun las/snang ba 'di chos can/ lha yin te/ ye shes rang snang yin pa'i phyir/ 'di skabs kyi lha ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug gi ye shes nyid yin la/ lha de nyid tshogs brgyad kyi rnam par bzhengs ba'i ye shes rang snang gi cha yin pa'i phyir/ zhes par go dgos zhes dang / rdzogs chen lugs la snang ba thams cad kyi chos nyid rig stong 'dus ma byas pa de 'bras bu yongs dag lha'i ngo bor dang po ngo shes/bar du yang yang bskyangs bas rtsal rdzogs pa'i thabs la slob cing / ma/thar brtan pa thob tshe sgom stobs kyis snang ba ltar grub pa'am shar ba yin no/ /bshad pa mang pos snang ba lhar mi 'grub kyi/ dang po sems dang rig pa gnyis su phye nas rig pa rkyang ded du bskyang ba ni snang ba lhar sgrub pa'i sgo yin la/ bar du snang lugs 'khrul ba cung zad log nas sems rig gnyis med chu dang rlabs ltar mthong nas sems rig gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrogs lhod nas rtsal gyi 356

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'achar sgo la dgag sgrub mi dgos par gu yangs blo bde ba'i dbyings kyi nam mkha' la rig pa'i mkha' lding g.yo ba na snang ba lhar 'grub pa'i mgo bo rtsom pa yin/ mthar brtan pa thob pa mthar thug pa na gser gling du sa rdo phal ba btsal kyang mi rnyed pa sems rig chu dang rlabs ltar rtogs par ma zad snang sems kyang de ltar rtogs pa dang gnas lugs dang snang lugs ma bu 'phrod de snang lugs kyi 'khrul cha dbyings su zad pa na slob lam gyi snang ba lhar sgrub mthar thug yin zhing / mthar rig pa dbyings su 'khyil/ rig gdangs sku dang zhing khams su smin/ rig rtsal rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su grol ba na snang ba lhar sgrub pa bla na med pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /rin po ches bla ma gter ston la/ 'od gsal rig pa ngo legs par 'phrod rjes de la mnyam par bzhag na dbyings la'ang mnyam par bzhag pa yin/ dbyings la mnyam par bzhag na yang 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag pa yin/ de gnyis me dang tsha ba lta bur gdod nas dbyer med zung 'jug chen por bzhugs pa yin gsungs/gter ston nyid kyis gsang snying 'chad skabs su de la zhes pa'i 'bru 'grel tshul yang 'od gsal de la zhes par sbyar nas gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan dbyings ye me dang tsha ba bzhin nam yang 'du 'bral med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/ rgyud 'di ltar na dbyings ye 'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes nyid sku gsum gyi yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin par ngo legs par 'phrod rjes/rig cha nyid bcos med du bskyang ba'i man ngag dang ldan pas rig cha de la mnyam par bzhag mthus chos kyi dbyings sam stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa 367

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyin pas stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag par 'gro zhes dang / rin po ches/kun mkhyen snga phyi'i lam dus kyi 'od gsal 'char dus rig cha sad dgos/dbu ma'i lta ba zur nas mi dgos gsungs/ zhes dang / ye shes rang ngo la kun gzhi'i bslad cha ma zhugs pas snang cha gang yang ye shes sam rig ngor song ba rig pa nyid snang cha de dang der 'char gyi tha dad du mi 'char ro/ /de'i snang cha thams cad rig pa nyid kyis bsdus yang yin te/ gzhi snang dang po bzhin no/ /zhes dang / de ltar snang ba gang dang gang rig thog tu song yang snang ba des rig pa btum du'am g.yogs rgyu'am 'gebs rgyu med par snang ba de nyid rig pa rang du hril gyis 'gro ba ni rig pa yul la mi thogs pa'i don te/ rig pa zang thal zer don de red ces dang / de dag kyang gzhi snang gi rig pa'i rang gshis la chos kun med snang gzugs mthong ba'i rtsal rang chas su yod pa yin gyi/ stong nyid de la thos bsam sngon song sogs kyis mthus min pas/ chos sku kun tu bzang po la/ /bla ma bya ba yod min te/ /rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs tsa na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bla ma 'jigs 'od gsung rgyun/ man ngag dang ldan pa zhes pa dbyings kyi tshul legs par ngo 'phrod pa'i rnal 'byor bas rig pa bcos med du mnyam par bzhag pas/stong nyid rtogs pa rang stobs kyis 'ong bas na zhes dang / zin bris las/dbyings la snang ba gang yang ma grub pas dbyings de la mnyam par bzhag ste nam mngon du gyur pa na yang rjes thob tu gang snang thams cad ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyag gcig tu 'char ba las rang dbang bar gtan mi 'char te/ yul snang 358

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthams cad ye shes kyi rnam rol kho nar 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/༈ bla ma nyag blas spyi don 'od gsal snying po 'di sngags kyi rgyud dang bcas pa'i spyi don dang / khyad par du nang rgyud sde gsum phyogs bcu'i mun sel dang dkon mchog 'grel gyi spyi don red gsungs gi/ ༈ spyir ma hā yo ga chos thams cad kyi gzhi lta bu yin tshul ni/ theg dman nas 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi bar gyi theg pa thams cad kyang / gnas tshul mthar thug lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i brjod byar gyur pa nyid rtogs pa'i thabs su bstan pa'i phyir na/ theg pa thams cad 'phro ba'i gzhir gyur pa dang / khyad par sngags bla med zhig nyams su lon pa la snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang gzhir bzhag gi steng nas 'chad nyan sgom sgrub la 'jug dgos pas na chos thams cad kyi gzhi lta bu/ de lta bu'i ma hā yo ga'i lugs kyis/ spyi rdul mtshon ras bris sogs kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum dbang bskur nas de'i lta ba snang srid dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med snang srid ye sangs rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du rtogs dgos/ de'i lam bskyed rim mo/ /de tsam ma rtogs kyang lung rigs rnam par dag pa la brten nas/ tha mal ma dag pa sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du sdom pa thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa dang sdom pa'ang red/ lha sngags chos nyid du mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su sdom pa shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang sdom pa'ang red/ de gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug tu rtogs pa de bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi ngo bo dang / e waṃ zung 'jug gi sdom pa red/ de ltar nges pa'i gang zag des mnyam bzhag skad cig ma de la rgyud kyi dngos po bcu gcig po 359

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃtshang tshul ni/ snang srid dag mnyam du rang ngo 'phrod pa lta ba/ ngang la gnas pa sgom pa'am ting nge 'dzin/ sno gsum gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la spyod pa spyod pa snod dag pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ bcud dag pa rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs/ rgyud dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo sad pa snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi dkyil 'kho+or/ dper na rgyal bu rgyal sar 'khod nas rgyal 'bangs mnga' 'og tu tshud pa ltar/ sngar tha mal ma dag pa'i dbang gis dag pa rab 'byams su ma dbang ba de/ da lta skad cig la dbang bas na skye med don gyi dbang / dag mnyam de las mi 'da' ba dam tshig gnas tshul dag mnyam rtogs pa'i gang zag de'i ci bsam gyi las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa ni phrin las/ de lta bu'i rig pa 'dzin pa de yi snying rje'i rdul tshon gyi thig le 'gul bskyod ye shes kyi phyagā rgya/bza' btung tshogs 'khor gyi rang bzhin zer ba ltar gang spyod thams cad ye shes phyag rgya/ ma dag mtshan 'dzin gyi yid las skyobs pas na sngags sogs mnyam bzhag gcig gi ldog cha la tshang ni red/ de ltar shes na gsang snying shes ni yin/ dper na 'o ma bsrubs pa las mar byung ba bzhin du snying po lon ni yin yang bshad dgos ni ma red bla ma nyag bla'i gsung gi/ dag mnyam yin tshul la yang yang dpyad nas/ dang po nges shes skye/ bar du brtan/ mthar nges shes las rtogs dgos/ de ltar nges pa'i gang zag de lus ma spangs bzhin du dag pa'i zhing na bzhugs ni red/ ces dpal sprul rin po ches gsungs ni red/ thog med nas bsags pa'i dam tshig nyams chag de hral hol tsam las mi lus gsungs gi/ ༈ rin po ches rdzogs chen la ma gtug bar du 360

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasang snying mi shes gsungs rgyu bo rdzogs chen la zhugs pa'i gang zag zhig la/bla mas ngo sprad nas snying kha chos kyi pho brang nas 'od gsal gyi rig pa nyid sad nas sems sems byung dang bcas pa'i yul can thams cad ye shes nyid du shar/yul lnga sogs yul thams cad rig pa'i rnam ldan du shar bas/ de dus snang ba lha yul can ye shes su sad nas/ rang dus na gnas tshul dang / snang tshul mthun/ dper na rin po che'i gser gling du phyin pa na sa rdo phal ba btsal kyang mi rnyed pa ltar/ dag pa 'ba' zhig las med/ ma dag pa'i snang ba ni snang ba'i mdun na mun pa'am 'khor bsgyur gyi khri la mu to ba bzhin du 'dug pa'i gnas ga la yod de med do/ /da lta nyid nas 'og min gyi zhing red/ spyir bgrang ba'i 'og min sogs mang yang / rang snang gi 'og min ni/ rang nyid gang du sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral ba de ma gtogs phyogs gang na yang yod tshul ma gsungs ni red/ ༈ nges pa tsam gyi ngor ma dag pa snang yang zhen pa med gsungs gi/rig ngo 'phrod pa la snang ngor nges ngor gnyis ka la dag pa red/ dpyad pa'i nges shes ngor na snang ngor ma dag pa dang / nges ngor dag pa gnyis phye dgos/༈ kun gzhi lung ma bstan ma rig pa'i rgya dang ma bral ba'i ngang las rtog pa gcig shar na log rtog gnyis shar na phyin ci log de bas gcig e shes ya bsams na/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la mig phye btsum goms pa'i 'degs 'jog gi yun la yang gsol ba btab na de'i dga' ni red/༈ gsar ma'i/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum dang / rnying ma'i nang rgyud sde gsum la don gyi cha nas brjod bya la bzang ngan med par shes 361

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdagos/ 'on kyang rdzogs chen gyi khyad chos ni dus 'khor sogs la yod ni ma red/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang /mchog du mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug tu bzhugs pa la/ mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje gsungs pa dang / rdzogs gyi gzhung rnams nas/ gdod ma'i stong chen gyi dbyings dang / bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis zung 'jug tu bzhugs pa la khyab brdal rig pa kun tu bzang gsungs pa rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs red/ ༈ rig pa ngo bo ye stong du bzhugs par rtogs pa la chos nyid lta ba dang / rang byung ye shes kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs par rtogs pa la chos can lta ba'i lta ba dang / de gnyis dbyer med du rtogs pa la zung 'jug lta ba'i lta ba gsungs ni red/ ༈ 'khor ba ya mtha' thug med nas da lta'i bar du skye 'chi'i kha brgyud yong kyang snga ma'i rlung sems rnams 'gags/ phyi ma'i rlung sems rnams ma mched pa'i bar der gzhi'i 'od gsal rkyang ba shar ni red/ de'i rang dus na zhabrul snang 'di gtan nas yod ni ma red/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi gzigs ngor na dag pa rab 'byams yin ni red/ des na ma dag zhabrul snang 'di thog ma'i spyi gzhi dus na ma grub/ mthar phyin 'bras bu dus na ma grub pa/ da lta glo bur gyi mgron po dang nam mkha'i skra shad lta bu zhig yin ni red/ ༈ a nu yo gas phyi gnyug ma'i mkha' dkyil dang / nang bkod pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor rtsal du bton/ spyir gzungs ma la yul rig chos kyi gzungs ma yul rig chos kyi gzungs ma ni yid kyis sprul ba'i lha mo/ chos nyid don gyi gzungs ma dang / stong gzugs lha 362

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ snyimo'i gzung ma/ shes rab ma mo'i gzung ma dang bzhi yod/ dbang gsang sher gnyis red/ de'ang rang lus thabs ldan rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bton nas snod rung bya ba sbyor lam ste/ sher dbang gi sngon 'gro red/ de'i lta ba gsal stong zung 'jug red/ dngos gzhi sher dbang ni gzhan lus la brten pa 'og sgo'i lam/ lta ba bde stong zung 'dug red/ de gnyis gyi lam rdzogs rim a nu des ni chos thams cad snang cha yab kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor/ stong cha yum kun tu bzang mo'i dkyil 'khor/ zung 'jug sras bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du 'dod/ ༈ a ti yo ga'i dkyil 'khor ni nang sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes yin/ lta ba rig stong zung 'jug red/ ༈ sems sems byung thams cad ye shes su shar song na/ dbang po ma shor na'ang gnyis snang nub zer ni red/ ༈ dag mnyam 'di bsgom nus na/ blo grub mthas bsgyur ba tsam gyis tshad ni ma red/ lam zhugs te tshogs lam la zhugs pa'i gang zag red/༈ rlung sems 'gags pa'i mnyam bzhag 'ur mthil tsam la lam khyad med pas/'od gsal rdzogs chen la khyad chos yod tshul mi pham rin po ches gsungs/༈ rang lugs la theg pa rim dgur 'jog tshul bskyed pa ma hā yo ga dang / khyad par du a nu las ni lta bas ma zad dbang grangs re gsungs yod/ rdzogs gyi rgyud rig pa rang shar sogs las kyang theg pa rim dgur gsungs ni red/slob dpon pad+ma'i man ngag lta phreng / ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis lta rim sogs las kyang gsungs/ ༈ dran pa brgya stong bsten kyang dran mkhan chos nyid du dngos su dran snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo shar ba na/ rang gi rang rtsal g.yos nas 363

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrang ngo shes pa tsam red/ gnyug ma'i dran pa dang / khyab brdal lhun grub kyi dran pa'ang zer/ de lta bu de dag mnyam gzhi yi dkyil 'khor red/ de min par sems 'jur bus bcing ba'i thugs dam pa gsungs pa ltar bud song na bskyur na dga'/ ༈ 'od gsal gyi rig pa ngo 'phrod na chos nyid mngon sum zer/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis med pa'i cha nas don spyi zer/ mngon sum yin pa'i cha 'dir mngon sum zer/ ༈ mi pham gyi sdud 'grel las ma dag pa tshogs sbyor/ci ༷)ga mudag pamathongalam/ shinapretādasbyanapasangasargyas kyi sa ste gsum las sdor+shaṭ+wā+oṃ /sha/kā dṛ snakā ༵ sduzlo/ ñtsār+sha /kya /ga/—gas pa ltar gtan la dbab dgos/ /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༄7/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang gzer bzhi'i rnam bzhag bshad pa/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma gdod ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po khrid nyan tshul gyi kun slong la/ sngags kyi smon sems ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sogs ltar/ sems ye shes su bskyed pa zhes rang gzhan gyi gzung 'dzin 'khrul sems rang gnas kyi ye shes rang rig dpal chen bla ma'i dbyings su grol 'dod kyi thugs bskyed/ sngags spyi dang khyad par nang rgyud sde gsum dag snang gi lam pa yin pas phun sum tshogs pa lnga gsal btab nas smin grol thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i rjes su 'gro dgos/ kun spyod kyang spang blang ma 'dzol bar gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan bya'i chos la ston pas gdul bya'i khams dbang dang bsdun nas chos sgo bsam mi khyab par gsungs kyang bsdu na 'jig rten pa'i theg pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa gnyis la 'du/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa de la theg pa che chung gnyis yod/ theg pa po la rgyu lam byed mtshan nyid theg pa dang / 'bras bu lam byed rdo rje theg pa gnyis yod/ dang po rgyu lam byed kyi theg pas ni 'bras bu sku gnyis kyi rgyu tshogs gnyis lam du byed pa dang / chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid gtan phab nas ring lam bskal pa'i mthar sangs rgyas thob/de'i nang tshan bka' tha ma nges don du 'dod pas bde gshegs snying po nyer len 365

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgyi rgyu dang tshogs gnyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas sangs rgyas thob/ sngags kyis mthar thug gi 'bras bu sku gnyis kyi rnam pa de lta nas bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis lam du byed pa yin/ rnam pa lam byed de'ang sol ba la gser 'dzin ltar blos sgro btags pa ma yin par gzhi 'bras kyi bzhugs tshul dang mthun par lam bsgoms pa yin snyabs kyis tshe lus gcig gis zung 'jug thob/ don du gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dus thams cad na gnas tshul ma gnas lugs chos sku dang / de'i rang rtsal gzugs sku ste sku gnyis las nam yang 'da' mi srid cing de gsum gyi ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pas na rdo rje'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje'i theg pa'i nang tshan nang rgyud sde gsum gyi/ thabs bskyed rims dang rlung gi rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pa pha rgyud/ rang lus dang gzhan lus la brten pa'i thig le'i rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pa ma rgyud dang / grol lam lta ba kho na gtso bor byed pa gnyis med kyi rgyud yin/ de'ang gsar ma ltar pha rgyud rim lnga/ ma rgyud chos drug gnyis med rgyud sbyor drug rnams yin kyang don du bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i ra ba las mi 'da' bas/ bskyed pa'i rim par legs gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi gdang bu lta bur bstan/ /zhes bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis las rim pa gnyis pa'i rim pa gnyis pa grol lam rdzogs pa chen po dang phyag chen gnyis khas mi len te/ sngags kyi rim pa gnyis pa thabs lam yin pa'i gnad kyis sa paṇa sogs kyi phyag chen la dbang dang rdo rje'i lus kyi phyed bcing sogs mi 'dug pas mdo yin nam sngags yin/ mdo yin na tshe 366

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlus gcig gi spros bral mi mthong / sngags yin na dbang dang thabs lam dgos gsungs/ de'i phyir/ nged kyi phyag rgya po ni/ /dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phyag chen mdo lugs su khrid zer ba la dbang dgos pa dang mi dgos pa gnyis ka bsgrub med gsungs/ ma hā'i grol tshag kha shas sam phreng gcig chad pa 'dra man ngag lta phreng dang rdzogs chen gnyis la'ang thabs bskyed rdzogs gang yang mi dgos phyir mdo yin na tshe gcig gis zung 'jug mi 'grub/ sngags yin na thabs lam yod dgos zer nas khas mi len kyang / 'phags yul la'ang grol lam yod de mkhas shing grub pa'i tshogs rnams kyi do ha skor drug dang grub pa sde bdun sogs na'ang thabs lam bkag nas grol lam kho nar bsngags/ khyad par 'phags mchog klu'i byang chub sems 'grel gyi bshad bya pha rgyud rim lnga'i nang tshan rim pa bzhi pa don dam byang chub kyi sems 'od gsal gyi skabs 'grel ba yin la/ dela'ang byedabacing sogs kyi thabs gang yang ma bstan par grol mal gyi lta ba kho nas gtan la dbab pa yin no/ /snga 'gyur ba'i lta ba dag mnyam chen po mngon sum myong thog tu khel ba'i gang zag gis lha bsgom pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug kyang 'phags yul na de 'dra med ces khas mi len kyang yod de gsang 'dus la 'phags pa klu la lung dang ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis su grags pa'i phyi ma'i lugs la gnas lugs mngon sum myong ba'i gang zag gis lha bsgoms na bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyi rgyas btab pa zhes zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim dang / lha sgom pa de thabs bskyed rim yin pas 'od gsal dang 367

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsgyu lus gnyis zung du 'jug pa dang mtshungs gsungs/ in+d+ra bo dhis kyang 'di la bskyed rim la ltos pa'i rdzogs rim dang / rdzogs rim la ltos pa'i bskyed rim zhes gsungs te/ bskyed rkyang bcos ma'i lha sku la ltos na 'di'i rtsa ba mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim gyi ye shes yin pas rdzogs rim dang / snang ba gsum gyi 'od gsal gyis rgyu byas rlung 'od zer lnga bas rkyen byas nas rtsol med du ldang ba'i rdzogs rim ma bcos pa'i lha sku la ltos na blo rtsol gyis bcos pa'i lha sku yin pas bskyed rim yin/ don du bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mthong lam 'od gsal de dang / rjes thob lha sku zung 'jug yin/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'di la gzhan yang lugs mang rung gsar mas dgongs pa ma lon nas rnying mas dgongs pa lon zhes gsung / zung du 'jug rgyu'i snang phyogs sku'i mgo bshad ma thag pa'i bskyed rim 'di dang / sgyu lus slob pa'i zung 'jug thod rgal mi slob pa'i zung 'jug rnams dang / 'od gsal yang grol lam gyis gtan la phab pa'i mngon sum dang / phyed bcing gis drangs pa'i dpe'i 'od gsal/ don gyi 'od gsal khregs chod chos sku rnams yin/ de'i nang tshan snga ma rnams la zung 'jug gi dod thub yod kyang zung 'jug mtshan nyid pa min/ mtshan nyid pa ni/ mthong lam thugs don gyi 'od gsal dang sku slob pa'i zung 'jug yin la sku thugs zung 'jug zer ro/ /dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'di la dgongs nas srog sdom gzer bzhi 'di gsungs pa yin pas snga bgyur ba'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi lam dang sbyar nas 'chad shes dgos/ 'og ma bskyed rkyang 'di'i dgongs pa mi 'byor/ 'di la rgyud gsum gyi rnam bzhag shes 368

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdagos pas/ rgyud gsum ni/ gzhi rgyud dang / lam rgyud/ 'brasargyud do/ /dang po la gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi dang / 'khrul bas btags pa'i gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ he ru gal po las/ gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi/ /lhag pa'i chos sku bcings grol med/ /ye nas lhun grub chen po la/ /ngo bo ka dag chen po gnas/ /snang tshul 'khor 'dus gnyis su snang / /zhes pa ltar/don du dbyings rig zung 'jug rig stong zung 'jug gi ye shes ngo bo ka dag gi sangs rgyas sam gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas sam rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas zhes gzhi bcings grol las 'das pa 'di la gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi zhes bya/ gzhi rgyud kyang 'di yin te/ dper na chu bo'i rgyud ltar gzhi 'a ma 'bras bu'i dus thams cad na mi 'gyur bar rgyud gcig pas so/ /skru 'phrul ltar 'di la lhag pa'i don dam dkor bdun ngo bo nyid lhun gyis grub pa zhes dbyings don dam ye shes don dam zung 'jug don dam gsum dang zung 'jug gi steng nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lngar dbye bas bdun no/ /'khrul ba btags pa'i gzhi ni phung po lnga'am/ gzung 'dzin gnyis sam tshogs brgyad sems byung dang bcas pa'am/ sgo gsum mam de bsdu na rtog sgrib 'di kho nar 'du/ 'di ni glo bur ba dper na gser dang g.ya'am me long dang g.ya' lta bu yin pas rgyun mtha'i rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis lhag ma ma lus par ldog go/ /lam rgyud rim gnyis kyang glo bur ba dper na sgrib pa lcags lta bu de zad tshe gnyen po'i lam bden btsa' lta bu de ldog 'gro bas ye shes sam don gyi 'od gsal rgyud la skyes/ rjes thob zung 'jug gi skur ldang / de dus mdzo mo 369

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsgo khyi bya chu len sogs tshom bu 'bum phrag tsam 'khor tshogs dang bcas pasazung 'jug grub/ bskyed rkyang las bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la bogs 'don 'di mi dgos/ tshogs pa de'i nang dam nyams gcig yod na gzhan thams cad dam ldan kho na yin kyang dam nyams gcig po'i stobs kyis thams cad kyi dngos grub gyi skal ba chad gsungs/ deng sang de'i dod thub sman 'grub dang bum sgrub rnams yin/ tshig dbang gi lam rdzogs chen ltar thabs bskyed rdzogs gang la mi ltos par bla ma'i man ngag gi stobs kyis gzhi lta ba ngo sprad nas ye shes rtsol med kho na la goms pas mnyam nyid rdzogs pa chen po'i mchog gi dngos grub myur bar thob nas rang don du chos brgyad mgo snyom pa dang gzhan don du brtse ba'i snying rje rang shugs kyis 'byung gsungs/ dbang bzhi'i lam de bsdu na sngags spyi ltar bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang rnying ma ltar bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum la 'du/ ༈ bskyed rdzogs gnyis po la/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum re yod pa'i/ dang po lta ba dag mnyam chen po/ bsgom pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ spyod pa spro bcas spros med kyis lta sgom de dag bogs dbyung ba'o/ /dang po lta ba la go ba myong ba rtogs pa gsum yod/ dang po go ba la gsar phyogs kyis mdo sngags kyi lta ba la khyad par med par bzhed do/ /sa paṇa gyis/ pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod gyur na/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sngags thabs kho nas 'phags par bzhed pas mtha' bral stong nyid dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la phab nas snang srid kyi gnas tshul ma dag pa zhig la thabs kyis bcos nas snang srid dag 370

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa rab 'byams su bsgom pa rim pa dang po bskyed rim yin/ rnying mas mdo sngags kyi lta ba la khyad yod par bzhed pas na/ dang po sems can rnams ni sogs kyi lung dang/ chos nyid kyi rigs pas gnas lugs chos sku dang / de'i rang rtsal gyi snang srid thams cad chos sku'i rang rtsal dag pa rab 'byams la gtan la phab pa na/ de ni lta ba dag mnyam chen po lung rig gnyis kas nges pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa yin pas de tsam la'ang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgra 'jug lung rigs sngon du ma song yang bla ma'i gsung sogs la brten nas snang srid dag mnyam chen por rtogs pa'i lam bden 'dus byas yin no/ /lam bden gyi ngo bo sher phyin gyi bdag nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang sngags kyi rig pa'i ye shes yin pas de 'dus byas yin nam snyam na rang ngo 'gyur ba med pas 'dus byas min kyang gong nas gong du rtsal rdzogs rim la ltos na 'dus byas lta bur snang /gnyis pa lam rgyud ni smin grol gnyis yin pas/ dbang ni sngags gyi 'jug sgo smin byed sdom chog rnams yin/ de la gzhi dbang rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon dang /'bras dbang ni rdo rje bzhi'i 'bras bu dang / lam dbang ni gzhi nyid 'bras bur smin byed kyi dbang thams cad yin la/ de lta bu'i gzhi dbang de sems can gyi rgyud na med na bskur bas mi thob te/ rgyud las/ dbang bskur rang la sogs ltar ro/ /lam dbang gi dus slob ma'i sgo gsum nas chu rgod lta bu la bla ma chang ma lta bu des/ snyabs sems sdom bzung sogs nas btsos pa lta bu dang / bla mas dgongs pa gtad slob mas mos gus byas/ de nas bla slob lhar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' khyab kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i 371

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃye shes slob ma'i sgo gsum la bstim pa ni phab btab pa lta bu yin/ de dus rab la rtogs pa skyes/ 'bring la sgrib pa bral rung dang ye shes skyes rung gi nus pa rgyud la bzhag nas nyams skyes/ tha ma shes rgyud 'gyur/ de nas dbang bzhi rim par bskur bas/ yang tha yin yang sgo gsum rdo rje gsum yin pa'i go ba rnam dag zhig ni skyes dgos/ rtags de rnams gang rung byung na dbang thob pa'i tshad yin pas/ skye ba snga phyi nam yin kyang de 'dra'i dbang dang po nam thob pa lam dbang gi gzhi dbang dang / de nas rang bzhin gyi rkyen gyis dbang zhus tshad lam dbang gi lam dbang dang / mthar rgyun mthar rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i dbang gsum zhu ba ni lam dbang gi 'bras dbang ngo / /de lta bu'i dbang de sngags kyi sdom chog yin pas dbang thob pa tsam gyis mi chog /dam tshig bsrung dgos/ dam tshig kyang dbang bzhi rang rang la ltos pa'i dam tshig gam/ mdor na sku'i dam tshig bla ma dang mched kyi sku mi brnyas/ gsung mi bcag /thugs mi dkugs/ gsung gi dam tshig lha sngags ting nge 'dzin la brtson/ thugs kyi dam tshig gsang bcu mi bsgrag /spyir sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dag snang dang bral tshe dam tshig nyams pa yin gsungs pas gzab 'tshal/ de ltar dam tshig dag na des dbang don gyi ye shes ma rtogs kyang grol byed kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su blangs na chang lang pa ltar rang rgyud grol bar 'gyur/ dam tshig nyams na chan la phab btab kyang chang tul ba'am rgod pa ltar rgyud tshig ste mchog thun mong gi dngos grub kyi skal ba chad nas/ ltar snang la bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i gdams pa la ji ltar brtson 372

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ /kyang don du sgrub pa log par gyur nas ru tra dang rgyal 'gong dam sri kho na 'grub par 'gyur la/ rang brlag par ma zad/ ji ltar 'o ma sogs ltar/ gzhan gyis kyang dngos grub kyi gegs byed pa dang / der yang ma zad ye shes gsang rgyud las kyang / dam tshig mi ldan rdo rje'i ni/ /be'u sbrel g.yang la lhung ba bzhin/ /bdag gzhan rdo rje'i khab tu lhung / /zhes pa ltar mthar rang gzhan rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'khrid pas dran shes kyi sgo nas dam las mi 'da' ba shin tu gal che'o/ /de ltar dbang thob dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i gang zag gis grol byed kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa la/ dang po bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim dang des tha mal gyis snang zhen sbyangs nas yul gsum gyad du gyur kyang /da dung gya noms lhar zhen gyi snang ba rdzogs rim gyis sdom dgos pas de yang gsang sher gnyis ka'i lam rdzogs rim mtshan bcas dang / tshig dbang gi lam rdzogs chen mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim yin/ de'i nang tshan gsang dbang gi lam rlung gi rdzogs rim dang / sher dbang gi thig le'i rdzogs rim mam/ yang na gsang dbang gi lam bdag byin gyis rlob pa sbru lus 'od gsal zung 'jug gsum yin pas/ dang po rang lus thabs ldan la brten nas rlung bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan bsgoms pas stong bzhis drangs ba'i dpe yi 'od gsal lam yang na thig le gnad du bsnun pas dga' bzhis drangs ba'i dpe yi 'od gsal rgyud la 'dren/ de'i rjes thob snang ba gsum gyi 'od gsal gyis rgyu byas/ rlung 'od zer lnga bas rkyen byas nas sbru lus kyi lha skur ldang / de dpe yi 'od gsal dang sgyu lus zung 'jug yin/ sher dbang gi lam dpe yi 373

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'od gsal de don gyi 'od gsal la sbyor ba'i thabs gzhan lus phyag rgya'i lam la brten pa yin pas gsar ma yin na sbyor lam thob tshe chos gos sogs dge 'dun la phul nas spyod pa gshegs zhes phyag rgya mtshan dang ldan na rang gi sring mo yin kyang khrid de dur khrod brgyad sogs la gshegs nas phyag rgya'i snyobs kyis thugs don gyi 'od gsal drangs nas rjes thob slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba sa ra ha ba sogs gsar ma'i grub thob phal cher lta bu yin/ rnying mas sbyor lam thob pa'i gang zag stong phrag sogs yab yum zung 'brel lhan du tshogs nas/ tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa byas nas mthar dgong mo lha las dngos grub blang / nam gung ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis dgra bo dngos su mdun du bkug ste chang gis myos par byas nas ral gris dngos su gshags nas 'tsheng ba gsum ldan gyi sgo nas bsgral te dgra las dngos grub blang / tho rengs rigs dang mthun par yab yum sbyor ba byas pas thig le yas bab kyi 'gros kyis dngos po lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye nges kyi sems can sngags kyis thabs mkhas kyis rdo rje 'chang gi sar btsan thabs su bkod/ de nas mas brtan gyis mthar snga ma'i nyams dang bral nas rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes te rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i sa la bsgrod pa rgyal sras pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs sngags rnying ma'i grub thob phal cher lta bu'o/ /lung rig gi nges pa med par mos pa tsam gyis lta ba bzung na mos pas 'dzin pa zer/ lta ba dngos grub slob dpon sogs mag de bla ma bzang po'i gsung la brten pa dang dngos po'i gnas tshul dang 374

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmathun pa yin pa'i phyir 'di tsam gyis bsgrubs na mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'grub gsungs/ snga ma la lung rigs sngon du song bas gzhan gyis blo mi 'phrog par brtan pa dang phyi ma la lung rigs med pas mi brtan par 'gyur sla/spyir sngags bla med kyi lta ba yin na mngon sum yin pas khyab gsungs pa gtso bo thabs grol gang rung gis drang bas myong thog tu khel ba yin pa la go dgos kyang / go ba de lta bu'ang mtshan nyid theg pa'i lta ba phung po rnam dpyad kyi stong ba kha phyi ltas la ltos na mngon sum lta bu yin/ gsar rnying gi go lta la'ang de tsam khyad yod gsungs/ go lta de lta bu'i steng nas bskyed rim bsnyoms na dngos po'i gnas tshul dang mthun pa'i sgom pa phyin ci ma log pa yin pas thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa mtshan nyid pa yin la/ 'dis thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub cing mchog gi dngos grub yang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa myong lta 'dren tshul/thabs grol gnyis las/ dang po thabs lam ni/ snang ba gsum gyi nang tshan yang dag ye shes kyi snang ba/ bskyed rkyang gi gya nom lhar zhen gyi snang ba rdzogs rim gyi ye shes kyis sdom dgos pas de 'dren thabs rlung dang thig le'i rdzogs rim gang rung la brten pa'i thabs rdo rje'i lus kyi phyed bcing gis thabs byung dpe yi 'od gsal mngon sum rang rgyud la 'dren/ de'i rjes thob sgyu lus kyi lha skur ldang / de ni nyams rtogs gzhis ka'i nang tshan nyams dang dpe don gnyis ka'i nang tshan dpe go myong rtogs gsum gyi nang tshan myong ba yin/ de nas phyag rgya'i nyer rgyur brten nas rtogs pa don gyi 'od gsal drangs nas rjes thob slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skur ldang / gsar phyogs kyis sngags lugs la thabs lam 375

g.yu khog bla rma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkho nas drangs ba'i mngon sum ma gtogs grol lam gtan nas mi bzhed/ bde gshegs snying po drang don la bkral nas sa skyas kun gzhi dang / dge phyogs kyis yid rtog med la 'dod/ rnying mas tshogs brgyad sems byung dang bcas pa la 'khrul ba btag pa'i gzhi zhes dag byar 'dod/ gsar phyogs kyis mdo sngags kyi lta ba la khyad par med pa bzhed/ gal srid khyad zhig bton na phung po rnam dpyad kyi stong ba de dang gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba gnyis zung 'jug la lhan skyes kyi ye shes sam zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ye shes sam mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes su 'dod kyang / de ni lhan skyes min par glo bur ba/ 'gyur med min par 'gyur bcas gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba/ 'dus ma byas min par dbang po gnyis sbyor las byung ba'i 'dus byas yin no/ /rnying ma'i gsang ba snying po sogs thabs lam dbang btsan ltar bkral na gzhi gnas ye shes 'dod pa ma gtogs snga ma dang mthun no/ /gnyis pa rnying ma'i khyad chos grol lam ni/ dang po dbang bskur tshe dbang don gyi ye shes rtogs pa'am ma rtogs kyang chan la phab kyis theb pa ltar sgrib pa bral rung dang ye shes skye rung gi nus pa rgyud la 'jog de nas grol lam lta bas phye zhes snga 'gyur rnying ma'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gtan tshig gis lta ba dag mnyams chen po gtan la 'bebs pa yin pas/ de'i tshul la/ rtogs pa bzhi'i gtan tshigamanyam pa bzhi'i gtan tshig /dag pa gsum gyi gtan tshig sogs yod kyang /rtogs pa bzhi'i gtan tshig ni/ rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum pa/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad 376

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmangon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyu gcig pa'i gtan tshig gis rang bzhin skye med du gtan la phab/ yig 'bru'i tshul gyi gtan tshig gis rol pa 'gag med du gtan la phab/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtan tshig gis ngo bo dbyer med du gtan la phab/ mngon sum pa'i gtan tshig gis mtshan nyid mngon sum blo bral du gtan la phab pas/ rig pa chos sku dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med mngon sum rang rgyud la drangs nas myong nus/ gal srid ma myong kyang go ba rnam dag sngar nges pa 'dzin pa zer ba de 'ong / de nas man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba dang sems sde pra khrid sogs kyi man ngag gi lag khrid btab pas dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med chos sku chen po mngon sum du myong nus/ myong lta de'i steng nas lha bsgom pa snga 'gyur ba'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin/ de rtogs pa la na spar dgos pas de la sngon gyi mkhas pa thams cad kyib phyag rgyas mtshams sbyor dgos gsungs kyang / mkhas mchog mi pham gyis rang gi lta ba goms stobs dang mos gus kyi stobs gyis 'od gsal na 'phar 'gro/ phyag rgya mi dgos/ gal srid dgos na mdo'i sbyor lam pas phyag rgya ma bsten par mthong lam mi thob pa zhig khas len dgos gsungs/ dge mang rin po ches kyang / mos gus nyer rgyu'i spyod par bzhag gsungs/ don gyi 'od gsal rtogs tshe lha ma bsgoms kyang tha mal gyi snang grags rig gsum 'di spu ma brje mdog ma bsgyur blos ma bcos par lha sngags ye shes kyi go chod dgos/ gal srid thabs bskyed rim gyis snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi dkyil 'khor du blos bsgoms te rtsal sbyangs byas kyang chog gsung / sgyu 'phrul 'di kun mkhyen rong 377

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃklong gnyis kas a ti'i ma hā dang / bka' sde zur bas ma hā'i a tir bzhed/de ltar dbang dang rgyud bshad man ngag gang rung gis mngon sum ye shes myong thog tu khel ba'i gang zag gis lha bsgom pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'di ka'i steng du srog sdom gzer bzhi'i man ngag khrid shes dgos pas/ de ni srog sdom gzer bzhi'i dmigs pa'i gnad 'gags sogs nas/ rnam mkhyen rgya mtshor ro gcig shog ces pa'i bar rgyud gsum gyi nang tshan lam rgyud dang / lta sgom spyod gsum gyi nang tshan sgom pa bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi skabs 'dir rgyas par 'chad shes pa'i rten 'brel zhu lags/ srog sdom gzer bzhi'i gnad kyang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dang bcas pa'i srog dang / lha ye shes pa'i sku gsung thugs phrin las dang bcas pa'i srog gnyis lhan du sdom pa'i gzer bu lta bu ni ting nge 'dzin lha'i gzer sogs bzhi yin la/ de'ang gnas tshul ma dag par 'dod tshe de gnyis tha dad lta bur snang yang / gnas tshul dag par 'dod tshe don la rang gi sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pa gnas tshul la ye nas lha ye shes pa'i sku gsung thugs phrin las dang bcas par gnas rung / snang tshul ma dag pa'i ngor 'di na sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pa sku gsung thugs phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgrib byed kyi dri ma ltar shar yod pa yin pas/ srog sdom gzer bzhi'i man ngag 'dis/ snang tshul la sgrib pa ltar shar ba'i sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pa dag nas/ gnas tshul ye shes pa'i sku gsung thugs phrin dang bcas pa mngon du gyur dgos pa yin no/ /rgyas par bkral na rang gzhung ltar ro/ /gsum pa spyod pa spros bcas spros med kyis lta sgom bogs 'don tshul la/378

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃspyir thabs lam brtul zhugs gyi spyod pa dang / grol lam bag yod kyi spyod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sbyor sgrol sogs yin la/ de la nang gses kyis spros bcas spros med gnyis su dbye na/ dngos rigs las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa'am de yang rnying lugs ltar tshogs sgrub dang 'brel ba spros bcas dang / stong gzugs kyi lha mo sogs brten pa'am/ dngos rigs las kyi phyag rgya bsten kyang / gsar lugs ltar gcig pur spyod pa gshegs 'gro ba'i spros med kyi spyod pa yin no/ /'di gnyis kas bskyed rkyang dang mawo bcas kyi rdzogs rim gnyis bogs 'don dgos/ gnyis pa grol lam bag yod kyi spyod pa ni/ lta ba yas babs dang / spyod pa mas 'dzeg lta ba dpa' dgos/ spyod pa sdar dgos gsungs pa ltar/ lta ba dag mnyams chen po la goms rung lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor bar byas nas nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims byang sems gyi bslab pa sogs la legs par slob pa'o/ /'di ni grol lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sogs kyi bogs 'don yin no/ /des lam rgyud la smin grol gnyis dang grol byed gyi lta sgom spyod gsum dang bcas pa mdo tsam song / gsum pa gang du mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ ma hā yo ga'i sa lam rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhis bsgrod dgos pas/ 'di la 'dod tshul gnyis te/ bka' sde zur bas rig 'dzin bzhi ga 'phags pa slob lam kho nar bzhed pas/ mthong lam don gyi rtogs pa skyes tshe rtogs pa'i rtsal shugs chung ba dag gis rnam smin gyi phung po sbyang ma nus pa rnam smin rig 'dzin/ de tshe la mi dbang bar 'das dus 'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal gyi steng nas sa gnyis pa'i ye shes la na 'phar nas rjes 379

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthob phyag chen la ldang / rtogs pa rtsal shugs che bsarnam smin gyi phung po sbyangs nas 'od lus su gyur pa lam mchog yongs rdzogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang /sgom lam sa dgu la phyag chen rig 'dzin/ sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' la lhun grub rig 'dzin du bzhed/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ so skyes nas 'phags pa mi slob pa'i bar rig 'dzin bzhi bos bsdu ba yin pas/ dpe'i 'od gsal rgyud la skyes nas rjes thob sgyu lus kyi lha skur ldang ba rnam smin rig 'dzin/ sa dang po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes nas rjes thob slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ sa gnyis pa nas rgyun mtha' man phyag chen rig 'dzin/ mi slob pa'i 'bras bu dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas kha sbyor bdun ldan mngon du gyur pa lhun grub rig 'dzin du bzhed pa yin pas 'bras rgyud dngos ni kun mkhyen gyi lugs kyi lhun grub rig 'dzin 'di la ngos 'dzin dgos so/ /zhes pa 'di yang dpal mgon bla ma dam pas srog sdom gzer bzhi'i gnad 'gag nyin gcig la gsungs pa'i tshe rdo rje'i mched po rnams kyi bka' nan ma ldog pa dang rang gis kyang brjed du phangs nas zab gsang gdams pa'i gnad rnams zin ris su bri mdog byas pa yin rung me+ongs bdag sngon gyi sbyang 'phro zhan cing tshe 'dir thos bsam sgom gsum gyi skal bas dben pa'i stabs kyis tshig don thams cad log lam kho nar bkral yod snyam pas shes ldan dam pa rnam nas dpe ngan rgyun 'byams sogs gtan nas mi mdzad par cis kyang bskul lo/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /༈ bdag mdun tha dad cing 'aX/ pa gcig pa ni/ bdag dang mdun

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃganyis dbyer med pa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las bdag mdun gnyis me long gcig la gnyis shar gyi tshul cho ga gcig gi dus gcig tu bskyed pa de yin/bdag mdun tha mi dad cing 'jug pa gcig pa ni/ thog mar bdag dang mdun bskyed gnyis dbyer med pa stong par gyur ba'i ngang las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la bstod pa'i mjug tu rtsa sngags la phaṭaḥdza btags pa'i rkyen gyis dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa go sa logs su phye la me ri 'dab 'byor gyi tshul du bsgom pa ste/ de gnyis tha dad dang tha mi dad ces pa ni rnam pa tha dad dang tha mi dad la zer ba yin gyi ngo bo la zer ba min te/ de gnyis gang ltar byas kyang ngo bo dbyer med du bsgom dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'jug pa gcig ces pa cho ga gcig gis bskyed pa la bya'o/ /bdag mdun tha dad 'jug pa'ang tha dad ni/thog mar bdag bskyed rdzogs par byas nas/ gdod mdun bskyed rdzogs par bsgom pa ste go sla'o/ /de gnyis sngon du song nas gsal cha kun snang ting nge 'dzin/ gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de hūṃ las rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas/ snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul/ /rgyu la 'bras bu grub pa'i tshul/ /zhes/ bya rgyud rang lam nas mngon yebyaji lnga'i'abrasabuyesheldalngaṭ+wāṃ byang chub bo/ /nang rgyudamu kyi /ngon byang sgri pang ༵bye snru sdi+otrī ram̐kā snyidī lhod/ tre/ 'o ga/nya/sa 'bras bu tha dad ma yan / gdul 381

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃ༄༅/ /bskyed rim la sku mdog phyag mtshan nges can gsal dgos mi dgos sogs kyi dris lan skor/thugs dam skyabs yul dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bskyed rim sogs la sku mdog phyag mtshan nges nges dag dag can gsal dgos mi dgos dri ba mdzad pa'i lan du phul ba/ de yang spyi khyab ltar na dmigs pa rnon po ni rnal 'byor ba'i mtshon cha yin pas ji ltar gsal bzhin bzang bar bzhed pa dang / bye brag tu ni bka' gsar rnying gnyis kyang bzhed tshul cung mi mthun par yod de gsar ma'i lugs la ni/ dmigs pa'i rigs gang yang shin tu gsal ba spyan gyi dkar nag dang sku'i ba spu tshun chad gsal ba zhig med na bskyed rim gyi go mi chod par 'dod/ rnying ma'i lugs la ni lha sgom pa dang rang sems ma bcos gnas lugs skyong ba gnyis ka khyad med pa'i ngang nas/ lha sgom mkhan sems yin/ bsgom rgyu'i lha yang sems kyi rang mdangs yin/ lha'i dbyibs ma bsgoms par sems rang babs su rang ngo shes thog tu 'jog pa yang lha ye shes sems dpa' yang dag pa chos sku'i ngo bo yin/ de'i phyir tha mal rnam rtog 'khrul rjes 'brangs na ni bskyed rdzogs gang gi yang go mi chod/ 'khrul ba a 'thas kyi dbang du ma shor ba rig pa ngos zin na lha gsal kyang chog la ma gsal kyang chog ste/ gnas lugs kyi rang ngo la bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka ye nas zung 'jug tu lhun gyis grub pa yin/ lar yang 'gro ba kun gyi lus ngag yid 382

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasum dang phung po khams dang skye mched mtha' dag lha dang sngags kyi rang bzhin du gdod ma nas yin pa'i yin lugs ma shes pas 'khrul zhing 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin la/ de yin pa'i yin tshul ngo shes par bya ba'i thabs su smin byed kyi dbang bskur/ grol byed kyi bskyed rdzogs sgom pa yin mod kyi/ ye nas yin pa la yin par ngo shes nas bskyed pa de la bskyed rim zer ba yin gyi/ ma yin pa la yin par bsgoms kyang don mi 'grub ste/ dper na dngul la dngul du shes na dngul gyi don 'grub la/ sol nag zhig la dngul du bsgoms na don mi 'grub pa dang / yid bzhin nor la nor bur shes nas gsol ba btab na dngos grub 'byung gi/ rdo phal ba zhig la nor bur bsgom zhing gsol ba btab kyang dngos grub mi 'byung ba dang mtshungs so/ /dper na bskyed rim dang kha ton chos spyod sogs gang la yang lha yi dbyibs dang rnam 'gyur yid la shar thog tu sems ma yengs tsam gyi ngang nas kha ton bzlas brjod bya/ lha sku ma gsal na yang cis kyang gsal dgos snyam pa'i zhe 'dod dang 'dzin rtog bskyed mi dgos te/ don rig pa ma yengasapa'i ngang nas dge spyor gang yang byas pas chog /don dam par lha dam tshig ye shes sam chos sku dang gzugs sku zhes ming ci btags kyang don gyi ngo bo rang rig 'di las gzhan med de/ o rgyan chen pos/ rtags kyi sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /don gyi sangs rgyas chos sku gang yin pa/ /chos nyid rig pa mngon sum 'di yin pas/ /sangs rgyasagazhan nas ma 'tshol rje 'bangs rnams/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang / phyi rol gyi bla ma gzugs dbyibs su snang ba ni mchon byed dpe'i 383

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbla ma tsam yin mod kyi/ rang rig rang ngo shes pa ni mtshon bya don gyi bla ma chos sku dngos yin pas/ gtso bo rang rig ma yengs na bla ma dang 'du 'bral med pa yin te/ gling ras kyi zhal nas/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med la/ /gzugs skur 'dzin pa stor nas thal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / sku mdog phyag mtshan ma bsgoms kyang bla ma yid la dran tsam nas rang sems bla ma dang mjal tshar ba yin/ slar bzo bcos mi dgos/ yang bla ma sangs rgyas chosasku ye nas yin par thag mi chod par gdos bcas sha khrag gi skur bsgoms na log rtog yin/ byin rlabs mi 'byung / deng sang gi gang zag rnams bla ma la sangs rgyas su ma mthong bar mi'i 'du shes byas pa'i skyon gyis byin rlabs mi 'jug byin rlabs ma zhugs pas nyams len rgyud la mi skye/ de ma skyes pas grub pa thob dus med pa yin te/ 'bri gung skyob pa rin po ches/ bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na/ /ji ltar byas kyang blos byas yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma mi tha mal gyi 'du shes ma yin par sangs rgyas su thag chod dgos pas/ de'i phyir bla sgrub thams cad du bla ma rdo rje 'chang ngam pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs su bsgom tshul gsungs pa de yang tha mal gyi 'du shes spang phyir yin mod kyi/ don la rdo rje 'chang ngam pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang cha lugs ci ltar bur bstan kyang rang gi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid las gzhan ma yin par go dgos pa lags/ mig yul du 'char ba'i thig le'i rnam pa gya gyur 'char ba de la chos lugs gzhan dang phyag chen sogs las ni ma gsung la/ dus 'khor sbyor drug pa rnams stong gzugs kyi re kha nag po zhes zer/ rdzogs pa chen po'i snying 384

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ /thig rnams su ni 'di ye don dang nyams su len thabs kho na yin pa ste/ 'di yi ming rig gdangs rdo rje lu gu rgyud ces bya zhing / rang gi rig pa'i gdangs dbang po'i yul du 'char ba yin te/ dper na nyi ma yod sar chu phor ba gang bzhag na de'i 'od gdangs thog gi gdung mtshams la skya 'khyil le 'char zhing / chu phor bsgrul na de yang 'gul/ chu ma 'gul na de yang mi 'gul ba dang mtshungs/rgyud las/ rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /phra zhing rta rnga'i mdud pa 'dra/ /bar bar thig le yungs 'bru tsam/ /de yang 'gro 'ong dag dang bcas/ /lu gu rgyud kyi mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs/ rdzogs chen 'od gsal thod rgal gyi nyams len kun kyang gtso bo 'di brtan dgos/ 'dis ni rang rig 'di yengs shor ma shor gyi tshod bzung ba yin te/ sems ma yengs na kho yang lham mer sdod cing sems 'gyu na kho rang yang 'gro bas kho 'gro ba'i rjes su ma 'brang bar/ mig dang sems gnyis ka rang tshod bzung dgos pa yin/ rgyud seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku mthong bar 'dod na rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud la ltos shig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dang dbyer med par 'dod na rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang ma bral bar gyis shig ces sogs rgyas par gsungs yod pas 'gro 'dug spyod lam ci byed kyang rang tshod zin tsam la rgyun du 'bad pa ni nyams len thams cad kyi snying po yin pas thugs la bzhugs par zhu/ thugs dam skor gyi char spyir ni/ sgom phyogs kyi nyams len 'di la lan gcig bogs bskyed thon thub pa zhig dang / mtshan mo'i rmi lam dang 'od gsal sogs zin thub pa zhig byed rgyu yin na/ gnas skabs tshe 'di'i bya byed 385

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang gtan nas 'dres mi dgos par mi med lung stong kho na 'grim zhing dka' spyad dang smra bcad/ 'dag sbyar sogs la mi tshe gcig dril zhig thub na/ bogs skyed med thabs med la/ nged rang rnams lto gos dang bya byed gzhan dang bsgrags cing mi'i kha ya byed dgos mkhan la thugs dam kyi bogs dang rtsal thon pa nam yang dka' la/ 'on kyang dus dang rnam pa kun tu/ 'gro 'dug za nyal smra brjod sogs dang phyag bskor kha ton bzlas brngod ci dang ci byed pa'i skabs thams cad du/ rig pa'i rang ngo de nyid rjen cer re bar ngos zin pa zhig la gcig tu dril zhing / gnas sam/ 'gyu'am/ bde sdug bzang ngan la sogs gang dang gang ltar 'char yang / de tshe de la brtags dbyad dang rjes 'brang dgag sgrub sogs gtan nas mi bya bar/ de dag ngos zin mkhan gyi rig pa rjen pa kho rang la sgom gyi snying po bya zhing gal te rnam rtog 'og 'gyu la 'byams song na'ang / slar ngos zin tsa na/ zin pa de ka'i thog tu rang sar bzhag pa las/dgag sgrub gzhan mi dgos/ yengs song ba ma tshor ba lta bu byung na bying snyon yin pas rig pa gsal ngar bton/ yang gzhan gyi lab brjod sogs kyi rkyen gyis yengs song na dran rig shugs che ru btang nas rang tshod thub par bya/mdor na rig pa rang ngo shes rung gi ngang las bya byed thams cad ma brjed ma 'khrul ba zhig dgos/ de ma yin par bya byed dang smra brjod kyi skabs su dran rig bskur/ dran rig skyong dus bya byed gzhan mi lcogs na sgom de nam yang lhag mthong dngos kyi rang ngo ma mthong bar zhi gnas la song ba'i rtags yin la/lar phyag chen la sgom gyi dngos gzhi dran pa kho na la mdzad pa dang / rdzogs 386

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃl rig ma rig kho na la sgom yin min gyi so mtshams phye ba ste/ de gnyis kyi khyad par ni dran pa skyong ba de la bcos ma'i cung zad grim nyams gcig dgos shing yengs kyi dogs pas sems khral lta bu byed mkhan de ka rnam rtog yin/ rdzogs chen lugs kyi gang snang thams cad la dgag sgrub med pa'i ngang las shar ba ngo shes mkhan de la rang rig zer ba yin/ rang rig de dang ma bral ba gcig pus chog pa ma gtogs yengs kyi dogs pa'am/ dran pa ched du bzung mi dgos par rang ngo rig na rnam rtog thams cad sgom yin/ rang ngo ma rig na gnas pa brtan po 'khor yug tu song yang sgom min te/ nyams kyi bye brag tsam yin no/ /des na thugs dam gyi snying po ni rang rig rang ngo shes pa gcig pu la 'bad 'tshal zhing /bzlas brjod ni de snga phan chad gang mdzad yod na da rung yang de ka la dril ba legs te/ ye shes lha thams cad don la dbyer med yin tshe/ spang len 'dam kha mang po gtan nas mi dgos/ lha gcig 'grub na kun 'grub par mdo rgyud tham sa cad mthun par gsungs so/ /slad du'ang rang gi gegs sogs la slebs tshe yang / 'jig rten pa zhig yin na rim gro dang tshe sgrub sogs thabs gzhan dgos mod kyang / spyir chos pa dang khyad par sgom can la gegs dang sri ngan sogs kyis gzab cha'i rnam rtog lar nas mi skye ste/ nam yang 'chi ba ma gtogs 'gro sa med pa thag chod/ 'chi bar lo zla zhag re song bzhin thag nye ru 'gro bar ni shes/ shi ba ni gegs chung ste/ 'khor bar gtan 'khyams su gyur pa 'di la phan thabs dang thar thabs ni/ dge sbyor las lhag pa gang yang ma mchis pa la bsams nas/ do nub rang 'chi nad phog byung na'ang / thugs 387

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdam byed pa'i 'phro la 'chi thub na de ka yin/ gegs dang lo tshad sogs la ma ltos par na so rgan du song bzhin dge sbyor la brtson 'grus che ru btang ba la mi tshe 'khyol dgos pa ma gtogs/ sku rim dang thabs la re mi dgos pas de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu zhing / spyir yang deng sang gi chos pa dang bla ma'i rigs ban btsun rtogs ldan sogs las cher zhig tshe stod la dka' spyad dang snying rus mtshams sgrub bcad rgya/ dge sbyor dam bca' sogs dga' rab byas kyang / tshe smad rgas kha shi khar song bzhin tu de bskrur/ bskyar nas grong chog dang gzhan gyi mgo dpon byed cing / dkor zas la bag med du spyod pa dang / kha nas bdag dang po de 'dra byas pa yin te/ da ni rgas nas lus gnad mi khyag 'dug zer ba tsho rang gis rang bslus pa yin mod tshe phyi ma'i don bsgrub pa la gnad ma khyag zer ba de ni sems gnad ma khyag pa los yin/ chos kyi dka' ba spyad nas shi nus na/ tshe rabs thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag 'gro bas 'gyod rgyu ci yod/de lta bu'i gnad go mkhan deng sang gar yang dkon par snang bas des na rgyu mtshan 'di rnams snying gtam gyi gdams ngag zab shos yin pas dgongs pa'i dbyings su nan 'jog mkhyen mkhyen/ gzhan yang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsar 'jug pa thams cad kyang rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa khams chen mod kyang / deng sang gi chos pa thams cad sha chang la mi brten mkhan med tshul dang /khyad par shi gson kun gyi dge rtsa ci byed kyang srog gcod kho na byed dgos pa 'di 'dra dang / chang tshong la 'jug pa sogs dar ba 'di 'dra mdo rgyud thams cad nas bzang por ma gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mchod sbyin byed pa 388

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrnams kyi nang nas chang gi sbyin pa dang / sha'i sbyin pa dang / mtshon cha'i sbyin pa dang / dug gi spyin pa dang / gzhan gyi nar la rku phrag byas nas spyin pa byas pa rnams ni dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu kho nar gsungs pas/ des na dge rtsa che chung ci byed kyang srog gcod la sogs sdig pa dang 'dres mi dgos pa zhig rang gal che ba yin/ de 'drar thugs la 'jog par zhu/ thugs dam gyi cha thams cad la gzhan tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa rang babs kyi ngang nas/ gang shar thams cad rang ngo rig par bya ba 'di kho na la gcig dril mdzad pa dang / mtshan mo'i skabs sogs su rmi lam zin zhing rang dbang 'dug par byung na ni de yang rang rig gis slebs pa zhig gal che zhing / rmi lam ma zin na yang gnyid du 'gro khar rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rang ngo rig la gnyid du log nam sad sad la rang rig de nyid rang 'phro mthud/ nangs bar langs pa'i dus su thog mar yang rnam rtog phal bas mdun mi bsu bar rig pa ngo shes pa rang la 'bung bar bya/ 'di lta bu la rgyun du 'bad na 'chi khar yang bar do'i gdam pa'i gnad kyang 'di la 'dus shing / gnyid dang 'chi ba gnyis thim tshan che chung ma gtogs ga⑫/na gcig ste/ des na rnam rtog na tsha sdug bsngal 'chi ba sogs thams cad rig pas sleb pa rang mdzad par zhu/ sha chang sogs spang ba ni gal shin tu che/spyir gsang sngags la sha chang 'dod yon sogs mi spang bar bshad pa de ni rnal 'byor ba rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa lam du lhong thub pa rnams la dgongs pa yin te/ slob dpon pad+ma/ te lo pa dang / birla pa sogs nyin gcig la chang tshong lnga brgya'i chang thams cad bzhes nas chang rin la 389

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnyi ma btson du bzung ste bsring du bcug pa'i lo rgyus 'dra bar chang gis bzi ba la sogs nus pa'i skyon thams cad zil gyis gnon thub pa'i grub thob rnams ma gtog gang zag las dang po bas sha chang la bag med du spyod pa ni sngags kyi lhung ba phog par gsungs la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang dngos gtsang tshul ldan zhig byed pa po yang rnal 'byor pho mo grub pa thob pa sha rtag ma gtogs phal bas mi 'ong zhing / tshogs kyi yo byad kyang gser srang bco brgyad kyi rin thang yan chad ma gtogs de las zhan pas ni tshogs 'khor mi rung bar gsungs kyang / deng sang 'o skol rnams kyis 'grub pa'i yul ma yin te/ da lta cho ga dang dbang skur la sogs pa'i skabs su brda tsam byed pa 'di la ni tshogs kyi mchod pa zhes bya ba yin pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul ba'i lhag ma sgrub pa po rnams kyis dngos grub kyi rdzas tsam du blang ba yin te/ des na deng sang gi chos pa rnam kyi spyod 'gros dang bya byed gang sa ci thad nas mdo sngags kyi chos lugs gang dang yang mthun pa zhig bka' gsar rnying su la'ang mi rnyed par 'dug kyang go mkhan dkon pa dang / dge ba ci dang ci byed kyang srog bcad sogs sdig pa kho na la brten dgos pa 'di lta bu dang / gsang sngags la khag bkal nas rtsing spyod dang 'chol spyod dang chos min 'ba' zhig dar ba 'dis 'phral phug rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung ba'i rgyu kho nar 'dug pas/ des na rang nyid kyi chos khrim rang gis byas nas rang rgyud 'dul ba kho na gal che tshul dgongs par bcag par zhu/ bya ba thams cad lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul lta bu byung dus nyams len bogs 'don la gang kheb che gsungs pa de la/ spyir 'jig rten phal ba dang gang zag 390

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthun mong kun gyi snang ngor ni snang srid kyi lha 'dre phan gnod bzang ngan thams cad kun rdzob rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu med yin pas rgyu 'bras khyad du gsad mi rung / spyir lha 'dre gdon bgegs thams cad pha mar shes pa'i byams snying rje bsgom zhing / gsur bsngo dang sgyu lus mchod sbyin sogs kyis tshim par byas la gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i go 'phang thob phyir smon lam bzang po btab pa 'di ni shin tu zab cing dge tshogs che ba lags/ yang don dam pa'i ngo bor ni/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul tsam du ma zad snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems kho na'i cho 'phrul las ma 'das pas sems kyi 'khrul snang las gzhan pa'i 'dre gdon ni gang du'ang ma grub/ med pa la yod par mthong ba'i mthong mkhan dang tshor mkhan ni rang sems 'di nyid yin te/ dper na rmi lam gyi snang ba la skyid sdug legs nyes ci tsam mthong yang sems kyi snang ba tsam las mngon sum du ma 'grub pa dang mtshungs so/ /de'i phyir cho 'phrul dang 'jigs sgrags kyi rnam pa de yang rang gis nyam len snying por gang la dril ba de gas bogs 'don zhing lam du khyer dgos te/ rang nyid bla ma'i rnal 'byor la thag chod mkhan zhig yin phyin lha 'dre yang bla ma'i rnam rol yin pa'i mos gus bya/ rang nyid yi dam lha'i bskyed rim la blo 'gel mkhan zhig yin na snang grags thams cad lha dang sngags kyi rang bzhin yin pas lha 'dre yang yi dam gyi lha los yin snyam pas dag snang sbyang / rang nyid phyag rdzogs kyi lta sgom kho na'i nyam len gang la blo khel ba de dag bsres nas lam du khyer ba ma gtogs thabs gzhan 'tshol mi dgos pas thugs la bzhag par zhu/ dpon drung nyid 391

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthugs dam la nan tan mdzad pa shin tu rjes su yi rang shing / bsam gtan gyi ngang la gnas bzhin tu 'dug bsam mkhan de dran rig gi ngo bo yin la/gnas mkhan dang gnas lug bsam mkhan de gnyis min pas gcig rang yin kyang / re zhig dbye na gnas pa de nyams kyi bye brag yin zhing gnas 'dug bsam mkhan de sems kyi ngo bo dngos yin pas gtso bo de rang dgos rgyu yin/de bzhin du 'gyu dus kyang 'gyu ba de rnam rtog yin/ 'gyu 'dug snyam mkhan de dran pa sems kyi ngo bo yin pas de dgos rgyu yin/ dran pa'i rig pa thugs chung snyon gyis 'gyus pa ma gtogs dran thugs che dus 'gyu rgyu med/ don la kho rang gcig pu ma gtogs 'gyu mkhan dran mkhan tha dad gnyis med pa'i gnad kyis yin/ lab pa dang las ka byed dus dran rig hrig ger yod thog nas byed rgyu 'am/ lab rgyu de yang ma 'chug tsam dang / de la ha cang gi 'dzin pa ma zhugs par dran rig so mas tshi zin tsam gyi ngang nas smra brjod dang kha ton bzlas brngod sogs dang 'gro 'dug za 'thung thams cad bsre thub par byed pa de la sgru ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin zer te/ bya byed thams cad la de 'dra ma thub par lab brjod dang lag las sogs gang yin de la sems 'dzin cher byas nas dran rig de mi yong tshe 'jig rten tha mal pa dang khyad mi 'ong bas sgom gyi ming med/dran rig gsal rung gi ngang nas lab chog pa de la slar da tung dran pa 'dug go snyam mkhan zhig mi dgos te dran pa kho rang gis kho rang ngos zin shugs yod pa yin/ lar 'khor 'das gnyis kyi so mtshams de/ rang la rang gis rig ma rig 'di tsam gcig pus yin pas/ rang ngo ma rig pa yengs song ba de ni 392

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'akhrul ba yin mod/ rang ngo nam rig dus kyi sems de las lhag pa cig gang yang mi dgos pas/ gnas cha 'am bde gsal mi rtog sogs ci dang ci byed kyang nyams kyi bye brag tsam ma gtogs sems ngo dngos mthong ba min pas/nyams su len rgyu'i snying po ni rang rig rjen pa kho rang ma brjed tsam bskyang ba de yin no/ /gnyid du 'gro khar khyod rang la byung lugs de tsho 'byung ba thim rim gyi 'char tshul snang zhing / shi kha dang gnyid du 'gro kha gnyis thim tshad che chung ma gtogs phyogs 'dra tsam 'ong ba yin 'dug /gang ltar yang gnyid 'od gsal du 'gro thabs kyi gdams ngag rigs mi 'dra ba gsar rnying gi bka' so sor mang mod kyang gnad bsnun byed par thub dka' bas/ de bas da lta'i dran rig 'di rang la goms bcug pa dga' che bas na/ gnyid 'gro khar dran pa shugs ha cang che na gnyid mi 'ong /shugs chung na zin thub dka' bas/ gnyid du 'gro khar bsam blo gzhan mi gtang bar dran rig ma yengs tsam la bzhag /gnyid nam sad la dran pa 'phro mthud de 'bad na/ gnyid la ma zin yang sad pa'i 'phro la dran pa slebs na re zhig des chog /'od gsal thod rgal gyi nyam len tshul ldan byed na lag khrid zhib nan zhig med thabs ma mchis lags/ gtso bo ni 'ja' 'od thig le ci dang ci ltar shar ba thams cad rang rig pa'i rang mdangs kho na ma gtogs phyi nas tshur byung ba ma yin par thag chod dgos/ de ltar shar ba la dga' brod dang zhen 'dzin skye na go mi chod/ de yang zla 'od dang mar me sogs la blta tshul bshad kyang / gtso bo nyi ma shar ma thag dang nub kha gnyisakyi dus la blta ba rang 'phel skyed che zhing / nyi ma tsha dus ni mig la gzen te/393

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃcis kyang blta na snam bu rgya tshos ma dang dmar po gang rung mig la bkab nas blta dgos/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba la nam bltas kyang thugs dam dran rig ngos zin thog dang ma bral ba gal che zhing / 'ja' 'od lnga ldan dbyibs ma nges par gyen thur 'phred sogs gar yang 'char ba dang / 'od lnga'i thig le sbrel ma che chung sna tshogs su shar ba de dag dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma dang / thig le stong ba'i sgron ma yin la/ de'i nang dang bar mtshams gang du yang nges med du thig le nya mig 'dra ba mang po dang / mu tig gi phreng ba thag pa chad pa lta bu gya gyur 'gro 'ong byed pa de thams cad ni shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma rig pa kho rang gi mdangs 'char ba rdo rje lu gu rgyud yin pas na/ mig dang sems gnyis ka de la gtad cing yengs med 'dzin med du nyams su blang bar bya/ 'di'i skabs su gsar ma ba thams cad kyi 'ja' 'od kyi thig le de 'dra la rig pa gtad pa dang phyi rol sa rdo ri brag sogs la gtad pa dang khyad par mi 'ong ste/zhakhrul na zhakhrul mnyam dang / grol na grol mnyam yin zer mod kyang / de gnyis mi 'dra ste phyi yi snang yul 'di ni bag chags 'khrul ba'i las snang yin zhing / 'od gsal gyi 'char sgo 'di ka rang rig pa ye shes kyi 'char sgo'i rang mdangs yin pas gtan nas mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas pa rdzogs chen rnams su 'byung ba ltar ro/ /mdor na nyams su len rgyu'i chos thams cad kyi snying po ni khregs chod rang rig kho na la dril ba mdzad par zhu/ thugs dam gyi ngo bo la/ bka' gsar rnying dang phyag rdzogs sogs ming bzang bzang mang po dang zab zab yin yin ci tsam brjod kyang don dam pa'i snying po la da lta'i sems mi 394

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbyed dgu byed 'di kho rang gang dran gang shar la rig pa ngos zin tsam byed pa las lhag pa gang yang bya rgyu med/ gnas pa skyong mi skyong zhes zer srol 'dug kyang de ni dang po zhi gnas sbyang dus kyi skad cha yin/ sgom dngos gzhi la gnas pa gcig pu dgos pa ma yin te/ gnas 'gyu gang byung thams cad la dran rig ngos zin na thams cad sgom yin/ mnyam bzhag yin/ rig pa rang ngo ma shes na ni/ gnas kyang sgom min la/ 'gyu yang snom min/ mdor na sgom zhes bya ba ni da lta'i rang sems hrig ge ba 'di ngos zin pa de la sgom gyi ngo bo yang zer/mnyam bzhag kyang zer/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa la sogs ming ci btags kyang 'di las gzhan med/ sems 'phro ma bcug par gnas pa kho na la sgom du zhen na blos byas kyi sgom yin/ rang ngo ma rig par sems yun ring por mi 'phro bar gnas kyang nyams tsam yin/ 'phro ba rnam rtog yin/ de gnyis kas sgom gyi go mi chod/ 'gag don la rnam rtog dug lnga zhabrul ba'i bye brag ci dang ci shar byung yang / de spang ba dang bkag pa 'i rtsol ba yang mi bya/ de'i ro myangs ba'i rjes la phar yang mi 'brang / kho rang bdag med du bskyur ba gcig pus chog /rang rig rjen pa hrig ge ba 'di 'gro 'dug za nyal thams cad du ma brjed na gzhan pa'i sgom rgyu gang yang mi dgos/ yi dam gyi lha dngos su bkra lam mer mardzal yang rang sems kyi 'char snang tsam yin/ de la phar skyabs mchi mi dgos rang rig pas chog /bdud bgegs bye ba dung phyur gyi dmag byung nas rang nyid sha dum khrag 'thor du btang byung yang rang snang yin pas zhed mi dgos/ don dam pa la/'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi snang ba min pa ni gang yang med pas gang 395

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃla'ang bden 'dzin med pa gal che/ de'i ngang nas sems kyi rtsal mdangs 'gag med kyi 'char sgo kun rdzob kyi rang gzugs rmi lam lta bu 'di khyad du mi gsad par las rgyu 'bras kyi zhib cha/ spros bcas kyi dge sbyor/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang / yul gong ma la mos gus/ 'og ma la snying rje/ bar ma la dag snang sogs mi spang / sgo gsum chos dang mthun par bya/ sems stong pa nyid kyi gnas tshul go yang 'khrul ba'i bag chags ma zad bar la tshig legs nyes kyi gtam tsam yang mi khyag cing / tsher ma zug pa'am me stag phog pa tsam yang mi bzod pa lags/ stong skad tho co byed pa ma yin par/ rang rgyud rang gis btul/ skyid sdug ci byung yang bla ma dkon mchog gsum la blo ling bskyur bya/ rtag tu dman sa bzung zhing dag snang sbyang / tshe 'di blos btang nas ri khrod du mi tshe 'khyol bas bla ma'i sku drin dang mkha' mnyam gyi pha ma'i drin chos kyis 'khor ba yin pas thugs bzhag zhu/ bdag rgan po'i kha chem snying gtams yin no thugs la stims/ thugs dam gyi cha thams cad la sngar zhus pa ltar las lhag pa med kyang gtso bor phyag rdzogs gang la'ang nyin snang gi rang rig bcos min 'di ga yengs med 'dzin med du skyong ba kho na gcig dril mdzad pa dang / gnyid dang 'chi kha bar do sogs nam gyi tshe yang gdams pa sna kha mang po mi dgos par ma bcos chos sku 'di ga rang gis chog cing zab par 'dug pas/ 'gro 'dug za nyal gnyid sogs kun la 'di dmar 'jus gnang na legs sam snyam 'dug pas dgongs 'jugs 'tshal/ dal 'byor don yod 'dod pa rnams nas dam pa'i chos kho na la brtson zhing skyid sdug legs nyes na tsha sdug bsngal rkyen 396

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃngan gang byung yang sgrib sbyang dang byin rlabs su shes nas gsol 'debs la 'bad cing bla ma rang sems dbyer med sku gsum gdod nas lhun grub ye nas yin par shes pas ma yengs tsam du ma 'khyul tsam gsal le hrig ge gu yangs khrol le ba'i ngang nas dge sbyor rnams dang zung 'jug mdzad par zhu/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad kyi thugs rje nus stobs dang / chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i rten 'brel gyi 'jug sgo mtha' yas pa'i bden nus pa'i stobs kyis zab chos 'di'i bka' lung gtad yongs su rdzogs pa dus 'dir thob par gyur cig 'di'i tshig don ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa rgyud la 'dres shing nyams len mngon du gyur nas tshe 'di nyid la rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub cing nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god nus par shog cig kā ya sirnyi ā+oX waska sirnyi āḥtsit+ta sirnyi hūṃX sarba sirnyi hrīX 'gag don la da lta'i rnam rtog 'gyu dran 'di ka la gsal ba zer ba yin/ 'di ga rang gis rig tsam dran tsam byed mkhan de la dran pa yang zer/rang rig kyang zer/ mnyam bzhag kyang zer/ lhag mthong yang zer ba ste chos lugs thams cad kyi dgongs pa mthun par sgom nyams su len rgyu 'di rang gis chog pa yin pas/ 'di las lhag pa'i sgom gnas cha'i bde gsal mi rtog sogs ci lta bu bsgrubs kyang bcos ma kho na yin pas ma bcos tha ma/la gyi shes pa bzo med du mi 'gro zhing / sgom skyon med du mi 'gyur bas des na gnad gcig pu la nges shes 'drong thag chod zhig dgos lags pas dgongs 'tshal/397

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlha dang dkyil 'khor sngags dang 'od zer spro bsdu sogs mtha' dag kyang don de nyid sgoms mkhan bsgom rgyu snom pa sogs sems las gzhan med pas sems kyi ngo bo stong pa rdzogs rim/ gsal cha lhar snang ba bskyed rim/ de gnyis sems gcig pur tshang phyir bskyed rdzogs dbyer med yin te/ 'di skabs kyi go don gsal bar shes dgos so/ /deng sang bskyed rim pa phal mo che rnams ni kun rtog blo byas kyi bskyed rim ma gtogs/ bskyed rdzogs dbyer med la blo khel mkhan cher ma mthong / yang kun gyi sems dang rang sems bsre ba gang yin snyam na/ spyir yang / bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /gsungs pa de yang mi re re la dum bu bgos nas yod pa lta bu ma yin te/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs/ sems can thams cad kyi sems/ snang grags thams cad kyi rang tshul mtha' dag rgyar ma chad phyogs su ma lhung pa/ ye gdod ma nas rang bzhin chos kyi skur kun la rtag khyab lhun grub phyogs ris bral ba'i thig le nyag gcig yin kyang rig ma rig dang / rtogs ma rtogs/zhakhrul ma zhabrul kho na'i khyad par du gyur pa yin la/ da lta lam nyams len gyi skabs su yang gong ma tshor yang bshad pa ltar bdag dang sems can tha dad du ma grub kyang snang tshul tha dad ltar snang ba tsam yin pa'i tshul rtogs na sems can gyi sems dang rang gi sems slar bsre rgyu zhig ma grub ste/ ye nas 'dres pa yin la/ 'on kyang las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor dag gis ni/ sems kyi rtsal sbyong ngam 'gag med kyi rol rtsal sgyu 'phrul tsam du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang / sems can thams cad la byams snying rje sems bskyed dang / las 'bras 398
yid ches sogs bskyed pa gal che/ dpal sprul rin po che'i zhal

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ sgo//stong thun seng ge'i nga tsho nyer mkhi bar ldeb phyogs bsdus/ldeb gnyis pa'i rgyab/lung gi tshad ma dang yid ches rjes dpag don gcig yin pa bzhin du lung tshad ma dang /dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung gnyis don gcig yin la/de la mthong ba mngon gyur la mngon sum tshad mas mi gnod pa dang /mi mthong ba skog gyur la rjes dpag tshad mas mi gnod pa dang /shin tu skog gyur la lung snga phyi dang mi 'gal ba dang gsum las/dang po/brgyad stong ba lta bu'i lung des 'di ni gzugs so zhes sogs mngon gyur bstan pa'i don de nyid rang gis mngon sum gyis de ltar yin min dpyad nas de ltar yin pa la tshad mas gnod pa med pa dang /gnyis pa/sgra mi rtag pa'o zhes sogs skog gyur bstan pa'i don de nyid de ltar yin min dngos stobs rjes dpag gis dpyad nas de ltar yin pa la gnod pa med pa dang /gsum pa/spyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde zhes pa la sogs pa'i shin tu skog gyur bstan pa'i don de nyid la lung rang gis dngos bstan shugs bstan dang gong 'og 'gal mi 'gal brtags nas 'gal ba'i gnod pa med par mthong ba'i lung de lung tshad ma dang dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lung tshad ma'i mtshan gzhi ni sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu'o//༈thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab/bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab/bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab/thos pa 400
