g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'achad nyan bya ba dang / bsam pa la rigs pa bzhi'i sgo nas legs par dpyad par bya ba ste/ de yang rigs pa bzhi ni/ bya ba byed pa'i rigs pa/ ltos pa'i rigs pa/ chos nyid kyi rigs pa/ 'thad pa sgrub pa'i rigasapa dang bzhi'o/ /de yang kun rdzob tu rgyu 'bras ngo bo nyid gsum ji lta bar rtogs pa dang / don dam par de gsum rang bzhin med pa'i rnam thar gsum gyi bdag nyid du shes dgos la/ de ltar rgyu 'bras ngo bo nyid gsum du bzhag pa de ni tha snyad dpyod pa'i skabs kyi rig pa gsum yin la/ don dam par ni rdo rje gzeg ma'i gtan drigs kyis dpyad na rgyu gang gis 'bras bu gang bskyed pa mi dmigs la/ yod med skye 'gog gis dpyad na 'bras bu rnams rgyu la ltos te skye ba yang med cing /gcig du bral sogs kyi rigs pas dpyad na/ sra ba la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid gang yang mi 'grub pas/ rgyu mtshan ma med pa/ 'bras bu smon pa med pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid de rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin du gnas pa ni don dam pa'i chos nyid do/ /'thad sgrub la mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis/ mngon sum la don dam mngon sum/ kun rdzob mngon sum/ rjes dang ga la'ang / kun rdzob pa rjes su dpag pa/ don dam pa rjes su dpag pa ste gnyis/ mthar bden gnyis gh+ridze+ekā trom̐/da /so so rang rig pa'i spyod yul chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa na mthar ༈ ldeb gsum pa'i skabs/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa ye shes snang ba rnam 'byed las/ de yang rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags pa thogs med kyis mi lo bcu gnyis su rje btsun byams pa bsgrubs 401

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i mthar zhal mngon sum du bstan nas dga' ldan lha'i gnas su khrid de/rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos rgyan gnyis 'byed gnyis rgyud bla ma ste chos lnga bstan pa 'di la/ mkhas pa kha cig gis lnga ga bstan bcos dkyus gcig gi tshul du bzhed la/ yang kha cig gis theg gsum dang theg gcig nges don du bshad pa sogs mthar thug gi bstan bya mi mthun pas bstan bcos kyi lus gcig tu 'dod pa de bkag nas/ rang lugs bka' so so'i dgongs 'grel du bzhed la/ de la yang thog mtha' gnyis dbu ma dang / bar ma gsum sems tsam gyi dgongs 'grel du bzhed pa dang / mdo rgyan kho na sems tsam gyi gzhung dang / gzhan bzhi dbu mar bzhed pa dang /mngon rtogs rgyan dbu ma dang / gzhan bzhi sems tsam du bzhed pa dang / yang kha cig gis lnga ga sems tsam gyi dgongs par gnas pa dang / yang lnga ga dbu ma'i dgongs par gnas par bzhed pa sogs yod kyang / don la mngon rtogs rgyan ni bka' bar pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs 'grel dang /rgyud bla ma zhakhor lo tha ma'i nges don bde gshegs snying po bstan pa'i mdo rnams kyi dgongs 'grel du rtsod pa med par grub cing / de gnyis kas mthar thug rigs gcig dang theg pa gcig tu 'dod la dbu ma'i don du dgongs pa mthun pa nyid do/ /mdo sde rgyan ni snga ma de gnyis kyis bshad bya'i mdo las gzhan pa'i mdo sde phal mo che'i don phyogs gcig bsdebs pa'i dgongs 'grel yin la/ der rigs dang theg pa gcig tu ma nges par bstan pa sogs phal cher sems tsam gyi mdo sde'i dgongs pa gtso bor 'grel par gsal lo/ /402

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'abyed gnyis po 'di ni theg pa spyi yi rgya che ba dang zab mo'i phyogs ston par byed pa ste/ 'di dag tu rang bzhin gsum dang phyi don ma grub pa'i tshul rgya cher bstan kyang de tsam zhig gis sems tsam pa'i gzhung kho nar 'gyur ba'i nges pa med de/dbu ma'i dgongs pa yang chos skad de dag gi tshul gyis bzhag pa tsam la 'gal ba med pa ni/ lang gshegs las/ chos lnga rang bzhin gsum dang ni/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad dang / /bdag med don gyi rnam gnyis por/ /theg chen mtha' dag bsdus pa yin/ /zhes chos skad 'di dag theg chen mtha' dag gi spyi sdom du gsungs pa dang / yum gyi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i mdo byams zhus na yang ngo bo nyid gsum gyi chos skad 'di dag bstan pa sogs kyis dngos su gsal la/ sems tsam pa'i 'dod gzhung bzhin gnyis stong gi shes pa bden grub tu mi 'dod pa'i 'os med kyi tshig zin dang rigs pa gang yang mi snang bas na/ phyogs su ma lhung bar theg pa spyi yi dgongs 'grel du bshad pa la nyes pa ci yang med par ma zad gzhung gi bab de ltar gnas pas na/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed 'di theg pa gsum gyi lam rgya che ba'i rnam bzhag ston pa'i gzhung dang / chos nyid rnam 'byed 'di bden gnyis zung 'jug dbu ma rnal 'byor spyod pa'i tshul dang mthun par/ zab mo'i mdo sde kun gyi brjod bya'i snying po rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gtan la 'beb pa'i gzhung yin la/ de'i phyir shin tu zab pas na 'di dang rgyud bla gnyis bka' rgya dam pa'i tshul gyis rgya gar du'ang phyis su dpe rgyun ma byung ba'i tshe/ mnga' bdag mai tri pas mchod rten zhig gi ser ka nas 'od byung ba gzigs pa de nas chos nyid rnam 'byed dang rgyud bla 403

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃm gnyis kyi dpe byung ste slar 'phel ba yin pas/ zha ma lo tsā ba seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi dpe 'di 'gyur zhus mdzad pa'i tshe/ paṇ+ḍi tas shog ldeb re re bzhin gnang nas 'di chud ma zos par gyis/ des bka' dam pas rgyun dkon phyir 'di med song na rje btsun byams pa 'dzam bu'i gling du sku mya ngan las 'das pa yin no zhes gtsigs su mdzad par gsungs pa ltar/lta ba'i nges gsang ston pa'i zab don yin pas theg pa chen po ba kun gyis lta ba 'di ltar rtogs dgos pas dbu sems su yi lugs su bkral kyang mi rung ba med mod/ dper na sher phyin gyi mdo sde la dbu sems kyi slob dpon rnams kyis so so rang rang gi bzhed gzhung du bkral kyang gzhung de'i dgongs pa mthar thug dbu mar gnas pa ltar/ gzhung 'di yang sems tsam gyi lta ba ston pa'i bstan bcos su bzhed mkhan yang / rang blo'i rtsal dang sbyar te de ltar bshad kyang 'gal ba med la/ 'on kyang don du gzhud 'dis theg pa chen po'i zab don mthar thug pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyid ci lta bu yin pa gsal bar ston pas na/ zab mo'i mdo sde mtha' dag gi spyi 'grel du 'gro zhing / kun rdzob chos can gyi 'dod tshul sems tsam dang mthun la/ don dam chos nyid kyi 'dod tshul dbu ma dang mthun pas mthar thug gi dgongs pa dbu mar gnas shing dbu sems zung 'jug gi tshul gyis theg pa chen po'i lta ba'i gnad ston pa'i tshul du go zhing bshad na bstan bcos chen po'i dgongs pa gting phyin par bshad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈bod snga rabasapa zhes pa'i skabs/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po rngog po bya ba de'i brgyud pa/ yar 'brog do'i phyi rol gyi 404

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmatsho chen po'i 'gram du grong chags pa'i sngags rnying ma ba'i dge bshes rdo rje gzhon nu zhes bya ba la sras lnga byung ba'i/ che ba rngog legs pa'i shes rab/gnyis pa klu khri/ gsum pa klu byang / bzhi pa chos skyabs/ lnga ba thub pa de+o rje rnams las/ rngog legs shes kyi dbon po rngog lo chen po de ni/ chos skyabs kyi sras su sa mo phag gi lo la 'khrungs/ de nas lo bco brgyad song ba na kha cher byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta sadz+dza na dang / ba ra he ta bha tra la sogs pa drug tsam bsten/ kha cher lo bcu bdun sbyangs pa mdzad nas chu pho spre'u sum cu rtsa lnga pa la slar bod du byon/ bod du yang paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang su ma ti kirtiX sogs la chos mang du gsan/ 'di yis 'gyur mdzad pa'i tshad ni gro lung pas/ dam chos bsgrur la mnga' brnyes pas/ /rgyal yum gnyis dang bstan bcos gzhung / /'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gsum/ /stong phrag bdun cu lhag bcas bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs pa de'o/ de la slob ma'i tshogs mtha' yas pa yod mod/sras kyi thu bo bzhi ni/ gsung rab kun la mkhas pa gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ phar phyin la mkhas pa 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar/ dbum la mkhas pa khyung rin chen grags/ dngos kyi gdan sa pa zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma dang bzhi'o/ /gro lung ba'i sras kyi thu bo bzhi ni/ zur chos pa sku 'bum gyi shar du phywa bas tshad ma/ lhor rgya mching ru bas byams chos/ nub tu rin tshul gyis mngon pa/byang du yon tan shes rab kyis 'dul ba 'chad do/ /gzhan yang tshad ma la mkhas pa gangs pa sher+sā de rnams kyi slob brgyud mkhas pa gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu rim par byon pa rnams kyis bshad grwa mang du btsugs te bod 405

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyul rig pa'i 'byung gnas gsang phu ne+e'u thog ces yongs su grags pa'o/ /gangs pa she'u dang / khyung ri gnyis kyi slob ma stod lung rgya dmar ba byang chub grags pa yin no/ /'bre sher gyi sras kyi thu bo ar byang chub ye shes so/ /gro lung pa sogs kyi slob ma phywa pa chos kyi seng ge la/ slob ma seng chen brgyad/ jo sras bzhi/ shes rab can bzhi'o/ /seng chen brgyad ni/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge/ dan phag pa smra ba'i seng ge/ bru sha bsod nams seng ge/ me bya rtsod pa'i seng ge/ rtsags dbang phyug seng ge/ myang bran chos kyi seng ge/ ldan ma dkon mchog seng ge/ gnyal po yon tan seng ge'o/ /kha cig gtsang pa 'jam dpal seng ge'ang zer/ jo sras bzhi ni/ 'khon jo sras rtse mo/rngog jo sras ra mo/ khu jo sras ne tso/ gnyos jo sras dpal ye'o/ /shes rab can bzhi ni/'gar dbang grub/ kong po 'jag chung / lho pa sgog zan/ par bu ba dang bzhi'o//phywa bas tshad ma bsdus pa la sogs mdzad de klog pa ba rnams kyi bsdus pa zhes pa'ang 'di nas dar ro/ /gtsang nag pa dang rma bya pa phal cher ma gtogs pas rang rgyud pa'i srol bzung / gzhan yang game pa dus mkhyen dang / phag gru rdo rje rgyal po gnyis kyis/ rgya dmar ba dang / phywa pa chos kyi seng ge la chos gsan pa dang / sa chen kun dga' snying pos/ khyung rin grags pa las dbu tshad gsan/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/ phywa pa chos seng las dbu ma/ sa paṇa gyis/ me bya byang brtson dang / tshur ston gzhon seng las tshad ma/ rtsegs pa dbang phyug seng ge las grub mtha' gsan/ thal 'gyur ba lo tsā ba ba tshab nyi ma grags pa ni/ 'phan yul na ba tshab stod smad gnyis yod pa'i stod pa yin/ kha 406

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃcher byon te sadz+dza na'i sras gnyis sogs paṇ+ḍi ta mang po la chos gsan te lo nyi shu rtsa gsum du sbyang ba mdzad nas bod du rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs kyi 'grel ba zla bas mdzad pa'i rigs rnams bsgyur/ 'phan yul du phebs/ dbu ma'i 'chad nyan legs par btsugs/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i gzhud lugs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi lam srol chen po phyes shing / gangs can ljongs kyi dbu ma thal 'gyur smra ba thams cad de las gyes/ slob ma rnams kyi nang nas/gtsang pa sar sbos/ me byang chub ye shes/ dar yon tan grags/ dzig la mkhas pa gangs pa shelnga don la mkhas pa gtsang pa 'bre skur/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa me bya byang brtson/ gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa zhang thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas rnams la ba tshab kyi bu bzhi zhes grags/ de rnams la brten nas dbus gtsang du dbu ma'i bshad pa dar ba'o/ /phywa pa'i slob ma rma bya byang brtson gyis ba tshab la dbu ma sogs gsan/ shad thang sag pas ni/ thang sag btab nas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan legs par mdzad do/ /༈ldeb bzhispu'i skabs/don rnam par nges pa shes rab ral gri las/ /dngos por dmigs dang dngos med dmigs/ /gnyis su dmigs dang gnyis min dmigs/ /ji ltar dmigs kyang dmigs pa ste/ /dmigs pas gang bzung bdud kyi ni/ /spyod yul yin zhes mdo las gsungs/ /zhes/ dngos por dmigs pa dang / de bkag pa'i dngos med du dmigs pa dang / dngos po dngos med gnyis su dmigs pa dang / gnyis ka min par dmigs pa sogs ji ltar dmigs kyang sems kyis g.yo ba yod pas dmigs pa ste/ dmigs 407

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpas dngos med dang dngos po sogs gang zhig bzung yang bdud kyi ni spyod yul yin zhes 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo dang / laṅkar gshegs pa'i mdo sogs las gsungs so// ༈ glog sgron las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dbang gis byung ba'i kun byang gi chos thams cad ma brtags nyams dga' tsam du snang yang / don dam par rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pas/ gang snang ba'i gzugs sogs chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pas gzugs stong pa dang /gnas skabs rten 'brel gyi snang ba ma 'gag par shar bas stong pa nyid gzugs dang / snang tsam nyid na ngo bo stong nyid las ma g.yos pas gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin pa dang / ngo bo stong nyid las ma g.yos pas gzugs sogs su snang bas stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin pa ste stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi dgongs pa/ 'phags pa klus/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /so so'i char ni shes gyur te/ /gang du yang dag 'dresagyur pa/ /zung du 'jug par de bshad do/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ mi pham rin po ches/ mnyam pa nyid la nges pa rim gyis skye ba'i dbang du na/ las dang po pas gcig du bral sogs stong nyid sgrub pa'i rigs pa rnams kyis tshul bzhin brtags tshe/ bum sogs ma grub pa'i don la bsams nas/ ma dpyad pa'i ngor yod kyang dpyad na mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ ma grub pa nyid gnas lugs so snyam pas snang stong res 'jog gi tshul du stong pa'i rnam pa zhig 'char zhing / de'i tshe de'i med pa nyid kyang btags pa tsam las don la ma grub pa'am/ ye nas stong bzhin du snang ba yin pa'i tshul la bsams pas chu zla ltar snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang 408

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃba'i nges pa khyad par can skye ste/ de'i tshe rang bzhin med pa dang rten 'byung 'gal med du shar ba'am zung 'jug tu go ba zhes bya zhing / de dus rang bzhin med pa dang rten 'byung de gnyis tshig gi brjod tshul la tha dad yod kyang ngo bo la tha dad cung zad med par dbyer med pa'i tshul la nges shes bskyed pas dgag gzhi snang ba dang dgag bya bcad pa sbyar nas 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rang sar zhig ste/ dgag sgrub bsal bzhag med par sor bzhag tu nus pa lta bu'i spros bral gyi rnam par 'char zhing / de 'dra'i spros bral la yang nas yang du goms pas/chos can re re ba la ltos pa'i chos nyid so so lta bu'i blo ris chad kyi dmigs pa'i spyod yul gnyis chos kyi rnam pa thams cad dag nas chos thams cad rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid la nges shes khyad par can skye bas mthar phyin to/ /de ltar stong pa dang / zung 'jug dang / spros bral dang / mnyam pa nyid de de bzhi po snga ma snga ma shes pa la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma'i tshul la 'jug gi/ snga ma la nges pa ma rnyed bar du phyi ma gtan la phebs pa mi 'byung ngo / /des na rnam grangs pa'i don dam bden med rkyang pa tsam la gnas lugs so snyam du blo rtse gtad pas ni skabs 'di'i mnyam pa nyid kyi phyogs tsam du yang mi phyin te/ bden grub bcad tsam gyi ldog pa ka ba dang bum pa sogs kyi steng na so sor yod par go ba tsam zhig gis/ chos thams cad la blang dor dang mtshan ma'i 'du shes gzhig pa mnyam pa nyid kyi bya ba byed mi nus te/ dmangs kyis rgyal po'i bya ba byed mi nus pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/༈ldeb bdun pa'i skabs/ rgyud bla'i /༷na 'grel mi pham zhal lung las/ ji

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃltar sngar 'khor bar gnas tshe ji lta yin pa bzhin phyis myang 'das na yang de bzhin du rtag tu rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid can du 'dod do / /zhes dang / ༈ sems skyu rang bzhin 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gang yi na pa de ni nam mkha' du sprin sogs kyis mi 'gyur ba bzhin du 'gyur ba med de yang dag min rtog tshul bzhin yid byed las byung ba'i 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs/ rin chen phreng ba las/dang po brgyad pa dgu nyon mongs/ /gnyisadang bcu pa las yin te/ /lhag ma rnams ni sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa glo bur gyi dri mas chos nyid de nyon mongs par mi 'gyur te rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / ༈ rang dang ngo bo nyid kyis rnam dbye med pa'i 'bral mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid can stobs sogs yon tan bla na med pa'i chos kyis stong pa ma yin te gdod nas ldan pas gsar du bzhag mi dgos pas nyi ma dang zer bzhin no/ /zhes dang / ༈ rgyud bla'i dogs bshad las/ 'o na khyi phag sogs sems can rnams kyi sems kyi rgyud la stobs bcu'i ye shes yod dam zer na/ stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi yon tan de'i rgyud kyi gshegs snying la ye nas yod do/ /kho rang gi chos nyid kyi yon tan yin pas khams yod na yon tan yod mod kyi mngon du mi 'gyur te/ ral gri la gcod pa'i bya ba yod kyang / shub tu chud pa la gcod pa'i bya ba mngon gyur du med pa dang / me long la gzugs brnyan 'char rung gi yon tan yod kyang sgrom du bcug pa la mngon gyur du mi 'char ba dang 'dra ste/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i rgyud la yod pa'i sgrib pas 410

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkhams kyi yon tan mngon du mi snang ste/ der ma zad de'i rang sems kyi chos nyid rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yod kyang mngon du mi 'gyur na yon tan ci la mngon/ de'i phyir mngon gyur du med pa 'di la bsams nas/ stobs bcu skye rung gi rgyu tsam yod kyi dngos su med zer ba yod pa'ang dpyad tshul de'i dbang du de ltar rung mod/ skye rung gi rgyu de 'dus byas sems kyi yin na sems yin tshad stobs bcu skyed rung du sgrub dka' la/ sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas sbyangs stobs kyis sems nyid rang gis byed pa yin na/ 'di 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings kyi yon tan yin pas/ smin pa'i rgyu ru mi rung ngo / /'di lta bu'i khams de sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gtsug sems gsungs pa de yin/ de nam yang rgyun chad pa med la ngo bo stong pas dmigs mtshan gang yang med kyang / stong rkyang min te mtshan ma med pa'i rang 'od gsal ba yin/ sgrib pa ma zad pa'i sems rgyud kyi gshegs snying la stobs bcu'i ye shes mngon gyur du med pa ni bdag cag kyang 'dod mod/ bla med chos kyi yon tan dbyings de la med pa min kyang /mngon du mi 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /khams rang gi ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ye ldan min na/ de 'dra'i khams de yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi rigs su mi 'grub ste/ stong rkyang bzhin no/ /des na chos dbyings 'od gsal lam/ rang byung ye shes sam/ gzhug sems 'od gsal lam/ bde gshegs snying po zhes pa rnams don gcig te/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin te/ sgrib bcas kyi rgyud la yod tshe sangs rgya rung gi rigs dang / sangs rgyas tshe mngon gyur yin/ sangs rgya rung yin yang 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid la snga phyi'i khyad 411

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpar gnas tshul la med de ngo bo 'gyur med yin pas so/ /snang tshul la gnas gyur pa'i tha snyad brjod rung ngo / /de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod par bstan pas nyes pa lnga spangs nas bla med byang chub la phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /nyes pa lnga po gshegs snying sems can thams cad la yod par ma thos pa las 'byung / mthar thug theg gcig 'grub pa'i gnad 'di yin la/rdo rje theg par sems nyid ye sangs rgyas pa'i gnad kyang 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs/༈ rngog lo dang / gtsang nag pas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba don dam pa'i bden pa la zer mod kyi/ don dam pa'i bden pa ni sgra dang rtog pa'i dngos kyi yul ma yin pa lta zhog /zhen pa'i yul tsam yang ma yin zhes gsungs/ phywa pas ni/ dngos po rnams bden pas stong pa'i med par dgag pa ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin zhing / de sgra rtog gi zhen pa'i yul du yang bzhed/btsan lugs pa rnams ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po yin pas/ de sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yang grung por bzhed/ rje btsun re mda' bas/ dang por rgyud bla ma sems tsam gyi bstan bcos su mdzad nas sems tsam dang mthun pa'i ṭī ka yang mdzad/ phyis dben pa bsten nas ni/de phyir rang sems rig stong dbyer med 'di/ /sems can kun la khyab par yod gzigs nas/ /sa 'og gter dang sbrum ma'i mngal sogs dpes/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can du gsungs/ /zhes bya ba'i mgur blangs pa las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /༈ldeb dgu ba'i skabs/ mi pham rin ṭ+wā+oṃ 2che'i sdud 'grel las/ 'di ltar snang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃtshul la ni yul can je dag tu song ba dang yul kyang gsar du dag par snang ba ltar yod kyang / gnas tshul la ni yul gzugs sogs kyi rang bzhin ye nas dag pa mthong ba de nyid yul can glo bur gyi dri ma las grol ba 'bras smi yi dag pa nyid yin par shes par byu ste/ de gnyis ye nas yul yul can gnyis su med par dag pa chen por gnas pa'i gnad la don gcig pas dag pa de gnyis ngo bo tha mi dad du shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'bras bu dag pa dang gzugs sogs kyi dag pa de nyid glo bur bral dag gi mthar thug pa sgrib gnyis yongs su spangs pa'i shin tu rnam par dag pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid kyi dag par 'gyur te dag pa de dag thams cad rtsa ba rang bzhin rnam dag gi don la gnad gcig pa bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /de ltar dag pa mthar thug pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dag pa dang / gnas skabs kyi lam so so'i 'bras bu thob pa'i dag pa dang / gzhi gzugs sogs phung khams skye mched kyi chos rnams kyi dag pa gsum po 'di ni snang tshul la tha dad du bzhag kyang / gnas tshul la nam mkha'i khams la tha dad med pa dang mtshungs te chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa gcig gi ngo bor dbyer med la blos kyang tha dad du gcad du med de/ chos nyid rnam dag de'i rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin du mngon sum gzigs pa sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi ngor/ chos thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas pa'am gdod nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin du gzigs kyi ma dag pa med la/ de ltar rtogs pa'i ye shes de'ang glo bur gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa mtha' dag gtan nas spangs 4/3

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i dag pa mthar thug pa yin pas/ des ji ltar gzigs pa ltar chos thams cad yul dang yul can la sogs pa'i gnyis chos kyi rang bzhin du med par gnyis med mnyam pa chen por ye nas dag cing sangs rgyas pa nyid du dbye ba med par ro gcig tu shes pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa yin la/ gshis rnal ma de'i don bab kyi cog bzhag tu skyong ba'i tshul kyang / 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba gang yang med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ /zhes pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/༈ldeb btu gnyis pa'i skabs/ bden pa gnyis po de yang gnas tshul dang sna nga tshul tha dad pas phan tshun 'gal ba nyid yin na bden gnyis tha dad du 'dod pa la yang skyon bzhin 'bab par mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las gsungs pa'i don/ 'di ltar don dam mngon sum du rtogs kyang kun rdzob de der ma 'dus pas logs su dmigs pa'i phyir myang 'das mi thob pa dang / kun rdzob dang tha dad pa'i don dam pa'i bden pa de kun rdzob bden pa'i chos nyid ma yin par 'gyur te bum pa snam bu'i chos nyid ma yin pa bzhin no/ /bden gnyis tha dad pa'i phyir kun rdzob kyi bdag rab tu ma grub pa tsam don dam pa'i bden pa ni ma yin par 'gyur te/ bum pa rab tu ma grub pa tsam snam bu ma yin pa bzhin no/ /don dam bden pa rtogs nas myang 'das thob pa'i dus na'ang kun rdzob de bas logs su dmigs pas kun nas nyon mongs par yang 'gyur bas skyes bu gcig gi rgyud la kun nyon dang rnam byang dus gcig la 'jug pa mi 'gal bar 414

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'agyur ba dang bzhi'o/ /yang gal te de 'dra'i bden gnyis gnas snang phan tshu na gzhan min pas gcig pa nyid yin na bden gnyis gcig pa'i skyon yang bzhis gnod par mdo de las gsungs pa ni/ so so'i skye bo thams cad kyis kun rdzob mthong ba'i phyir don dam yang mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / kun rdzob la brten nas zag pa 'phel ba ltar don dam la brten nas kyang zag pa 'phel bar thal ba dang / don dam la dbye ba med par ltar kun rdzob la'ang dbye ba med par thal ba dang / kun rdzob ji ltar mthong ba dang thos pa las btsal bar bya mi dgos pa bzhin don dam kyang de ltar 'gyur ba ste bzhi'o/ /des na gnas snang gcig tha dad du khas blang bar mi bya gsungs/ /༈ldeb bcu gsum pa'i skabs/ mi pham rin po che'i rgyud bla'i phyag mchan las/dpe dgu ni sangs rgyas kyi sku pad+ma ngan pa'i nang na gnas pa dang / de bzhin du sbrang ñtsā sbrang ma mang po yi dbus la dang / sbun pa la 'bras bu'i snying po dang /mi gtsang pa'i nang na gser dang / dbul po'i khyim gyis 'og la rin po che'i gter dang / myu gu sogs skye ba'i nus pa 'bras bu chung ngu la yod pa dang /gos hrul nang na rin po che las byas pa'i rgyal ba'i sku gzugs yod pa dang ni/bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag 'khor bsgyur yod pa dang / blug gong gi sa la rin chen gser gyi gzugs yod pa ji lta bar glo bur nyon mongs dri mas bsgribs pa yi sems can rnams la dpe de bzhin du/ khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'di gnas so/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas ye shes chos kyi sku sems can gyi tshogs la zhugs shing gnas pa nam zhig mngon du 'gyur ba 'phro 415

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃba'i phyir dang / rang bzhin dri med chos nyid de ni 'bor 'das gnyis la khyad med de/ sangs rgyas rigs gdod nas dag pa de mngon du gyur pa la de 'bras sangs rgyas su nyer btags phyir 'gru+o kun sangs rgyas snying po can du gsungs so/ /zhes dang / rang bzhin gsum gang zhe na/ snying po 'di yi rang bzhin ni rang byung ye shes chos kyi sku dang / gzhan du mi 'gyur ba de bzhin nyid da nga /sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rigs kyang snye gsum mo/ /zhes dang / glo bur gyi dri ma la ltos nas khams de dri mas ma dag pa'i skabs dang / ma dag dag pa gnyis ldan gyi skabs dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas skabs na go rim bzhi na du sems can dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa'i ming gsum gyis brjod cing bstan to/ /zhes gsungs/༈ldeb bcu bzhi'i skabs/ 'jam dpal gnas pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gsungs pa/ byis pa rnams kyang mi dmigs/ byis pa'i chos dang dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams kyang mi dmigs so/ /nam mi dmigs pa de'i tshe na mi rtog go/ /kun tu mi spyod do/ /de spyod pa med la/ spros pa med cing nye bar zhi ba ste/ yod do zhes khas mi len/ med do zhes khas mi lemyo// yod kyang yod la med kyang med do zhes khas mi len/ yod pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang ma yin zhes de skad kyang khas mi len to/ /nam khas mi len pa de ni dmigs pa med do/ /de dmigs pa thams cad dang bral bas sems med cing sems dang bral te gnas med pa'i tshul gyis dge sbyong gi chos la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /tshul 'di bshad pa na gzhor de'i dge ṭ+wā+oṃḍi lnga brgya stan las langs te 'di skad

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃces/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mi blta'o/ /mi mnyan to/ /'jam dpal gang du gnas pa'i phyogs de yang spang bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'dir ltar 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas ston pa mngon sum du gyur bzhin du kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba mtshan nyid gcig tu ston pas chos ma yin pa smra'o zhes brjod nas/ bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la tshangs par spyod pa spyad do snyam nas dong ngo / /de nas shā ri'i bus/ 'jam dpal la smras pa/ dge slong lnga brgya po stan las langs te mi snyan pa zer zhing song ngo zhes smras pa la/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/dge slong lnga brgya po 'di skad ces 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mi blta'o/ /mi mnyan to/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang du gnas pa'i phyogs de yang spang bar bya'o zhes zer ba ni legs so legs so/ /shā ri'i bu/de dag gis tshig de legs par smras pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni yod pa ma yin te/ dmigs su med do/ /gang yod pa ma yin cing dmigs su med pa de la blta ba'am mnyan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa phyogs gang na gnas pa'i phyogs de yang spang bar bya zhes pa yang / 'jam dpal yod pa ma yin te dmigs su med na/ gang de'i gnas kyang yod pa ma yin te dmigs su med do/ /dge slong de dag 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa de thos nas slar yang der phyir log ste/ 'jam dpal khyod kyis bstan pa bdag cag gis mi shes so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/dge slong dag legs so/ /de lta bu ni ston pa'i nyan thos kyi bya ba ste/ dge slong 417

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdag 'di la ni kun shes par bya ba med/ rnam par shes par bya ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos kyi dbyings 'di ni mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa nyid do/ /de ni yod pa ma yin te dmigs su med cing g.yo ba med pa la 'chi 'pho ba med do zhes sogs gsungs pas/ dge slong bzhi brgya ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /brgya ni sems cher 'khrugs nas/ lus des sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod du skyes kyang /chos 'di thos pas myur du de las ldang nas/ dga' ldan pa'i lha rnams dang skal pa mnyam par skyes nas byams pa'i 'dus pa dang por dgra bcom pa thob par lung bstan to/ /zhes dang / lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal gyis/ rigs kyi bu'am bu mo gang dag bdag dang sems can du lta ba brten pa gang gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed cig la/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa dang / gang gis chos zab mo shes par dka' ba/ 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa 'di lta bu thos shing chos stong pa dang mtshan med smon pa med pa 'di lta bu thos nas spangs te sems can dmyal ba rnams su lhung bar gyur pa ni ches myur bar gnas de las ldang bar 'gyur gyi/ dmigs pa can sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur byed pa ni de lta ma yin no zhes bshad pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'jam dpal legs so legs so ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ thos pa 'di ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang 'dra'o zhes sogs bsngags pa mdzad cing / gzhan yang shā ri'i bu/ dge slong de dag ches 418

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmyur bar ldang zhing yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur gyi/ mi gti mug can dmigs pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa the tshom du gyur pa gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byed pa de ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ni de'i yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i rgyur 'gyur gyi myur du rnam par thar par ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos zab mo dag ma thos pa'i phyir ro zhes bka' stsal ba ltar/ zab mo 'khu 'phrigs can 'jigs pa/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i chos 'dis byis pa rnams skrag par 'gyur na yang ji ltar sman rtsub mo ma byin par nad mi 'byin pa ltar bsgrags dgos par 'jam dpal gyis gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ lang kar gshegs pa las gsung pa'i stong pa nyid rnam pa bdun ni/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / srid pa stong pa nyid dang / mi srid pa snyong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad brjod du med pa stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa chen po nyid dang / gcig gis gcig stong pa nyid dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ dngos po thams cad ni rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi rang bzhin gyis dngos po skye ba med pa'i phyir chos thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid yin te/ de'i phyir dngos po'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag dang bdag gi dang bral ba'i phung po rnams te/ rgyu dang / rigs pa dang / byed pa dang / las dang / 'byor ba las skye zhing 'byung ste/ de'i phyir srid pa'i stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /bzhi ba ni/phung po rnam/sa la mya ngan las 'das pa sngon mi srid pa yin te/ de'i phyir mi srid 419

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ kun brtags pa'i rang bzhin brngod du med pa'i phyir chos thams cad brjod du med pa'i stong pa nyid de/ de'i phyir brjod du med pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ bdag gi so so rang gi 'phags pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa ni lta ba dang / nyes pa'i bag chags thams cad kyis stong ste/ de'i phyir don dam pa 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa chen po nyid ces bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ gang na ci med pa de ni des stong zhes bya'o/ /ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma'i khang pa na glang po dang / ba lang dang / lug la sogs pa med kyang dge slong dang / dge slong ma la sogs pas ni stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /de bzhin du chos thams cad rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ni gcig la gcig med de/ de'i phyir gcig gis gcig stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /'di ni stong pa nyid bdun gyi tha shal te de ni spang bar bya'o/ /zhes so// ༈ mi pham rin po che'i sdud 'grel las/rigs pas dpyad pa la brten pa phyang po 'di kun gyi rang bzhin ni dgag bya bden grub bkag pa'i med dgag stong pa de tsam gnas lugs so zhes rtog par byed na'ang de 'dra'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni/ gnas lugs sgro skur dang bral ba rtog pa'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i don la mi gnas pa'i phyir/dmigs pa can gyi mtshan ma la spyod pa yin gyi mtshan ma'i spros pa kun gyis dben pa'i skye med chos dbyings zab mo'i gnas la yid ches pa'i dad pa thob ma yin te dmigs gtad mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa can du shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/༈ldeb bcu dgu ba'i skabs/ mkhas ༷༷ga las/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasal ba la/ dri ma glo bur ba mtha' dag spangs bas rang bzhin rnam dag chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur pa spang rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas gyur mthar thug pa sangs rgyas chos kyi sku ni yon tan tshad med kyang mdor bsdu na/ gtsang bde rtag bdag gi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ ji ltar na/ chos kyi dbyings ngo bo rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de ji lta ba bzhin du bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i ye shes chen pos glo bur gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa slar mi skye bar bcom pas dag pa gnyis ldan ni gtsang ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa rnam grol gyi sku'am/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sku'o/ /sdug kun gyi nyes pa rags pa lta ci smos kyi nyan rang rnams kyis kyang spang bar ma nus pa yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phung po dang / de'i rgyu ma rig bag chags kyi sa yang rnam pa kun du spangs pas/'gyur ba'i zug rngu thams cad dang bral ba ni bde ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bde chen kyi sku'o/ /'khor ba dang myang 'das la tha dad du 'dzin pa med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas dngos dngos med kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i 'dus ma byas chen po 'jig pa med pa ni rtag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku ste/de yang srid pa snga ma rgyun chad nas gsar du skye ba dang / 'du byed rnams rnying nas myags pa'i rga ba dang / khams rnam por 'gyur bas na ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gyur ba'i 'chi 'pho ba bzhi'i nyes pa cha tsam yang mi gnas pas na rim pa ltar/ rtag brtan zhi ba 'pho med g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du gyur pa'o/ /bdag dngos por yod pa dang / bdag med pa tsam gyis rab tu phye ba dngos med nyi tshe ba'i mtha' las 'das te/ de dag gi spros pa nye bar zhi ba/421

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃchos thams cad kyi chos nyid srid zhi kun khyab kyi ye shes nyid du gnas gyur thob pa ni bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ bdag nyid chen po nam mkha' lta bu mnyam pa nyid ye shes kyi sku chos thams cad la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba/ stobs bcu dang dbang bcu la sogs pa zag pa med pa'i chos rgya mtsho gzhal du med pa mnyam pa med pa mtha' dag gi gnas su gyur pa don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rten dam par gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs// ༈ mi pham rin po che'i rgyud bla'i phyag mchan las/ lung la brten nas blo ldan gang zhig rgyal ba'i yul bzhi po de la mos pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi tshogs skyu ste tshogs bsam mi khyab pa gnas pa'i snod du rung bar 'gyur te/ phal bas bsam du med pa'i yon ta na gyi tshogs can gyi gnas 'di bzhi la mngon par dga' ba'i dge bas/ de dang ma 'brel ba'i sems can kun sgyu sbyin sogs bsod nams tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon te 'di las gong du gyur pa'i chos gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag gang zhig gis bsam pa bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po don du gnyer ba'i bsam pas gser las grub pa'i zhing khams rgya chen po nor bus te nor bu rin chen dpag tu med pas spras pa ni/ grangs sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dag gi rdul dang mnyam pa dus nyin re bzhin du rgyun mi 'chad par yul mchog tu gyur pa chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la dus rtag par 'bul na bsod nams ches mang du 'phel mod/ de bas kyang gang zag gzhan gang la la zhig gis don gnas bzhi po 'di las brtsams te don rtogs na lta ci smos/ tha na drig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni yid ches pas mos na 422

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmos pa'i dge ba 'di gong du bshad pa'i sbyin pa las byung ba'i dge ba rgya chen po de las kyang bsod nams ches mang po thob par 'gyur ro/ /blo ldan ga nga zhig bsam pa bla med byang chub 'dod pas dus bskal pa du mar yang / lus ngag yid sgyu sgo nas goms pa'i dbang gis dka' tshegs kyis 'bad pa me da par 'jug pa'i stobs kyis tshul khrims nyes pa phra mos kyang dri ma med pa sru nga par byed pa la bsod nams ches 'phel mod/ de las kyang gang zag gzha na gang la la zhig gis gnas bzhi po 'di las don rtogs pa lta ci smos tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos par gyur na mos pa'i dge ba 'dis gong bshad kyi tshul khrims las byung ba'i dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang du thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang zag gang zhig 'jig rten 'di na byed las srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs pa'i me 'jil bar nus pa'i bsam gtan ni/ lha yi gnas pa bsam gtan bzhi dang tshangs pa'i gnas pa tshad med bzhi rnams phul byung ma thar son pa zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho ba med pa thob pa'i thabs su bsgoms pa la bsod nams ches mang po 'phel mod/ de bas kyang gang zag gzhan gang la la zhig gis gnas bzhi po 'di las brtsams te don rtogs pa lta ci smos/ tha na'ang tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni yid ches pas mos na de ltar mos pa'i dge ba 'di gong bstan gyi bsam gtan las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'phel zhing thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di rnams ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo tshigs bcad du byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ /423

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༄7/ /zhal gdams sogs gsung thor bu'i skor las/༄7/ /hor bla gzhan phan la phul ba'i zhu yig /rgyal kun phrin las gcig bsdus mtsho skyes rje/ /zhal mi gnyis pa bdag sogs 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa po/ /gter chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gser khri'i drung / /sra mkhregs rdo gdan steng nas/ /chos med sprang po zhig gis/ /sor bcu spyi bor bzlums nas/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so/ /gang sku gser ri lhun po/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal zhing / /zab chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston/ /'gyed bzhin bzhugs pa dga' spro/ /dngos ngan phran me+ongs bdag kyang / /bla ma mchog gsum drin las/ /sgru lus ma bor tsam du/ /bag med byung rgyal gnas lags/ /deng skabs 'phral gyi zhu ba/ /nyid gsung bdud rtsi'i zegs ma/ /bka' stsal spyi bor phebs pa/ /rab dga'i dpal las cher 'phel/ /drin nyid kyis gsungs bzhin/ /skyabs rje'i mdun sar lhag nas/ /zasaskom ro la sred bzhin/ /rdo yul slong mor song skabs/ /chu bo rlung gis bskyod nas/ /gru gzings gtor la khad byung / /bdag gis khyed la gsol btab/ /chu bo'i pha rol slebs song / /de nas yar la song nas/ /sa ngan 'phrang chen zhig tu/ /mi ngan grogs med rgyu dus/ /rkyen ngan gcan gzan gzig ni/ /ma bu gsum dang 'phrad nas/ /yar bda' mar ded byas nas/ /skrag sngangs drag po byung dus/ /skyabs rje khyed nyid dran bzhin/ /gsol ba snying nas btab pas/ /rkyen ngan kha 424

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnas thar song / /skrag sngangs de yis rkyen byas/ /zhag grangs nges med mang por/ /gcan gzan du ma rmis tshe// sgrag sngangs 'jigs gsum mang byung / /re zhig bud med zhig gis/ /gcan gzan de rnams khrid nas/ /'di rnams nga yi cho 'phrul/ /de sngon khyod kyis ma go/ /de skad zer ma thag tu/ /gcan gzan bud med thim zhing / /bud med yi ger gyur song / /skyabs rje bla mar zhugatshe/ /de rnams thams cad lhong yin/ /da bar khyod kyis ma chod/ /da ni chod pa yin gsungs/ /rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i/ /rnam thar dpe char mjal rkyen/ /nyin zhag lnga phrag gcig la/ /dbang med mal du lus thal/ /de phyin snang ba thams cad/ /'di yin gtad so med 'dra/ /snang ba'i 'ching zhen lhod nas/ /de rjes nyams snang zhig la/ /drin chen khyed dang mjal nas/ /rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gtad bzhin/ /stod phyogs mar pa'i gdan sar/ /da ni 'gro ran gsungs nas/ /skyabs rje bla ma'i drung du/ /'gro ba'i zhu ba phul tshe/ /mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yin yang / /da dung ma 'gro gsungs nas/ /de rjes lo zung song tshe/ /drin chen skyabs rje bla ma'i/ /sku lus bsnyung gzhis zin nas/ /mchog sprul rol pa'i rdo rje/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan phyir/ /yul 'dir chags phebs byung tshe/ /dad gus gdung ba chen pos/ /dngos ngan mdun sar song nas/ /kye kye rje btsun chen po/ /deng sang rdzogs pa chen po'i/ /chosaskad gleng ba mang yang / /bdag gi rgyud la ma 'byor/ /da ni cis kyang khyed las/ /skyabs gnas gzhan na med pas/ /thugs rjes 'dzin dgos zhus tshe/ /drin chen de yi zhal nas/ /o lo ban chung khyod nyid/ /mchog sprul gzhan phan nyid nas/ /'di 425

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃru mngag pa yin skad/ /bdag kyang gzhan phan nyid la/ /mjal 'dod lhag par che yang / /deng skabs mjal stabs ma 'grigs/ /mi rgan nga yi khong nas/ /rdzogs rtogs pa med kyang / /khyod rang nga dang lhan du/ /mgo log phyogs su shog dang / /lto gos gnyis po ngas ster/ /rdo grub mdun sar song dang //rdzogs rgyud la 'byor 'ong / /zhes pa'i bka' zhus gnang nas/ /skyabs rje nyid la khong gis/ /zhu ba nan tan byas kyang / /'gro ba'i gnang ba ma ster/ /da ni ban chung khyod la/ /skyabs rjes gnang ba med kyang / /mchog sprul rdo grub nyid kyi/ /gdams pa'i byin brgyud pha phog /nga yis khyod la ster zhes/ /dgyes bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i/ /khrid yig ye shes bla ma'i/ /gtso byas rdzogs chen khrid de/ /zab gnad mang po gnang nas/ /da ni mthar thug yang zab/ khrub rje nyid kyis bzhed ltar/ /snying po 'di nyid yin zhes/ /gsungs nas bdag la gnang ba/ /spyir ni bde gshegs snying po/ /'gro ba'i khams la bzhugs kyang / /snang gsum kun rtog brgyad cu/ /las rlung nyi khri sogs kyis/ /rkyen byas rang / /zhal bsgribs nas/ /sus kyang rtogs par dka' 'o/ /de phyir mngon du byed pa'igadams pa rdzogs pa po/ /kun mkhyen yab sras sogs nas/ /brgyud pa'i gsang lam zab mo/ /gsang bdag dpa' bo'i zlos gar/ /rdo grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /bar du rim par brgyud nas/ /zab pa'i zab gnad yin pas/ /gzung 'dzin las rlung bzhon pa/ /dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum/ /thim pa'i rang rtsal rdzogs tshe/ /bzhi cha gsum dang bral ba/ /khyad chos drug dang ldan pa'i/ /nyer thob chos sku'i 'od gsal/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chen por/ /426

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmangon du gyur nas 'ong zhes/ /bka' yi gnang ba byung tshe/ /dka' spyad du ma byas nas/ /rtsol ba'i 'bad pas bsgrub tshe/ /bdun phrag gcig tsam song nas//re zhig mal na nyal tshe/ /gnyid dang rmi lam mtshams su/ /mi mang 'tshogs sar thon 'dug /nga la gcig gisamada' 'phang / /rā hu la yi mda' gzhu/ /yin zhes nga rtsar snang nas/ /nga yi phar la 'phangs bas/ /mi gcig bsad nas yang ni/ /'phen pa'i bsam pa shar tshe/ /mchog sprul rol pa'i rdo rjes/ /nga yis khyod la snang srid/ /bla mar ngo sprod things zhing / /nga la 'phang ba mi rigs//khyod rang shar la song dang / /mda' mo nga yis 'phen zhes/ /mda' brgyag nam mkhar bkyags pas/ /sa gzhi rgya mtsho por/ /phyed tshal me dpung 'bar zhing / /phyed tshal chu chen mched sogs/ /snang ba du ma shar nas/ /nyi shar bar du lus thal/ /de sogs nyams snang mang po/ /ngal nas bri bar ma nus/ /gzung 'dzin las rlung bzhon pa/ /dbyings su nub pa'i zla shar/ /mi rtog dbu ma'i gshis la/ /thim yang dran med mun pa/ /lta bu'i gzeb las grol nas/lung ma bstan du ma 'byams/ /bum nang mar me sbar bzhin/ /'od gsal 'char sko 'gag med/ /'khor 'das so so'i mtshangs rnams/ /rig cing de ru 'dzin pas/ /kun rtog blo dang bral ba'i/ /gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing khams/ /mthong ba yin zhes gzugs med/ /sgra yi rnam pas bstan song / /de yang stong pa'i rang mdangs/ /ches cher rab tu 'bar nas/ /snang srid snod bcud thams cad/ /rtog med 'od gsal ngang du/ /me long gzugs brnyan ltar ram/ /rgya mtshor gza' skar shar bzhin/ /de la der 'dzin med pa'i/ /ngang nas ltad mo 427

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmathong zhing / /gzhi dbyings mthing gsal klong du/ /rigs lnga'i zhing sogs shar tshe/ /snang cha yin zhes gsal zhing / /stong cha yin zhes gzhir thim/ /dbu med rgyan ldan du mas/ /'di rnams rigs lnga'i zhing sogs/ /yin zhes brda sprad snang ngo / /rgya yig bod yig la sogs/ /yig rigs du ma mang po'i/ /snang brnyan sna tshogs shar nas/ /yang yang bud med du mas/ /tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas thogs med/ /yin zhes kha ba la der/ /bzhugs yod de ru song sogs/ /nyams snang du ma shar ro/ /nyams snang de yi ngang nas/ /nyin zhag zung sogs thal lo/ /de nas sad rgyu med kyang / /sad pa'i snang ba shar ro/ /thod rgal nyams dang ma mtshungs/ /de sogs nyams snang cha la/ /'khrul rtog gya gyu'i ri mo/ /rje btsun po'i snyan du/ /lhad med byis pas blangs yod/ /zhu gsol don gyi snying po/ /mchog sprul rang yul phebs song / /sprang po gtad med lus thal/ /da ni cis kyang nyid kyis/ /yo ga gsum gyi rdzogs rim/ /gzhi lam 'bras bur 'brel ba'i/ /zhal gdams zab pa'i mthar thug /bdag gzhan yongs la phan phyir/ /cis kyang gnang bar 'tshal lo/ /sprang po'i re 'brasade rnams/ /ma hā gu ru'i thugs nas/ /gal te yal bar dor na/ /sprang po bsad dang khyad par/ /yod na dkon mchog gsum po/ /skabs su dad pa'i rten du/ /phyag tham na bza' dbu skra/ /spyi bor stsol ba'i bka' drin/ /re 'bras don ldan zhu zhu/ /nyid kyi bka' bzhin 'di rtswa /lo bar cha shas song 'dug /da ni sprang po bdag la/ /skyabs rje dgung lo bgres rkyen/ /yul 'dir 'dug snyam med mod/ /'on kyang da dung skyabs rje'i/ /428

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbaka' yi gnang ba ma byung / /de tshe sprang po bdag ni/ /nges med zhig tu 'gro nges/ /snga sor rje btsun nyid dang / /pha ma a khu sogs la/ /mjal 'dod lhag par yod kyang / /da ni drin chen a khus/ /sgyu lus me tog 'thor song / /de phyir 'ong snyam sprang po/ /bdag la gtan nas mi 'dug /deng nas byang chub bar du/ /khyed las re sa skyabs gnas/ /sprang po bdag la med pas/ /dusadang rnam pa kun tu/ /zab gsal thugs kyi klong nas/ /nam yang 'dor med mkhyen mkhyen/ /ched gsol gangs can bod yul/ /gser gyi sa gzhi'i khyon 'dir/ /gang sku gser ri lhun po/ /bskal brgya'i bar du bzhugs shig /de skad nyams snang rdzun gtam/ /lha dgon nye ba'i ri nas/ /rje yi 'bangs kyi tha shal/ /nges med sprang pos bris so/ /dge'o/ /༄༅/ /'brug pa rin po che laphul ba'i zhu yig/dus bzhi mnyam nyid kyi zhing na/ /sku gsum rang snang gi ston mchog /thugs rje'i phyag yangs de rkyongs la/ /byin rlabs snying dbus su stsol dang / /ka dag ye grol gyi zhing na/ /'pho med chos sku yi rgyal sa/ /chos med sprang po ngas zin tshe/ /rgyang glu ring mo zhig mchod ya/ /mnyam bzhag lta stangs kyi 'dzin pa/ /sems 'dzin yid dpyod kyi bsam gtan/ /sdug btsir 'jur bcings kyi dran pa/ /ma bcos lhod grol la langs song / /dbyings rig phyam brdal gyi klong na/ /rig rtsal 'gag med kyi rol pa/ /rgyu 'bras snga phyi ru 'brel ba'i/ /bag chags gsog long ni mi 'dug /'khor 'das ye grol gyi klong na/ /gang shar ye shes kyi rol pa/ /snang semasakhral khrol dang ban bun/ /rtogs grosdu 9nyams len rang mthar thug /na rung

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'atsher ba ni mi 'dug /shi yang 'gyod pa yang mi skye/ /na dga' shi skyid kyi ngang nas/ /nges med dben khrod du chas 'gro/ /rje yi bka' drin la bsams na/ /sdod mi tshugs pa zhig byung yang / /gzhan nas bya thabs ni mi 'dug /bka' shog legs po zhig gnang shog /phran la thugs rje yis gzigs dang / /nam zhig mgon kyā+od kyi drung du/ /skyir+sha pa'i zhabs bror de ༷khra~X bzhin/ /dāga' ༷'i smi bye:ོ༵sadu ṭ+wāṃpa ṭ+wā+o+oṃ~X/da/ 'ong /// /—sa 'brug pa —na pa — la phul ba' zhu rmeg

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ༄tsho/ /ngal gso'i mgron po'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sde gsum klong dgu yi man ngag /zhabrul med lam bzang gi rdzogs chen/ /ston mdzad brgyud gsum gyi bla ma'i/ /zhabs pad spyi bo ru mchod ya/ /grub brnyes rig 'dzin gyi bla ma'i/ /brgyud pa'i gral rim la bsams na/ /gral mtha'i mdo med kyi sprang pos/ /nyams dga'i glu chung zhig 'then ya/ /a ho/grong dgon spel ma yi khrod na/ /gnas nyams 'thug po yi mal du/ /nyams zhen ro myong la chags pa'i/ /ngal ba don med kyi sgom che // /a 'thas nyams zhen gyis 'chings bas/ /rang rgyud bsdam pa de e go/dbang med byed po ni ma mchis/ cung zad glod na ni bde'o/ /cir yang ma grub pa'i ngang nas/ /dwangs gsal 'gag med kyi nyams len/ /zhad zhung bon po dang mthun pa'i/ /lta de spros can du 'dug go/bsnyoms kyang sems 'dzin gyi bsam gtan/ /ma bsgoms 'khrul 'byams kyi rang bzhin/ /de 'dra'i gnas 'gyu yi ngang la mi tshe zad pa 'di e gzigs/ /gzugs med bsam gtan gyi khung bur/ /sems gnas dgung lo ni bgres kyang / /gnas dga' 'gyu sdug gi ngang nas/ /da dung 'o brgyal zhig yod skad/ /lta ba'i bgro gleng re byas tshe/ /'dri sa gleng sa tsam med pa'i/ /khyod kyi log rtog de spongs dang / /nga tshos lta mgur zhig 'then ya/ /a ho/ mnyam bzhag lta stangs kyi 'dzin pa/ /da ni gang 'gro la thongs zhog /sems 'dzin yid dpyod kyi bsam gtan/ /dgos med rang bab du skyur 431

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthongs/ /skye med ka dag gi dbyings na/ /'gag med ye grol gyi rig pa/ /nyams zhen shun pa dang bral nas/ /gcer bu rjen pa ru 'dug go/'phral byung dgag sgrub kyi shes pa/ /mi sdod rang yal la song nas/ kun rtog las rlung gi rgyu ba/ /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su phebs thal/ /'jur bcings a 'thas kyi dran pa/ /ma bcos lhod grol la song nas/ /gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog gi mdud rgya/ /nam mkha'i bya rjes la 'gran thal/ /dran pa rang grol gyi dgongs pa/ /dran snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ /khyab brdal lhun grub kyi dran pa/ /ma bcos cham brdal la longs song / /chos nyid ye grol gyi klong na/ /gzung 'dzin gzhi grol dang rgya grol/ /ka dag chos zad kyi dgongs pa/ /zang thal rjen pa ru thal lo/ /phar la ma bskoms pas cog bzhag /tshur la ma bcings pas rgya yan/ /dbus la mi gnas pas zang thal/ /'pho med chos sku yi rgyal khab/ /gang snang bden med du shar ba/ /sgru ma'i dpe brgyad kyi rnam rol/ /rgyun 'dzin shes pa'ang mi sdod/ /rang yal rjes med la phebs song / /bsgoms kyang gtad so ni mi 'dug /ma bsgoms 'khrul 'byams ni mi snang / /sgom dang mi sgom dang bral ba'i/ /'od gsal mtha' dbus las 'das song / /ye gzhi ka dag gi rang mdangs/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi snang cha/ /sku dang ye shes kyi tshom bu/ /gnyis med rol pa 'di ha ha/ /ka dag ye grol gyi lta ba/ /mtha' dbus spros mtha' dang bral song / /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi sgom pa/ /nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu 'byams thal/ /gang shar rang grol gyi spyod pa/ /ma bcos lhod grol la longs song / /sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bu/ /re dogs yid smon ni mi 432

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adug /pha rgan drin chen gyi thugs rjes/ /nga cag skyid po rang 'dug gi/ /smyon pa 'ur langs kyi tshul du/ /zhabs bro ci zhig na mi brdung / /a ho/ blo bral zang thal gyi lta ba/ /gnyug ma'i dran pa yis skyongs dang / /'pho med chos sku ru grol la/ /de tsam dka' rgyu zhig mi 'dug /sa lam byar med kyi ngang du/ /tshogs drug lhug pa ru zhog dang / /sgyu lus phung po kho zhig tshe/ /gdod ma'i nang dbyings su chas 'gro/ /de 'dra'i lta mgur ni snyan po'i/ /rgyang glu ring mo zhig 'then mkhan//chos med btsun pa yi gzugs brnyan/ /sprang po smyon pa de yin skad/ /'di nas byang chub kyi bar du/ /'bral med mched po des bskul tshe/ /gang shar thol byung gi tshul du/ /mig 'phrul lta bu ru bris so/ /zhes skyabs rje rin po che'i zhabs rdul spyi bor 'dzin pa chos med btsun pa'i gzugs brnyan kun bzang gzhan phan mtha' yas su g.yu khog bla ma'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'bod pas bris pa'o/ /bha wan+tu/༄tsho/ /bla ma dam pa chosadaga' la gdams pa/ bla ma dam pa chos dga' la gdams pa/ mgon rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /pha bka' drin mtshungs med rnga yab gling / /de dbyer med bla ma rin po che/ /steng spyi gtsug zhalor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /a ho/ mtha' med kyi 'khor ba'i grong khyer du/ /zin med kyi tshe 'di'i bya bzhag rnams/ /bar med du sku tshe 'di nyid la/ /de bsgrubs kyang 'grub dus mi 'ong gi /don de phyir skal bzang grogs khyed kyis/ /'jig rten gyi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /nges med kyi dben pa'i ri ngogs su/ /theg rgyal gyi khyad chos nyams su longs/ /a ho/ gaṭ+wāṃsdu tsit+ta smug po'i gur khang nas/ /rtsa rgya

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmatsho gser gyi nyi ma las/ /byung ba yi ka ti shel sbug can/ /de rgyang zhag chu yi sgron mar 'brel/ /'dus ma byas rdul bral nam mkha'i dbyings/ /blo 'jur bu ma yin lhod grol dus/ /don gzigs stangs gsum gyi dbyings la ltos/ /dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma 'di/ /'od lnga yi zlum zhakhrigs ra ba can/ /de dbus thig le stong pa'i sgron/ /lnga ldan 'od kyi tshom bu can/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bzhis brgyan/ /de dbus rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ mu tig bstar la brgyus pa'am/ /gser gyi skud pa lding 'dra la/ /thig le dang thig phran mang pos brgyan/ /don de mthong gi skyes bu skal ba bzang / /thabs cog bzhag 'khyil ba'i man ngag gis/ /lus mi g.yo sku gsum bzhugs stangs dang / /ngag mi smra las rlung dbu mar bskyal/ /sems 'khrul med dbyings rig ma bu bsre/ /gnas dag dbyings dbu ma'i grong khyer na/ /gzhi chos sku'i rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /lam lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin nas/ /don 'bras bu sku bzhi'i rgyal sa zin/ /zhes bla ma dam pa chos dga' nas zhal gdams zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor chos dbyings rang grol gyis bris pa dge/༄tsho/ /skye med chos sku'i sogs sho lo ka nga gsum can/skye med chos sku'i bla ma kun mkhyen rje/ /'gag med longs sku'i bla ma 'jigs med gling / /ris med sprul sku'i bla ma 'brug pa dang / /dbyer med rang byung rig pa'i rgyal por 'dud/ /srid rtse nas bzung mnar med yan chad du/ /sdug bsngal las gzhan bde ba yod min phyir/ /de las thar 'dod blo shugs drag po yis/ /'khor bar zhen pa log pa'i nges 'byung sgoms/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i grong khyer drug po na/ /ma 434

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrgan nyam thag las kyi rjes 'brang nas/ /yang nas yang 'khor shing rta'i 'phang lo bzhin/ /de tshul som la byang chub sems gnyis skoms/ /rigs stong zung 'jug chen po'i rang rtsal las/ /rol pa 'gag med snod bcud zhing skur shar/ /brjod bral sngags kyi rgyal po'i rang rtsal las/ /rol pa 'gag med sgra grags sngags su shar/ /thugs rje kun la khyab pa'i rig rtsal las/ /rol pa 'gag med dran rtog bzang ngan kun/ /spang blang med par gang shar rang sar grol/ /de ltar snang srid rnam dag dag snang sgoms/ /gdod ma'i stong chen dbyings kyi dgongs klong na/ /rig pa'i ye shes g.yo med ye nas bzhugs/ /rang rtsal 'gag med me long g.ya' bral bzhin/ /rol pa shar grol nam mkha'i bya rjes ltar/ /dge dang mi dge rtog tshogs bzang ngan kun/ /bag chags bsags long med par grol ba'i tshe/ /tha mal 'khrul 'byams yod pa ma yin te/rin chen gling du sa rdo btsal bzhin no/ /chos kyi dbyings la mtha' dbus yod min zhing / /dbyings kyis gar khyab rig pa'i ye shes kyis/ /khyab pa yin te rig stong dbyer med phyir/ /me dang tsha ba chu dang rlan bzhin no/ /de 'dra'i dgongs klong mngon du ma gyur na/ /ka dag zang thal mtha' dbus bral zhes dang / /khyab brdal rig pa tshig tsam brjod pa la/ /gshis der phebs pa'i skal ba yod mi srid/ /de phyir sems rig la shan ma phye bar/ /nyams dang sems kyi sbubs dang bral ba yi/ /rig stong rjen pa'i rang zhal mthong srid na/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi bzhad gad gnas/ /rnam rtog med pa'i stong nyams tsam zhig la/ /mnyam par bzhag na 'khrul rtogs bag nyal du/ /yod pa 435

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃre zhig ldang bar mi nus kyang / /rtog ngan dug ro rkyen dang phrad na ldang / /lta mtshang spyod pas phud ces gsungs pa de/ /'di la mi smra gzhan du yod dam ci/ /de phyir grol tshul gdengs dang ldan byas na/ /sgrub brgyud dam pa'i phyag bzhes kho na 'o/ /chos med sprang po spyon pa'i ngang tshul ngas/ /glu dbyangs dar dir sgrogs pa'i bh+ya ma ra/ /lha rdzas dar gyi 'dab gshog legs bskyod de/ /khyod drung pad+ma'i tshal du de ring mngag /dge'o/ /༄7ོ/ /sems rig shan 'byed kyi man ngag bzhugs/ a ho/ dpal mgon bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi/ /byin rlabs mos gus kho na yis/ /'dren par 'dod pa gang su zhig /yod na snyan gyi dbang pos gson/ /khregs chod stong pa'i ye shes dang / /thod rgal snang ba'i 'od gsal gnyis/ /zung 'jug chen por bzhugs pa la/ /'phags lam rdzogs pa chen por grags/ /gzhon nu bum sku'i mkha' klong na/ /'pho rdo rje'i rol mo can/ /nang gsal thim la ma rmugs pa'i/ /phra ba'i ye shes 'gag pa med/ /de la rtog ge'i dpyad ra dang / /blun sgom mun rdo 'phen pa yis/ /go rgyu myong rgyu med mod kyang / /gnyid dang brgyal ba lta bu min/ /rtsol med cog bzhag rnam bzhi'i ngang / /sems dang sems byung 'gags pa'i cha/ /ye shes rjen par mthong 'dod na/ /rdzogs pa chen por blo phug gtod/ /las kyi rlung 'di rang sor zhog /rtog tshogs nyon rlung bag la zha/ /ye shes rlung ni dbyings su 'khyil/ /'di ni gdod ma'i grol sa 'o/ /sems dang ye shes 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /rig gdangs las kyi rlung gis bskyod/ /kun rtog zhabrul ba'i 'khor lo la/ /༷ṭ+wāṃ/ pa'i rtogs ldan 'o re brgyal/ /'gyu

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃba'i cha ni sems yin la/ /rig pa'i cha la ye shes zer/ /rig gdangs rlung dang bral ba'i tshe/ /yid las 'das pa'i 'od gsal 'char/ /de tshe sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /ngo bo stong pas rtag mtha' bral/ /rang bzhin gsal bas chad mtha' bral/ /thugs rje'i rig pa bem stong min/ /'di ni kun la brjod mi bya/ /gnad med sdug skur byed rnams kyis/ /mthong na ca co'i 'ur skad 'don/ /snying gi dbus su a thim rgya/ /de ltar spyon pa'i rgyang glu 'di/ /tshig dang dpe la ma ltos par/ /mnyam bzhag ngos la zhal bshus nas/ /dad ldan dge ba'i grogs la gdams/ /zhes chos med sprang po spyon pa chos dbyings rang grol gyis shar mar bris pa'o/ /༄7ོ/ /snga ma'i rtog pa sogs tshigs bcad lnga pa/ a ho/ snga ma'i rtog pa de 'gags nas/ /phyi ma'i rtog pa yang ma skyes/ /bar gyi stong nyams la zhen nas/ /mi tshe stong zad du ma gtong / /bsgoms kyang sems 'dzin gyi bsam gtan/ /ma bsgoms 'khrul 'byams kyi rang bzhin/ /de 'dra'i gnas 'gyu yi nyams len/ /ngal ba don med de skyur thongs/ brgyud gsum dpal mgon gyi bla ma/ /spyi gtsug bde chen du bsgoms la/ /dbang bzhi legs po zhig blangs rjes/ /thugs yid dbyer med du sres shog /'khor ba zhen log gi nges 'byung / /gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byang sems/ /snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang / /chos kyi rtsa ba ru 'dug go/ka dag ye grol gyi lta ba/ /gnyug ma'i dran pa yis skyongs dang / /a wa dhu ti yi mdud rgya/ /'grol ba dka' mo rang mi 'dug /dge'o/ /༄7/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs sho lo 4sdu 7nyer gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrnga yab gling pa/ /gang dang mi gnyis/ /kun mkhyen yab sras/ /snying gi dbus na/ /'du 'bral med do/ /rang re kun mkhyen/ /chen po'i rjes 'jug /'khor bar zhen pa/ /log pa'i nges 'byung / /gzhan phan don du/ /gnyer ba'i byang sems/ /bla ma sangs rgyas/ /dngos su mthong ba'i/ /dad dang mos gus/ /yang yang byas na/ /byin rgyun snying gi /dbus su 'pho 'ong / /rdo rje'i mched po/ /bdag la gson dang / /gang gis rnal ma/ /bsgom pa'i tshe na/ /bying dang rmugs pa'i/ /dbang du song na/ /ci tsam bsgom yang / /ngal ba don med/ /bying ba dwangs ba'i/ /dwangs cha thon na/ /yul med sangs ba'i/ /ye shes ngang la/ /mi g.yo rgya mtsho/ /lta bur gnas lags/ /rmugs pa sangs ba'i/ /gsal cha thon na/ /gsal la rtog med/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /lta bu'i ngang la/ /gnas pa yin lags/ /stong cha dag pa'i/ /rjen cha thon na/ /bya rtsol bral ba/ /nam mkhar dwangs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lta bu'i/ /ngang la gnas lags/ /gsum du dbye yang / /tha mi dad cing / /dus gsum dus med/ /chos nyid 'khor lo/ /thun mtshams ris med/ /nyams len ma shes/ /dwangs gsal rjen pa/ /rjen 'ded gyis dang / /gzung 'dzin las rlung / /nyi khri chig stong / /dbu mar zhugs pa/ /dka' mor mi 'dug /a wa dhu ti'i/ /mdud rgya grol na/ /gang ltar bsgoms kyang / /de yis mi 'ching / /ka dag rig pa/ /de la los zer/ /zhabrul snang gzhi la/ /thim pa'i lag rjes/ /chos kyi lubor lo'i/ /rtsa mdud grol tshe/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i/ /rdza rnga rdungs shog /thod rgal bsgoms pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la/ /snang cha longs spyod/ /rdzogs skur grol 'ong / /rags 438

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃlus rdul phran/ /dengs ba a ti/ /rngogs pa po'i/ /khyad chos yin lags//dran pa rnam grangs/ /mang du yod kyang / /tshogs brgyad blo dang / /bral ba'i tshe na/ /ming la gnyug ma'i/ /dran pa thog cig /chos grogs dam pa/ /yon tan rgya mtshos/ /'di ltar dgos zhes/ /yang yang bskul nas/ /snyom las mkhan gyis/ /mig 'phrul lta bur/ /gang shar thol byung / /myur du bris so/ /༄༅/ /mtshungs med drin chen sogs sho lo ka nyer gnyis pa/mtshungs med drin gyi bla ma'i/ /zhabs rdul spyi bo ru mchod ya/ /'di nas byang chub kyi bar du/ /'bral med mched po des zhu 'bras/ /rten bzang 'di rnyed par dka' bas dal ba la snying po longs/ /mi tshe la nges pa med pas nam 'chi cha med soms/ /las 'bras la bslu ba med pas rgyu 'bras la blang dor gyis/ /'khor ba la snying po med pas chos brgyad kyi bya ba thongs/ /dge chos kyi 'bras bu yin pas thar lam la spro ba skyed/ /dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas yin pas bla ma la gsol ba thobs/ /skyabs gnas kyi mchog gyur yi na pas dkon mchog la blo snying gtod/ /'gro drug 'di pha ma yin pas brtse ba'i snying rje sgoms/ /sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing yin pas gnyen po stobs bzhi sgoms/ /lha chos kyi rtsa ba yin pas kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /snang srid 'di bden med yin pas sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyangs gyis/ /zhal gdams kyi nying khu yin pas rang sems 'di chos kyis ༵la// /sprang nga yi snying gtam yin pas grogs khyed kyi thugs la zungs/ /maṅga ༄7ོ/ /snang stong zung 'jug zhes bya'i mtshan don ni/dus gsum gzhi rtsa bral la stong 439

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzhes brngod/ /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gags snang ba zhes/ /gnyis med rol la snang stong zung 'jug smra/ /dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i tha snyad yang / /gdod nas spros mtha' bral la dbyings su brjod/ /ye shes rjen par bzhugs la rig pa zhes/ /ye nas 'du 'bral med la dbyings rig grags/ /snang sems ma bu 'phrad pa zhes bya yang / /sems nyid gdod nas grol la ma zhes brjod/ /gang snang 'dzin zhen bral la bu ru grags/ /gnyis med rol la ma bu 'phrad par smra/ /zhes chos dbyings rang grol pas so/ /ralo/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus sogs tshigs su bcad pa bcu drug pa/skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /drin chen bla ma de mkhyen no/ khre ba srog la ni thug kyang / /chos tshugs bzang po zhig med na/ /nges 'byung yad yud dang sad sud/ /chu nang ko gru bzhin bsgyur sla/ /tshul min yid byed kyi rtog ngan/ /gang dran lag len du btab na/ /las mtha' ci 'gro ni mi shes/ /sna thag rang mgo la dkris shig /mi rtag mdza' bshes kyi grogs la/ /yun ring 'grogs rlom zhig byas kyang / /'chi bdag gshin rje yi bsu ma/ /nam 'ong rang res ni mi shes/ /'phrang ring bar do yi yul du/ /rang nyid gcig pu ru phebs dus/ /brtse ba'i mdza' bshes kyi grogs la/ /'grogs pa'i thabs shig de e yod/ /'chi bdag khrims kha rang tsha bas/ /dbang med shi gson gyi snang ba/ /mi 'dod so so ru bral te/ /rang nyid gcig pu ru 'gro dgos/ /de bas da lta nas rang nyid/ /grogs med gcig pu ru bsdad nas/ /'chi kha 'gyod med kyi chos shig /da lta da lta nas sgrubs shig /tshe srog mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ /rlung gseb mar me dang 440

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adra bas/ /rtag brtan med tshul la bsamar+sān/ /'chi ba mi rtag de dran 'ong / /zin med tshe 'di yi bya bzhag /nyin mtshan bar med du bsgrubs kyang / /ngal ba 'bras med kyi rang bzhin/ /shes nas dgos med du skyur thongs/ /mtha' med 'khor ba yi gnas su/ /ma rgan nyam thag gi 'gro ba/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis mnar tshul/ /bsam na snying rje rang skye 'ong / /phyi nang snod bcud kyi gnas tshul/ /sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ /gdod nas rnam dag tu shes na/ /snang srid dag mnyam du rtogs 'ong / /snang grags rig gsum gyi rang bzhin/ /pha cig drin chen gyi bla ma'i/ /sku gsung thugs gsum du shes na/ /snang srid bla ma ru shar 'ong / /snying gi pad+mo yi dbus na/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bla ma/ /rig stong chos sku yi tshul du/ /'di nas byang chub kyi bar du/ /'pho med mngon sum du bzhugs la/ /kha tsam tshig tsam de min pa'i/ /nges shes gting tshugs zhig rnyed na/ /thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres 'ong / /sna tshogs nyams zhen gyi shun pa/ /dus gsum 'khrul rtog gi yo lang / /ma bcos lhod grol la song na/ /rig stong rjen pa ru shar 'ong / /a ho/ nyams snang za zi yi ngang nas/ /nyams chod dam dum du las dkyil/ /mgo med mjug rdum gyi zhal ṭ+wāṃkākāsal/ga/sdin/ po/ mgo bskor 'dis ci bya/ /zhes bskul ngor ldog min tsam du ༄7/ /'khrul 'byamasal song tshe ci byed mi 'dug dris pa'i lan ni/a ho/ /stong chen dbyingasakyi pho brang na/ /rang byung rig pa'i rgyal po de/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs/ /de ru sdod dang zhagrul 'byams med/ /gal te las rlung 441

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang 'grogs nas/ /tshogs drug yul la rgya 'byams na/ /'od gsal khang pa'i sgo drung du/ /rang grol gnyug ma'i dran pa yod/ /de la myur du sbran gyur na/ /skad cig nyid la gzhi dbyings su/ /slebs nas rgyal sa zin pa mā /the tshom med do sa ma ya/ /rjes thob skabs kyi 'khrul 'byams dang / /rmi lam yul gyi 'khrul snang sogs/ /'od gsal klo+ong du grol 'dod na/ /lus ngag yid kyi bya ba thongs / /rlung sems gdod ma'i gshis thog tu/ /thim nas rig stong chos sku'i zhal/ /mngon sum mardzal nas shi mtha'i bar/ /nyams len thang lhod med par mdzod/ /de min 'di las thabs gzhan ni/ /kho bos mi shes gzhan la dris/ /de ltar bskul ngor ldog min tsam/ /gang shar thol byung tshul gyis smras/ /zhes chos dbyings rang grol pas so// ༈ bla ma thogs med la gdams pa/ /kun mkhyen rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran pa rnam grangs mang mod kyang / /grogs khyod yengs pa tshor tsam nas/ /gnas lugs thog tu phebs 'dug kyang / /de la da dung goms gyur na/ /yengs tshor tsam gyi dran pa de/ /yul med sangs pa'i dus shig yod/ /de tshe dran snang ye shes su/ /'char ba'i mgo bo rtsom pa yin/ /de yi ngang mdangs bskyangs gyur na/ /nam zhig yengs yul tshogs drug dang / /yengs ba'i mkhan po gnyis 'dzin sems/ /chos nyid dbyings su stor ba'i tshe /mnyam rjes thams cad sgom du shar/ /nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin/ /de dag mdor na 'di ltar lags/ shes bya yul dang shes byed blo/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni/ /mnyam pa nyid du shar ba'i tshe/ /yengs yul chos nyid sangs ba zhes/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i zhal rgyun yin/ /tshul 'di bla ma thogs med 442

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyi/ /thugs kyi dgyes bzhed bskang phyir du/ /spyon pas rtsed mo byas pa la /gzhan gyis thugs khrel mdzad dogs med/ /dge zhing bkra shis bha wan+tu/ /༄7/ /sems don la gal gnad kyi skor kha shas/ rig pa'i ngo bo stong pa/gdangs rang gsal 'gag pa med pa/ thugs rje ris med par khyab pa'i gshis kyi bzhugs tshul ngo 'phrod phan chan/ de'i ngang la 'gags med shugs 'byung du 'ardzog pa ma gtogs/ bsal bzhag spro bsdu dang / yin min gyi rtsis gdab sogs rdul phra rab tsam yang bya rgyu med pa lags/ dh+wa ki badz+ra gyi zhal nas/ rgya grol rnal 'byor nam langs nyi shar 'dra/ /chos sku'i snang ba yin no e ma ho/ /zhes gsungasaso/ /rig stong kha sbyor gyi dgongasapa ni/ dang po rlung sems gnyis kyi rgyab gyes pa dang / bar du sna tshogs nyams la zhen pa'i shun pa bral ba dang / tha ma dbyings lung ma bstan gyi stong cha dwangs ba dang / de lta bu'i bral bya'i chos gsum bral ba'i tshe na/ yul can gyi rig pa rjen pa/ yul chos nyid mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i klong du gnyis med zung 'jug tu bzhugs pa ni/dper na gnam stong gi zla ba mkha' dbyings su 'khyil ba lta bu'i cha de ni rig stong kha sbyor yin te/ de yi rtsal shar grol dus mnyam yin pas 'od gsal gyi 'char sgo 'gag med du brjod pa'o/ /rang thog tu ngo shes/ yin thog tu thag chod/grol thog tu gdeng bca' ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /de lam rig gi cha'o/ gzhi rig ni chos dbyings gdod ma'i gzhi dang / ye shes thim bya'i rig pa gnyis med zung 'jug tu bzhugs pa yin te/ de'i rtsal ye shes la ye shes rol pa'o/ /'bras bu'i rig pa ni/ sems can grol ba'am sangs rgyas pa gdod ma'i stong 443

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃchen gyi dbyings dang nang gsal phra ba'i ye shes gnyis med zung 'jug chen por bzhugs nas rtsal chos nyid la ye shes rol pa'o/ /gzhan yang / bying ba ni rig pa'i gsal ngar gyi cha lhod pa dang / rgod pa ni 'dod pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i 'phro ba'i cha'o/ /rmugs pa ni sems la mun pa babs pa'i rnam pa can no/ /de'ang rang stobs kyis dwangs ba ni rtsol med cog bzhag rnam gsum gyi ngang mdangs bskyang ba'i tshe na/ bying rgod rmugs gsum sprin bzhin du dwangs 'gro ba dang / thabs la brten pa ni/ bying ba'i tshe rlung ro dgu phrugs byas nas/don dam ye shes kyi rtsa rlung 'dzin rtsol dang bral ba la brten nas rlung sems gnyis kyi rgyab gyes tshul la mkhas par bya'o/ /rgod na bla ma snying dbus su bsgoms nas thugs yid dbyer med du bsres te dran pa rang yal gyi steng du bla ma'i zhal mthong ba la mkhas par bya'o/ /rmugs na dbyings rig bsre ba ste/las dang po pa'i shes pa mig la gtad na dbyings dang thig le 'char mi srid/shar kyang yul dang yul can las ma 'das pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir na dbyings rig bsre dgos/ de'ang shes pa nang du log nas dag dgos pa yin te/ de'i rtags dbyings thig srab mo tsam du 'gro ba yin/ de'i ngang la bsgoms na dbyings thig 'thug por 'char ba yin te/ de'i tshe dbyings rig dbyer med du 'dres pa yin/ de'i rtags dbyings thig la 'gul 'phrig gi rnam pa yod pa min no/ /nyid kyis 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len par 'dod na/ glen bsgom u tshugs byas pa la snying po med par ma zad/ srog rtsa la las rlung 'jug pa'i grogs su 'gro ba las lo brgyar bskoms kyang grol ba med lags/ de 444

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃphyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zab mo la brten nas 'khor 'das gnyis kyi spyi gzhi gtan la dbab nas 'khor 'das dag mnyam gyi lta ba rtogs dgos pa yin/ de yang 'di nyid rtogs na gdod ma'i grol gzhi byed pa dang /ma rtogs na sems can gyi 'khrul gzhi byed pas spyi gzhi zer ba yin/ mdor na ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i dus gsum yid kyi 'byul ba las gzhan pa'i 'khor ba med pa dang / 'khyul pa'i rtog tshogs zhi ba las gzhan pa'i myang 'das med par shes par gyis la zhib tu gtan la dbab dgos so/ /'khor lo bar pa'i bstan don chos thams cad dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i stong pa chen po dang / 'khor lo tha ma'i bstan don sku dang ye shes bsnyan pa de gnyis/dbyer med zung 'jug chen por kun mkhyen klong dang / 'jam mgon mi pham rnam rgyal sogs kyi bzhed pa yin la/ gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud sde rnams su/ gdod ma'i ye gzhi'am chos sku gzhi gnas kyi rig pa zhes gsungs pa dang / 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i skabs su gzhi bcings grol med pa'i gnas lugs chos zad ka dag gi dgongs pa ngo 'phrod/ lhun grub rang gdangs 'gag pa med pas 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhi ma 'gag par ngo shes/thugs rje'i rol pa yul thog tu shar nas bag chags bsags long med par dran rtogs rjes med du grol bas yid ches/ de gsum gdod nas dbyer med du bzhugs pa la sku gsum dbyer med kyi rig pa'am rig stong zung 'jug zhes snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa rnams kyis bzhed pa yin no/ /ye grol zhes pa ni/gzhi rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba de nyid ye gdod ma nas grol ba'i bdag nyid 445

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃcan yin te/ da gzod 'bad pas sus kyang bkrol mi dgos zhes/ 'bad pa dang rtsol ba'i sgo nas sus kyang bkrol mi dgos te/ grol ba med de grol gzhi rdul tsam med/ /ces gsungs so/ /shar grol zhes khang stong gi rkun ma lta bu'i grol tshul ni/ khang stong la shor rgyu dang rkun ma la thob rgyu med pa ltar rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad bag chags gsog long med par lta ba'i klong der grol ba'o/ /rang grol zhes sbrul gyi mdud pa lta bu'i grol tshul ni/ sgrul mdud de gzhan rkyen la ltos mi dgos par rang stobs kyis zhig 'gro ba ltar rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad rkyen gzhan la ltos mi dgos par rang stobs kyis rang grol ba'o/ /cer grol zhes sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa ltar rtog pa yul la g.yo ba'i tshe dran pas zin tsam nas dran mkhan chos nyid du stor ba'i dus/thog ma'i skyong tshul ma nor ba yin gsungs so/ /rig pa'i ngo rang thog tu sprad pa la/ da ni khyod kyis rig pa'i dbyings 'di la ltos dang / dbyings kun bzang bde ba chen po'i pho brang klong chen chos sku'i mkha' ltar phyal ba'i don 'di ni chos thams cad kyi snang gzhi mthar thug pa/ snod bcud thams cad dbyings 'di la gnas shing / dbyings 'di las g.yos pa skad cig kyang med par/dbyings 'di'i klong du so sor ma 'dres par rgya mtsho la gza' skar shar ba bzhin du rdzogs shing / dbyings kyi rol pa rang byung gi ye shes rang shar zhing rang grol ba chu las chu rlabs g.yo ba ltar bzang ngan med pa'i thugs rje'i rang rtsal kun la khyab pa/ de lta bu'i rig pa 'di ni/ dpe rkyen gsum dang bral ba'i nam mkha' lta bu/don dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa/ rtags rol pa 446

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'agag med du shar nas grol ba/ngo bo chos sku'i dbyings la bltas na/ grub pa'i chos rdul tsam yang med pa ye gzhi ka dag gi dgongs pa rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba/ rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku'i gdangs ma spangs rang gsal gyi rgyan la bltas na/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams dbang yul du snang ba thams cad klong chen chos sku'i rgya mtsho la nam mkha'i gza' skar snang ba bzhin du ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang du rang snang zhing rang gsal ba/ tshogs drug lhug pa'i dgongs pa/ snang srid dag mnyam chen po/ sku dang ye shes kyi nyams snang / bde 'od gsal gyi pho brang sogs rang snang gnas dag gi dkyil 'khor sogs su snang ba dang thugs rje rang byung sprul sku'i ye shes rol pa gnas dag gi 'char tshul la bltas na/ rang byung 'gag pa med pa'i rang gdangs las rang shar ba'i ye shes kyi rol pa 'du 'phro dang bral ba skye 'gag las 'das pa/ma byung ma skyes pa ma 'gag pa'i thugs rje/ shar ba ltar snang yang shar sa dang shar mkhan med/ grol ba ltar snang yang grol rgyu dang grol mkhan med/ thams cad mnyam nyid rig pa'i rol pa 'phro 'du gnas dag gi dgongs pa rgya mtsho las rba rlabs g.yo ba ltar/ dbyings las ma g.yos shing bzang ngan med pa ste/rig pa'i rang bzhin de lta bur ngo 'phrod pa'i gang zag de la nges shes kyi nyams snang bsam las 'das pa'ang 'char zhing / bla ma dang chos la yid ches dang ngesapa gting nas 'drong ba yin no gsungs so/ /mnyam bzhag gi skabs su nyams zhen gyi shun pa dang bral ba'i rig stong zung 'ardug gi dbyings su dus gsum gyi rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad bag chags gsog long med par shar grol 447

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrjes med du dag pa dang / rjes thob kyi skabs su de nyid spyod lam la bsre ba gal che/ brtan cha thob ma thob rmi lam du tshad 'dzin pa yin/rtog pa rang sar grol mi grol rkyen ngan pa dang 'phrad dus go dgos/ yang dag pa'i lam du 'gro mi 'gro mnyam bzhag gi shugs rjes thob spyod lam skabs su dag snang dang snying rje la sogs pas shes par gyis/ rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis ka gsal zhing rig pa tsam du mtshungs kyang / yul ji bzhin mi rig par phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa dang / ji bzhin rig pa gnyis kyi khyad yod la/ gzung 'dzin can gyi rnam shes ldog kyang ye shes mi ldog par shes par bya'o/ /mdor na rnam shes tshogs brgyad las 'das pa'i/ rig stong gnyug ma spros bral rang byung gi ye shes su thad kar rjen par shar ba ngo sprad bar bya'o/ /'od gsal zhes pa ni/ med dgag stong rkyang tsam min te/ dbyings spros bral la rig gdangs kyi cha yod pa'o/ /gzhi las gzhi snang 'char tshul dang / de las zhakhrul grol 'byung tshul/'khrul ba gzhi la ldog nas slar zhakhrul mi srid pa'i tshul shes par bya'o/ /theg brgyad grub mtha'i zhe 'dod kyi 'dzin pa dbyings su zhig pa dang / log rtog 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'di kun thad kar rang sar dag pas tha snyad kyi rdzun ris dbyings su yal nas gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin gzigs pa'o/ /mnyam bzhag gi skabs su shes rig rang tshugs zin pa gnad gal po che yin/ de las gzhan pa'i stong pa nam mkha' 'dra ba sogs la dgos pa ci yang mi 'dug spyod lam gyi skabs su rig ngo dran pas rgyun du skyong ba gal che bas de lugs rem//༈ lags/ thad ka'i shes pa ma bcos par zhog gsungs pa dang / da lta'i 448

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃtha mal gyi shes pa ma bcos par zhog gsungs pa'i don ni thad ka zhes pa brda rnying ste da lta'i ming yin/ da lta zhes pa dus kyi ming yin/ tha mal zhes lus ngag yid gsum bcos bsgyur med par rang gar bsdad pa'i don yin/ de dus kyi shes pa ci yang bsam rgyu dang brjod rgyu med pa de nyid ngang du gnas pa la/ bla ma la las 'di ni ma rig pa yin gsungs/ bla ma la las 'di btang snyom lung ma bstan yin gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches yin ni kun gzhi'i ngang du tha lam rang kar bsdad pa yin gsungs/ spyir tha mal gyi shes pa de la/ phyag 'ga' zhig na 'khrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa/ nyams zhen tha mal gyi shes pa/ 'char gzhi'i 'od gsal tha mal gyi shes pa dang gsum gsungs/ rdzogs chen gyi gzhung ltar na/ mi pham rin po ches tha mal gyi shes pa la bzang ngan gnyis gsungs/ tha mal gyi shes pa zer ba la de ltar khyad mang po yod pa 'di phye ma shes par tha mal gyi shes pa zer tshad gzhi yin na/ zhabs drung rin po che'i zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu las/ bla rnal skabs tha mal gyi shes pa rang 'gags su 'gro bar gsal btab ces gsungs pa de 'od gsal gyi rig pa de nyid 'gag 'gro dgos pa i red/ ha ha/ mdor na 'brul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa rjes mthud med par rang grol du 'gro dgos pa dang / nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum la zhen pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa dbyings su dag dgos pa dang / 'od gsal tha mal gyi shes pa ni/ skye med chos sku'i dbyings na 'gag med zang thal rjen pa'i rig cha sems rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad las 'das pa'i rig stong zung 'jug chen po de nyid ngo rang thog tu 'phrod nas shes rig gi rang tshugs 449

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃzin dgos pa ni shin tu gal che/ de ltar mi shes par gong du mi pham rin po ches gsungs pa'i kun gzhi'i ngang du tha mal rang gar bsdad pa tsam rtog pa mthon por rlom pa ni mi tshe stong zad byed pa las snying po yod par ma mthong gsungs srol yod pa de lugs dgongs chub zhu/ bla ma nas zhus/ dge'o//༄༅/ /semasarig shan 'byed/ lags/ sems rig dbye ba bris shig gsungs pa la/ 'di bya 'di byed dang nyon mongs rnam rtog sogs dang tshogs drug gi yul la zhen cing / bzang ngan sogs dbye zhing re dogs spang blang byed mkhan 'di la sems zer/ de rnams ji ltar shar yang re dogs spang blang ci yang bya mi dgos pa'i skad cig ma'i shes pa gra ma nyams pa/ bying rmugs dang bzang rtog ngan rtog gang gis kyang ma bslad pa'i rig stong rjen pa 'di la rig pa zer ba lags/sems kyi cha thams cad ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtod phur yod pas rnam rtog shar tshad rdo la ri mo bris pa lta bu yin/ rig pa ni gzung 'dzin rang sar dag pas rnam rtog shar tshad shar ba dang grol ba dus mnyam pa chu dang bar snang la ri mo bris pa lta bu yin/ bde gsal mi rtog sogs nyams kyi zhen pa yod pa thams cad kyang sems su gdags la/ nyams zhen rnams rang sar dag nas rang rig rjen pa smra brjod las 'das pa gtad so thams cad dang bral ba'i zang ka ma/ 'di la rig pa dang / chos sku ka dag sogs kyi tha snyad tsam du btags pa yin pas go bar gyis shig lung las/ bsgom ma myong dang bral ma myong / /mi sgom don dang mi 'bral ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi sgom pas sgom pa chen po/ bsgom rgyu spu tsam med la/ yengs su skad cig kyang med pa'i chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor 450

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ /'di dang 'bral ba med par mdzod cig /ces phul lags/༄7/ /thad ka'i shes pa dang tha mal gyi shes pa gnyis kyi go don/ lags/ thad ka'i shes pa ma bcos par zhog gsungs pa dang / da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa ma bcos par zhog gsungs pa'i don/ thad ka zhes pa brda rnying ste da lta'i ming yin/da lta zhes pa dus kyi ming yin/ tha mal zhes pa lus ngag yid gsum bcos bsgrur med par rang gar bsdad pa'i don yin/ de dus kyi shes pa yang bsam rgyu dang brngod rgyu med pa de'i ngang du gnas pa la/ bla ma la las 'di ni ma rig pa yin gsungs/ bla ma la las 'di btang snyoms lung ma bstan yin gsungs/mi pham rin po ches/ yid ni kun gzhi'i ngang du tha mal rang gar bsdad pa yin gsungs/ spyir tha mal gyi shes pa de la/ phyag 'ga' zhig na/ 'khrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa/ nyams zhen tha mal gyi shes pa/ 'char gzhi'i 'od gsal tha mal gyi shes pa dang gsum gsungs/ rdzogs chen gyi gzhung na mi pham rin po ches tha mal gyi shes pa la bzang ngan gnyis gsungs/ tha mal gyi shes pa zer ba la de ltar khyad mang po yod pa 'di phye ma shes par tha mal gyi shes pa zer tshad gzhi yin na/ zhabs drung rin po ches/ zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu las/ bla rnal skabs/ tha mal gyi shes pa rang 'gags su 'gro bar gsal btab ces gsungs pa de 'od gsal gyi rig pa de nyid 'gag 'gro dgos pa e red/ ha ha/mdor na zhakhrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa rjes mthud med par rang grol du 'gro dgos pa dang / nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum la zhen pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa dbyings su dag dgos pa dang / 'od gsal tha mal gyi shes pa ni/ skye med 451
