g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃchos sku'i dbyings na 'gags med zang thal rjen pa'i rig cha sems rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad las 'das pa'i rig stong zung 'jug chen po de nyid ngo rang thog tu 'phrod nas shes rig rang tshugs zin dgos pa ni shin tu gal che/de ltar mi shes par gong du mi pham rin po ches gsungs pa'i kun gzhi'i ngang du tha mal rang gar bsdad pa tsam la rtogs pa mthon por rlom pa ni mi tshe stong zad ṭ+wāṃ kā sna ༵༵ tīng/ po ma mthong gsungs srol yod pas de lugs dgongs chub zhu/༄7ོ/ /'tsho byed sman pa gzhon nus sems don gyi dris lan byis pa'i rna rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir nyid kyis sems don gyi dris lan rdzogs chen sems sde'i nyams rim dang phyogs mtshungs par sbyar nas bshad na/ nyams dang po'i skye lugs ni dpe ri gzar gyi rbab chu dang 'dra ste/chags sdang la sogs pa'i rnam rtog mang du song ba zhig 'ong / de tshe re 'ga' rnam rtog shar ba la skyon du bltas nas dgag sgrub byas pas snying rlung ldang nas tshig pa za ba dang / res nga la sgom mi 'ong bar 'dug snyam nas yi mug skye ba'ang yod/ 'di dus blo tshab tshub mang po mi byed par lus sems lhod pa gnad yin/yang na 'gyu ba ar gtad pa'i man ngag yang zab/ nyams gnyis pa'i skye lugs ni/ dpe chu nang gi byi'u dang 'dra ste/ res chu nang 'dzul/ res steng du thon/ skabs re rdo steng sdod pa dang 'dra/ res 'ga' 'phro/ res 'ga' gnas/'di'i tshe gnas par dga' spro mi bya/ shar ba skyon du mi blta ba gnad yin/nyams gsum pa'i skye lugs ni/ dpe mi rgan dang 'dra ste/ sdod pa shas che 452

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃskabs rer 'phro yang / shas cher gnas pa'i nyams shugs che ba zhig 'ong /de'i tshe sgom yong du re ba dang / ma byung ba'i dogs pa gnyis ka mi bya ba gnad yin/ nyams bzhi pa'i skye lugs ni/ dpe phub ma'i 'og gi chu dang 'dra ste/ lhod che na rnam rtog mi rtog pa 'dra mo 'gyu dran gang yang med pa zhig 'ong / de'i rjes su sgom mkhan rang gis mi tshor ba rnam rtog phra mo 'og 'gyur 'gro ba yin pas 'di dus dran pa cung zad sgrim pa gnad yin/ nyams lnga pa'i skye lugs ni/ dpe ri bo dang 'dra ste/ sems gang du mi 'gro bar nyin mtshan kun tu gnas pa zhig 'byung / 'di nyes na nyan thos 'gog pa'i phyogs su 'gro/legs na zhi gnas phul du phyin pa yin/ 'di'i skabs su nga'i lta ba 'di las lhag pa gzhan su la yod snyam pa'i rang mthong gi nga rgyal skyes nas 'dri sa dang gleng sa tsam med pa'i blun sgom mun rdo 'phen par yang 'gro srid/ de ni byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ma 'brel na dpal sprul rin po che'i bskyed rim lha'i dka' gnad las/ stong nyid kyi go yul yod pa/ bskyed rim gyi gsal snang thon pa/ bzlas pa'i grangs 'khyol ba du ma byams snying rje dang bral nas rgyal 'gong du skye ba yin ces yang yang zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pas gzab par bya dgos/ mdor na zhi gnas kyi nyams mi rtog pa de nyid lhag mthong gsal ba'i ye shes kyis sad par byas nas zhi lhag zung 'brel du bsgom pa gnad yin pas thugs la nges par zhu zhes phran chos dbyings rang grol nas phul/༄༅/ /shar rgyal mo rong ba 'jigs med ye shes la yig 'dzar phul ba/'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam ma nor ba de brgyud ldan gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten 453

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdagos pas bsags sbyang spel gsum gyi gnad 'dus pa bla rnal la 'bad pa gal che/ de nas o rgyan pad+ma dang rang sems dbyer med bsres la/ bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog gang gis kyang ma bslad cing spang blang dgag sgrub kyi rtsol bas ma gos pa'i gshis rang babs kyi rig cha rjen pa de shes par byas te/ phyi'i yul snang mi snang dang / nang rnam rtog 'char mi 'char sogs la rjes 'ded rtsis 'debs gang yang mi bya bar/ rig pa zang thal gyi ngang las ma g.yos pa la bslab/ cung zad yengs grab byed tshe yang / nga yengs 'gro 'am zhes dang / 'di ltar yengs 'dug ces dang / mi g.yeng pa'i phyir du gnyen po ji ltar bsten na drag ces sogs tsab tsub zang zing gtan nas mi byed par rig pa de ka hur phyung la gshis thog tu sa bzung / mdor na ngo sprod gegs sel bog 'don thams cad kha kha so so mang po mi dgos/ da lta'i rig pa ngo bo mi rtog pa/ gdangs ma 'gags pa/ rtsal phyogs med du 'char ba nyams su myong yang brngod mi shes pa de ga'i rang 'gros bzo med du skyong bas chog par gsungs yod pas thugs la zungs mdzod/ nga rang nad ros mnar nas zhal gdams slob ston zer ba'i za zi'i rigs ci yang 'bri long med kyang khyed thag ring nas 'ong ba sha tsha nas glen gtam yig nag tu phab te byin pa dge bar gyur cig /༄༅/ /bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs la gdam sa pa /kye lags/ mtshungs med drin chen bla ma rin po che/ /'dug pa'i dus su spyi bo'i gcug tu bsgom/ /yang yang gsol ba thob la dbang bzhi longs/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i dgos pa yod/ /spyod lam skabs su gzugs snang bla ma'i sku/ /sgra grags thams cad 454

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃgasung gi rang bzhin dang / /dran rtog bzang ngan thugs su 'byer shes na/ /snang srid bla mar 'char ba'i gdams ngag yin/ /za ba'i dus su mgrin pa'i dbus su bsgom/ /bza' btung bdud rtsi'i phud kyis legs mchod na/ /bza' bca' btung ba'i sgrib pa mi 'byung zhing / /dga' ston tshogs su 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ /nyal ba'i dus su snying gi dkyil du bsgom/ /sku yi 'od kyis brtan g.yo'i snang ba kun/ /'od du gyur nas slar yang rang la bsdus/ /rmi lam 'od gsal 'char ba'i gdams ngag yin/ /nam zhig mi sdod phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshe/ /blo sna tshab tshub mang po mi byed par/ /rang rig bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med du/ /'jog pa 'pho ba kun kyi rgyal po yin/ /khyod dang nga gnyis mi tshe gang po la/ /mnyam du bsdad kyang 'di las lhag pa yi/ /zab pa'i man ngag bdag la 'bul rgyu med/ /de phyir snying gi dbus su 'di zungs shig /ces chos mthun gyi skyes bu dam pa bsod nams phun tshogs nas yang yang zhal gdams zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i tshe bzhed skong ldog min tsam du mdo med kyi sprang po chos dbyings rang grol nas bris pa'o/ /dge zhing bkra shis/༄7/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin bla ma de mkhyen no/ /sems rig la shan 'byed pa'i man ngag 'di shes na/ /snang ba'i mdun na mun pa mi gnas pa bzhin du/ /sna tshogs nyams la zhen pa'i shun pa de 'thor ba'i/ /rig stong zang thal rjen pa'i bzhugs tshul la gzigs shig /gang shar rang sar grol ba'i gnad gsang 'di shes na/ /gser gling sa rdo phal pa mi rnyed pa bzhin du/ /blo la gang shar chos sku'i yo lang du shar 455

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnas/ /bag chags gsogs long med pa'i grol tshul la gzigs shig /ces bu mchog bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gdams pa'o/ /༄tsho/ /zhal gdamasabazhugs/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo dpal mgon bla ma yin/ /snang srid bla ma'i rnam rol du/ /'bral bar ma byed rigs kyi bu/ /'dug pa'i dus su spyi bor sgoms/ /gsol ba thob la dbang bzhi longs/ /za ba'i dus su mgrin par sgoms/ /bza' btung bdud rtsi'i phud kyis mchod/ /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu sgoms/ /rang rig bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho/ /thugs yid dbyer med ngang la zhog /'pho ba kun kyi rgyal po yin/ /dge'o// ༈ mtha' med zhalor ba yi khrod na/ /zin med tshe 'di yi bya bzhag /nyin mtshan bar med du bsgrubs kyang / /'grub pa'i dus tshod ni mi 'dug /ngal ba don med du mthong nas/ /dben pa'i ri ngogs su phebs te/ /phyi mar 'gro chas re byas na/ /rang drin rang la ni che 'o/ /ra bsha' rnga brdung gi gto rgan/ /dka' ba'i khur chen zhig khur nas/ /'phrang ring bar do ru phebs dus/ /khyod la 'o brgyal zhig 'ong gi /tshe gang gto yas la 'byams kyang / /lon lon rig rgyu ni mi 'dug /da ni chog shes re byas nas/ /dkor sbyong legs po re mdzad ran/ /zhes chos dbyings rang grol nas bris pa dge/༄༅/ /mdo pa gdams ngag rgya mtsho la gdams pa/ bla ma lags/ dal ba'i rten 'di rnyed par dka' bas tshe 'di'i bya ba la blo ldog dgos pa dang gcig rnyed par dka' ba rnyed kyang 'chi bar sla bas rtag 'dzin gyi blo ldog dgos pa dang gnyis/ shi nas las 'bras kyi rjes su 'brangs pas mi dge ba'i las la blo 456

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃldog dgos pa dang gsum/ 'khor ba'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas mtho ris thob 'dod kyi blo yang ldog dgos pa dang bzhi/mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyu dge ba bsgrubs pa las byung ba yin pas sgo gsum dge ba la 'jug dgos pa dang lnga/ lam gyi ded dpon drin chen gyi bla ma yin pas ci mdzad chos su mthong ba'i sgo nas mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten dgos pa dang drug go/ /'di dag rnams la thun mong phyi yi sngon 'gro'i khrid rkang drug tu grags pa yin no/ /sdom pa thams cad kyi gzhi rten skyabs 'gro yin pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos pa dang gcig /rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gshegs shul gyi lam po che yin pas/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dgos pa dang gnyis/ lam gyi 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib yin pas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i snyom bzlas la brtson dgos pa dang gsum/ lam gyi mthun rkyen tshogs bsags yin pas sku gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul dgos pa dang bzhi/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyi 'byung khungs ngar 'dzin yin pas ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i dus gsum yid kyi 'brul ba chos nyid kyi dbyings su gcod dgos pa dang lnga/mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bla ma bsgoms pa las byung ba yin pas snang srid bla mar shar ba'i bskyed rim dang / thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i rdzogs rim la nyams len gyi snying po mdzad dgos pa dang drug go/ /'di dag rnams la ni thun min nang gi sngon 'gro'i khrid rkang drug tu grags pa yin no/ /lam gyi sun ma 'pho ba yin pas rang rig bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer 457

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmed du 'jog pa 'pho ba kun gyi rgyal po yin zhing gnad zab pas cis kyang nyid kyi thugs la zungs shig ces mdo ba gdams ngag rgya mtsho la chos dbyings rang grol gyis gdams pa'o/ /dge'o//༄7/ /mdo pa gdams ngag rgya mtsho rang yul du phebs dus gces nor du gdamasapa/ bla ma lags/ nyams len gyi snying po ni/ mnyam bzhag gi skabs su nyams zhen gyi shun pa dang bral ba'i rig stong zang thal gyi ngang nas dus gsum gyi rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad bag chags bsags long med par rang shar rang grol du 'gro dgos pas lta ba gdengs dang ldan pa gal che/ rjes thob kyi dus su dran pas zin pa tsam nas dran mkhan chos nyid kyi dbyings su grol nas chos nyid kyi ngang du rgya 'byams dgos pas yengs pa'i tshe dran pas zin pa gal che/ zhes mdo ba gdams ngag rgya mtsho rang yul du phebs dus gces nor du gdams pa yin no// ༈ phrin yig zhal gdams dang sbrel te gnang ba/ bla ma dam pa gang gi phyag tu/ gang sku bde bar bzhugs pas dga' spro 'phel/ 'dir snyom las pa yang bde skabs lags/ spyir 'dus byas mi rtag pa zhabor ba'i chos nyid yin pas bya thabs bral ba la thugs ngal ma mdzad/ khyad par nyams len gyi skabs sngar zhus pa las lhag pa med kyang / nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang/ byang chub kyi sems/ dad pa dang dag snang sogs gzhir byas nas/ gdod ma'i ye gzhi bcings grol med pa'i gnas lugs chos zad ka dag gi dgongs pa da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa spu ma brje/ mdog ma bsgyur bar sangs rgyas su ngo 'phrod/ lhun grub kyi gdangs 'gag pa med pa 'khoX ḍidas kyi 'char gzhi ma 'gag par ngo

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃshes/ thugs rje'i rtsal yul thog tu shar yang bag chags bsags long med par dran rtog rjes med du yal ba chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin du/ gang shar rang grol du shar ba la yid ches/ de lta bu'i gnas lugs kyi ngo sprod phyin ci ma log pa zhig thob nas rig pa yin lugs kyi steng du 'jog pa gal che ba dang / lung ma bstan gyi la shan 'byed tshul gsungs skabs/ bsnom bya'i yul dang sgom byed kyi blo dbyings su nub nas chos nyid kyi ngang du rgya 'byams pa dang / rnam rtog bag la nyal ba'i sems rtse gcig gi sgom pa dbyings lung ma bstan gyi ngang du dus 'da' ba gnyis la nor 'khrul med par thugs la nges par zhu zhes phran chos dbyings rang grol nas phul/༄༅/ /rdo le kha spu can la gdams pa/bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid nas kha tsam ma yin par snying nas dam pa'i chos zhig sgrub par 'dod na/las 'bras bslu med la yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed nas blang dor byed pa dang gcig /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar 'dod kyi blo shugs drag po bcos min rgyud la skye ba dang gnyis/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad drin chen gyi pha mar shes nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che sgom pa dang gsum/ phyi nang snod bcud kyi gnas tshul sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pas dag snang sbyang pa dang bzhi/ chos dang dam tshig gis bsdus pa rnams rdo rje'i spun grogs yin pas brtse gdung rgyun chad med par byed pa dang lnga/dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo drin chen gyi bla ma yin pas yid khyed shes kyi dad pas gsol 'debs byas te thu/༷ yid dbyer med du bsre ba dang drug

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnyams zhen gyi sbubs dang bral ba'i rig stong zang thal gyi lta ba yang dag gnyug ma'i dran pas rgyun du skyong ba dang bdun po 'di nyid nyin mtshan thang lhod med ༵ṭ+wā+oṃ /nya//sna trom̐/na/ mdzad par zhu zhu zhes bla ma nas rdo le kha spu can la gdams ༄tsho/ /bstan 'dzin ngor gdams pa/ bla ma lags/ 'khor ba la zhen log gi nges 'byung / gzhan phan don du gnyer ba'i byang sems/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i dag snang ste/ gnad gsum dang bral na chos gang bsgrub kyang kha chos yin la don chos min pa sngar zhus ltar dang / khyad par nyams len gyi skabs su/ tshogs drug gi yul la g.yengs kyang dran pas zin pa tsam gyis sems gsal stong tsam du gnas pa dang / rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du dang bral ba'i had de gnas pa'i stong cha ngos bzung bral ba dang / sgo lnga'i gdangs ma 'gag la yid kyi rnam shes gsal la mi rtog pa dang / 'char tshul 'di gsum la rdzogs chen gyi man ngag du ma nas byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan tsam skye ba'i rten byed pa yin gsungs yod pa la thugs bzhag mdzod/ gzhan yang / rtog med rang gsal yul dang ma 'dres pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang / rlung sems kyi bzhon pa bltar mi mngon pa'i dbyings dwangs pa'i rig pa'i cha 'od gsal gyi gdangs ma 'gag pa gnyis la lta thog nas la shan 'byed pa gnad dam pa'o/ /zhes bstan 'dzin ngor bris so/ /'khor ba la nges 'byung / sems can la snying rje/ kun la dag snang / bla ma la mos gus sogs gzhir bzhag gi steng nas nyams len byed dgos pa yin/ mnyam bzhag gi skabs su bde gsal mi rtog 460

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃl sogs pa'i nyams zhen gyi shun pa dang bral ba'i rig stong zung 'jug gi dbyings su/ nga rgyal dang khong khro/ phrag dog dang zur za/ gzhan la khyad gsod kyi rtog pa sogs skye ba dang grol ba dus mnyam du song nas bag chags bsags long med pa la phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba rnam dag gsungs pa lags/ rjes thob kyi skabs su chos rnams bden med rmi lam lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas nyams len spyod lam la bsre ba dang tshogs bsags pa gal che zhing / de ltar ma yin par rang rgyud kyi chags sogs nyon mongs pa shar grol lta ci re zhig mgo non tsam yang med par/ nga ni sgom yin/ nga rang la yengs 'khrul med zer ba rnams ni bzhad gad kyi gnas yin zhes bla ma nas so/ /༄7ོ/ /rgu nang bla ma 'jigs med rang grol la gdams pa/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'brug pa rdo rje 'chang la gus pas 'dud do thugs rjes zungs/ gang dag sems las 'das pa'i ye shes chen po lam du byed pa'i tshul la/ kun gzhi dang chosasku/sems dang ye shes la sogs dbye ba mang du yod mod kyang / blun sgom mun rdo 'phen pa bdag 'dras rdo rje'i tshig rnams dgrol bar ga la nus/ de phyir gnas pa dang ni rtsal gyi shan 'byed ri mo'i mar me bzhin du 'di na spro/ de la gnas pa ngo bo'i shan 'byed dang 'phro ba rtsal gyi shan 'byed de gnyis las/ dang po la sems kyi ngo bo dang rig pa'i ngo bo de gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsal la rtog med tsam du sems dang rig pa mtshungs na'ang / kun mkhyen gnyis pas/sems ni lteng ka lta bur 'khyil zhing rmongs/ zhes gsungs pas shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' las 'das pa'i klong na rang bzhin lhun 461

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgrub kyi gdangs nang gsal thim la ma rmugs pa'i shin tu phra ba'i ye shes dper na gnam stong gi zla ba mkha' dbyings su 'khyil ba lta bu yin te/ cang med stong rkyang du 'dod pa ni min te/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ rig pa gnam stong zla ba gting gsal 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa 'phro ba rtsal gyi shan 'byed la'ang gnyis las/ dang po sems kyi rtsal ni/ thog mar yul la shar/ bar du dran pas zin/ tha ma nang du log pa de ni gzung 'dzin las ma 'das pa'i chos so/ /gnyis pa rig pa'i rtsal ni/ shar ba dang grol ba dus mnyam du song nas shar grol dbye ba'i mkhan po dbyings su dag nas gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thad kar du zhig pa'o/ /tshul 'di bla ma 'jigs med rang grol nas lan grangs du ma'i bar du bskul tshe bzhed skong ldog min tsam du chos med sprang po smyon pa'i ngang tshul can des myur du bris/ dge'o//༄7/ /rdo le kha spu can la gdams pa'i nyams len gnad bdun ma/ rig pa'i ngo bo stong pa/ gdangs rang gsal 'gag pa med pa/ thugs rje ris med par khyab pa'i gshis kyi bzhugs tshul ngo 'phrod phan chad/ de'i ngang la 'gags med shugs 'byung du 'jog pa ma gtogs/ bsal bzhag spro bsdu dang / yin min rtsis gdab sogs rdul phra rab tsam yang bya rgyu med pa legs/ dhā zhi badz+ra gyi zhal nas/ rgya grol rnal 'byar nam langs nyi shar 'dra/ /chas sku'i snang ba yin no e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid nas kha tsam ma yin par snying nas dam pa'i chos shig sgrub par 'dod na las 'bras bslu med la yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed nas blang dor byed pa dang 462

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgacig 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar 'dod kyi blo shugs bcos min rgyud la skye ba dang gnyis/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad drin chen gyi pha mar shes nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che sgom pa dang gsum/ phyi nang snod bcud gnas tshul sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pas dag snang sbyang pa dang bzhi/ chos dang dam tshig gis bsdus pa rnams rdo rje'i spun grogs yin pas brtse gdung rgyun chad med par byed pa dang lnga/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo drin chen kyi bla ma yin pas yid khyed shes kyi dad pas gsol 'debs byas te thugs yid dbyer med du bsre ba dang drug /nyams zhen gyi shun pa dang bral ba'i rig stong zang thal gyi lta ba yang dag gnyug ma'i dran pas rgyun du skyong ba dang bdun po 'di nyid nyin mtshan thang lhod med par zhu zhu zhes bla ma nas rdo le kha spu can la gdams pa'o/ /dge'o/ /༄༅/ /me thugs la gdamasapa/ bde ldan zhing gi mgon po'i thugs ka'i hrīḥ/ /sizlo'i dwangs mtshor smin pa'i mtsho skyes rjes/ /sprul pa'i rol gar zhing rdul grangs mnyam pa'i/ /thugs sras rje 'bangs brgyud bcas rgyal gyur cig /kye lags/ /chos med chos gzugs sprang po smyon pa bdag /gal te khyod kyi bla mar 'dzin srid na/ /dgos med ral rdzong 'thug po rtsad nas chod/ /sor gsum gtsug skra'i mchod pa mkhan por phul/ /mthing gos zlum po'i snam phran lus la gyon/ /lhags phran snal ma ser po'i ska rags chongs/ /rab tu byung ba'i bsil khang la zhugs nas/ /ngur smig rgyal mtshan 'dzin la snying stobs skyed/ /dpa' bo'i lcang lo mi breg zur 'chang nas/ /bde stong dga' bzhi'i ro la dgyes rol 463

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyang / /de 'dra'i shag po ma red sku tshe ring / /las ngan zog po'i gral du lhung la khad/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka'i spyod ngan sna tshogs la/ /yang yang bsams na mig nas mchi ma 'thor/ /bsam zhing bsams na gdungs ba'i smre sngags 'di/ /mi 'don rang dbang rang la mi 'dug gi /deng dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mar gsham 'dir/ /rdzun gyi rnal 'byor mang pos ljongs 'dir gang / /rgyan med ral rdzong 'thug pos mgo bo 'phyings/ gtum mo mi shes ras gos gos su gyon/ /thabs lam mi shes nag mo'i gzhang sgo 'grim/ /nyin mtshan med par byi rkun byed pa 'di/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gsungs kyang / /gter rdzun stu la dga' ba'i khyad chos lags/ /dgos 'brel mi shes 'phyor sgeg bsam pa yis/ /rna cha gdu bu sogs kyis lus po brgyan/ /grub rdzun spyon pa bag ma'i ngang tshul can/ /'di mthong mi skyo sems ldan su zhig yod/ /gnad med stong 'ur byed pa'i gter rdzun 'gas/ /bla gter brgyad dang thugs gter chen po lnga/ /zab pa'i gter chen nyer lnga la sogs pa'i/ /ming tsam mi shes gter bzhes lta ci smros/ /gcig gis gcig la nag mo ma bsten na/ /khyod kyi srog gi dbang po 'gag la khad/ /sha dang rus pa'i tshogs kyang zhig tu nye/ /kho bor 'byung 'gyur lung bstan byung ngo lo/ /de skad smra ba'i zog po chos rdzun mkhan/ /tshul 'chal sdom pa shor la gter yum zhes/ /ngo tsha khrel med grong gi khyi phag bzhin/ /nag mo las ngan rnams la shi spar 'tham/ /gza' tshang mi sos mi tshe sdug gis zad/ /dbyar dgun gnyis la sprang dbyug sprang snye bzung / /dus rnams kun tu ngan shag 'thab mo byas/ /spyon pa 'dis ni rang skyon mi 46tsho1

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsems kyi/ /ban btsun pho mo rnams la dka' log dang / /khyod kyis 'gro don dpag med 'byung ba ni/ /bslu ba med do pad+ma'i lung bstan zhes/ /mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyi cho nge 'debs/ /zog po ngan sgyug mkhan 'dis cir smras kyang //snying nas brtse ba'i brtse ldan grogs khyed kyis/ /de 'dra'i spyod ngan bsten pa lta ci smos/ /thos par gyur na rna ba mdzub mos khob/ /'phung byed nag mo mang po'i khyo ga 'di/ /gter ston yin na gter min de su zhig /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa mi shes kyang / /tha na ma ṇi phreng skor gcig kyang med/ /da dung dad gshin dkor la longs spyad nas/ /rang mgo mi thon ro mgor hig sgra byed/ /mtshan mo nag mo rnams dang lhan cig nyal/ /'di las smyon pa srid 'dir su zhig yod/ /ngan spyod sna dgu byed pa'i gter rdzun 'di/ /yul na yod kyang bstan pa spyi yi dgra/ /dgon du gnas na spyod ngan kun la 'go/grong du bsdad kyang kun la byi rkun byed/ /pad+ma'i zab gter 'di la mi dbang kyang /las ngan nag mo mang po'i lto ba nas/ /shi gson byis pa mang po gter nas drangs/ /sus mthong mi yis log lta skye nges bya/ /'khrul med gling pa bcu gsum la sogs pa'i/ /gter ston brgya dang rtsa brgyad byon mod kyang / /'di 'dra'i gter ston de sngon ma byon pas/ /'di yi mtshan la byi gter zhes su gsol/ /'gro ba bslu ba'i gter rdzun 'ga' zhig gis/ /btsun ma sdom ldan rnams kyi sdom pa bshig /'di 'dra'i grong sngags skya min ser min gyi/ /lus de nam yang len par ma gyur cig /ces mdo khams pa grub dbang rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa 'brug pa rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor 465

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adzin pa'i btsun pa kun bzang gzhan phan mtha' yas su 'bod pas thugs mchog la gdams pa dge'o/ /sabo dā su she yo maṅga la/ bha waskyo/༄༅/ /yang mnyam bzhag gi rang sazin kyang de nyid rkyen dang bsres nas rtogasapa'i rtsal sbyang ma byas na gnyen posarkyen mi thub pas/ mnyam bzhag legs po de'i klo+ong na rtog ngan gyi dug sprul 'jigs su rung ba mang po gnas gcig tu 'tshogs nas sdod pa lta bu yin pas/ mdzes ma'i gzugs sogs chags yul yid du 'ong ba dang / gzhan gyis brnyas smod sogs sdang ba'i yul rkyen gang rung re'i dbang gis khong khro dang 'dod chags sogs mngon du gyur 'ong ba de/ rang rgyud kyi sgom de'i klong nas byung ba min na sha las mi 'byung khrag dang lngags pa dang rus pa dang rkang sogs gang las byung soms shig de dag sbyang ma thub na zhe sdang gi dbang gis dmyal ba/ 'dod chags kyi dbang gisayi dwags/ gti mug gis dud 'gro/ phrag dog gisalha min/ nga rgyal gyisalha sogasasu skye ba thos grol gyi gzhung na gsal ba ltar yin pas de dag sbyang dgos/ de yang ji ltar sbyang ba'i tshul ni/ rgya gar grub chen tshos dang po dben pa'i gnas su mnyam bzhag la brtan pa thob pa'i rjes su tshogs dus sogs su song nasami mang gi rgyu 'grul dang bde sdug sogasal bltas nas rtsal sbyang / de nasagrong dbus mi gtsang ba slogs te gtsang rme'i gnyis rtog la rtsal sbyang pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pa gcod pa'i sar phyin te mig 'byin pa dang rkang lag gcod pa gsod pa sogs la bltas te sems can rang rgyud pa dang snying rjes rang rgyud pa la rtsal sbyang / de nasadur khrod du phyin te gcan gzan ga65 po 466

gasnye khog bla ma chosadabyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ snedang mi ma yin gdug pa can sogs mthong na 'jigs skrag la rtsal sbyang pa sogs mdzad pa ltar/ gnas ri rtse mtsho gling skyed mo'i tshal sogasasu phyin nasamig gis gzugs mthong na de la yang yang blta/ rna bas sgra thosan yang yang nyan pa sogs dang yid la ci shar yang 'char du bcug ste ngag nasakyang ming brjod sems rtog kyang yul la 'phro bcug ste yul ka ba lta bu gcig gi steng du 'byams pa gcod pa'i phyir ka ba'o snyam pa'i de ma thag bum pa'o/ /lda'o/ khreng ngo zhes pa lta bur kha spo zhing rtsa ba rig pa'i rang sa ma shor bzhin shes pa yul la 'phror gzhug ste rig thog tu grol ba la bslabs pas rkyen ngan dang rnam rtog gang shar rig pa'i rtsal sbyang du 'char nus pa ni dper na bla ma zhad rin po ches dbu brag phug la brdab pa dang zhabs rkang la tsher ma zug pa yang bde stong du 'char nus pa bzhin no/ /de ltar rtsal sbyang bya ba ni/ las dang po pa la rig pa ngo sprod pa'i dus su nyams zhen gyi shun pa gtor ba'i thabs dang nyams len la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag gis rkyen thub kyi rtogs pa 'phel ba'i ched du bya ba ste/ ma mtha' zhag po brgya re tsam la nges par slob dgos gsungs/ /༄tsho/ /kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ rang ngo 'phrod kyang gomasa'adres ma byas na/ /rnam rtog dgras khyer g.yul ngo bu chung 'dra/ /zhes dang /las rlung ye shes klong du ma gyur bar/ /gnyug ma'i yin lugs sus kyang mthong ba med/ /ces dang / ji srid snang ba'i 'du shesam zad par/ /de srid rgyal ba'i dgongasapa lon pa med/ /cesadang / kun mkhyen klo+ong chen pas/ lhun grub snang bzhi'i sa rgya ma chod par/ /ji ltar byasakyang rdzogs pa po min/ /zhes467

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasungs/ tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ da ni blta rgyu mi blta rgyu/ /med de gar bzhag 'dra ba des/ /kha rog bsdad pa 'dra ba yi/ /ji yang bya rgyu ma rnyed pa/ngo bo dang po mthong ba ste/ tha mal shes pa ming du btags/ /de yi ngang du gnas tsam na/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs/ tshogs drug snang ba gang shar yang / /sna tshogs so sor gsal mod kyang / /de dus 'dzin pa so sor med/ /gzugs rnams sna tshogs gang mthong yang //byis pas lha khang mthong ba bzhin/ /sna tshogs mthong yang 'dzin pa med/ /snyan dang mi snyan sgra rnams kyang / /so sor thos kyang chags sdang med/ /brag ri khyod kyi sgra skad bzhin/ /chu nang shar ba'i zla gzugs bzhin/ /rnam pa so sor gsal na yang / /ngo bo stong pa nyid du snang //rang grol chu dang chu rlabs bzhin/ /chos kyi bdag med de la zer/ /stong nyid yongs rdzogs rtogs mod kyang / /da rung yengs skabs brjed skabs mang / /yengs tshe tha mal 'khrul pa ste/ /nyon mongs gang skyes tha mal ba/ /'di skabs dran pas yang dang yang / /gsal gdab byed pa gar che snang / /yengs dang ma yengs khyad par med/ /dran dang ma dran khyad par med/ /'brul dang ma zhabrul khyad par med/ /thams cad stong par 'dug snyam pa'i/ /go ba skyes te re 'ga' skyes/ /de la gdeng bcas lhod drag na/ /tha mal nyid du 'chor nyed yod/ /go ba rtogs pa byed pa gces/ /da rung dran pa'i gsal 'debs ni/ /ma brjed yang dang yang du dgos/ /cis phyir zhe na na dug lnga yi/ /rtog pa ma non tshig ngan sogs/ /the tshom de lan sgra shor sogs/ /'byung ba yengs ba'i skyon du nges/ /de ni dran rjes yang yang dgos/ /zhes gsungs/ o rgyan rin po ches/468

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyun thung grangs mang khang stong thig pa bzhin/ /ma yengs ma sgom lhod de hrig ge lhoṭ+wāṃng/ṭ+wāṃs/ gsungs/ da res 'phro mthud pa la gzhug ma'i de nyid yod/ ces ༄7/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bsgom la dad pas/ /rang rig don gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs las shar ba'i/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus bla ma yi sprul pa/ /rang sems rtsal du shar ba'i dngos grub zhig zhu'o/ /dang po phyi ru bzung nas gsol 'debs dang mos gus/ bar du sems dang bsres nas thugs yid gnyis mtshams sbyor/ /mthar thug dbyer med ro gcig sangs rgyas su grol nas/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam de 'grub shog /ces bla ma sgrub thabs gsol 'debs mos gus la brten pa 'brug pa rin po che'i ṭīṭ+wāṃ~X /la/ spyi bor len pa chos dbyings rang grol nas bris pa dge 'o/ /sabo ༄༅/ /spyo+or dngos mjug gsum tshang bas dam pa'i lha chos sgrub tshul/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos gang bsgrub pa'i thog mar kun slong bcos pa gal che bas/dang po rang gi sems la brtags te/ lung ma bstan gyi kun slong / mi dge ba'i kun slong / dge ba'i kun slong gsum las/ dang po lung ma bstan gyi kun slong ni/ chos gral du tshogs tshe lta bur ci bsam 'di bsam med par/ dad sogs dge ba'i bsam pas ma zin chags sogs mi dge ba'i dbang du ma song bar/ mi dred kyi mi'i lad mo lta bu/ mi rjes khyi zhen pa lta bu/ byis pas me tog thu ba lta bu/ mda' stong 'phen 'dra ba dang / gzhan sbyor dngos rjes gsum gang 469

g.yu khog bla ma chos dgings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃyang med par rang gar mnyam bzhag tu 'dug pa mi rgan chad po ma' len pa ngal bsos pa lta bu ha rgan log pa 'dra ba rnams bcos/ dpal sprul rin po che'i zhal gsungs/ lung ma bstan gyi dge sbyor la 'bras bu med pas thar ba'i sa bon tsam yang mi theb gsungs/ bla ma lung rtogs nas gang zag dbang btsan du byas na de ltar yin mod chos dbang btsan byas na chos kyi byin rlabs kyis thar ba'i sa bon tsam thebs gsungs/ gnyis pa mi dge pa'i kun slong ni/ gnyen la chags pa/ dgra la sdang ba/ bar ma la gti mug ste mdor na dug gsum dang 'dres pa'i kun slong dang gzhan tshe 'di sgrub 'dod kyis/ dgra gdon na tsha sogs zhi byed 'jigs skyobs dang chos brgyad du zhen nas gzhan gyis rnyed bstod snyan grags dkor kha grong chog sogs legs smon gyi kun slong rnams rtsa ba dug gsum la zug pas spong dgos pa ni/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /zhes gsungs/ gsum pa dge ba'i kun slong la'ang / rang 'dod sgrub pa'i kun slong dang gzhan don sgrub pa'i kun slong gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang ngan song gsum las thar nas mngon mtho thob 'dod skyes bu chung ngu'i kun slong ste/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /zhes gsungs/ rang 'khor ba las nges par 'byung te rang 'bras don du gnyer ba skyes bu 'bring nyan rang gi kun slong ste/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /zhes gsungs pas kun slong de dag spang dgos/ gnyis pa gzhan don sgrub pa skyes bu chen po'i kun slong ni/nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pas/ skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing 470

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃngam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni las dang po bas zhal phyag mtshan ma'i rnam pa sogs gsal ma thub kyang mos sgom gyi skabs 'dir chog la/ de yang gu ru rin po che rang gis/ gzhan gang zag las la bzang ngan/ lus la pho mo/ rig la mtho dman/ na tshod la rgan gzhon med par su zhig gis nga nyid dran pas mos shing dad pa'i sgo de la byon gsungs pa ni/ dad pa can la pad 'byung sgo nyal yod/ /gsungs pas des na rang gi spyi bor skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo o rgyan rdo rje 'chang ye shes kyi phung por bzhugs yod snyam pas dad pa mos gus rtse gcig tu bskyed/ dad pa de yang khams gsum 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rgya ma/tsho ru nges pas de las sgrol ba'i nus pa rang nyid dang gzhan pha ma nye 'brel ri dang shing gi lha dang tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug sogs la med par shes nas/ de las sgrol ba'i nus pa su la yod na skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag gu ru rin po che la yod par shes pa'i shes pa gnyis tshogs pa shes thob kyi dad pa bskyed dgos la/ ji skad du/ shes las byung ba'i dad pa ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis bzhed/ /ces gsungs pas dad pa mos gus drag pos gu ru rin po che de nyid sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun te dkon mchog kun 'dus/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ste rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku ste sku gsum kun 'dus te skyabs gnas dgu'i bdag nyid du mos pa dang / gzhan yang gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ dur khrod po'i gnas brgyad/ he ru ka'i gnas bcu sogs na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam pa dang / mdor na/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang 471

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃnas/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud de brgyud pa de dag nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar dang / rang la yi ge slob pa'i slob dpon yan chad/ gzhan dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje'i mched grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams dang / tha na gos dmar ser tsam 'dzin pa dang /rang la phan btags pa'i pha ma dgra gdon sogs dang sems med sa rdo'i rnam pa yan chad 'dus par bsam pa kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom zhing /de yang ji skad du/ gzhan yang skyabs gyur re sa rnams o rgyan bdag la rdzogs par somasaḥ zhes dang / o rgyan pad+ma nga nyid laḥ mos gus gdung shugs drag po yisaX gsol ba drag tu btab pa'i tshe nga nyid de yi drung du byonaḥzhes dang / lha sku 'bum phrag sgom pa bsaX bla ma'i sku gcig sgom pa mchog zhes dang / nga bsgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grubaḥ nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthongaX nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yinaX mos gus can gyi drung du niḥ nga nyid 'du 'bral med par gnasaḥ zhes dang / ji skad du/ o rgyan nga nyid rnga yab dpal ri nasaX gces pa'i bu ngu ma yis mi bzod ltaraḥ byin gyis rlob byon dam tshig na ra kanaX zhes dang / bod kyi rgyal blon bu slob laX byung ngo zla ba'i tshes bcu laX nga nyid byon pa'i dbu basmung mdzadaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas gzhan mi bsluḥ zhes sogs rdo rje'i zhal bzhes bslu med mang pos mos gus can gyi drung du byon pa dbu basmung mdzad pa yin pas/ dad pa can la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rtags su de'i dus su dus gsum yid gyi 'khrul rtog dang bde gsal mi rtog sogs nyams zhen rang 'gags su 'gro ba'o/ /bla ma rgyang 'bod lan 472

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasum gyi bla ma mkhyen dang por 'khor ba zhen log gi nges 'byung rgyud la skye ba'i ched du zhabor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas de las thar 'dod zhen log gi sna drangs nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad de las nges par 'byung ba zhig khyed mkhyen snyam pas so thar lam gyi rtsa ba nges 'byung dang 'brel/bla ma mkhyen gnyis pa'i dus/ gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byang chub sems rgyud la skye ba'i ched du sdug bsngal ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje byang chub sems kyis sna drangs nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal de las thar te sangs rgyas thob pa zhig khyed mkhyen snyam pas byang sems lam gyi rtsa ba dang 'brel/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum po khyed mkhyen no/ /zhes gsum pa'i dus su snang srid dag mnyam gyi lta ba rtogs pa'i ched du 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad gnas tshul sku dang ye shes lha sngags chos nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pa de nyid snang tshul de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad dang bral nas gnas tshul sku dang ye shes mngon du gyur pa zhig khyed mkhyen snyam pas gsang sngags lam gyi rtsa ba dang 'brel/ de ni sngags kyi snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang yang yin la sems bskyed kyang yin no/ /de nas blo ldog rnam bzhi'i gnad bsdus ni/dal 'byor rnyed dka' thob pa da res tsam/ /gsungs pas dal brgyad 'byor bcu rang la tshang ngam mi tshang legs par brtags te ma tshang na de tshang pa'i thabs la 'bad/ tshang na de lta bu'i lus rten phun sum tshogs pa de/ rgyu dpe grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' tshul la bsams te/ dal 'byor chud za ba tshe 'dir snang gi bya ba bsgrub pa las blo ldog ste/ dal 'byor chos la bkol te snying po len 473

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'adod/ mi rtag 'chi ba nam 'ong cha ma mchis/ /zhes chos sang bsgrub gnang bsgrub sogs kyi rtag 'dzin las blo ldog te nam 'chi cha med bsam/ 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /zhes 'khor ba mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pa de la bde bar rlom pa sdig pa mi dge ba las blo ldog ste sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la zhen log skyo shas nges 'byung bskyed/dge sdig las 'bras bde sdug bslu ba med/ /ces rgyu dge sdig las 'bras bu bde sdug bslu med yin pa la the tshom za ba las blo ldog ste/ las 'bras la yid ches brtan po bskyed/ thar lam thob pa bla mas thugs rjes zungs/ /thar pa rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang la rang gi sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i nyams len yang dag pa thob pa zhig skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bla ma khyed mkhyen khyed kyi thugs rjes zungs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi ngag 'don ni sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs sogs sho lo ka tshad med bzhi dang bcas bya/ dmigs rim ni/rang gi spyi bor skyabs gnas kun kyi ngo bo gu ru rin po che gsal btab la/skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag ni rang gzhan thams cad skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /dus ni rang thun du 'dug pa'i dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar du/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gu ru rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o snyam pas mos gus gdung shugs drag pos blo yag na nyes na las mtho ru gtong na dma' ru gtong na khyed las gzhan pa'i skyabs gnas re sa gzhan med pas srog dmar po la bab kyang khyed mi gtong snyam pa'i dam bca' dang ldan pas gsol ba snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su 'gro ste/ ji 474

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃskad du/ skyid sdug legs nyes la sogs paḥ shi gson tshe 'di phyi ma sogasaX gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad duḥ skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pasaX bdag la re sa gzhan na medaḥ o rgyan mkhyen no snyam pa yiḥ blo yi yang yang gtad par byaḥ zhes gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i rgyu'i skyabs 'gros/ bde gshegs snying po'i steng na sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i yon tan rang chas su yod pa sad pa 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro'o/ /sems bskyed kyi dmigs rim ni snyer dang po snying rjes gzhan don la dmigs pa sems can thams cad gyi don du/ zur phyi ma shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya snyam pa'i dam bca' dang ldan pas smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de yang rgyu med las mi skye bas de'i ched du lam zab mo'i rim pa bsgom par bya'o snyam du dam bca' dngos su 'jug pa 'jug pa sems bskyed de smon 'jug sems bskyed sgom/ 'di lta bu'i kun rdzob byang chub sems la brten nas dbyings ye zung 'jug don dam sems bskyed mngon du gyur dgos pa'o/ /de yan chad gyis sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pas dngos gzhi thugs yid dbyer med bsre ba sogs bla ma rin po che'i man ngag ltar bskyangs te mnyam bzhag las ldang ma thag /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /gsungs pas rjes bsngo smon gyis zin dgos pas/ bsngo smon gyi dmigs rim ni/ bsngo ba'i dpang por mdun gyi nam mkhar mos gus gdung shug drag pos skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gu ru rin po che bzhugs par mos la de'i mdun du bde sdug gtong len gyi dmigs pa ni/ gu ru rin po 475

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃche sogs kyi thugs rje'i stobs dang rang gi dkar po dge ba'i stobs kyis rang la dge ba rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam pas sems can thams cad la phog ma thag sems can re re la cha shas phran bu re tsam min par bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po yongs rdzogs re thob par bsam/ sems can de dag gi mi dge ba rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa rlung nag po'i rnam pas rang gi snying gar bdag 'dzin gyi rnam pa thig le dud kha yod pa de la phog pas bdag 'dzin de na bun rlung gis gtor ba ltar dang se lung lcags kyi rgya mdud 'thor ba ltar gtor nas chos kyi dbyings su dengs bar bsam pa dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan te sangs rgyas par bsam pa'i ngang du dar gcig mnyam par bzhag /de nas skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo gu ru rin po che la/ bsngo ba'i thog mar snyan gsan dbab te bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa rang gi sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i dge ba dang rang gzhan gyi dus gsum bsags yod gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang zhing dga' ba sgom bzhin pas dge rtsa rnam gcig tu bsdus te phud gu ru rin po che sogs la mchod pa dpag tu med pa 'bul/ bsngo yul nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la/ bsngo ba'i don po sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du/ bsngo ba'i tshul gu ru rin po che sogs kyis ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin bdag gis kyang bsngo bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi bsngo ba rjes mthun pa bya'o/ /smon lam ni/ de ltar bsngos pa bzhin du/ gu ru rin po che sogs kyi thugs rjes stobs kyis 'grub par gyur cig 'grub par gyur pa'i 476

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmathun gyur gu ru rin po che sogs kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam ci rigs pa brjod do/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i dge rtsa khong khros mi 'jig log ltas mi gcod zhes dpal sprul sogs dam pa du mas 'chad do/ /de lta bur dang po gu ru rin po che spyi bor bsgoms te snabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ bar du snying dbus su bsgoms te thugs yid dbyer med bsre/ mthar mdun gyi nam mkhar bsgoms te bsngo ba dang smon lam byas te/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas nyam len tshe gcig la nus na/ rab tshe 'dir grol ba dang / min kyang 'chi kha bar dor grol nus la/ der grol ma nus na bar do'i gnas skabs su gu ru rin po che dngos su byon nas gdam ngag mi ston mi srid/ bstan nas mi grol mi srid gsungs so/ /kun ma khyen 'jigs med gling bas blo bla mar gtod pa skyabs 'gro yi mthar thug gsungs pa de de yin no/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis/ /༄tsho/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi rnam bzhag zhe chen rgyal tshab kyi gsung las btus pa/skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ gang la skyabs su 'gro na bla ma mchog gsum dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ gang skyabs su 'gro na rang gzhan sem can thams cad/ rgyu ci yi phyir 'gro na skyabs gnas kyi yon tan shes pas/ spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ dgos rang don yid byed/ yang dgos tha mal zhabrul 'dzin gyi zhen rtog las skyob pa'i phyir/ tshul ji ltar na kun rdzob tu snyon pa lam grogs kyi tshul tu khas len pa dang / don dam par rang sem dang gnyis su med par shes pas/ dus ji srid byang chub kyi bar te skyabs yul rang rgyud la nam grub pa'i bar ro/ /sems bskyed ni/ ched du bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don du/477

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃthob bya bla med kyi 'bras bu nyid thob par 'dod pas 'bras bu la dam bca' ba smon pa dang / rgyu la dam bca' ba 'jugs pa sems bskyed/ de kun rdzob brda las byung dang / don dam chos nyid sgom stobs las shar ba bdag dang sem can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid yin pa la yin par shes pa'i nges shes kyis gsal btab ste/ de yi ngang du bsal bzhag dang bral bar sgom pa don dam sems bskyed de mdor na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi sems so/ /mthar dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i gnas lugs gshis bde ba chen po gsal stong brjod bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog pa ni don dam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /rjes la bsngo ba ni/ gang bsngo rgyu'i dge ba de ltar bskyed rdzogs kyi lam rim pa gnyis la sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du slob par byas pa de nyid kyis mtshon rten du byas te dus gsum byas yod kyi rnam dkar mtha' dag gang du bsngo na gnyis la mi gnas pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid khyab bdag rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi sar/ su'i ched du bsngo na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can bla med ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i phyir/ tshul lam rnam pa ji lta bus bsngo na/ don dam par chos thams cad rang bzhin gnyis su med pas bsngo bya bsngo byed sogs kyi spros pa ma dmigs kyang / kun rdzob tha snyad tsam du gang gis byed pa po dang gang la bya ba'i yul dang / ji ltar bya ba'i dge ba thams cad 478

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrmi lam sgyu ma lta bur snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis ji ltar dus gsum du gshegs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas dge rtsa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu ji ltar bsngo bar mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o snyam du 'dun pa rtse gcig pas bsngo ba'i tshig brjod/ de ltar bsngos pa'i dgos pa'am phan yon ni bsgrub pa mi zad pa ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /zhe chen rgyal tshab rin po che'i gsung las bsdus pa'o/ /༄༅/ /bla ma'i zhal mtshar gyi gsung 'ga' zhig /bla ma g.yu khog pa'i zhal mtshar gyi gsung 'ga' zhig ni/ gzhan dag gis snang ba'i dngos po rang ngos nas mi stong kyang / 'di bden par grub pas stong bar 'dod pa mi 'thad gsungs kyang /de bu snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching / /zhen pa chod cig na ro pa/ /zhes gsungs ba de bden zhen nam gnyis 'dzin yi na pas/ de 'khor bar 'ching byed du gsung bas/ snang ba 'ching byed ma gsungs te/ gang snang ba'i dngos po de dgag sgrub gnyis ka mi dgos par/ don byed nus pa ni dngos po mtshan nyid yin la/ de bzhin du/ ji ltar mthong thos shes dag /'di ni dgag par bya min te/ /bden par rtog pa dgag bya yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pas dgag byar ngos bzung ba la/ ye mi 'thad do snyam kyang / mda' 'phangs ba'i lan yin gyi bdag la khur thang cher med do/ /snang ba'i dngos po 'di rang gi ngo bos stong par rgya sde ba slob tshogs dang bcas pa zhes gsungs gnang yang / spyir rgya sde 4༷9 kho na ma yin de/ nges pa don gyi mdo

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang / de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i klu grub yab sras la sogs pa'i rgya gar mkhas pa'i legs bshad thams cad na gsal bzhin pa la/ sgron me bzung nas nyi ma btsal mi dgos pa yin no/ /'on kyang spyir snang ba'i chos 'di thams cad snyong par 'dod dam mi 'dod/ stong bar mi 'dod na/ zhus pas dben la/stong bar zhal gyis bzhes na/ ye stong yin nam gsar stong gang yin la/ phyag rdzogs kyi chos skad 'dra 'dre zhig gsungs 'dug pas/ ye stong yin par dgongs na rang gi ngo bos stong ba/ gzhan gyi ngo bos stong ba/ gnyis ka'i dngos po stong ba/ gnyis min gyi ngo bos stong gang khas len legs/ dang po ltar 'dod na ye mi mthun pa med do/ /ji skad du/ stong ba bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la/ /nges don mdo sde dag gi shes par bya/ /zhes dang / gdod nas skye med rang bzhin 'di/ /blo yi gting nas rtogs gyur na/ /sogs dang / rang rang ngo bos stong ba'i phyir/ /stong ba nyid ni nyi shu'o/ /zhes dang / zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig bdag gi rnyed/ /ces sogs dang / yod pas srid pa 'di la min/ /med pas rnal 'byor mi grol de/ /dngos dang dngos med sogs shes na/ /bdag nyid chen po rnam par grol/ /zhes sogs lung rigs mang du yod kyang / zhu mi dgos pa red/ khyed kyi bla ma mi pham gyis ka gsungs na khyed gyis kyang ka /mi pham gyis kha gsung na khyed kyis kyang kha gsungs ba lad mo tsam gyis mi yong gi/ snang stong zung 'jug thugs la med na/ gzhan la kha btsag pa ni/ rang gi nang cha phyir ngom pas mi rigs la/ 'bel gtam tsam bya na rogs gi dri rtsod lta grub rgya bod kyi legs 480

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbashad mtha' dag la/ go myong rtogs gsum gang rung la nges pa rnyed pa med na lung rig gi ra bar tshud tshe phyir 'byon dbang dka'o/ /de yang snang ba bzhin stong pa/ stong pa bzhin snang ba ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung thams cad kyi khyad chos su gsungs te/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /de phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / stong dang mi stong la sogs bzhi/ /zhi ba 'di la ga la yod/ /ces dang / stong ngo zhes kyang mi brngod de/ /mi stong zhes kyang ga la yod/ /gzhan las shes min zhi ba ste/ /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ /rnam rtog med don tha dad med/ /de ni de yi mtshan nyid do/ /zhes sogs ni spros bral rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba yin pas/ yul can blo don mthun pa'o/ /gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong ba nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no zhes sogs stong nyid bzhi sbyor kyi rigs pas/stong nyid rten 'byung / chos dang chos can/ snang ba stong ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam sogs ni/ sa thob 'phags pa'i mnyam rjes gang gi skabs su bzhag kyang /sus kyang dgag pa'i gnas med do/ /snang ba'i dngos po gcig gzhir bzhag nas/ de la stong ba'i ngo bo zhig 'jug pa ni/ snang stong zung 'jug mi zer ro/ /chu la 'o ma 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /lar snang stong zung 'jug gi chos 'byung ba/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa shas che bas de yi grub mthas gong ma rnam dag 'geb pa ni mtshar che ha ha/ dam pa khyed kyi zhal gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rtog ge bdag gi mgrin pa'i khong du mid/ /gnyis snang zhakhrul ba'i gcong nad sel nus pa'i/ /481

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbyin rlabs dngos grub stsol shog drin chen rje/ /bod 'dir rang 'dod bzhag pa'i grub mtha' mang / /de yi rjes 'jug thams cad de bzhin mdzod/ /chos khungs rgya gar gzhung la gtug pa la/ /dgag pa'i go skabs yod na lhag par gyis/ /ho ho/ mtshar mtshar yin/ rgya rgya rgya/ mtsho sprul mkhan po theg mchog bstan 'dzin gyis g.yu khog bla ma la zhal rtsed kyi tshul du bskur ni zhig red yod khi/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba yang dag zhig go dgos na mkhan po'i gsung 'di yis go nus nges can red lags/༄༅/ /sdig can rnams tshe 'phos tshe ji ltar byed tshul mdo las khol du byung ba/tshe 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba zhus pa'i mdo las/ yab rgyal pos gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag gis mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i las mi dge ba dag bgyis pas de'i rnam par smin pa mi bzad pa myong bar 'gyur ba 'di dag gis ji ltar bgyis na bde bar 'gyur/ bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po po sems can gang dag gis mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i las mi dge ba byas pa dag gis sgyu med pa'i sems dwangs bas rnam par smin pa la yid ches par byas te/sems thag pa nas bshags na 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i tshe mi dge ba sngar byas pa dag la 'gyod pa bskyed de sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs gsol na sdig pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe phyi ma med pa'i 'du shes bskyed par mi bya'o/ /las 'bras rnam bzhag las khol du phyung ba'o/ /ri'i+o/ shan 'byed sogs las gsapa/ rdzogs chen las ni rig stong gnyug ma 482

g.yu khog bla ma chos dgings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrang byung gi ye shes ngo sprad pa de nyid don gyi lhan skyes ngo sprad pa yin/ de la nges shes skyes pas tshogs lam po dang skal ba mnyam/ goms pas nyams myong sbyor lam/ rtogs pa mthong lam/ rtsal rdzogs sgom lam/ sgrib gnyis zad pa mthar phyin lam mo// ༈ mtshan med rdzogs pa chen por ni/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa rang sa ma 'gag kyang / bla ma'i man ngag dang dbang gi don brgyud 'pho ba'i stobs kyis sems kyi chos nyid ngo sprad du yod pa ni rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi khyad chos so/ /snang gsum mtha'i 'od gsal nyams su myong ba dang /rdzogs chen rig ngo rjen par rtogs pa gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po 'am so so rang rig pas mngon sum yin gyi rjes dpag la ltos pa min no/ /'o na chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs pa'i 'phags lam sa dang po yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ sprin bral nyi mthong bzhin du mngon sum rtogs kyang /rnal 'byor goms pa rdzogs na chos thams cad de kho na'i ngang du 'ub chub par mngon sum rtogs pa'i rtogs pa 'pho 'gyur med pa thob tshe sa dang po'i rtogs pa mngon gyur yin te/ de'i tshe don gyi 'od gsal mngon du byas pa yin gyi/ da lta sngags mtshan bcas kyi lam gyi 'od gsal shar ba dang / mtshan med rdzogs chen gyi rig ngo 'phrod pa de la dpe yi ye shes zhes bya ba yin no// ༈ mtshan mo snying nang gi a dkar po la sems bzung bas/ gnyid kyi shes pa nang du sdud tshe snang ba gsum gyi nyams dang / nam mkha' dag pa lta bu'i 'od gsal cha 'dra 'char ba dang / nam mkha' sum phrug sogs gdams pa sna tshogs kyi sno nas kyang / dwangs gsal nam mkha' 'dra ba'i nyams 'char te de kun 'od gsal 483

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdang cha 'dra tsam du rung mod kyi/rtogs pa don gyi 'od gsal dngos ma yin te nyams yin la/nyams zhes pa sems la gnas lugs 'od gsal de'i rnam pa cha 'dra shar ba ste dpe yi 'od gsal yang zer ro/ /ye shes kyi ngo bo la nyams zhes mi bya ste/don gyi 'od gsal zhes bya'o/ /des na yid rang mtshan pas bsgom bya 'od gsal lam stong nyid ces gzung 'dzin du sgoms pa thams cad/rnam pa stong nyid 'od gsal gyi cha 'dra shar kyang ri mo bris pa'i zla ba lta bu yin la/rdzogs chen gyi sems nyid ngo sprad pa'i don bzhin rang sems skye med kyi gnas lugs thad kar bzo bcos dpyad ra mi dgos par thag chod na/dpe yi ye shes dngos yin la/chu nang gi zla gzugs lta bu yin te/nyi zla'i gzugs brnyan chu la shar ba la nyi zla dngos la yod pa'i rnam pa rnams snang ba yin no/ /'di 'dra'i sems kyi gnas lugs phyag chen nam rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i sgom pa po rnams kyis 'di rjes dpag gis rtogs pa ma yin te/ rang gis mngon sum du rtogs pa yin pas/skyes bu dam pa mang pos kyang 'di sngags kyi mthong lam yin zhes gsungs/yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs med pa ni lus rgyas sgrib pa sogs su 'chad/klong chen rab 'byams kyis sngags kyi mthong lam dngos min yang chos nyid de bzhin nyid dngos su rtogs pa yin/mthong lam la yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs yod dgos pas/'di rang rig mngon sum yin yang dpe yi ye shes su bzhed/don gyi ye shes zla ba dngos mthong ba lta bu mthong lam du bzhed do// ༈mdor na rang rig gnyug ma/'i don rang snang ma 'gag pa'i dus su rtogs kyang rung /snang gsum mtha'i 'od gsal 484

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum hūṃgyi dus su rtogs kyang rung ste/ rig stong rjen par 'char te/ de sus shes na shes byed shes bya tha dad du med de rang gsal du 'char gyi/rtogs par byed pa po yid phra ba ma yin te/shes rab rang byung gis rang gsal du shes pa yin/snang gsum mtha'i 'od gsal nyams su myong ba'i rjes su yid rags pas de dran pa ni/shes rab rang byung shes pa thams cad la khyab pa'i cha nas yid dang tha dad du 'byed du med pa des shes pa yin/shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma la/rdzogs pa chen po sgra thal 'gyur gyi rgyud las dbye ba lnga gsungs te/ gzhi gnas rang byung gi shes rab kyis chos thams cad kyi rten byed la/ snang ba cer 'dzin gyi shes rab kyis dbyings rig thad kar rtogs pa/ dran pa 'gag med kyi shes rab kyis mnyam bzhag tu gsal dwangs 'byed pa yin la/ 'di rang byung ye shes la ldan pa dang / ldan chos su ngo bo gcig par bstan pa ste/ rang gnas kyi shes rab yin pas/ ye shes kyi cha yin la/rtog dpyod dang gzung 'dzin can sem sa kyis bsdus pa min par kun mkhyen chen pos gsungs/ lta ba thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa yang yid shes kyi cha la khyab pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid shes pa dang / 'jug byed rnam gsum gyi shes rab kyis thos bsam sgom pa'i mtshams byed pa zhes gsungs pa'i shes rab 'di lta bus don gyi 'od gsal mngon du byed pa yin yang / yid dang cha 'dra ba yid shes kyis chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong bar gzhung spyi las gsungs/༈ snang gsum gyi 'od gsal shar ba'i skabs su/shar rgyu chos nyid gnyug ma de yin/shar nas ngos zin pa po tshogs brgyad med na su yin snyam na/shes rab 485

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃrang byung yin te/ gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma med pa'i chos nyid de lta bu nyams su myong ba'i snyobs kyis rjes thob tu chos nyid bsam mi khyab pa'i don la sgro 'dogs chod pa yod par bsnyon du med la/ de dus kyi nyams su myong mkhan gyi blo gzhan dang myong bya 'od gsal gnyis su med par rang bzhin 'od gsal mtha' dbus bral ba'i nyams shar ba de/ gnyug ma'i 'od gsal gyi rang gdangs su gyur pa'i shes rab yin la/ yid shes kyi 'khor gyi shes rab ma yin te/ yid med na de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems byung shes rab ga la yod de med do/ /yid shes 'khor gyi sems byung shes rab rkyen bzhi las nges par skye dgos pas 'dus byas yin gyi rang byung ga la yin/ 'di la rkyen bzhi med de/dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma'i rkyen dang / rang gi nyer len du gyur pa'i de ma thag rkyen dang / skal mnyam sogs rgyu rkyen dang byed rgyu bdag rkyen bzhi dpyad du med/ yul chos nyid las tha dad pa'i blo med pas dmigs rkyen med la/ de med pas rgyu rkyen sogs med do/ /de dag la yul yul can tha dad kyi ma tshan ma cung zad dmigs na de ltar yod rung yang / der dmigs pa cung zad med pa la rkyen bzhi'i tha snyad med do/ /des na gzhi rang byung gi ye shes dang gnyis su med kyang rnam pa'i cha nas gzhi ji bzhin par rang 'od du gsal ba la myong ba'i tha snyad btags kyi myang bya myong byed kyi rdzas tha dad du med do/ /'o na 'od gsal rang la rang gdangs shes rab rang byung yod na/ lam la ma 'bad pa'i so skye rnams kyis 'bad pa med par de 'dra'i ngos nas 'od gsal ngos cis mi zin snyam na/ mi zin te/ gzhi rang byung gi ye shes rang gdangs shes rab 'char rung 486

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgi rang bzhin du ye nas yod kyang / 'khrul pa'i sgrib pa 'thug pos mnan nas gzhi thog tu gnas pa'i dus der/ sgrib pa'i dbang gis 'od gsal mi mthong bas sems med kyi gnas skabs 'di shes 'di dran ci yang med par brgyal ba ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// ༈ da lta gsal tsam rig tsam yid kyi snyeng gi 'di gnyug sems kyi gsal cha tshogs drug la khyab pa'i nang gi yid kyi steng gi de red/'di'i ngang du lam pas stong nyid sgom pa sogs yid kho nas byed pas/ yid phra ba zer rgyu 'di red/ 'di gnyug sems dngos ma red/ rnam rtog gis bslad pa'i skabs yin pas so/ /'di 'dra mig shes kyi steng na'ang gsal tsam la sngo ser sogs kyis slad zhugs pa sogs/ sgo lnga la'ang yod dgos so/ /yid phra ba gsal tsam rtog med des rang gi rang stong par mthong na gtsug sems kyis stong nyid bsgoms na chod che zer ba de rnying ma tsho'i bsgom rgyu de red/ ༈ dgag rtog sgrub rtog gang yin yang rnam rtog las mi 'da' la/ mi rtog ye shes ni dgag rtog sgrub rtog gang yang min te/ gang du'ang mi rtog pa yin no/ /kha cig na re/ mi rtog ye shes chos can/ dgag rtog yin te/ spros pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ spros pa dgag pa'i rtog pa dang / spros bral sgrub pa'i rnam rtog yin no snyam na spros pa mtha' dag kheg pa la spros pa dang bral lo snyam du 'dzin pa ga la yod/ yod na da dung spri+os pa ma khegs pas sbros bral ma yin no// ༈bden gnyis dbyer med rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid so so rang gis rig pa'i yul de chos dbyings dang stong nyid mthar thug yin/ de rtogs tshe rtogs bya chos dbyings rtogs byed ye shes zhes tha snyad kyis phye ba las don la tha dad cung zad 487

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃkyang med do/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rang bzhin can gyi gsal zhing rig pa rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ rnam par mi rtog pa gnas lugs so so rang gis rig pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba ye shes kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rnam shes kyi chos nyid ni ye shes so/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa yongs su dag pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid/ ye shes de la chos nyid gzigs pa'i cha nas ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes dang / chos can mtha' dag gzigs pa'i cha nas ji snyed pa'i ye shes zhes ldog chas btags kyi/ ngo bo ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyag gcig las tha dad du med de/ /bden gnyis dbyer med kyi gnas lugs mthar thug gzigs pa'i ye shes yin no/ /des na rnam shes tshogs brgyad chos can dang / de'i rang bzhin chos nyid kyi ye shes gnyis ni/ gcig tha dad gang du'ang khas blang bya min par/ dgongs 'grel las/ 'du byed khams dang don dam mtshan nyid ni/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /gcig dang tha dad du yang gang rtog pa/ /de dag tshul min lta la zhugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung bzhin klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs la/ de'i phyir de gnyis tha snyad du gcig ma yin te/sems rtogs pa tsam gyis sems kyi chos nyid ye shes mi rtogs pa dang / chos can dang chos nyid yin pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ /don dam par tha dad min te/sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes yin pas/ ye shes rtogs dus sems kyang de las tha dad du ma dmigs pa'i phyir dang / ye shes rtogs tshe sems rang grol du 'char ba sogs kyi phyir na'o// ༈ sngags mtshan bcas thabs kyi lam mdo las 488

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃ'aphags na/ de dag dpe yi ye shes kyi sgo nas don gyi ye shes 'tshol ba'i lam yin la/ de'i mtshon bya don gyi ye shes de nyid thad kar 'char ba rdzogs chen gyi lam myur lam cis ma yin te/ de'i ngang du goms na gang snang sku gsum kyi rol par shar nas tshe 'di la sangs rgyas nus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos sku ka dag gi dgongs pa khregs chod kyis mngon sum mthong zhing / gzugs sku lhun grub kyi dgongs pa thod rgal gyis mngon sum mthong bas/ sangs rgyas mngon sum lam byed kyi theg pa 'di lta bu mdo lam na med do/ /des na stong nyid rjes dpag gis gtan la phab nas tshogs rgya chen po dang 'brel bar nyams su blangs bas/ rim bzhin chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba je nyer 'gyur ba'i lam mdo na yod kyi/ las dang po pa'i sa nas mngon sum yid ches skyed pa'i thabs ma bstan to/ de ltar chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis kyi gnas tshul las dang po pa'i sa nas kyang yid ches rnyed pa de bzhin bsgoms pas don gyi ye shes myur du 'dren pa yin la/ de lta bu'i dpe yi ye shes de yang chu nang gi zla gzugs ltar don gyi ye shes mtshon nus pas mdo las 'phags shing / nyi zla'i gzugs brnyan chu la shar ba la nyi zla dngos la yod pa'i rnam pa rnams snang ba yin/ don gyi ye shes zla ba lta bu mngon du mthong ba'i tshe na don gyi ye shes des mthong ba yin yang / tshes gcig gi zla ba zla ba dngos yin yang da dung bco lnga'i bar rgya je cher mthong ba yod pa bzhin/ sgom pa'i lam du don gyi ye shes mthong ba je cher 'phel te/ mthar thug bco lnga'i zla ba mthong ba ltar/ mthong ba yongs su rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'grub pa'o// ༈ rong klong gnyis ni mdo lam 489

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgyi sa bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas kyi sa mtshan nyid par bzhed cing ma chags pad+ma dang yi ge 'khor lo tshogs sku gsum gyi ldog chas dbye bar bzhed/ ༈ da lta tshogs brgyad kyi yul kun ma 'gag bzhin du gdod ma'i 'od gsal ngos zin rgyu yod pa 'di rdzogs chen gyi lam gyi khyad chos yin/ lam gzhan bla med yin yang de ngos zin phyir snang gsum gyi 'od gsal je bas je gsal du sbyang dgos pa de rtsol ba'i lam yin/ 'di rtsol med rang sar rnyed pa'i man ngag yin pa khyad phyed dgos/ rig pa nyid rnam rtog bral te rjen par shar tshe snang ba'i 'od gsal mthar thug dang khyad med/ ༈ rnal 'byor pa la shar ba'i dus su 'od gsal shar zhes zer kyang / rnal 'byor pa min yang tha mal ba rnam la gnyid 'thug sogs kyi dus su 'od gsal 'gag pa ni ma yin pas/ rnal 'byor gyi ngo shes dus 'od gsal yod la/ gzhan rnam la de dus gzhi 'od gsal med pa ma yin pas/ 'di gnyis brjod tshul mi 'dra yang don de lta bur sus kyang khas blang dgos so/ 'o na de dus shes byed kyi blo med pas/ rnal 'byor pas lam gyi stobs las kyang de shes par mi srid snyam na ma yin te/mdo sngags kyi lam gang yin yang bden gnyis dbyer med gzhi yi chos nyid la nges pa rnyed nas/ bsgoms pas myong ba skyes pa'i stobs kyis gzhi yi steng gi zhakhrul ba'i sgrib pa bsal stobs kyis/ de dus shes rab kyi gdangs kyi de ngos zin pa srid de/ sngags kyi grol lam ltar na tshogs brgyad ma 'gag pa'i dus kyi yid kyi shes pas sems rang gi chos nyid rig stong zung 'jug tu myong ba na/sems de nyid rig stong blo 'das su rtogs nus la/ de la gom pas sems 490

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃdaben sogs ched du ma bsgom/sa kyang / gnyid 'thug dang 'chi dus kyi 'od gsal ngos zin pa 'byung ngo / /rig stong gi chos nyid rtogs pa'i skabs na yid rtog bcas rtog med kyis mtshon pa'i tshogs brgyad dam drug gi shes pa thams cad ye shes 'ba' zhig gi rang bzhin du 'char gyi ye shes las tha dad pa'i rnam shes mi dmigs te/ sems kun gyi chos nyid de las gzhan pa'i sems med pa'i phyir ro// ༈ glog gi sgron ma las/ phyag rdzogs kyi khyad par/ phyag pa lta bas yul la phar rgyas btab nas gsal stong du gtan la 'bebs/ rdzogs chen pas chos thams cad sems kyi rol par bsdus nas yul rig stong du gtan la 'bebs pa yin/ rdzogs chen sde gsum ga yul snang ba dang bcas pa yul can rig pa'i klong du rdzogs par 'du yang sems sdes chos thams cad rang byung gi ye shes brjod bral du 'dod/ klong sdes sems nyid rtsal snang dang bcas pa chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las 'gro sa med par ye grol rang dag tu 'dod/ man ngag sdes ye nas zung 'jug blo 'das rang byung gi ye shes rtsol bral du 'dod pas/ mdor na bskyed rdzogs gsum kyi dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes lus rdzogs par ston pa la sde gsum rim gyis 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / mdo lam du stong nyid don spyi'i tshul du gtan la phab nas goms tshul las da lta so skye'i sar don rang mtshan goms pa med kyang / sngags su thabs ma sbas par gsal bar bstan pas/ gang zag gi skal ba'i khyad par gyis da lta mngon du byed nus mi nus dang / de yang dbang rab cig car ba dbang dus su ngo 'phrod pa'am gtan tshigs bstan pa tsam gyis rtogs nus pa dang / dbang 'bring la rtsa 491

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃmadud 'grol ba'i dmigs gnad sogs goms stobs kyis rim gyis rtogs pa dang / dbang rtul bsags sbyang sogs brgyud nas rtogs tshul sogs kyi dbye ba yod mod kyi/ spyi ldog tu da lta tshogs sbyor gyi lam du'ang chos nyid rang mtshan mngon sum du mthong ba ni yod do/ /zhi byed chu klung rol pa las rang gi bsags pa rab tu gyur pa dang / /bla ma dam pa bsten la mkhas pa dang / /rnal 'byor rig pa dwangs pas mngon sum du/ /mthong lam che chung skye ba kho nar bshad/ /ces dang / nges don 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ da lta chos skur ma shes na/ /gsang sngags man ngag ci la che/ /de phyir bstan shes sgom ma dgos/ /zhes gsungs/ de las gzhan du na/ gsang sngags 'bras bu'i lam ma yin zhing rgyu lam byed dang khyad med du thal ba dang / chos nyid ngo sprod kyi man ngag rgyun chad par thal ba dang / rang rig pa'i tshad ma rgyun chad par thal ba dang / mngon sum rtogs byed kyi rig pa'i gtan tshigs rgyun chad par thal ba'i skyon bzhis gnod cing / mthong tshul yang gsal ba mthar phyin ma phyin gyi bye brag gis/dper na dbang po'i yul du mthong yang thag nye ring gis gsal ba mthar phyin ma phyin yod pa bzhin/ lam rims las/ dbang po dwangs pa'i spyod yul las/ /nye ring drung phyin stobs 'phel bas/ khyun rkyen gong 'og 'bras bu bgrod/ /gsal bas bye brag rim par 'gro/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad chos can dang / de'i rang bzhin nam chos nyid kyi ye shes gnyis tha snyad du gcig ma yin te/ sems rtogs pa tsam gyis sems kyi chos nyid ye shes mi rtogs pa dang /ngo bo zhakhrul ma zhabrul dang / gzung 'dzin yod med 492

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsogs kyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ don dam par tha dad pa ma yin te sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes yin pa dang / ye shes rtogs dus sems kyang de las tha dad du ma dmigs pa dang / ye shes rtogs tshe sems rang grol du 'char ba sogs kyi phyir/ des na de gnyis gcig tha dad gang du'ang khas len par mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / ༈ rdzogs chen gyi rig ngo 'chug med 'phrod na sngags lam gyi dpe yi 'od gsal skyes pa yin/ 'di nyid mngon sum yin phyir don gyi ye shes dngos su bzhed pa yod kyang / rang lugs kun mkhyen chen pos ni/ don gyi ye shes dngos mthong lam yin pas de la yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis mngon gyur du yod dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dir mngon sum gyis mthong ba yin yang da dung mthong spang gi dri ma'i sbub las ma grol ba'i phyir don gyi 'od gsal dngos ma yin la/dpe'i 'od gsal du bzhed do// ༈ a nus ni/ dbyings stong nyid kun tu bzang mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / thabs bde ba kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor gnyis dbyer med pa ni sras bde chen byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor yin pas/ de nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag tu nges pa'i bde stong gi lta ba zhes/ don la rang byung zag med bde ba chen po zhes pa ye nas bde stong 'du 'bral spangs ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid yin la de nyid kyis chos thams cad la khyab cing rjes su song bas snang srid ye nas sangs rgyas par gtan la phab po/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ kun mkhyen chos rjes gzhi snang ye shes sgron mer/ bdag nyid gcig pa ye ldan gyi tshul/ lhan cig skyes pa dus mnyam gyi tshul/ kun tu brtags pa phyis 'byung gi tshul du rang ma rig pa'i cha las so 493

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsor btags so/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ gter bla ma'i 'das rjes bsdus 'grel las/ gzhi snang shar ba'i tshe/ 'od lnga la bzung bas 'byung lnga snod kyi 'jig rten grub/ sku la 'dzin pa zhugs pas lus dang / chos nyid kyi sgra la 'dzin pa zhugs pas ngag dang / rig pa'i gdangs rig tsam gsal tsam la 'dzin pa zhugs pas sems su snang nas zhabrul bas don la ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes rdul cha phra mo tsam du grub ma myong yod ma myong bar da lta snang dus nyid nas sku dang ye shes kyi rol ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ glog gi sgron ma las/ de ltar gdod ma'i spyi gzhi laspogrol zhabrul gyi sgo ji ltar 'byung tshul yang / da lta'i gnyid dang 'chi ba'i 'od gsal 'di nyid kyis mtshon nus te/ gnyid kyi skabs/sgo lnga nyon yid dang bcas pa yid shes la thim/ yid shes kun gzhi'i rnam shes la/ de kun gzhi rtog med la/ de chos dbyings su thim pas phra rags kyi 'dzin pa nub la stong gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i chos nyid 'char bas de ngos zin na zhakhrul ba bzlog ste/ gsang ba rin po che'i rgyud las/ tshogs bdun kun gzhi'i rnam shes su/ /thim pas kun gzhi dbyings su dag /de tshe gdod ma'i lhan cig skyes/ /stong gsal rang byung ye shes so/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /zhes gsungs/ de las slar mched pa'i tshe/ chos dbyings las kun gzhi/ de las kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ de las yid shes gcig po langs pas rmi lam 'char ba dang / dbang po so sor brten pa'i rtsar rlung zhugs pas gnyid sad de nyin snang gi yul la gzung 'dzin rags pa 'char bar shing rta chen mor gsungs/'dis grol 'khrul dang khyad par sems phra ba nas rim gyis mched tshul mtshon/494

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃsems can rnams 'chi ba'i tshe sa chu me rlung rnams rim pas thim mthar/ rlung rnam shes la thim ste/ phyi dbugs chad pa'i bar rags pa thim pa dang / de nas nang dbugs gnas pa'i dang por/ rtog pa thim pa'i rim pa phyi rtags slo ba/nang rtags du ba/ snang ba'i skabs de mched pa la thim/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum 'gag /phyi rtags nyi ma/ nang rtags me khyer/ mched pa'i skabs snang ba nyer thob la thim/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag /phyi rtags nag lam sgra gcan gyi snang ba/ nang rtags bum nang gi mar me/ snang ba nyer thob de 'od gsal la thim/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun 'gag /phra ba thim/ phyi rtags skya reng shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags ston gnam dri med/ bzhi pa'i 'od gsal de 'chi srid kyi dngos gzhir bzhed cing / de ngos zin pa rnams 'od gsal de la ji tsam 'dod par gnas shing / de nas zung 'jug gi skur langs par bzhed pas 'dis grol tshul dang / ngo ma shes pa rnams de las rim par lugs bzlog tu/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun langs/ nyer thob shar/ de las 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu langs/ mched pa shar/ de nas zhe sdang gi rtog pa po gsum langs/ snang ba shar/ de nas khyab byed kyi rlung gis 'du byas te rnam par shes pa sngar gyi phung po rnying pa'i sgo dgu gang rung gi lam las 'phos nas bar do'i srid pa 'grub par gsungs te/ 'dis thog ma'i zhakhrul tshul mtshon nus/ ༈ ye thog gzhi yi gnas lugs sam 'od gsal ni rtogs zin 'khrul zin gnyis ka min pas gzhi dbyings lung ma bstan zhes bya ste dpe 'chi ba'i 'od gsal bzhin no/ /de yang sems can rnams 'chi ba'i tshe snang gsum mtha'i nyer thob 'od 495

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgasal la thim pa'i skabs su shar ba'i 'od gsal de'i rang gi ngo bo ni dwangs gsal sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba ston gnam dwangs ba lta bu ste/ de'i tshe 'khrul sems gzung 'dzin gyi kun rtog rags phra rnams ni chos nyid kyi rtsal gzhi thim du song bas de'i dus na med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang phal pa rnams la lam rkyen med pas 'od gsal de'i rang rtsal ye shes ni ma shar bas/ yul 'od gsal yod kyang yul can med pas su zhig gis ngos zin/ de ltar ngos ma zin pa'i cha nas sems med mun pa'i gnas skabs sam brgyal ba zhes bya ste/ 'od gsal rang gi ngo bo ni nag thom lung ma bstan brgyal ba lta bu min no/ /zhes gsungs/༈ ma rig pa gsum ni/ thog ma'i spyi gzhi mnyam pa po'i ngo bo mi rtog pa'i cha de rang ngo ma shes na 'khrul ba 'byung rung gi cha tsam ma 'gag pa de la rgyu bdag nyid gcig pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya ste gzhi mnyam pa chen po las ma g.yos pa'i phyir 'di la thog ma bzhag rgyu med de/ rgyu bla mar/ thog med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas ka dag stong pa chen pos 'char gzhi'i go phyes te/ lhun grub 'od gsal gyi 'char cha ma 'gag pa'i gdangs te/thugs rje'i rtsal skyod byed ye shes kyi rlung gis rta byas te/ 'char lugs drug sgo gnyis dang brgyad kyi cha nas lhun grub rin po che'i snang ba zhes bya ste gzhi snang ye shes chen po'i bkod pa rang shar ba'i tshe/ gzhi gzhi snang gnyis ka'i ngo bo la zhakhrul ba med kyang / sngar gyi rgyu bdag nyid gcig pa'i ma rig pa ma spangs ldan pa'i tshul gyis yod pa'i dbang gis/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi snang cha de rang rtsal du ma shes pa ni snang ba de dang dus snga phyi med par byung bas lha cig skyes 496

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃpa'i ma rig pa zhes bya/ de'i tshe ma shes pa tsam du mi sdod par shes pa spun po pha gi las bdag byung ngam/ bdag las pha gi byung snyam du thugs rje rang rig tu ma shes pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi cha shin tu phra ba byung ba ni kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya'o/ /rkyen bzhi ni/ rgyu'i rkyen ma rig pa gsum mam lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas rang ngo ma shes pa/ dmigs pa'i rkyen 'od snang sogs sna tshogs su snang ba/ bdag po'i rkyen rang snang du ma shes te gzhan du bzung bas/ de ma thag rkyen gzung 'dzin gyi zhabrul ba je rags su song bas rang snang ye shes nyid bsgribs te zhabrul ba'i sbubs su chud de 'phrul snang mu med par shar ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ kun gzhi'i skabs/ mi pham rin po ches/ don gyi kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po zag med kyi chos kun gyi gzhi yin la/ 'khor ba'i kun gzhi zag bcas kyi chos kun gyi gzhi ma yin pas kun gzhir gsungs la/ nges don sgron mer/ kun smon las/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang / /kun gzhi sangs rgyas nga dang mnyam/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i kun gzhi ni sbyor ba don gyi kun gzhi'am kun gzhi'i ye shes bde gshegs snying po nyid yin no/ /zhes dang / rgyan sdug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sa rnams sna tshogs kun gzhi ste/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'ang de/ /snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras/ /bde bar gshegs pas bstan par mdzad/ /snying po kun gzhir bsgrags par mdzad/ blo zhan rnams kyis mi shes so/ /de yang 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams kyi bag chags sna tshogs pa'i sgrib pa dang / 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad kun gyi gzhi 'am/ 'byung khungs/ chos nyid de/ de 'dra'i gzhi/ spros 497

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃbral bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'ang de yin zhes ngos bzung bar mdzad la/bde gshegs snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras bde bar gshegs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis btags par mdzad do/ /bde gshegs snying po kun gzhir bsgrags par mdzad la/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra/ /sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung gi/ ngas 'di byis pa rnams la yongs ma bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi la rtogs pa'i tshul dang sbyar te/ blo zhan pa rnams kyis bde gshegs snying po kun gzhi'i 'jog tshul la/kun gzhi zhes pa'i rags pa zhig tu 'khrul te phra ba'i 'jog tshul mi shes so/ /zhes dang / ye shes rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ gnas pa zhes bya kun gzhi ste/ /las dang rnam shes de la brten/ /zhes pas/ de lta bu'i kun gzhi'i de'i ngo bo gang yin snyam na/ rnam par shes pa ji snyed cig 'phro ba'i gzhir gyur pa shes pa phyogs su ma lhung ba snod bcud rgya chen po la dmigs pa yul gyi spru ris mi 'byed pa/ rang gi ngo bo la rnam rtog rags pa'i rlabs zhi ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sas bsdus pa dang / rang gi ngo bo shes pa rang blo skog tu ma gyur pa'i gsal ba gzugs khams kyi sas bsdus pa de ni rtog pa med pa nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba ltar mi rtog pa de ni shes pa snga ma'i bag chags 'dzin zhing phyi ma'i rten du gyur pa'i zhi ba zab pa phra ba'i rang bzhin can gyis rtogs par dka' ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig las/ de yang phyogs re'i dper mtshon na/ /skyes bu 498

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃgacig ngal bso ba lta bu'i tshe shes pa dar cig gang du yang mi rtog par lung ma bstan du gnas pa kun gzhi/ de las dar gcig snang yul ma 'gag par lam me gsal yang / der 'dzin ma zhugs pas gsal la rtog med kyi rnam pa de kun gzhi'i rnam par shes par gsungs/ nyin dus shes pa 'phro ba na yang kun gzhi las mched de yul dang mthun pa'i tshogs su 'char gsungs/ mtshan mo nyal dus gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa la rtog pa'i tshogs bdun rags pa ste/gnyid du 'gro ba'i shes pa gsal la rtog med kun gzhi'i rnam shes su thim nas/kun gzhi'i rnam shes de yang rim gyis rtog med gnyid kyi shes pa kun gzhir thim nas/ de yang skye med bsam yul las 'das pa'i chos skur thim ste dar cig gnas so/ /de nyid zin pa la mi rtog pa gzhi'i 'od gsal zin pa zhes bya'o// ༈ kun gzhi ni rtog med yengs zhabrul dang bral ba'i rmongs cha can de kun gzhi yin/ chos sku ni rig stong zung 'jug thig le nyag gcig go/ /chos sku de la phye na gzhi'i chos sku ni glo bur gyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i skabs yin/lam gyi chos sku ni rnal 'byor pas lam dus su gnas lugs ci rigs pa rtogs pa yin/ 'bras bu'i chos sku ni 'bras bu sgrib bral gyi dus na dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas yin/ ༈ gang shar chos sku'i rang rtsal la ngo sprad pa de ni kun rdzob kyi chos yod do cog thams cad rig pa chos sku chen po de'i rtsal/rol pa che ba'i rgyan/ gzhi snang lhun grub kyi snang ba yin pas na/ gnas lugs ye shes chen po de lus ltar snang ba rgyal ba'i sku rdo rje/ de'i rang gdangs a ā sogs dbyangs dang / ka sogs gsal byed rnams dbyings ye zung 'jug gam 499

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃde'i gdangs ngag ltar du grags pa rgyal ba'i gsung rdo rje/ yid ltar du 'phro ba rgyal ba'i thugs rdo rje yin no/ /ye shes de nyid lus ngag yid gsum dang gnas kyi rnam par shar ba ni dag pa rab 'byams yin/ ji ltar yin na 'gro drug gi shes rgyud la ye shes chen pos khyab yod pas/ de nyid lus ngag yid gsum ltar du shar ba ni rdo rje gsum dang / gnas ltar du shar ba 'og min gyi gnas yin pas dag pa rab 'byams yin/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos la ye shes pos khyab yod pas na/ 'khor 'das thams cad ye shes klong du gcig /ces so// ༈ nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i man ngag las kyang lhug par bzhag ces pa ni/ dbang po lnga yul la yan pa'o/ /'o na so so'i skye bo dang khyad ci yod ce na/ des ni de ltar ma rtogs te ye shes la ye shes rol pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gnas lugs kyi rang ngo la bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka ye nas zung 'jug lhun grub tu bzhugs pa yin pas snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rnam rol du shes na lha bskyed kyang rung la ma bskyed kyang rung ba yin te/ o rgyan chen pos/ rtags kyi sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /don gyi sangs rgyas chos sku gang yin pa/ /chos nyid rig pa mngon sum 'di yin pas/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas ma 'tshol rje 'bangs rnams/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang phyi rol gyi bla ma gzugs dbyibs su snang ba ni mtshon byed dpe'i bla ma tsam yin/ rang rig rang ngo shes pa ni mtshon bya don gyi bla ma chos sku dngos yin pas/ gtso bo shes rig gi rang tshugs ma shor ba bla ma dang 'du 'bral med pa yin te/ klong ras kyi zhal nas/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med 500

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ hūṃl/ /gzugs skur 'dzin pa stor nas thal/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ rang nyid bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na la brtson pa'i skabs 'dir lha 'dre yang bla ma'i rnam rol yin par shes dgos te/ snang srid bla mar shar ba'i bskyed rim dang / thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i rdzogs rim la gnad du bsnun dgos so// ༈ mi g.yeng ba'i zhi gnas ji lta bu zhe na/ g.yeng ba rnam pa drug dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa'o/ /g.yeng ba rnam pa drug po gang zhe na/ngo bo nyid kyi g.yeng ba ni/ mig shes sogs tshogs lnga ste/ de dag rang bzhin gyis kha phyir bltas pas ting nge 'dzin las ldang ba yin pa dang / phyi rol du g.yeng ba yid shes yul la 'phro ba'am 'jug pa dang / de bzhin du nang gi g.yeng ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ro myong ba dang / bying rgod dang / mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin de nyid la yid ches pa yi bsam pas mtshan mar bzung zhing zhen pa dang / gnas ngan len gyi g.yeng ba ni/ ngar 'dzin dang bcas pa'i sgo nas yid la byed pa ste/ nga rgyal gyis gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par yid la byed pa'am ngar 'dzin dang bcas pa zhes bya'o/ /yid la byed pa'i g.yengs ba ni/ theg pa chung ngu'i sems dang ma bral ba theg dman yid la byed pa dang ni de ltar g.yeng ba drug ste/de drug po rnam bcad la khegs pa'i yongs gcod mi g.yengs ba'i zhi gnas ni theg pa chen po'i zhi gnas khyad par can te/ nang du rtse gcig par gnas pa'i zhi gnas skyon med pa yin no// ༈ rig pa'i rang ngo shes nas shes rig gi rang tshugs ma shor na/ gnas 'gyu gang byung thams cad sgom yin/ mnyam bzhag yin/ rig pa'i rang ngo ma shes na sems yun ring por mi 'phro bar gnas pa 501
